objects.title: Answer the call
objects.text:
I knew you would be one of those that want so desperately to help, to rise to the task and face the challenge of those terrifying worlds and bring to others hope.

The hope that Harmony will always come through and grow all over the omniverse!

scores.beforeText: for evil peoples to win it only take good peoples to do nothing.

objects.title: Reject the call
objects.text:
I understand, i hoped you would be one of those who have this... This GOOD in their heart, that spark that want nothing more than to spill out and bath the world in shining light, to cast away the despair that blight those less fortunate, to push and erase the hurt and pain of the world and help everyone grow in harmony. 

Maybe you will, one day, crave to shine your inner light as well and that day, i will be here waiting with a smile for you to take your next step as a new YOU.

rows.title: the calling of Faust!
rows.titleText:
Welcome dear, I am Faust the creator of the pony-verses, you can see me as the one above all of marvel but with a cute and noble-bright twist!  

That last point is why i guided your step here, see i noticed recently that a lot of worlds have taken a more gritty-edgy-nasty turn outside my corner of the Omniverse. Out there chaos gods, entities, mad spirit, cruel cultivators, demons and even heroes falling to evil are running rampant and unchecked.

Of course i also saw many "gods" and others such beings fighting back but they always rely purely on an outrageous amount of violence or such  other destructive ways, so i decided i would do things a different way, a more creative way, a better way, the way of Harmony. 

Here is how its gonna go, you my dear will remake yourself as one of my little pony or some other races i made, don't worry we have a LOT of options to bring out your inner self. 

Then you will get a few blessings from little old me, once its done, we will shoot you into a grimdark world of you choice from the list i will give you, for obvious reason a lot here is about making you strong enough to defend yourself when needed or even remove pure evil beings from whatever places of power they hold if needed. 

BUT here is the kicker my dear! when i shoot you into this world it will shatter the boundary of this world and it will allow me to sneak some very big modifiers into the fabric of this world, in a way this is the really important bit of this whole project, but for that i need you willing and cooperative so here is the deal:

You get to choose the modifiers from a second list i made, eh? yes i like listing thing, see my cutie mark? anyway you pick the modifiers and then it is up to you to make the world a better place for all and un-grimdark the Tartarus out of it! 

Once you are done you can either:

-go back to your previous life where you left it, with or without what you received here and as your new superior form or you old human one.

-Stay in this new brighter world and enjoy the result of your effort surrounded by the pon-peoples you got to know and befriend -maybe more- and all around resting after a life well spent.

Or if you feel particularly benevolent:

- go to another world and do it all over again. 

In the last case we will go through this whole thing again, you can remake yourself -thrust me if you live more than a few centuries you can sometime feel the need to shake things up a bit- as well as pick modifiers but instead of picking more blessing you get to pick peoples to bring along for the ride one person per 20 blessings points and they can remake themselves for free as well! 

So now that you know what this whole thing is about, saving the hopeless rescuing the defenseless, to guide the lost and forsaken to stand against oblivion and horror not with grim determination but a resolute spirit and a smile, more than certain that there is GOOD in all worlds worth saving! 

Will you answer this call?

The call to be A TRUE HERO OF HARMONY!?

rows.title: INDEX

objects.title: Female
objects.text: Alright then, do know that period are not a thing, i mean really what cruel god would impose that on half its population? Instead you have heat one weekend per month where sex (at two or alone) is both a lot more pleasurable -because you just got a fresh batch of eggs- and can very easily end in pregnancy so keep that in mind. (Also yes its always the weekend.)

objects.title: Male
objects.text:
Alright then do know that a hit down there still hurt like hell, but i did fix the whole nausea and vertigo thing from it.
I just moved some nerve around for that but with how fragile those parts tend to be it was always going to be sensitive, also the nerve restructuration make it harder to reach release so expect to have to go at it longer -especially alone.

objects.title: "manliness"
objects.text:
Thicker bone with sharper edges and deeper voice, solitary pony with independent personality often chose this.

Make no mistake though, they generally care greatly for others but stumble in how to express it and can easily come of as condescending.

 Still they often are the pillars of their communities.

objects.title: "androgyny"
objects.text:
Honestly most pony pick this at first and it act as a good middle ground, they are often very versatile, capable of shining if never dominate in every activities in society.

Honestly its hard to argue for or against this choice it is just a bit indecisive and those who pick it generally outgrow it and fall into either side by their mid life crisis.

 Still if manly and feminine are the pillar and heart of their communities androgynous are the floor, wall and roof.

objects.title: "femininity"
objects.text:
Thinner bone, soft edges and higher voices, pony with gentle caring soul often go this way to try and put at ease others with a more "comely" look.

Make no mistake though,  despite their "docile" appearance they are not a weak gender and can also be quite sly. 

Still they are often the heart of their communities.

objects.title: tiny
objects.text:
From your chosen race average to tiny you get to pick what size you will be once fully grown. 

Keep that in mind that tiny for a dragon (the biggest race on average) and a breezy (the smallest race on average) have very different result.

objects.title: small
objects.text: From your chosen race average to small you get to pick what size you will be once fully grown.

objects.title: average
objects.text: Perfect middle of the size chart, not gonna shock or turn head but peoples will generally notice you presence, unless you're a breezy.

objects.title: tall
objects.text: From your chosen race average to tall you get to pick what size you will be once fully grown.

objects.title: gigantic
objects.text:
From your chosen race average to gigantic you get to pick what size you will be once fully grown. 

Keep that in mind that gigantic for a dragon (the biggest race on average) and a breezy (the smallest race on average) have very different result.

objects.title: forbidden twist.
objects.text:
Body and mind eroded by madness and self hatred. 

Yeah no that wont do, just so we are clear if you pick this you will be in tremendous amount of mental suffering and I'm not allowing that so yep this is no.

Body dysphoria: twisted horror.

objects.title: uncanny reflection.
objects.text:
Okay so some severe body dysphoria right here.

Still bearable but clearly something is wrong with your perception of yourself and it reflect on how you look, which drop you straight into the uncanny valley....

Okay just so we are clear i am sending you there to help other worlds inhabitants but i DO care about you as well dear so here is a few more "humph" to my blessings and you make sure to pick a few blessings to fix that up later ok dear?

Body dysphoria: uncanny reflection.

objects.title: just as you are.
objects.text:
Confortable in your skin both psychically and mentally, still some work to be done but that is hardly a fault from you.

Most are here until they find some loved ones that make them loves themselves and a meaning to their existence they can be happy with.

Body dysphoria: rapid adaptation.

objects.title: in dominie spiritus.
objects.text:
Wow that is some impressive introspection work, such a stable and self aware mind.

You know yourself and what you are here to do, definitely going to make you an absolute force to reckon with when the time come for you to bring your light onto the world!

Body dysphoria: this is me.

objects.title: thy name is perfection.
objects.text:
Body and mind united to perfection, truly the apex of sentient life. 

Your body and mind are at peace with one another in a form that you love and always turn out to fit your preference in spite of all circumstances.

Body dysphoria: nevermore.

objects.title: frail
objects.text:
Eat! just eat dear! for my sake if nothing else! you need some meat between this skin and bones! 

This build does give you a hyper effective metabolism and reduce the risk of ever getting overweight but this mean you are at risk of becoming underweight.

on arrival:

strength is low
dexterity is average
endurance is low

can reach balanced and athletic with training.

objects.title: plump
objects.text:
Okay maybe lay of the cake darling or you might have yours overflow from whatever cloth you can get, i mean a bit of plumpness can be desirable but there is a high risk of it reaching grotesque level if you don't keep yourself in check. 

This build give you an hyper efficient metabolism that process every bit of food you ingest with no waste at all this allow you to sustain yourself completely with little food but this mean you are at risk of becoming overweight. 

on arrival:

strength is average
dexterity is low
endurance is low

can reach balanced or athletic with training.

objects.title: balanced
objects.text:
Jack of all trade master of none. 

Can jump, run and crouch, block and dodge, hit and carry stuff of decent weight. 

You will be out of breath after a while of doing hard work and will know cramp pain when pushing further, you still will get most job done.

This build is a pretty good pick, it can do everything well but won't shine without hard work and contrary to athletic and bombshell can also fall into disrepair without maintenance. 

on arrival: 

strength is average
dexterity is average
endurance is average

can become any of the others. with hard work and training it can become athletic.

With great challenges and constant, relentless dedication it might reach bombshell.

objects.title: athletic
objects.text:
Now that is an athletic body my dear! this bad boy will take you through almost any terrain with ease and will look good while doing it,  its a costly investment but when it come to quality of life? we do our best!

This build make you physically gifted among your chosen species, the best of everyone else is your minimum and hard work will see you a force to be reckoned with.

on arrival:

strength is high
dexterity is high
endurance is high 

can easily maintain its present state but with hard work, training and dedication it can maybe one day reach bombshell.

objects.title: bombshell
objects.text:
Your world use to have comic about "peak human" right? Where peoples could master every martial art and looked as if they were carved from stone, with eight pack and capable of working the day and spending the night fighting crime with like no rest for a week straight, eating and drinking nothing for days yet staying a beautiful mass of muscle that still got killing curves. In short completely impossible in real life.

Well this is what bombshell is. You are the apex of whatever species you are and not being at physical peak would be a challenge for you. 

That will leave you free to seek betterment of you new self through other mean than common training. 

on arrival:

strength is outstanding
dexterity is outstanding
endurance is outstanding


you have the best build possible, now only the supernatural can push you further.

objects.title: "Realistic...."
objects.text:
Realistic for you maybe but for me pretty uncanny. Like how do your brain fit in such small head? and how can you breath enough with such small mouth? and those slender legs can't be stable i swear! also why are muscle showing so much through their coats it can't be healthy!

No really an inferior art style i assure you, also expensive since it would be my first time using this art style.

objects.title: "realistic?"
objects.text:
This art style is like "realistic 1:1" but a bit more "serious", coat are darker magic less sparkly and voice less cutesy. 

Should keep whatever world you go to from getting to big of a whiplash i think? maybe?

objects.title: realistic 1:1
objects.text:
Ok this is what my pony actually look like, proportion are one to one with their inside and also less range of shapes between specimen. 

Might look cartoonish to you but that is because you human are all a bit uncanny yourself, what with the small eyes and flat faces *shudder*. 

Free to use since i have a lot of experience with this one.

objects.title: almost realistic
objects.text: Almost there now its still a bit more "cartoony" than what they should look like but everything is well proportioned already, still a lot of ranges shape-wize between specimen of the same species.

objects.title: adorable? cute? really cute!
objects.text:
I expect this one to be very jarring to whatever world you will be going to, its probably what my  pony look like to you and its fair to say it isn't really the case.

This art style make proportion go out of whack.

Costly since the worlds you are headed to will usually resist this a lot.

rows.title: the basics
rows.titleText:
Now that i know know you are in on the plan dear lets get to work!

First the basics:

1: "biological gender" (what you got between your legs and nothing else, in my worlds this has no impact on how you are treated or expected to treat other at all.)

2: "gender identity" (how you identify and baseline look, now this has an impact in my worlds, its something every-creature often don't even have to choose at the start of adulthood since they naturally grow into how they feel is right during their teenage years, granted mare and stallion role in society are basically identical in my world contrary to yours but still.)

3: "size" (how big you are, each species has a "tiny" to "gigantic" scale and this decide where you stand on that scale.)

4: "beauty" (this is a subjective thing, its meant to make you outwardly beautiful or ugly based on your own criteria but also how confortable you are with your look.)

5: "build" (muscular and bulky, graceful and lithe, skin thin with wired cords of pure muscles or chubby with plenty of curve, its all here and you get to pick. be aware that its not gonna stay that way if you don't do the effort to keep it so at least a minimum.)

6: "art-style" (first true reality warping bit here, it change the basic aspect of the world but not much else.)

Now go on, get to it dear the best is still to come!

rows.title: Faust menagerie (Races folders section)
rows.titleText:
now that you are done with "the basics" its time to move on to you new race. 

I know i said earlier that i would make you one of my pony but it was more a figure of speech, i also have plenty of non-pony races for you to pick from!

i mean human are okay but what i have in store for you is just wild, i mean isn't it a human that once said: "Always be yourself. Unless you can be a dragon. Then always be a dragon." 

well i got more than dragon right here, each with perks and traits -and a drawbacks inherent to the races- and you get to pick!

Each species have unique upgrades or "traits" you can take as well for a few more points, those are either "rare trait" seen amongst less than 10% of the race population and "unique"(not literally they are just so rare that the list of creature having them is only around one digit.) still all traits where found on exceptional individual of that chosen species or very rare mutations.

you can pick up to two races and become an hybride, in this case you get all perks and all drawbacks.

remember there are some hidden species only accessible by taking specific races.
__________________________

do not use this and the "ALL the races" tab together.

only close the race folders tabs after picking traits.

rows.title: The bird folks.
rows.titleText:
The bird folk are bipedal flightless bird taller than most quadruped. Gifted with keen eyesight and no fuck to give bird folk culture is one of freedom and piracy, whether its on the sea or in the sky using daring airship design bird folk roam unbound. The bird folk have proven that despite the lack of wings they knew how to fly, they are also master of the dueling blade and crack shot with handguns. Their reaction time and speed only seen in the most skilled of f-1 racers of your world, never challenge a bird folk in a reflex game you are bound to lose.
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=2.4m
small=3m
average=3.6m
tall=4.2m
gigantic=4.8m

The perks are:

-Feather guard:
 Bird folk feathers are insulated to extreme colds as well as humidity, but also have a surprisingly strong spine capable of stopping blades and bullet when layered, which is why bird folks tail are often used as a weapon and shield. Those tail are generally at least as long as the bird folk is tall and make for a constant threat to enemy and protection for its owner.

-Golden goose: 
Bird folk lay unfertilized eggs daily that are packed with nutrients, they are a proven cure for most common disease as they boost the immune system and restore energy greatly. this lead to bird folk collecting those eggs either to be sold or to use when falling sick. this egg laying require no effort on the bird folks parts and allow a bird folk to sustain itself on just them and water if needed.

the drawback is:

-Heart's longing:
 Bird folk are a most tragic race if you think about it, evolution came with the loss of their ability to fly unaided but not their longing for the sky. Bird folk that stay too long away from the heaven will grow depressed and distracted as their thought turn more and more to the sky, only the rush of the high wind and the proximity of the clouds will ease their aching heart.

rows.title: The breezies.
rows.titleText:
That breezies exist at all is a miracle only possible in my world to be honest, they are a flight reliant species that is too small and light to fight the winds yet to big to not catch them. this mean that breezies tend to be thrown of course by any stray wind and can't even remain grounded when it become windy unless indoor or tied up to something.

On the other hand breezies are technically immortal in that all breezies come from and live into a pocket space uniquely accessible to breezies and that any breezies that die out of it just pop back into it safe and sound, only old age can end them but one of their perk make even that unlikely. 

This dimension is constituted of only one gigantic tree (even to non breezies) and while it offer plenty of water and food and endless material to make home and furniture it still require pollen from the outside world to bear a wide variety of magical fruits, those fruits are sacred to the breezies as it allow a breezie to change into a wide variety of insect and arachnid variant of the breezie, some fruit turn a breezie into a moth pony other into a bee pony and so on. 

All those breezies variant gain unique abilities with their new form and are generally bigger by a whole meter -which meant the average ascended breezie are about 1.15 meter tall- this newfound size allow ascended breezie to safely leave their home dimension and to gather more pollen for the next generation of breezies those ascended breezies are often more daring and confrontational with their new size and often bite more than they can chew at often lethal consequences, sadly when an ascended breezie die it come back to is home dimension as a regular breezie which keep them searching for more pollen.

height at maturity:

tiny=7cm
small=10cm
average=15cm
tall=20cm
gigantic=25cm

+1meter when ascended

the perks are:

-Pride of the smoll:
 Breezies are brave beyond belief considering their sizes, maybe because they know death has no hold on them or because they are born at the very bottom of the food chain and have nothing to lose.

A breezie will charge into battle and face pain and challenges with no shiver or tear because yes breezies don't feel pain, what would be the point since they can't die. Some breezies simply let themselves dies of thirst or hunger when trapped or kill themselves when they get lost after being carried by stray wind to return back home.
Breezies are hardcore dear and this perk grant you the same "bonus", you don't feel pain or fear death. the closest thing to feeling fear for you would be the feeling that come when you might lose the pollen you struggled to collect.

-Role-Playing-Life:
 You can with a single bite of the sacred breezie fruit turn into a whole different you, with new form new abilities and the best part? you can do it more than once in a lifetime! or at least once per lifetime.

Tired of being a spider breezie? want to retake to the sky? kick the bucket, bite a different fruit and bam you're a moth breezie! best part? most others species fail to recognize a specific breezie in a different form and you can have some good fun with that, in fact a lot of the things breezies in general do is "troll" others, perfectly aware they can just switch form later and start a whole new relationship with this stranger at a later date.

If you burned all your form somehow guess what? changing form take you back to prime age so as long as you bring that pollen in and switch form often enough you can just "wait out" a generation or two and start again. truly breezies are hardcore fairy-tale accurate fairy of my worlds.

the drawback is:

-Air head sociopath: 
Breezies cannot die and can easily escape capture and retribution this lack of consequence tend to make them a bit "weird" in the cranium department. 

Breezies also have a hard time empathizing with other species (because they don't have any understanding of fear or doubt or pain.) and tend to be easily distracted (unless pollen is concerned.)

A breezie not pulling its own scheme or collecting pollen is gullible and influenceable but amongst the breezies some are old enough that they have learned of this weakness and a scorned breezie is a lifetime enemy for you at least and maybe even your descendants (depending on how much fun your family is to mess with.), at least you can appease them by helping them on a pollen run.

rows.title: The buffalos.
rows.titleText:
Buffalos are very similar to earth pony in that they are physically strong but with the difference that buffalos look the part. With larger body on average and much thicker neck you'd expect buffalos to be like your world bull and you'd be wrong.

Buffalos are actually long distance runner yet do not have the endless stamina of earth pony and instead are sure footed and skilled traveler that can travel by hooves entire continent three time over in a decade. buffalos are granted powerful gift by the wild wandering magic of the world, at least as long as they remain unbound from a too static lifestyle for long periods of time and cover long distance regularly. 

height at maturity:

tiny=1.8m
small=2.5m
average=2.7m
tall=3m
gigantic=4m

the perks are:

-Sure hooved: 
Buffalos are unaffected by the state of the surface beneath their cloven hooves, be it muddy or dry, sand or swamp ,red hot steel or atop deep water as long as only their hooves are on contact with it they are unaffected by and can walk or run atop it without it affecting their balance or speed in any way but positive.

-The road's providence: 
Buffalos on a roam are lucky beyond belief and will always find both food and shelter when needed while roaming, this extend and grow stronger with basically everything they do while moving long distance uninterrupted for more than a full day be it by hooves or not.

An ever traveling buffalos working only a few hours a day will be met with tremendous success compared to a settled one working every waking hours and this is because for the first buffalos every action taken or not that can be smoothed out by luck will be, from a simple bout of motivation leading to calling a possible client at the perfect time for a favorable response or a sudden urge of selling company share just before a dip almost everything will ligne up perfectly to a buffalos on the move.

the drawback is:

-Call of the roam:
Buffalos are spiritually driven to travel or "roam" by hooves over distances of at least three to four hundred kilometer every years and in group of a few hundreds families or prospecting bachelor and bachelorette, this call need to be answered by all buffalos to remain mentally healthy and promote social connectivity. without this a bison grow more frustrated and depressed the longer they go without roaming.

rows.title: The centaurs.
rows.titleText:
Centaur are a rare physical powerhouse, dexterous thanks to having actual fingers, fast and stable by being quadruped, tough because they come from a harsh land where sand is sharp like blades and beat daily on all who live there. 

Their main weakness is that they are magically poor and cannot use magic at all unless they can somehow consume some and even then it leave them with a finite amount, every time they use magic they spend it and must find more to consume. It is possible for them to steal the ethereal magical core of other beings to gain their own magical source for themselves and with it the -greatly reduced- magic output of the robbed individual. 

Centaur cannot cast actual spells instead the magic they consume just make them into a more powerful centaur, fed enough magic a centaur will regain and maintain their peak age as well as grow physically for as long as they have magic to sustain it, by spending some they can blast large amount of unshaped magic out of their body as both beam and crud shields but the main aspect is that by stealing magical cores those power can grow to ridiculous degree, contrary to most species centaur don't have a maximum amount of magic they can spend at a time and instead can invest their stolen magic as they please and so the more cores they have the more they can afford to spend in their bodily enhancement growing more and more and more to colossal sizes.

This power is still stolen though and should the worst come to pass and a being you have stolen the core of dies for any reason, you will not only lose that core's magic output but will also suffer terrible pain until you spit it out. 

Centaur cannot choose what core they spit out or even how many precisely, cores also instantly go back to their owner ounce spit out so you won't be able to swallow them back without finding the owner again, the pain of holding the core of a diseased being can stack endlessly until it become so unbearable you will literally up and die.

Greed and callousness will not favor your odds should you fall to the temptation of easy power.

height at maturity:

tiny=2.5m
small=3m
average=4m
tall=5m
gigantic=8 meter (infinite if you can sustain it with magic and have infinite livable space, infinite food and infinite water.)

the perks are:

-Strong lifeforce: 
Centaur rarely die from wounds, often time a centaur need to be actively killed to die or die of old age. 

Yet if not using it for physical boosts or spell work a centaur can live for millennia with little food and water and about a couples spell worth of magic in the tank, they are immune to most disease and can heal from debilitating wounds in a matter of days outside of straight up amputation. 

This also grant them a gift for the good old way of strengthening themselves that is working out as they rapidly recuperate from strenuous activity and show greater reward for it.

-Gluttonous technic: 
Centaurs are the bane of magic users the world over as a centaur can eat any form of magic be it from another creature, an enchanted item, a magical ward or even a spell thrown at them so long as they can see it coming they can just suck it in which will pull it in their mouth no matter the aiming or applied surface.

This make channeled spells very dangerous and rarer enchanted items not only a waste to bring against them but a danger as they will grow stronger from it. Worst yet spell that affect their inside also suffer this fate from curses cast on them or potion they ingest even healing magic feed their powers. 

Centaur can even drain an area of magic but this is very time consuming and never provide more than a small amount of magic.

the drawback is:

- The taller they are: 
As we saw centaurs are true powerhouse but this come at the cost of a rather short lifespan, in fact when dry of magic a centaur lifespan is a measly 40 years total. Their natural age also catch up to them quickly when they run out of magic and cannot sustain their peak age.

This also mean that a centaur past a hundred will die in days when they run out of magic and this can happen more easily than you think, because if for any reason a centaur start to vomit cores, magic will go out as well. 

On another note did you know centaur get violently nauseous when seeing fast flashing rainbow colors, weird right? must be their mostly brown and grey homeland, never got used to so many flashing colors...

rows.title: The changelings.
rows.titleText:
Changeling are a sore subject for me. You see they are an accidental specie and were born through a series of very unlikely events involving an acorn, a carnivorous tree, a unicorn's magic and a pond of liquid wild dark magic. 
This mess spat out The first changeling queen and a few mindless drones that would later become the first changeling hive and ravage about half a dozen city state and require the full power of an alicorn to defeat. 

Changeling are shapeshifters that feed on love, not all of them are equals and they are separated into casts.
They all have two main form though, the dark very evil looking one which is what a predation changeling look like and the colorful friendly one which is a what a symbiotic changeling look like. 

Predation changeling can produce mindless drones that they control like additional bodies, drones are expendable soldiers and workers best used on either simple repetitive task or managed by a sentient changeling, about a dozen drone can be controlled at a time by a royal changeling, eight for nobles and four by common changeling. predation changeling can also steal memory and mind control others as well as reap out the very life force of their prey along with their love. 

On the other hoof symbiotic changeling are powerful empath and Pathokinesis capable of reading, changing, sharing and projecting the entire emotional spectrum of those around them.
Their need for love is greatly reduced and they are physically stronger but in exchange cannot generate or control drones anymore.

changeling can be connected into hives mind built around a noble or royal changeling, any who wish to join merely need to ask to join a royal changeling courts or team up with a royal to be added to the hive and benefit from it.
the advantages are the abilities to: share senses, thought, memories and also control drone over long distance.

height at maturity:

tiny=1.4m
small=1.8m
average=2.3m
tall=2.8m
gigantic=4.5m (only seen in the royal and viceroy cast.)

the perks are:

-Perfect biologie: 
Changelings cells don't degrade, that is for all casts even the drones, a changeling only die from disease, untreated wounds or hunger. Otherwise changeling are eternal and can even regrow limbs and organ given proper care, food and time.

-Hivemind safety-net:
If a changeling die while still connected to the hivemind network its mind can remain into stasis in the network until a drone is made for them to take over, then the changeling can slowly regain their previous cast by feeding on extra love and recuperate. 

Do be careful though the changeling hivemind network is not world wide and only spread a few hundred meter from each sentient changelings in the network though it can be combined and stretched outward if the changeling forming it group closer to each others.

the drawback is:

-Dependence: 
The changeling cannot feed on each other and regular food while tasty and useful in making the main construction material of the changeling -a greenish resin they spit out- does not sustain them, as such they always need another race to thrive for them feed on.

This also mean that being too numerous is a dangerous thing for the changeling and can lead to famine. They instead have to regulate their population at all time as they do not age. 

In fact splinter faction of changeling are a common occurrence from changeling wanting their own children and can create a real headache for the whole changeling race, changeling by their very need and way of life are easy to point out as a common enemy by other parties as well and any conflict is a loss for the changeling, either because they are actually facing defeat or because they are effectively destroying their main source of food.

rows.title: The deer.
rows.titleText:
Oh dear, the deer are a spiritual kind indeed, they are strongly connected to wild plant magic. They shine when living in forests and other place filled with plant life,.
They are fast and agile as well if a bit fragile, they can also use magic through their antlers like unicorn by engraving runes on them its not a definitive action as deer antlers fall and regrow every four month. Female can grow larger antlers too if they want but generally prefer the coat tattoo that allow more complex spells and changeable after the large shedding at the end of winter. 
Most deer often pick spells that can help in the deer main practice: shamanism, the art of using natural reagents to create magical effect and borrow the help of greater powers.

height at maturity(without the horns):

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-Root network: 
Settlement of deer can work to build something called a Worldroot gate. Those gate are all connected to each other through a magical Worldroots network and allow instantaneous movement between other deer settlement with a gate. 

Gates are powered by the presence of a forest around them and maintained by the deer and will only allow organic living being as well as simple natural object through, such as a wood cart, leather cloths and even steel tools but anything like a truck, plastics of any kind and even powered tools will not.

-Green cloven hooves: 
Deer are masters at growing plants of all kind, even rare magical plants will bloom all over the fields they tend to and with no averse effect on the land as well.
They also possess a gift in protecting their crop from insect and diseases and polluting elements.

the drawback is:

-Wild bound:
Deer are only ever confortable in highly forested lands and to them living in a wide open area would induce strong discomfort while a "concrete jungle" would cause recurring and violent panic attack.

rows.title: The diamond dogs.
rows.titleText:
Diamond dog are one of the few bipedal races on this list, they are generally top heavy, live underground and have a love of gems hence the diamond of their name. 

Diamond dog are spread into three category called alpha? beta and gamma those category does not impact how they are treated but what role in the pack they may have to carry out and is given when they reach maturity.

the beta have strong physic but are mentally average, the gamma are smart but physically average and the alpha are the best of both but very few in numbers. 

Female tend to be bigger and more of them can be found in the beta cast while men fall into the gamma cast by being more resourceful too compensate for their short stature, the alpha cast possess a decent mix of both.

The diamond dog defining feature are that they are good at digging, can smell and ear better than all other species and are one of the slowest on foot due too their shorter legs, they doe have massive upper body strength and dexterous hand which help maintain the two central export products of the diamond dog: forged item and gemstones.

height at maturity:

tiny=2m
small=2.5m
average=3m
tall=4.5m
gigantic=5m

the perks are:

-Solid swimmer: 
Diamond dog digging prowess are no secret and universal to all of them, this show as them being able to move through dirt like a human would through water.

Their hearing allow them to track people walking above and inside their tunnel and surprise them if necessary, they can also move through stone and even steel but the harder the material the more physicals strength is needed to move in it making the female dominant beta cast outstanding in this. 

This ability render most non-enchanted armor, shield and fortification pointless.

-Matchless smith: 
Diamond dog have sensitive ears and any attempt to forge with hammering would cause tremendous pain to any would be smith diamond dog. 

Thankfully while moving their entire bodies through steel and other hard materials require large amount of bodily strength, shaping a piece of said material is much more doable, here the male dominant gamma cast shine by crafting with paw, claws and bite -no hammers or heat needed- a wide variety of wonderous item of great value.

From tools to armor to furniture or jewelry as long as it is made from something that can be dug out out of the ground the diamond dog are the best at it. All their creation also tend to be tougher than others.

the drawback is:

-Dog whistle of doom:
Diamond dog earing is very keen and capable of earing for miles and at pitch that not many species can pick up.

This powerful earing while useful most of the time can also turn into a terrible weakness. indeed diamond dogs earing is easy to exploit and can be used to cause large amount of pain, vertigo, nausea, and head splitting headache to any diamond dogs with a simple whistle.

rows.title: The donkeys.
rows.titleText:
The donkeys, what to say about the donkey well.....they are a bit like earth pony but less unstoppable physical force of nature and more inexhaustible "spreader of life". 

Donkey are "compatible" with all species and quite daring and generally successful with all gender types. Donkeys are also consummate lovers, loyal and faithful as well as responsible, no donkey ever rejected an offspring of his let alone mistreat one and will only ever move to another lover when certain the past one is either dead or done with them.

If unsure the donkey will seek them until death often getting more and more cranky while doing so. Those upstanding moral qualities alone more than make up for them having no greater powers and their sometime asshole-ish temperament when they get heartbroken by less respectful partners.

height at maturity:

tiny=1m
small=1.4m
average=1.6m
tall=1.8m
gigantic=2.5m

the perks are:

-Breeder of millions: 
Donkey never fail to spread or bear life no matter the age or race. 
The offspring will always be hale and healthy, in addition those offspring will be blessed with the best genes of their parents.

Also the gender of the child will always be the one the child will want, the numbers the parents wanted ,the birth will be painless and the recovery perfect and with no long lasting effects on the mother's body and health.

-Pleased to please: 
Donkey will never leave a partner unsatisfied and will instinctively know what and how their partner want it done, this also stretch to more wholesome matter of relationship with donkeys knowing when their mate need supports or alone time.

They will never misinterpret you or misspeak their feeling. A relationship with a donkey only ever end when the problem is outside both party's control or if one of them is both not a donkey and an horrendous lover in all aspect.

the drawback is:

-Bland existence:
Donkey have no greater purpose granted to their lives beside raising a following generation and being decent folks, and are actually the closest species to the average human just infinitely nicer.

rows.title: The dragons.
rows.titleText:
Dragon are the strongest species here in pretty much all aspect.
They can fly, have hands to wield tools, can use magic while immune to most of it, they can breath fire and have scale that render most threat harmless, and they can reach massive size naturally.

There is a few evolutionary pitfall that can ruin them though like the "greed growth" which is when a dragon become obsessed with wealth and lose their higher though capacity until snapped out of it which also come with tremendous size growth with next to no development (as in a young dragon will become a giant young dragon not a giant adult one). 

Their utter obedience to the dragon lord which can (if unchallenged) add and remove rules in the dragon code.

they are also not immortal just long lived, at about 5000 years old from birth to death most die much earlier in battles with other dragon or simply let themselves fade earlier out of boredom or loneliness.

Dragon are both capable of magic and immune to it; this dichotomy is possible because dragon are more magic than flesh and this make them impermeable to magic. 

Regular contact with a specific type magic can attune them to it making them more compatible with the use of said magic while also striping them of defense against similar magic its why dragon often refuse to learn and perform magic and instead relying on their natural weapons like their claws and fire breath.

height at maturity:

tiny=1.8m
small=10m
average=18m
tall=26m
gigantic=60m

the perks are:

-Apex predator: 
Dragon are the apex predator, once a dragon want something to deny it satisfaction is a doomed endeavor and they always find their quarry. 

This extend to both living and non living things a dragon is a master treasure hunter and wealth collector as well as hunter from birth to death. 

Its also easier for dragon to kill without being traumatized or feeling remorse as they are very much aware of their place in the food chain and are the true omnivore on this list, a dragon can sustain themselves with pretty much anything they eat even gemstone, only the quantity needed and taste will vary.

-Magical being: 
Dragon are more magic than flesh and every part of the dragon anatomy can be used to make powerful magical item and reagent, this mean that dragon always carry on themselves an armory and apothecary should they bother learning the crafts. 

The fire of dragon is no different and can apply magical effect on item or even become magical itself if properly attuned to a magic type. the breath from the start can: burn like napalm, generate large amount of smoke, be condensed into a blowtorch and even not actually burn beyond a chosen degree.

Dragon also get better in a magical field the more they use and interact with this field of magic but they also become more vulnerable to this field of magic in turn.

the drawback is:

-Dragon pride: 
Dragon are bound to the dragon code and they have to follow that code or terrible curses befall them? the worst one being the loss of sentience and them turning into a feral mindless beast to be put down.

The dragon code can be modified by the dragon lord during a dragon gathering with at least 70% of the entire dragon population. The dragon lord is whichever dragon is holding the bloodstone scepter, the scepter will first appear in a volcano and all dragon will be made aware of its general direction.

When acquired it will send out a call for the first dragon gathering where the new holder will have to answer any challenge made to them.

The dragon code:
Rule 1: a dragon will not know rest until it repay all debt of life through servitude or saving his savior's life.
Rule 2: a dragon will not break a promise once spoken.
Rule 3: a dragon will honor his/her dragon lord commands or will openly challenge him/her for the title in a duel to the death or until the dragon lord relinquish is title.
Rule 4: a dragon will honor his/her egg layers commands until he/she best them in either wit or might or become dragon lord themselves.
Rule 5: a dragon will answer the call of the dragon lord in the shortest delay that can be afforded by circumstances.
Rule 6: a dragon will if dragon lord, relinquish is title after it hold it for more than a 1000 years straight, he/she will choose and ensure the proceeding of "the gauntlet of fire".
Rule 7: a dragon will have to participate to every gauntlet of fire unless dispensed by the dragon lord at the time.
Rule 8: a dragon will if dragon lord, protect and manage the egg nests of the dragon land with its life.

rows.title: The earth ponies.
rows.titleText:
The earth pony are a straightforward sort, they are physically strong and enduring simple as that. In this simplicity lies their genius, earth pony don't fly under their own power or bend magic with the flick of a horn but they can endure and break the world with hooves alone, when the chip are down earth pony never falter they may panic and make mistake but never falter.

height at maturity:

tiny=1.6m
small=1.8m
average=2.3m
tall=2.8m
gigantic=4m

the perks are:

-Weight of the mountain: 
When earth ponies make a stand no one can subdue them, they become invulnerable, immovable objects as long as they remain all four hooves on the ground.

This can be interpreted as a 100% decrease in incoming damage and a 100% reduction to all form of unwilling momentum gain. ( the entropy magical field can bypass this.)

Nothing can move an earth pony making a stand but victory, hunger and thirst. you can still damage the ground around their hoof to break the effect or somehow suffocate them.

-Tireless unrelenting charge: 
An earth pony charge is like an unstoppable force, the longer a earth pony run without interruption the faster they move up to a 100x multiplier and the faster they move the stronger they become with up to a 100x multiplier. 

Still they can be redirected or made to stumble.

the drawback is:

-The lethargy of peace: 
Earth pony lack the drive for conflict -even necessary ones- and will almost always pick a less confrontational path if offered ones, the longer this "calm" last the less likely they become to ever rouse themselves from it.

rows.title: The abyssinian.
rows.titleText:
The Abyssinian, a good choice considering you peoples obsession with cat. This race is identical to cat in all aspect -except smarter and capable of speech- until their teen then they become bipedal almost twice as tall as the average pony and terrifying to deal with.

I mean that literally, Abyssinian are crazy good merchant and business cat. Cunning and sly as well as sneaky and stealthy they shine in both the legal and the illegal side of information and "retrieval" of already owned items be it with good old robbery or a lawsuit. 

They are also agile and dexterous, their senses of sight is one of the best but as a whole not particularly tough, they also get tired quickly and often enjoy about 12 hours of sleep a day.

height at maturity:

tiny=2.4m
small=3m
average=3.6m
tall=4.2m
gigantic=4.8m

the perks are:

-An eye for detail: 
Abyssinian  are known to see more deeply into the world than others races. they have proven capable of finding with just a look entryway in seemingly secure places. 

They have also developed this talent in the more social world and can spot any weakness in peoples this give them a strong advantage in negotiations. of course you can also use this talent when reading an opponent you are fighting.

-If i sleek, i fit: 
Abyssinian appear almost liquide when trying to squeeze somewhere, bone twist and flex with no break or dislocation, skin stretch, fur become sleek and slide on surfaces with ease and organs move and bend as needed with no problems. 

If a cat try to fit somewhere it will fit, slowly in the most extreme case but it will they only limitation is that the brain and skull must fit whole themselves.

the drawback is:

-Lazy sadism: 
Abyssinian are, how to say this..."little shit?" seem appropriate, feline folk are little shit that snark and taunt and just love messing with others for fun. 

Its an instinctual need to draw attention of peoples around them and it get even worst for peoples they find interesting, they get more and more insufferable until their target snark back and earn proper respect or the feline lose interest. 

This show as most feline folk being a weird mix of mayadere, kuudere and kamidere.

rows.title: The griffons.
rows.titleText:
Griffon are part lion and part eagle and take the best of both. If dragon are the toughest flight capable race, the Pegasus the best cloud builders and the hippogriff the most graceful in flight then the griffin are the best warriors. 

They fight in packs wielding expert tactics, weapon and predatory instinct to take down even dragon with ease, they are also deft builder and industrious on the ground making large nest to live in that are both cheap et durable if of limited comfort. 

Griffon tend to pursue material wealth a bit too much and do not handle disrespect well, this sadly predispose them to banditry and raiding but do know that if a group of griffin find a strong charismatic leader to turn this pride and interest of wealth to constructive pursuit you will have an honorable, prosperous and loyal force of good.

height at maturity:

tiny=2.2m
small=2.7m
average=3m
tall=3.5m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-Griffin fury: 
A griffon is a dangerous thing to corner, when pushed to the limit a griffon will lose any sense pain, it will also become more determined and violent. this fury will persist until the griffon is allowed to retreat or the threat is dispatched. 

This also come with a constitution boost that almost garanti a griffon will no die from minor wounds and blood loss after the effect ends.

-Diving ace:
During dive a griffon perception of time dilate, allowing them more time to think and react to their surrounding, their targets or even pursuers this does not speed up their whole body, only their mind and eyes but work even on very short dive. 

A dive is any action where the griffon close is wing more than halfway or actively speeding up while aiming to the closest gravity well capable of moving it.

the drawback is:

-The razor's edge: 
The griffon race as a whole tend to vary wildly between lawful and chaotic, good and evil from individual to individual and make them untrustworthy in the eye of many other races and even to other griffons.

This confine griffons to small solitary but tightly knit "flocks" unless an highly charismatic and competent griffon appear to unite them in a "pride" under them, for better or worst.

rows.title: The Hippogriffs.
rows.titleText:
Hippogriff are very averse to violence, preferring retreat and the evasion over conflict even when they are the wronged party, despite that an Hippogriff will happily march to battle for an ally that earned its trust. 

Hippogriff are graceful flyers and that is both in battle and daily life, a hippogriff rather than the efficient flight of a Pegasus, the tactical flight of the griffons or the predatory flight of a dragon will instead dance across the sky with swift and sharp -albeit short- turn, dive and rise while easily dodging any retaliation.

Of course the reason Hippogriff rarely get into conflict is because they also have the mean of turning into a Seapony, this form allow them to do all they would usually do but in the safety of the deep sea rather than the open sky, its a tremendous advantage as no other sentient races on my worlds developed under water aside a very, very small amount of sea serpent.

In the end Hippogriff are generally easy going and pretty chill, they are almost all artists, performers, singers and so much more. For them life true meaning is to live peacefully and make the whole world a little more beautiful, one day at a time.

height at maturity:

tiny=2.2m
small=2.6m
average=2.9m
tall=3.3m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-Beautiful evermore: 
Hippogriff are considered beautiful by all races, this is because the spirit of arts blessed them, this show by them having a supernatural mastery in: makeup, posture, mane styling/dressing, coat/skin care, hoof/claw care along with them always having the best aesthetical bit of both parents and complete psychical symmetrical facial feature. they also look young all the way to the their last few years of life.

-Vocal virtuoso in marvelous motion: 
Of all the arts, hippogriff are above all master of singing and dancing, an hippogriff dancer in motion is a thing a pure beauty to behold. An Hippogriff singer vocalizing will make your skin tingle and hair rise with every high notes as for an Hippogriff doing both at the same time?

They are momentary wonders and all life around will stop what they are doing to witness it. From insect to predators, all will be silent and their eyes glued the Hippogriff. Even after the performance the witness will for a time bask in the recent memory and stay peacefully at rest, the more competent the hippogriff is in singing and dancing the more potent and long lasting the effect.

the drawback is:

-Artistic imperative: 
Hippogriff are not good at making efficient, fit for purpose design in anything. They will always add decorative component to anything they make, from statues on buildings to poetry in science reports or even a few artful dancing moves while scooting an area. 

Hippogriff of all statuts and during every job will perform some art and will strongly encourage any non-Hippogriff coworkers to do the same, in the end having Hippogriffs work somewhere will both make the place more beautiful and enjoyable to work in but also reduce productivity.

rows.title: The kirin.
rows.titleText:
The kirin have a small population and are at first glance very reserved but are -once they open up- a passionate and lively bunch, downright motormouths even. 

Some think they are the mixed offspring of a pony and a dragon, but they are actually descendant of unicorns that got separated from the main wave of settlers when they left the valley of the sun to move to what is now called Equestria.

Those stranded unicorn adapted to living near the Dragonlands by growing scales, becoming bigger and physically stronger on average.

they also developed on of the main feature of the kirin which they call "the inner fire not-so-much inner anymore when my neighbor make a ruckus but what can i say i like my tranquility and-blah blah blah." as i said, motormouth, the lot of them.

This "inner fire" appear when a kirin grow too passionate and turn them into demonic looking fire "nirik" with a burst of flames and ignite  their mane and tail into an inferno all rounded up with glowing eyes.

In this form the kirin can breath fire and become fireproof. They also become a lot more commanding and authoritative downright dominant. but here the kicker, a single bucket of water snuff this transformation out and return them to their calm if a bit bashful kirin selves for losing their cool. 

Kirin are still capable of unicorn magic but have gained the ability o regrow their horn at the cost of them becoming more like wood and growing at all time and requiring trimming which is unpleasant, the ever changing horn shape and length also cause them trouble with spells practice requiring more consistency like enchantement and healing.

height at maturity:

tiny=2.2m
small=2.6m
average=2.9m
tall=3.3m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-Burning love: 
A kirin in love can ignite in a fire that does not burn said loved one, instead shielding them and burning away disease and curses.

It is said this ability developed when the first kirin lost their access to easy healing magic and a terrible plague befall them.

Its not, its just how the dragon-flavored magic coming from the Dragonlands and seeped into them over generation shaped itself to preserve what those kirin valued most: their very few kirin kin.

-Kirin scale: 
Kirin can sniff out a scam a mile away, that as well as betrayal, lies and in fact injustice of all kind, kirin are fervent believer in karma and are more than capable of helping the scale of said karma be righted.

They are naturally skilled judges lawyers and prosecutors, their skill with the spoken words and written laws is unrivaled and while they tend to blabber and speak a lot to tell nothing of value in their free time, when justice call for it a kirin is a masterful orator. 

This come from their often damaging burst of anger, those outburst require kirin to be honest with their feelings and fair in their judgement to maintain a society where any ressentiment can cause property damage in a cascading disaster.

This tend to make them fervent followers of moral and written laws and inclined toward honesty to prevent bad blood from forming.

the drawback is:

-Forced isolationist: 
Kirin are immune to their own fire as well the the flames of other kirin -or any other flames not fueled by entropy-, not so much the other species on this list.

Even dragon can be burned by kirin flames if the kirin is mad enough, this mean that a kirin living in a non kirin settlement is a moving fire hazard and living in a kirin settlement is like walking amongst fire hazard that move all around you and might ignite at any inconvenience. 

This led to kirin often being required to both keep a minimum distance from others species and to make their own house a distance from any Neighbors. 

This also cause issue for relationship with non kirin who might not really thrust the "burning love" of the interested kirin or worst count on it even when the kirin isn't interested.

Sadly while even my most "pushy" creation are less pushy than any human ever was some still get burned for their folly.

rows.title: The pegasus ponies.
rows.titleText:
Pegasus pony are master the of the skies not because they are the best flying species -though a Pegasus pony do earn the title of best flyer every few generation- but because of how they shine in every aspect related to the skies rather than dominate in a single one.

They are some of the best in flight both short and long range, some of the best in weather manipulation fine and large scales, some of the best navigator no matter what lies beneath their wings be it land or sea, and with all those combined the only species to truly live life into the sky, among the cloud that serve as their home.

height at maturity:

tiny=1.4m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-Born amongst the heaven: 
A Pegasus in flight cannot ever lose its way for it is always home, a Pegasus pony will always find what it seek when looking at the world below no matter the distances and always know whoever share its sky in a large radius around itself in spite of any kind of stealth.

-Beloved of the sky:
Pegasus are never hurt by weather phenomenon, they may be tossed around and even loose control but they will always survive the fall with no crippling wounds for the sky love them beyond measure.

Further more they can easily turn those weather toward their own goal for a storm wind will send them ever onward their destination and the rain quench their thirst as it come,  even stray cloud are somehow always there for them to sleep on when tiredness arrive.

the drawback is:

-Like dust in the winds: 
Pegasus were never meant to settle themselves elsewhere than in the clouds and become fragile on the solid ground. 

The longer they stay on contact with the ground the weaker their perks become, this doesn't happen when on things who themselves rest on cloud but anything set anywhere else will also -if more slowly- sap the perks powers (such as tree and roof) and it will take a few minutes of flight for them to regrow to full power.

rows.title: The shadow ponies.
rows.titleText:
Shadow ponies while looking similar to unicorn are actually an opposite to it as one of the races that possess rare members that can use dark magic with almost no mental corruption, in fact they are capable of growing their immunity to it over time till complete resistance to it.

Their specialty is as you probably guessed shadow magic, a versatile if weak magic on its own that when used by shadow ponies grow tremendously in potency, this affinity come from the shadow ponies ancestry being related to Umbrum, shadow spirit that once tried to upheaval the natural order of some of my worlds.

This connection to the Umbrum lead to them having a more curved horn than unicorn and a more predatory appearance including fangs and more of a furry hide than a coat. their weakness is that they are lethally vulnerable to light based attack.

height at maturity:

tiny=2.6m
small=2.7m
average=3m
tall=3.3m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-Shadow born: *
A shadow pony is not fully made of flesh and can repair or even reconstruct their limbs, their horn and other organs by gathering shadow nearby, this can also be used to "bulk up" by absorbing excess shadow to renforce the physical attribute of the shadow pony.

This also allow minor flight by partially dispersing into shadow and can even mimic teleportation by dispersing and reforming somewhere else, this incorporeal state greatly increase the shadow pony weakness to light.

-Encroaching darkness: 
A shadow pony can -in a twisted mirror of a unicorn- generate magic in the surrounding area to absorb and replenish their own store but in this case they generate unnatural shadow they then absorb through their body to empower either their magic or body with.

The main difference being that shadow pony can contrary to unicorn still cast other spells while doing so, in exchange focused light and even strong wind can disperse those shadow and the dispersion of those shadows while they are being absorbed inflict pain and damages to the shadow pony.

the drawback is:

-Shadow constitution: 
Shadow ponies are half flesh half shadow, they are as such weakened greatly in both too bright environment and in an ironic twist complet darkness as they require shadow not complete darkness to truly bring their power to bear. in addition direct focused light can hurt and even kill them.

rows.title: The thestrals.
rows.titleText:
Thestral otherwise called bat pony are nocturnal equivalent to the Pegasus and have some of the attributes of regular bat like echolocation and anesthetic saliva but none of the disadvantage like blindness.

As the smallest and most adorable of the ponies subtype they sleep hanging by their tail have cute tuft of hair on their ears and chest and will make adorable squeak at the sight of a juicy mango!

They also happen to be the biggest meat eaters of the pony, the others being capable of eating meat but preferring an herbivores diet this difference led to them developing fangs and a less fearful instinctual reaction to blood in general.

Seriously though thestral are very good at scouting and stealth as well as spying on others, able to stake out a targets for hours and in complete darkness.

height at maturity:

tiny=1m
small=1.3m
average=1.5m
tall=1.7m
gigantic=2.8m

the perks are:

-Red diet: 
Thestral enjoy meat and this show in their strong body, despite being smaller than all other pony subtype thestral are generally three time stronger than they look, easily capable of splitting tree in half with their back hooves, their wings can also prove to be deadly weapon considering the clawed tips and the strong muscles moving them.

-Night blessed: 
Thestral are in their element in the dark of the night, when it is night thestral are faster stronger and more focused and attentive, delaying any exhaustion and fatigue for once the sun start rising this mean that during the night thestral are technically inexhaustible, but when the day come around a thestral that pushed itself too far will drop like a rock and sleep that much longer and deeper.

the drawback is:

-Cold's embrace: 
Thestral hate the cold, their large naked wing mean the cold seep the heat out of them quickly and this rapidly can cause frostbite as such they tend to shirk cold places and high altitude instead flying low and living in warm climate. 

This also make them weak to weather magic making them lackluster in it and forcing them to live near the ground instead of in the clouds.

rows.title: The unicorns.
rows.titleText:
Unicorn -once adult- can through their horn manipulate magic much more freely than almost all other races but this come at a cost, contrary to all other ponies unicorn have no instinctive feel of their magic and must instead learn to use it by themselves. 

A unicorn feel for its magic hardly ever work for another, sure standardized spells are easy to learn but freeform magic also called spell crafting is a whole other can of worm.

worst yet, a unicorn horn is both a focus and a mean of channeling magic and a wrongly cast spell can fail explosively. If the unicorn is lucky the explosion happen around their horn and they just get dazed. If they are not the moment said spell fail the horn shatter and a broken horn lose all capacity for fine casting and is only able to release very wild and destructive spell. 

If a unicorn take the time to learn and familiarize itself with its own magic its power grow exponentially as the more time a unicorn pony successfully cast spells the more robust its horn grow and the more potent its core -the source of its magic- become allowing for more daring experimentation and longer training session. an old unicorn pony is a force that can challenge armies by itself.

height at maturity:

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-Star touched: 
Unicorn where touched by the star of magic itself, this mean that from the moment they are born they are guaranteed genius level compréhension of at least one basic magical practice amongst: Safe telekinesis, small scale transfiguration, small item conjuration, self teleportation or self shielding. 

This genius can and will stretch toward understanding of the advanced, expert and even master level spells connected to the chosen magical practice through pursued study and training.

-Endless well of magic: 
Unicorn can perceive magic much more clearly than other races and contrary to most other species who are bound to the natural and passive recovery of their magic, unicorn have the unique ability to not only absorb magic consciously to replenish their own store but to do so from nothing.

Unicorn can slowly and with great concentration freely generate magic in their surrounding and slowly guide it through their horn to their core for storage and use, this ability also become -contrary to expectation- more potent with a broken horn. 

This task require the complete inactivity of a unicorn core and cannot be done while casting, channeling or supplying spells in any way shape and form.

the drawback is:

-The endless abyss: 
Unicorn are taught very young and remain aware all their lives that should they fall to temptation even once the fall will be quick and the landing most likely fatal.

A unicorn who start using dark magic will almost instantly become trapped into a viscous cycle that only a third party can free it from, dark magic is a potent cancerous infection that spread eagerly onto whoever it get a hold of and sadly the gift for magic unicorn have been born with also make them that much more vulnerable to it.

Mind you all species not born to use it can fall to dark magic and all will be made lesser by it for a time after freeing themselves from it but to unicorn it is a most foul poison, one that corrode their mind and corrupt their heart so quickly and strongly that there is no hope of the unicorn freeing itself from it alone.

rows.title: The yaks.
rows.titleText:
Yaks are good at three things in particular, breaking stuff when mildly displeased, building beautiful and robust woodworks, and standing up for their friend and allies. 

Yaks are simple, straightforward as well as brutally honest they are the most confortable in cold places, can endure but never relish being wet. Are master woodworker but happily break it on a moments notice absolutely certain they can make it just as good if not better again right after and that the cold land they inhabit can always use more firewood.

they see fighting as a good way to keep the blood warm and flowing but look down on brutality and cruelty. one of the more violence inclined of my creation. (also drink alcohol by the pints almost every meal.)

height at maturity:

tiny=2.5m
small=2.9m
average=3.6m
tall=4.3m
gigantic=5m

the perks are:

-Träarbetare: 
Yaks are skilled woodworker, they have such a strong affinity with wood that they can shape it into work of arts with an otherworldly ease.

Their works beat the test of time as well, lasting for centuries with ease and this is why it is often the targets of yak assault as it is the only way to make room for new creation of younger yaks eager to contribute to the rich woodworking history of the yaks.

-Brutal revelry: 
Yaks celebration are wild and filled with alcohol, friendly bout of violence and very loud noise. yet the next morning yaks wake up with the sun and get to work with no troubles or loss of productivity. 

Come the dusk they will celebrate the hard work of the day being done in a massive party and yet again not face any consequences on the morrow. 

Yaks are impossible to drink under the table, impossible to put down with a good time and will never let any form of enjoyment stop them from doing of their work the next day, nothing.

the drawback is:

-Hair trigger: 
Yaks get loud and angry very easily? Simple as that.

it does not make you more angry nor does it make you more likely to hurt others you just start screaming and hitting things -not others- almost the moment something tick you off. 

Does make you out to be a bit immature and lacking in self control.

rows.title: The zebras.
rows.titleText:
Zebras are similar to earth pony but lack the strength and constitution part instead they have stronger connection to the spiritual world, they use this connection with the wild spirit of magic to make potion and alchemical concoction as well as perform shamanism and voodoo ritual for many purposes.

They in exchange protect and preserve the lands in which those spirit live and prosper. While their powers are borrowed, regular use and good relation with the spirit can see them earn and develop their own spiritual form with which to influence the world and power their craft with.

height at maturity:

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-Spiritual attention: 
The spirit pay closer attention to zebra than other races, this make it more likely for zebra to earn their favors and increase the zebra chance of making a connection with said spirit, this also make zebra more successful in awakening new spirit from area filled with magic.

-Stripped charisma: 
Zebra have a unique aura and mystical presence to them, this stem from the spirits often gathering around them and give their words and action more weight to magical beings. 

To the untrained this pressure cause unease and sometime even fear and to the magical practitioners this incite respect and reverence in proportion to the amount of spirits willingly following the zebra.

the drawback is:

-The wrong kind of attention: 
Not all spirits are benevolent, some were twisted by the corruption of their land and the twisting of their mind by dark magic and event.

Those spirit can attempt to possess vulnerable being and zebra are more vulnerable to this than other races due to their affinity with spirit magic. 

A zebra need to train from young age to build strong mental fortitude and self control so as to prevent possession, this also mean they require daily meditation to maintain this inner control or strong emotion will give twisted spirit an opening.

objects.title: Magicis natura.
objects.text:
You can now connect to all plant life on whatever planet you walk upon to yourself ignoring range and obstacle in the way. 
 
You can enter and exit any tree larger and taller than yourself as a mean of teleportation across the planet. 
 
You can also affect all plants you are connected to with any of your magic at once or selectively no matter the range.

you also gain perfect awareness of the state of all plants across the planet and their immediate surrounding (about 1 meter) as a form of "minor omniscience".
 
This effect can happen and last as long as you remain within the world gravitational field after touching it.

objects.title: Naturaliter Magicae.
objects.text:
You now possess the ability to create "in vitro" magical core, this come as a tear shaped crystal the size of a grape and generate endless amount of magic at a steady rate.

They are made of your own tears, take a day of focus and the remembrance of a true moments of perfect joy or utter sadness to make and you can only make one per day. 

They generate as much magic as a unicorn with the S-tier magical boost and can be drawn upon as battery or used for enchanting.

they do not store magic but radiate it in the surrounding.

rows.title: hybride race: the Unideers.
rows.titleText:
This is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

As an hybrid you gain access to one (1) new perk but also lose the drawback of their constituent races. 

They also get to chose from two mutually exclusive traits of great power.

(hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. )

The Unideer is the mix of a deer and a unicorn, their antlers now are made of crystals and they have a permanent if shorter horn on their foreheads that allow them to use unicorn magic.

They have the body and cloven hoof of a deer but the mane and tail of a pony, the facial feature are pony like but with larger ears. 

height at maturity:

tiny=1m

-Pure existance:
Unideers are the combination of two races in tune with two of the most powerful energies of the world: magic and nature itself, as such they are gifted with a silvery blood that cannot be blighted by illness or woe and can heals any wounds and purge any curse

The unideers benefit of those effect at all time as well giving them regeneration and immunity to all curses as long as they have energy to spare (vitality).

the removed drawback are:

--Wild bound:
--The endless abyss:

objects.title: Venator noctis.
objects.text:
You gain complete awareness of all that happen in the dark on the planet you are on.

This make you near omniscient at night unless an area is overwhelmingly lit up.

this traits does not give you the mean to parse through all the informations you perceive beyond allowing you to focus on specific keyword or peoples.

objects.title: Vorax nox.
objects.text:
You can now drag others into the shadow and minerals you dive into, this force you and them either into a lightless sea of breathable oily water with no wall and a roof that reflect the real world, clouds of razor sharp obsidian chip float and drift along unseen current with increasing thickness the deeper one dives. 

This realm possess no edges and no one can see in this realm but you, anyone but you will lose their way and be lost forever or sink deeper and die.

Any one stuck in this realm does not age or starve and is trapped until you let them out or die yourself.

While no one but you can see in this realm those trapped in it can still attack you when you are going in and out of shadows/minerals or lurking.

-Abyssal lurker:
A shadow dog can move through the ground and any mineral based material and the shadows as easily as through air and can ignore the width or depth limitation.

Indeed they can fit inside the shadow of a small pockets or a plunge entirely inside a small flower pot and stay there without issue. They can also only partially exit this spot even while moving this is called "lurking", the speed they move while 
"lurking" is always the fastest speed they can move when unrestrained.

the removed drawback are:

--Shadow constitution:

objects.title: Corpus aethereum.
objects.text:
As a kibra your zebra strong connection to the spirit realm merged with your more spiritually responsive kirin body and can now partially slip into the in-between, you can now exist at the hair thin edge of reality and imagination.

This make you able to enter into a sort of half state unique to you wich make you incorporeal, imperceptible and inviolable to others. 

In this state the world to you appear the same as always excepted that you can float around and goes through walls, you can remain in this state at all time at no cost and even asleep.

You can also set this state to turn on if you pass out.

In this state any wound or injury you suffered are slowly reversed until you resume you "righteous" state.

objects.title: Regium spiritum.
objects.text:
As a kibra your zebra's mastery of the self merged with your more "mind over reality" kirin origin and can now impose your will upon the world beyond your mere form.

You can now warp reality in a small area (about a three kilometer at first but growing with practice) around you so that it become a "field" that fit you.

The "field" will favor you at all time and shift around your mood and need, it will keep unwanted visitor at bay and trap targets in its border with fervor. It will also warp and bend and even create matter to shield and assist you, anything made from "field" provided materials disappear with the field. 

This "field" can remain up exactly 20 minutes at a time and must stay off 20 minutes after being turned off. 

the area "covered" by your field is unaffected by what happen in the "field".

the zebra connection to the spiritual world and the kirin self control and good judge of character merge to allow the kibra to seek judgement onto others.

indeed a kibra can perceive the spirit of those still living and know any source of bad and good karma they carry in details, this mean no one can hide their sin from a kibra no matter the time that passed or degree of separation from the crimes. 

the removed drawback are:
