--Forced isolationist:

objects.title: Felis Schrödingeriana.
objects.text:
As a  cheshi-earth cat your existence is a paradox and it grant you a constant if minor power over causality.

For exemple, if you get wounded but hide that wounds and no one but yourself know it existed then the wounds never happened. If you do a lot of work but no one see you rest then you will never get tired.

This power can only be beneficial so even if someone is sure to have hurt you when they didn't you won't suddenly be hurt, but if they have a doubt for even a moment that they missed they will never be able to touch you

Even further if you can somehow convince someone you wounded them, even if its a lie as long as they believe you did, they will suddenly bear whatever wounds they thought you inflicted upon them. 

Both effects work on an individual level so if you convince one person that they cannot harm you, another different person can still harm you until they also start to believe they cannot.

Both effect also work passively at all time but only when you would want them to so no suddenly hurting peoples afraid of you just because they think you hurt them unless you also wanted them to be hurt.

Work especially well with poison and/or a reputation.

This trait also mean that if you die but then those that killed you think you are alive -for even a moment- then you become alive again. (much less likely to work if they see your dead body but almost certain to work if they don't.)

objects.title: paradoxon cattus.
objects.text:
As a  cheshi-earth cat your existence is a paradox but instead of a constant effect like with Felis Schrödingeriana, you instead build up charge in yourself to spend in more potent but less frequent effects on causality.

you build one charge every 3 month and can store up to 9 charges, by spending a charge you can fulfill any task you would be capable of accomplishing yourself in three month instantly without having to actually take the step needed to fulfill it. 

In practice this mean if you can do something with whatever you have on hoof at the time you spend a charge and three month worth of free time then it instantly happen without taking either time or ressources and instead drain a charge. 

This trait also work as additional lives, if you die while having a charge the cause of your death is negated and you just don't die. (like the Izanagi in Naruto but rechargeable.)

rows.title: hybride race: cheshi-earth cat.
rows.titleText:
this is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

As an hybrid you gain access to one (1) new traits but also lose the drawback of their constituent races. 

hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. 

The cheshi-earth cat is a mix of a feline folk and earth pony, they focus on the speed and stealth aspect of both races. They are quadrupeds like earth pony but also have paws and the tail and ears of a feline folk, they have a earth pony head but the sharp teeth and slitted eyes of a a feline folk.

-living anomaly:
Feline pony can move at the speed of light but cannot affect the world as they do, they always safely land on all fours paws and become invisible while crouching they can also -while no one see them- teleport freely to any spot no one is looking at. all those powers only work while touching the solid ground with at least one paw. 


the removed drawback are:

--The lethargy of peace: 
--Lazy sadism:

objects.title: Scala exitii.
objects.text:
You now can shed dust like scales, those scales are so small they feel like fine flour and spread out all around you with even the slightest winds, the more scale around you to more scales you shed in an exponential manner.

For every of your own "body weight" (BW) in "shed scales" (SS) you double your "shed scale rate" (SSR). (1*BW of SS=2*SSR / 2*BW of SS=4*SSR / 3*BW of SS=8*SSR etc...)

Those scale are highly reactive to your own dragon breath and pegasus magic while being impervious to all other form of magic or dragon breath and pegasus magic not your own. 

Those scale will merge and amplify any breath or pegasus magic you use while spreading around allowing you to ignite or electrocute wider and wider area as you shed and spread more scale around.

Those shed scales are not consumed by doing so either instead building up over time until you "dismiss" them into nothing. 

Past a certain point of shed scales saturation covering at entire world in a raging inferno of dragon fire or a never ending storm of lighting and tornado can be done with but a single spark of fire or lightning and one flap of your wings.

Shed scales also possess the same resistance as your own dragon scale and can as such act like an armor cloud around, the scale are so fine that breathing in wont hurt by itself but too much of them can cause respiratory problem unless you dismiss them.

You can selectively choose to dismiss some or all your shed scale but you can only affect your shed scale in other way when they are in direct contact of other shed scale you are touching them or they directly affected by your dragon breath or pegasus magic. (you cannot ignite the shed scale in someone lungs without having shed scales connected to both you and the shed scale in the other's lung for exemple..

The speed at which the effects spread across your shed scales is about 30kmh at minimum but it increase with the concentration of shed scales in the area.

objects.title: Mordens plumis.
objects.text:
your wings can regrow their feathers instantly and all your feather become twice as resistant as your dragon scales but just as soft as pegasus feathers.

You can project and remotely control those feathers and they are twice as sharp as your teeth when projected, they also lose their softness and become much more rigid and as heavy as steel. 

when they stab into a living being those feather will "hook" themselves firmly in them and try and move around to catch the wind and slow their victims down. 

Your feather never rot or decay and must physically be destroyed to get rid of them, range is a unlimited and you always know where your projected feather are in relation to you  but you have no awareness of their surrounding so be carful not to shred innocents when blindly moving them around.

your feather can hold "scalechemy" enchantement just like your dragon scale can.

rows.title: hybride race: angel drake.
rows.titleText:
This is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

As an hybrid you gain access to one (1) new traits but also lose the drawback of their constituent races. 

Hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. 

The angel drake is a mix of pegasus and dragon, they are quadruped with the front hooves of a pony and the talon of a dragon, they have feathered wing but a long prehensible scaled tail. their ears have fin like ends and while pony shaped their maw is wider and filled with sharp teeth.

height at maturity:

the gained perk is:

-Heaven's pride.
As an angel drake you are the the supreme ruler in the sky, the one that dominate all who stand below them. This perk partially negate the potency of all attack that target you and increase the potency of your own based on how much "higher" you are to your opponents. The "higher" you are in comparaison to someone else the more this perk grow in power, this perk use the "concept" of higher rather than its literal meaning, in short its about how much you look down on your opponents with pride. 
Be carful not to become arrogant rather than prideful. (instead of being "too angry to die" its being "too prideful to die." or Vegeta from DBZ in short.)

the removed drawback are:

--Dragon pride: 
--Like dust in the winds:

objects.title: Amor vincit omnia.
objects.text:
you can now tie the souls of peoples who love each others in a "love bound", by doing so as long as one still live the others cannot die of old age. 

When one is wounded the wound is divided amongst all the connected individuals, a large enough group will make a paper cut out of a severed limbs and a bee sting of a bullet wound.

The natural and magical healings of all connected individual is also shared, rapidly fixing most wounds.

Pains of all wounds are also shared and they are not dampened and felt in full by all members of the "love bound".

objects.title: Amor oblivionem non novit.
objects.text:
Your swarm (changeling of all cast and drones born from you or born of changeling you birthed.) now possess perfect perception and perfect mental, magical and muscle memory and as such can perfectly replicate anything they see and ear be it physicals and magical as long as they see it in person.

As long as they have the magical power and shapeshift into the form of whoever they are imitating they are a perfect match to them. 

Your changeling are also very good at converting the skills they imitate to the basic changeling form.

Since the changeling of your swarm can also imitate other changeling this way, master level skills can as such spread across your entire swarm in a matter of days.

rows.title: hybride race: Night-lings.
rows.titleText:
this is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. 

The night-lings are a mix of thestral and changeling, they are nocturnal quadruped with moth like antennas and are extra fluffy, they possess three pairs of large insectoid wings and a much larger horn, they need to feed on both emotions and food.

height at maturity:

the gained perk is:

-lovely swarm:
your love reserve and the love reserve of all your changelings -no matter the castes- are now all connected and shared, no matter the distance all the swarm can now keep itself sustained without the time consuming and logistical burden of creating a supply chain for love. You merely need to have a large enough source of love to sustain your swarm. only love that is safe to eat is shared this way and other mean of sustenance are not shared at all.

the removed drawback are:

-Dependence.
-Cold's embrace.

objects.title: Canticum ruinam.
objects.text:
As a harpy you are freed from the "heart's longing" drawback but a part of you still remember the heart ache of your kindred, this feeling of wrongness can be channeled through your voice into a mournful cry that strike those who ear it with an entire race tragic circumstances.

Those who ear this song will be faced with ruin, their luck and fortune will turn any unearned success into so much ash. 

This song curse those who have more than they deserve into losing all that excesses one way or another until the scale of fortune are balance once more, the more unbalanced the scale was the more drastic and sudden their fall from grace will be. 

This song does not cause collateral damage in anyway as such the cursed one family or loved ones are not affected their belonging and personal health on the other hoof are fair games.

You yourself are not affected by your own song but any one around you that ear it is even your allies.

If you die the song effect end, if someone you cursed start balancing the scale on its own the song effect are paused. This can create "anti villain" (doctor doom, snape, magneto etc...evil goals with redeeming qualities and righteous methodology. In essence a benevolent tyrant.)

objects.title: Link raptor.
objects.text:
Did you know harpy in Greek mean "snatcher"?

Its because they were known to punish mortal for their misdeed by "stealing" their loved ones.

As a harpy you can do something similar in that you can steal and highjack the wrongful control someone as over others, to put simply  you are a mind controller worst nightmare. 

Brainwashing, body jacking, slave contract even cult worship you can kick out the previous focal point and master off its throne and place yourself in it.

You also have the ability to then free your new flock while reversing any damage they sustained when they were controlled be it physicals, mental or spiritual. 

you can also sense if anyone is in such a situation and infer the nature of the control that are in proximity to you.

The more toxic and abusive the connection the further away and the quicker you figure out its nature.

rows.title: hybride race: harpies.
rows.titleText:
this is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. 

The harpies are a mix of bird folk and hippogriff, they are winged biped with a long prehensible scaled tail. They have a more raptor like head and are almost entirely covered with feathers aside their claws, tail and legs who have large powerful talon to run, jump and kick. (the horns are not biological and only part of the helmet.) They also now possess flight capable wings and while their speed in the air is nothing noteworthy they are exceptionally fast on the ground with strong legs and using their wings as control surfaces.

height at maturity:

the gained perk is:

-gyroscopic precision: 
By combining the inherent precision, focus and attention to detail of the bird folks and hippogriff the harpy have unmatched kinetic vision and aim no matter the speed they and their targets move at. If a harpy is taking a shot it land 999.999 time out of a 1.000.000 and always right where it hurts most. If you face a harpy blocking or being tough enough to endure the blow is the only way to deal with an attack, that or a préemptive strike.

the removed drawback are:

-Heart's longing.
-Artistic imperative.

objects.title: Malevolus emissio.
objects.text:
Instead of having to die to release a unfocused uncontrolledly release of you stored magical cores you can willingly release all your core into a devastatingly potent focused mouth beam, this multiply its potential power by a hundred time (X100) and doesn't kill you. You can also release a precise percentage or amount of them of them rather than all of them. Magical cores whose owner have died are always released first when you use this traits.

This traits can also be used as an emergency release to expel your magical cores but not the magic powers you have stored into your own magical store. Losing their magical production but not you own magical reserve.

With practice you can use this traits with other form of magic than the mouth beam, allowing you to trade magical cores for instant power output far beyond what you could cast normally.

objects.title: Superimpositum agro.
objects.text:
You can enforce the breezie dimension sense of scale to the sapient being in the real world around you, basically you turn everyone around you to the size of a regular breezie -breezie and tiny-taurs are not affected- with no regard to enemy allies or passerby. 

The area start with a 10 meter radius and double in size every minutes. It cost nothing to maintain and can encompass the entire reality you are in. 

It only turn off when you consciously make it, you falling asleep or others knocking you out won't stop it but if you die the effect end and this traits activation cooldown is twice the lengths of time it was one the last time it was used.

This area is centered around the user and move with them, the effect is instantaneous and the activation and edge of the area invisible to all even the user.

rows.title: hybride race: tiny-taur.
rows.titleText:
this is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

As an hybrid you gain access to one (1) new traits but also lose the drawback of their constituent races. 

hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. 

The tiny-taur are a mix of breezie and centaur, they are breezie sized centaur with longer horns instead of antenna and six wings instead of four they also have much fluffier tail and mane and thinner limbs.

height at maturity:

tiny=1m

gigantic=3m

the gained perk is:

-pint sized nuke:
As a tiny-taur your body can contain an entire army worth of magical core inside your hoof sized body,  this come with an...interesting side effect, if you die you still return to the breezie dimension but your dead body also still release the stolen core but it does so...explosively, the more core you have the bigger the kaboom this effectively make you the first repeated suicide bomber. be carful not to crack whatever planet you go to. The cores are not destroyed and still return to their owners, they just release all the magic they held at the time of death before doing so. A thousand average magical core will result in a 5 kilotons magical explosion (with no radioactive fallout).

the removed drawback are:

-Air head sociopath.
-The taller they are.

objects.title: Impulsum vector.
objects.text:
The enduring mentality of your buffalo blood shine through in the ability to store kinetic energy that affect you at a 1/1 ratio. This make you immune to all mundane physicals attack.

You can store an infinite amount of this potential energy and spend it to increase your velocity or the kinetic impact of any physicals blow you deliver. 

The storing despite not having any hard limitation in how long it can be active and lacking any form of "cooldown" time does require conscious intent to maintain active, surprise attack or getting distracted render you vulnerable. 

The release of this energy is very precise and does not require you to spend it all in one go, instead you can spend it in parts as needed.

objects.title: Praedictio oculi.
objects.text:
The keen eyes of your griffon blood grant you the unique ability to perceive motion into the future.

Anything moving in "your field of view" (280° whichever way your head is turned.) possess a ghostly form preceding it, this ghostly image showing you their movement 5 second in advance. 

This ghostly image then split into any other future paths they may take in the 5 second that follow, this repeat three more time, allowing you to predict the path of anything you are observing up to 25 second in advance.

This vision is 100% accurate in the first 5 second no matter how fast or reactive the observed parties are, but the accuracy drastically drop past those first 5 seconds.
 
This ghostly image remain even with you eyes closed or blindfolded, even if you are permanently blinded.

rows.title: hybride race: griffalo.
rows.titleText:
this is an hybrid race, its something that happen when lovers of two different races give birth to a perfect mix of their two races.

As an hybrid you gain access to one (1) new traits but also lose the drawback of their constituent races. 

hybrid races are a so rare they are considered a statistical error in most census. 

the griffalo are a mix of griffon and buffalo, the head and chest of the eagle are replaced with a buffalo but they still possess wings and still have the rear of a lion and talon eagle for forelimbs. Their fur now also have feathers mixed in and they have much better eyesight as well. 

height at maturity:

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the gained perk is:

-Flying tank:
Griffalo are slower than most flying species but contrary to them there bones are not hollow, their body are not built light or enhanced to fly fast or be agile in the air, they are literally physically capable of lifting themselves through pure muscle power, griffalo are physically stronger than species four time their size and weight, they are tough enough to take light and medium infantry weapons fire without a scratch and heavy infantry weapons fire with only superficial damage. this show as a flat increase to the strength and toughness.

the removed drawback are:

-Call of the roam.
-The razor's edge.

objects.title: bird folk
objects.text:
the bird folk are bipedal flightless bird taller than most quadruped with keen eyesight and no fuck to give, bird folk culture is one of freedom and piracy, whether its on the sea or in the sky using daring airship design. The bird folk have proven that despite the lack of wings they knew how to fly. They are also master of dueling blade and crack shot with handguns their reaction time and speed only seen in the most skilled of f-1 racers of your world, never challenge a bird folk in a reflex game you are bound to lose.
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=2.4m
small=3m
average=3.6m
tall=4.2m
gigantic=4.8m

the perks are:

-feather guard: bird folk feathers are insulated to extreme colds as well as humidity, but also have a surprisingly strong spine capable of stopping blades and bullet when layered which is why bird folks tail are often used as a weapon and shield. those tail are generally at least as long as the bird folk is tall and make for a constant threat to enemy and protection for its owner.

-golden goose: bird folk lay unfertilized eggs daily that are packed with nutrients, they are a proven cure for most common disease as they boost the immune system and restore energy greatly. this lead to bird folk collecting those eggs either to be sold or to use when falling sick. this egg laying require no effort on the bird folks parts and allow a bird folk to sustain itself on just them and water if needed.

the drawback is:

-heart's longing: bird folk are a most tragic race if you think about it, evolution came with the loss of their ability to fly unaided but not their longing for the sky. bird folk that stay too long away from the heaven will grow depressed and distracted as their thought turn more and more to the sky, only the rush of the high wind and the proximity of the clouds will ease their aching heart.

objects.title: breezie
objects.text:
That Breezies exist at all is a miracle only possible in my world to be honest. They are a flight reliant species that is too small and light to fight the winds yet to big to not catch them. This mean that Breezies tend to be thrown off course by any stray wind and can't even remain grounded when it become windy unless indoor or tied up to something. 

On the other hand Breezies are technically immortal in that all Breezies come from and live into a pocket space uniquely accessible to Breezies and that any Breezies that die out of it just pop back inside of it safe and sound, only old age can end them but one of their perk make even that unlikely. This dimension is constituted of only one gigantic tree (even to non Breezies) and while it offer plenty of food, water and an endless supply materials to make home and furniture with, it still require pollen from the outside world to bear a wide variety of magical fruits.

Those fruits are sacred to Breezies as it allow a Breezies to change into a wide variety of insect and arachnid variant of the Breezies. Some fruit turn a Breezies into a moth pony, other into a bee pony and so on. All those Breezies variant gain unique abilities with their new form and are generally bigger by a whole meter -which meant most average ascended Breezies are about 1.15 meter tall- this newfound size allow ascended Breezies to safely leave their home dimension and to gather more pollen for the next generation of Breezies.

Those ascended Breezies are often more daring and confrontational with their new size and often bite more than they can chew at often lethal consequences, sadly when an ascended Breezies die it come back to is home dimension as a regular Breezies which keep them searching for more pollen.

height at maturity: 

tiny=7cm
small=10cm
average=15cm
tall=20cm
gigantic=25cm

+1meter when ascended

the perks are:

-pride of the smoll: Breezies are brave beyond belief considering their sizes. It may be because they know that death has no hold on them or because they are born at the very bottom of the food chain and have nothing to lose, a Breezies will charge into battle and face pain and challenge with no shiver or tear because yes Breezies don't feel pain, what would be the point since they can't die. Some Breezies simply let themselves dies of thirst or hunger when trapped or kill themselves when they get lost after being carried by stray wind to return back home. Breezies are hardcore dear and this perk grant you the same "bonus", you don't feel pain or fear death. the closest thing to feeling fear for you would be the feeling that come when you might lose the pollen you struggled to collect. 

-Role-Playing-Life: you can with a single  of the sacred Breezies tree fruit turn into a whole different form, with new form new abilities and an increase in size sure but the best part? You can do it more than once in a lifetime or at least once per lifetime, tired of being a spider Breezies? want to retake to the sky? kick the bucket, bite a different fruit and bam you're a moth Breezies! Funnily enough most others species fail to recognize a specific Breezies in a different form and you can have some good fun with that, in fact a lot of the things Breezies do in general is "troll" others. They are perfectly aware they can just switch form later and start a whole new relationship with this stranger at a later date and if you burned all your form somehow guess what? Changing form rejuvenate you back to your prime, so as long as you bring that pollen in and switch form often enough you can just "wait out" a generation or two and start again. truly the Breezies are the hardcore fairy-tale accurate fairy of my worlds.

the drawback is:

-air head sociopath: the Breezies cannot die and can easily escape capture and retribution, this lack of consequence tend to make them a bit "weird" in the cranium department. Breezies also have a hard time empathizing with other species (because they don't have any understanding of fear or doubt or pain.) and tend to be easily distracted (unless pollen is concerned.) a Breezies not pulling its own scheme or collecting pollen is gullible and influenceable but amongst the Breezies some are old enough that they have learned of this weakness and a scorned Breezies is a lifetime enemy for you at the least and maybe even your descendants (depending on how much fun your family is to mess with.), at least you can appease them by helping them on a pollen run.

objects.title: buffalos
objects.text:
Buffalos are very similar to earth pony in that they are physically strong, the difference is that Buffalos look the part. with larger body on average and much thicker neck you'd expect Buffalos to be like your world bull and you'd be wrong, Buffalos are actually long distance runner yet do not have the endless stamina of earth pony and they are instead sure footed and skilled traveler that can travel by hooves entire continent three time over in a decade. Buffalos are granted powerful gift by the wild wandering magic of the world, at least as long as they remain unbound from a sedentary lifestyle for long periods of time and cover long distance often.

 height at maturity: 

tiny=1.8m
small=2.5m
average=2.7m
tall=3m
gigantic=4m

the perks are:

-sure hooved: Buffalos are unaffected by the state of the surface beneath their cloven hooves, be it muddy or dry, sand or swamp ,red hot steel or atop deep water. As long as only their hooves are on contact with it they are unaffected by it and can walk or run atop it without it affecting their balance or speed in any way but positive.

-the road's providence: Buffalos on a roam are lucky beyond belief and will always find both food and shelter when needed while roaming. This extend and grow stronger with basically everything they do while moving long distance uninterrupted for more than a full day be it by hooves or not. An ever traveling buffalos working only a few hours a day will be met with tremendous success compared to a settled one working every waking hours and this is because for the first Buffalos every action taken or not that can be smoothed out by luck will be, from a simple bout of motivation leading to call a possible client at the perfect time for a favorable response or a sudden urge of selling company share just before a dip almost everything will line up perfectly to a Buffalos on the road.  

the drawback is:

-call of the roam: Buffalos are spiritually driven to travel or "roam" by hooves over distances of at least three to four hundred kilometer every years and in group of a few hundreds families or prospecting bachelor and bachelorette. This call need to be answered by all buffalos  to remain mentally healthy and promote social connectivity. without this a Buffalos grow more frustrated and depressed the longer they go without roaming.

objects.title: Centaur
objects.text:
Centaurs are rare and physical powerhouse, dexterous thanks to having actual fingers, fast and stable by being quadruped, tough because they come from a harsh land where sand is sharp like blades and the sun bear down on all who live there. 

Their main weakness is that they are magically poor and cannot use magic at all unless they can somehow consume some and even then it leave them with a finite amount, every time they use magic they spend it and must find more to consume. It is possible for them though to steal the ethereal magical core of other beings to gain their own magical source for themselves and with it the -greatly reduced- magic output of the robbed individual.

Centaurs  cannot cast actual spells instead the magic they consume just make them into a more powerful creature, once it has fed on enough magic a centaur will regain and maintain their peak age as well as grow physically larger for as long as they have magic to sustain it, by spending some they can also blast large amount of unshaped magic out of their body as both beam and crud shields but the main aspect is that by stealing magical cores those power can grow to ridiculous degree.

Contrary to most species Centaurs don't have a maximum amount of magic they can spend at a time and instead can invest their stolen magic as they please and so the more cores they have the more they can afford to spend in their bodily enhancement, growing more and more and more to colossal sizes. 

This power is still stolen though and should the worst come and a being you have stolen the core of dies for any reason you will not only lose that core's magic output but will also suffer terrible pain until you spit it out. Centaurs cannot choose what core they spit out or even how many precisely, a core instantly go back to their owner ounce spit out too so you won't be able to swallow them back without finding the owner again, the pain can stack endlessly until it become so unbearable you will literally up and die. greed and callousness will not favor your odds should you fall to the temptation of easy power.
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=2.5m
small=3m
average=4m
tall=5m
gigantic=8 meter (infinite if you can sustain it with magic and have infinite livable space, infinite food and infinite water or a magical mean of sustenance.)

the perks are:

-strong lifeforce: Centaurs rarely die of accidental wounds, they need to be actively killed to die or die of old age. yet if not using it for boosts a centaur can live for millennia with little food and water and about a couples spell worth of magic in the tank, they are immune to most disease and can heal from debilitating wounds in a matter of days outside of straight up amputation. this also  grant them a gift for the good old way of strengthening themselves that is working out as they rapidly recuperate from strenuous activity and show greater reward for it.

-gluttonous technic: centaurs are the bane of magic users the world over, a centaur can eat any form of magic be it from another creature, an enchanted item, a magical ward or even a spell thrown at them. As long as they can see it coming a Centaurs can just suck up any magical attack which will pull it in their mouth no matter the aiming or applied surface, this make channeled spells very dangerous and rare enchanted item not only a waste to bring against them but a danger as they will grow stronger from it. Worst yet is that spells that affect their inside also suffer this fate, from curses cast on them or potion they ingest, even healing magic feed their power. centaur can even drain an area of magic but this is very time consuming and never provide more than a finite amount of magic before the land simply reject your attempt and make the area unlivable for you one way or another, time will let it forgive you.

the drawback is:

- the taller they are: as we saw centaurs are true powerhouse but this come at the cost of a rather short lifespan when dry of magic, a measly 40 years total in fact. their natural age also catch up to them quickly when they run out of magic and cannot sustain the peak age boost, this also mean that a centaur past a hundred will die in seconds when it run out of magic and this can happen more easily than you think because if for any reason a centaur start to vomit all the cores, magic will go out as well. on another note did you know centaur get violently nauseous when seeing fast flashing rainbow colors, weird right? must be their mostly brown and grey homeland, never got used to this many colors...

objects.title: Changeling
objects.text:
changeling are a sore subject for me, you see they are an accidental specie and were born through a series of very unlikely events involving an acorn a carnivorous tree a unicorn magic and a pond of liquid wild dark magic. this mess spat out The first changeling queen and a few mindless drones that would later become the first changeling hive and ravage about half a dozen city state and require the full power of an alicorn to defeat. changeling are shapeshifter that feed on love not all of them are equals and are separated into casts they all have two main form though, the dark very evil looking one which is what a predation changeling will look like and the colorful friendly one which is a what a symbiotic changeling look like, predation changeling can produce mindless drones that they control like additional bodies. drones are expendable soldiers and workers best used on either simple repetitive task or managed by sentient changeling, about a dozen drone for a royal, eight by nobles and four by common changeling. the predation changeling can also steal memory and mind control others as well as reap out the very life force of their prey along with their love. on the other hand symbiotic changeling are powerful empath and Pathokinesis capable of reading, changing, sharing and projecting the entire emotional spectrum of those around them, their need for love is greatly reduced as well in exchange they are weaker and less magically powerful though more cost effective there as well and can no longer make or use drones.
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=1.4m
small=1.8m
average=2.3m
tall=2.8m
gigantic=4.5m (only seen in the royal and viceroy cast.)

the perks are:

-perfect biologie: changelings cells don't degrade, that is for all casts even the drones, a changeling only die from disease, untreated wounds or hunger. otherwise changeling are eternal and can even regrow limbs and organ given proper care food and time.
-hivemind safety-net: if a changeling die while still connected to the hivemind network its mind can remain into stasis in the network until a drone is made for it to take over,  then the changeling can slowly regaining is previous casts and power by feeding on extra love and recuperate. do be careful though the changeling hivemind network is not world wide and only spread a few hundred meter from each sentient changelings in the network though it can be combined and stretched outward if changeling group close to each others.

the drawback is:

-dependence: the changeling cannot feed on each other and regular food while tasty and useful in making the main construction material of the changeling -a greenish resin they spit out- does not sustain them so they always need another race to thrive for them feed on, this also mean that being too numerous is a dangerous thing and can lead to changeling famine and have to regulate their population at all time as they do not age. in fact splinter faction of changeling are a common occurrence from changeling wanting their own children and can create a real headache for the whole changeling race, changeling by their very need and way of life are easy to point out as an common enemy by other parties as well and any conflict is a loss to changeling either because they are actually facing defeat or because they are forced to cull their food source.

objects.title: Deer
objects.text:
oh dear, the deer are a spiritual kind indeed, they are strongly connected to wild plant magic. they shine when in forest and other place filled with plant life, they are fast and agile as well if a bit fragile also they can also use magic through their antlers like unicorn by engraving runes on them its not a definitive action as deer antlers fall and regrow every four month. Female can grow larger antlers too if they want but generally prefer the coat tattoo that allow more complex spells and changeable after the large shedding at the end of winter. both gender often pick spells that can help in the deer main practice: shamanism, the art of using natural reagents to create magical effect and borrow the help of greater powers.

height at maturity(without the horns): 

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-root network: settlement of deer can work to build something called a Worldroot gate,  those gate are all connected to each other through a magical Worldroots network and allow instantaneous movement between other deer settlement with a gate, those gate are powered by the presence of a forest around them and maintained by the deer and will only allow organic living being as well as simple natural object through, such as a wood cart, leather cloths and even iron tools but anything like a truck, plastics of any kind and even powered tools will not.

-green cloven hooves: deer are master at growing plants of all kind even rare magical plants will bloom all over the land they tend to and with no side effect on the land as well, they also have a gift in protecting their crop from insect and diseases. this perk only work on natural plants not engineered one unless it was done by a deer. 

the drawback is:

-wild bound: deer are only ever confortable in highly forested lands and to them living in a wide open area would induce strong discomfort while a "concrete jungle" would cause recurring and violent panic attack.

objects.title: diamond dog
objects.text:
diamond dog are one of the few races on this list, they are generally top heavy, live underground and have a love of gems hence the diamond of their name. diamond dog are spread into three category called alpha beta and gamma those category does not impact how they are treated but what role in the pack they may have to carry out and is given when they reach maturity, the beta have strong physic but are mentally average, the gamma are smart but physically average and the alpha are the best of both but very few in numbers. female tend to be bigger and more of them can be found in the beta cast while men fall into the gamma cast by being more resourceful too compensate for their short stature. the alpha cast as a decent mix of both. the diamond dog defining feature are that they are good at digging can smell and ear better than all other species and are one of the slowest on foot due too their shorter legs, they doe have massive upper body strengh and dexterous hand which help maintain the two central export products of the diamond dog: forged item and gemstones.

height at maturity: 

tiny=2m
small=2.5m
average=3m
tall=4.5m
gigantic=5m

the perks are:

-solid swimmer: diamond dog digging prowess are no secret and universal to all of them, this show as them being able to move through dirt like a human would through water, their hearing allow them to track people walking above and inside their tunnel and surprise them if necessary. they can also move through stone and even steel but the harder the material the more physicals strength is needed to move in it making the female dominant beta cast outstanding in this. this ability render most non-enchanted armor, shield and fortification pointless. 

-matchless smith: diamond dog have sensitive ears and any attempt to forge with hammering would cause tremendous pain to any would be smith, thankfully while moving their entire bodies through steel and other hard materials require large amount of bodily strength shaping a piece of said material is much more doable, here the male dominant gamma cast shine by crafting with paw, claws and bite -no hammers or heat needed- a wide variety of wonderous item of great value. From tools to armor to furniture or jewelry as long as it is made from something that can be dug out out of the ground the diamond dog are the best at it. all their creation also tend to be tougher than others.

the drawback is:

-diamond dog earing is very keen capable of earing for miles and at range that no other species can pick up, this weakness is known and easy to exploit as this can be used to cause large amount of pain and strong headache to any diamond dogs be aware that unwarranted use of such sound on diamond dogs will cause them to instinctively memorize your smell before leaving, they will then plug their ear at home arm up and track you down to ask for justice from whatever land you came from.

objects.title: donkey
objects.text:
so, donkey. what to say about the donkey well.....they are a bit like earth pony but less unstoppable physical force of nature and more inexhaustible "spreader of life". donkey are "compatible" with all species and quite daring and generally successful with all gender types. donkeys are also consummate lovers, loyal and faithful as well as responsible, no donkey ever rejected an offspring of his let alone mistreat one and will only ever move to another lover when certain the past one is either dead or done with them if unsure the donkey will seek them until death often getting more and more cranky while doing so. those upstanding moral qualities alone more than make up for them having no greater powers and their sometime asshole-ish temperament when they get heartbroken by less respectful partners.

height at maturity: 

tiny=1m
small=1.4m
average=1.6m
tall=1.8m
gigantic=2.5m

the perks are:

-breeder of millions: donkey never fail into spreading or bearing life no matter age or race the offspring will always be hale and healthy, in addition those offspring will be blessed with the best genes of their parents also the gender of the child will always be the one the child will want, the numbers the parents wanted ,the birth will be painless and the recovery perfect and with no long lasting effect on the mother body.

-pleased to please: donkey will  never leave a partner unsatisfied and will instinctively know what and how their partner want it done, this also stretch to more wholesome matter of relationship with donkey knowing when their mate need supports or alone time they will never misinterpret you or misspeak their feeling. A relationship with a donkey only ever end when the problem is outside both party's control or if one of them is both not a donkey and an horrendous lover in all aspect.

the drawback is:

-bland existence: donkey have no greater purpose granted to their lives beside raising a following generation and being decent folks, and are actually the closest species to the average human just infinitely nicer.

objects.title: dragon
objects.text:
dragon is the strongest species here in pretty much all aspect, they can fly, have hands to wield tools, can use magic while immune to most of it, they can breath fire and have scale that render most threat harmless, and they can reach massive size naturally. there is a few evolutionary pitfall that can ruin them though like the "greed growth" which is when a dragon become obsessed with wealth and lose their higher though capacity until snapped out of it which also come with tremendous size growth with next to no development (as in a young dragon will become a giant young dragon not a giant adult one). their utter obedience to the dragon lord which can (if unchallenged) add and remove rules in the dragon code.

they are also not immortal just long lived at about 5000 years old from birth to death, most die much earlier in battles with other dragon or simply let themselves fade earlier out of boredom or loneliness. dragon are both capable of magic and immune to it; this dichotomy is possible because dragon are more magic than flesh and this make them impermeable to magic. regular contact with a specific type magic can attune them to it making them more compatible with the use of said magic while also striping them of defense against similar magic its why dragon often refuse to learn and perform magic and instead relying on their natural weapons like their claws and fire breath.
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=1.8m
small=10m
average=18m
tall=26m
gigantic=60m

the perks are:

-apex predator: dragon are the apex predator, once a dragon want something to deny it satisfaction is a doomed endeavor and they always find their quarry. this extend to both living and non living things a dragon is a master treasure hunter and wealth collector as well as hunter from birth to death. its also easier for dragon to kill without being traumatized or feeling remorse as they are very much aware of their place in the food chain and are the true omnivore on this list, a dragon can sustain themselves with pretty much anything they eat even simple stone, only the quantity needed and taste will vary.

-magical being: dragon are more magic than flesh and every part of the dragon anatomy can be used to make powerful magical item and reagent, this mean that dragon always carry on themselves an armory and apothecary should they bother learning the crafts. the fire of dragon is no different and can apply magical effect on item or even become magical itself if properly attuned to a magic type. the breath from the start can: burn like napalm, generate large amount of smoke, be condensed into a blowtorch and even not actually burn beyond a chosen degree.

the drawback is:

-dragon pride: dragon are bound to the dragon code and they have to follow that code or terrible curses befall them, the worst one being the loss of sentience and them turning into a feral mindless beast to be put down. the dragon code can be modified by the dragon lord during a dragon gathering with at least 70% of the entire dragon population. the dragon lord is whichever dragon is holding the bloodstone scepter, the scepter will first appear in a volcano and all dragon will be aware of is general direction and when acquired will send out a call for the first dragon gathering where the new holder will have to answer any challenge made to him/her. 

the dragon code:  
rule 1: a dragon will not know rest until it repay all debt of life through servitude or saving is own savior life. 
rule 2: a dragon will not break a promise once spoken.
rule 3: a dragon will honor his/her dragon lord commands or will openly challenge him/her for the title in a duel to the death or until the dragon lord relinquish is title.
rule 4: a dragon will honor his/her egg layers commands until he/she best them in either wit or might or become dragon lord themselves.
rule 5: a dragon will answer the call of the dragon lord in the shortest delay that can be afforded by circumstances.
rule 6: a dragon will if dragon lord, relinquish is title after it hold it for more than a 1000 years straight, he/she will choose and ensure the proceeding of "the gauntlet of fire".
rule 7: a dragon will have to participate to every gauntlet of fire unless dispensed by the dragon lord at the time.
rule 8: a dragon will if dragon lord, protect and manage the egg nests of the dragon land with its life.

objects.title: earth pony
objects.text:
the first on this list and in my world, earth pony are a straightforward sort simple as that and in this simplicity lies their genius, earth pony don't fly under their own power or bend magic with the flick of a horn but they can endure and break the world with hooves alone, when the chip are down earth pony never falter they may panic and make mistake but never falter.

height at maturity: 

tiny=1.6m
small=1.8m
average=2.3m
tall=2.8m
gigantic=4m

the perks are:

-weight of the mountain: when earth ponies make a stand no one can subdue them, they become invulnerable, immovable objects as long as they remain static and all four hooves on the ground this can be interpreted as a 100% decrease in incoming damage and a 100% reduction to all form of unwilling momentum gain. (the damage reduction is caped at a 90% against entropy based attack.). nothing can move an earth pony making a stand but victory,  hunger and thirst. you can still damage the ground around their hoof to break the effect or somehow suffocate them.

-tireless unrelenting charge: An earth pony charge is like an unstoppable force, the longer a earth pony run without interruption the faster they move up to a 100x multiplier and the faster they move the stronger they become with up to a 100x multiplier. still they can be redirected or made to stumble. 

the drawback is:

-the lethargy of calm: earth pony lack the drive for conflict -even necessary ones- and will almost always pick a less confrontational path if offered ones, the longer this "calm" last the less likely they become to ever rouse themselves from it.

objects.title: feline folk
objects.text:
the feline folk, a good choice considering you peoples obsession with cat. those peoples are identical to cat in all aspect -except smarter and capable of speech- until their teen then they become bipedal almost twice as tall as the average pony and terrifying to deal with, and i mean that literally, feline folk are crazy good merchant and businesscat. cunning and sly as well as sneaky and stealthy they shine in both the legal and the illegal side of information and "retrieval" of already owned items be it with good old robbery or a lawsuit. they are agile and dexterous, their senses of sight is one of the best but as a whole not particularly tough they also get tired quickly and often requiring about 12 hours of sleep a day.  
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=2.4m
small=3m
average=3.6m
tall=4.2m
gigantic=4.8m

the perks are:

-an eye for detail: feline folk are known to see more deeply into the world than others races. they have proven capable of finding with just a look entryway in seemingly secure places. they have also developed this talent in the more social world and can spot any weakness in peoples this give them a strong advantage in negotiations. of course you can also use this talent when reading an opponent you are fighting.

-if i sleek, i fit: feline folk appear almost liquide when trying to squeeze somewhere, bone twist and flex with no break or dislocation, skin stretch, fur become sleek and slide on surfaces with ease and organs move and bend as needed with no problems. if a cat try to fit somewhere it will, slowly in the most extreme case but it will they only limitation is that brain and skull must fit whole themselves.

the drawback is:

-lazy sadism: feline folk are, how to say this..."little shit?" seem appropriate, feline folk are little shit that snark and taunt and just love messing with others for fun. its an instinctual need to draw attention of peoples around them and it get even worst for peoples they find interesting, they get more and more insufferable until their target snark back and earn proper respect or the feline lose interest. this show as most feline folk being a weird mix of mayadere, kuudere and kamidere.

objects.title: griffon
objects.text:
if dragon are the best individual predator of the sky, the Pegasus the best builders of the sky and the hippogriff the most graceful of the sky then the griffin are the best warriors. griffon are part lion and part eagle and take the best of both, they fight in packs wielding expert tactics, weapon and predator instinct to take down even dragon with ease, they are also deft builder and industrious on the ground making large nest to live in that are both cheap et durable if of limited comfort. griffon tend to pursue material wealth a bit too much and do not handle disrespect well this sadly predispose them to banditry and raiding. but do know that if a group of griffin find a strong charismatic leader to turn this pride and interest of wealth to constructive pursuit you will have a honorable, prosperous and loyal force of good. 
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=2.2m
small=2.7m
average=3m
tall=3.5m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-griffin fury: a griffon is a dangerous thing to corner, when pushed to the limit a griffon will lose any sense pain, it will also become more determined and violent. this fury will persist until the griffon is allowed to retreat or the threat is dispatched. this also come with a constitution boost that almost garanti a griffon will no die from minor wounds and blood loss after the effect ends. 

-diving ace: during dive a griffon perception of time dilate allowing them more time to think and react to their surrounding, target or even pursuer  this does not speed up their whole body only their mind and eyes but work even on very short dive. a dive is any action where the griffon close is wing more than halfway or actively speeding up while aiming to the closest gravity well capable of moving it.

the drawback is:

-the razor's edge: the griffon race as a whole tend to part wildly between lawful and chaotic, good and evil from individual to individual, this make them untrustworthy in the eye of many other races and even the other griffon who look at each others with suspicion and wariness this limit griffon to small solitary but tightly knit group unless an highly charismatic and competent griffon appear to unite them in a common belief, for better or worst.

objects.title: Hippogriff
objects.text:
Hippogriff are very averse to violence preferring retreat and the evasion of conflict, even when they are the wronged party. despite that an Hippogriff will happily march to battle for an ally that earned its trust.  Hippogriff are graceful flyers and that is both in battle and daily life, a hippogriff rather than focusing on the efficient flight of a Pegasus, the predatory flight of a griffon or the domineering flight of a dragon will instead dance across the sky with swift and sharp -albeit short- turn, dive and rise while easily dodging any retaliation. of course the reason Hippogriff rarely get into conflict is because they also have the mean of turning into a Seapony, this form allow them to do all they would usually do but in the safety of the deep sea rather than the open sky, its a tremendous advantage as no other sentient races on my worlds developed under water aside a very, very small amount of sea serpent. in the end Hippogriff are generally easy going and pretty chill, they are almost all artists, performers, singers and so much more. For them life true meaning is to live peacfully and make the whole world a little more beautiful, one day at a time. 
 
height at maturity: 

tiny=2.2m
small=2.6m
average=2.9m
tall=3.3m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-beautiful evermore: Hippogriff are considered beautiful by all races, this is because the spirit of arts blessed them, this show by them having a supernatural mastery in: makeup, posture, mane styling/dressing, coat/skin care, hoof/claw care along with them always having the best aesthetical bit of both parents and complete psychical symmetry facial feature included. they also look young all the way to the their last few years of life.

-vocal virtuoso in marvelous motion: of all the arts Hippogriff are above all master of singing and dancing, an hippogriff dancer in motion is a thing a pure beauty to behold, an Hippogriff singer vocalizing will make your skin tingle and hair rise with every high notes as for an Hippogriff doing both at the same time? they are momentary wonders and all life around will stop all they are doing to witness it. from insect to predator all will be silent and their eyes glued the Hippogriff even after the performance the witness will for a time bask in the recent memory and stay peacefully at rest, the more competent in singing and dancing the more potent and long lasting the effect.

the drawback is:

-artistic imperative: Hippogriff are not good at making efficient, fit for purpose design in anything, they will always add decorative component to anything they make. from statue on buildings to poetry in science reports or even a few artful dancing moves while scooting an area. Hippogriff of all statut and during every job will perform some art and will strongly encourage any non-Hippogriff coworkers to do the same, in the end having Hippogriff work somewhere will both make the place more beautiful and enjoyable to work in but also reduce productivity.

objects.title: kirin
objects.text:
the kirin have a small population and are at first glance very reserved but are once they open up a passionate bunch, very lively and downright motormouh. some think they are the mixed offspring of a pony and a dragon but they are actually descendant of unicorn that got separated from the main wave of settlers when they left the valley of the sun to move to what is now called Equestria, those stranded unicorn adapted to living near the Dragonlands by growing scales, becoming bigger and physically stronger on average as well one of the main feature of the kirin which they call "the inner fire not-so-much inner anymore when my neighbor make a ruckus but what can i say  i like my silence and-blah blah blah.", as i said motormouth the lot of them. this "inner fire" appear when a kirin grow too passionate and turn them into demonic looking fire kirin with a burst of flames and ignite mane and tail into an inferno all rounded up with glowing eyes, in this form the kirin can breath fire ignore any common form of heat changes and cannot be burned they also become a lot more commanding and authoritative downright dominant. but here the kicker, a single bucket of water snuff this transformation out and return them to calm and a bit bashful for the loss of their cool. kirin are still capable of unicorn magic but have gained the ability o regrow their horn at the cost of them becoming more like wood and growing at all time and requiring trimming which is unpleasant, the ever changing horn shape and length also cause them trouble with spells practice requiring more consistency like enchantement and healing.

height at maturity: 

tiny=2.2m
small=2.6m
average=2.9m
tall=3.3m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-burning love: a kirin in love can ignite in a fire that does not burn said loved one, instead shielding them and burning away disease and curses, it is said this ability was developed when the first kirin lost their access to easy healing magic and a terrible plague befall them. its not, its just how the dragon-flavored magic comming from the Dragonland and seeped into them over generation shaped itself to preserve what those kirin valued most: their very few kirin kin. 

-kirin scale: kirin can sniff out a scam a mile away, that as well as betrayal, lies and in fact injustice of all kind. kirin are fervent believer in karma and are more than capable of helping the scale of said karma be righted. they are skilled judge lawyer and prosecutor, their skill with the spoken word and written law is unrivaled and while they tend to blabber and speak a lot to tell nothing of value in their free time when justice call for it a kirin is a masterful orator. this come from their often damaging burst of anger, those require kirin to be honest with their feelings and maintaining a society when any ressentiment can cause property damage in a cascading disaster tend to make one a fervent follower of the written law and inclined toward honesty to prevent bad blood from forming.

the drawback is:

-forced isolationist: kirin are immune to their own fire as well the the flames of other kirin -or any other flames not fueled by entropy-, not so much the other species on this list, even dragon can be burned by kirin flames if the kirin is mad enough. this mean that a kirin living in a non kirin settlement is a moving fire hazard and living in a kirin settlement is like walking amongst fire hazard that move all around you and might ignite at any inconvenience. this lead to kirin being often asked to both keep at a minimum distance from others species or to make their own house a distance from any Neighbors this also cause trouble for relationship with non kirin who might not really thrust the "burning love" of the interested kirin or worst count on it even when the kirin isn't interested, sadly while even my most pushy creation are less pushy than any pushy human ever was some still get burned for the trouble.

objects.title: Pegasus pony
objects.text:
Pegasus pony are master the of the skies not because they are the best flying species -though Pegasus pony do earn the title of best flyer every few generation- but because of how they shine in all  aspect related to the skies,  they are some of the best in flight both short and long range, some of the best in weather manipulation fine and large scales, some of the best navigator no matter what lies beneath their wings be it land or sea, and with all those combined the only species to truly live life into the sky, among the cloud that serve as their home. 

height at maturity: 

tiny=1.4m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-born amongst the heaven: a Pegasus in flight cannot ever lose its way for it is always home, a Pegasus pony will always find what it seek when looking at the world below no matter the distances and always know whoever share its sky in a large radius around itself in spite of any kind of stealth.

-beloved of the sky: Pegasus are never hurt by weather phenomenon they may be tossed around even loose control but they will always survive the fall with no crippling wounds for the sky love them beyond  measure, further more they can easily turn those weather toward their own goal for a storm wind will send them ever onward their destination and the rain quench their thirst as it come and astray cloud wait for them to sleep on when tiredness arrive.

the drawback is: 

-like dust in the winds: Pegasus pony were never meant to settle themselves elsewhere than their clouds made homes and become fragile on the solid ground and the longer they stay on contact with the ground the weaker its perk become, this doesn't happen when on things who themselves rest on cloud but anything set anywhere else will also -if more slowly- sap the perks powers (such as tree and roof) and it will take a few minutes of flight for them to regrow to full power.

objects.title: shadow pony
objects.text:
shadow ponies while looking similar to unicorn are actually an opposite to it as one of the races that can use dark magic with almost no mental corruption in fact they are capable of growing their immunity to it over time till complete resistance to it. their specialty is as you probably guessed shadow magic a versatile if weak magic on its own that when used by shadow ponies grow tremendously in potency, this affinity come from the shadow ponies ancestry being related to Umbrum, shadow spirit that once tried to upheaval the natural order of some of my world. this connection to the Umbrum lead to them having a more curved horn than unicorn and a more predatory appearance including fangs and more of a furry hide than a coat. their weakness is that they are lethally vulnerable to spirit and divine magic.

height at maturity: 

tiny=2.6m
small=2.7m
average=3m
tall=3.3m
gigantic=4.5m

the perks are:

-shadow born: a shadow pony is not fully made of flesh and can repair or even reconstruct limbs or their horn and non vital organs by gathering shadow nearby, this can also be used to "bulk up" by absorbing excess shadow to renforce the physical attribute of the shadow pony; this also allow minor flight by partially dispersing into shadow and can even mimic teleportation by dispersing and reforming somewhere else, this incorporeal state greatly increase the shadow pony weakness to light. 

-encroaching darkness: a shadow pony can -in a twisted mirror of a unicorn- generate magic in the surrounding area to absorb and replenish their own store but in this case they generate unnatural shadow they then absorb through their body to empower either their magic or body with the main difference being that shadow pony can contrary to unicorn still cast other spells while doing so,  in exchange focused light and even strong wind can disperse those shadow and that the dispersion of those shadows while they are being absorbed inflict pain if not damages on the shadow pony.

the drawback is:

-shadow constitution: shadow ponies are half flesh half shadow they are as such weakened greatly in both too bright environment and in an ironic twist completely dark ones as they require shadow not complete darkness to truly bring their power to bear. in addition direct focused light can hurt and even kill them.

objects.title: thestral
objects.text:
thestral otherwise called bat pony are nocturnal equivalent to the Pegasus and have all the good trait of regular bat like echolocation and anesthetic saliva but none of the disadvantage like blindness. as the smallest and most adorable of the ponies subtype they sleep hanging by their tail have cute tuft of hair on their ears and chest and will make adorable squee at the sight of a juicy mango! they also happen to be the biggest meat eaters of the pony the other being capable of eating meat but preferring an herbivores diet this difference led to them developing fangs and a less fearful instinctual reaction to blood in general. seriously though thestral are very good scouts and stealth units as well as spies able to stake out a targets for hours and in complete darkness. 

height at maturity: 

tiny=1m
small=1.3m
average=1.5m
tall=1.7m
gigantic=2.8m

the perks are:

-red diet: thestral enjoy meat and this show in their strong body, despite being smaller than all other pony subtype thestral are generally three time stronger than they look, easily capable of splitting tree in half with their back hooves, their wings can also prove to be deadly weapon considering the clawed tips and the strong muscles moving them.

-night blessed: thestral are in their element in the dark of the night and it show, when it is night thestral are faster stronger and more focused and attentive, delaying any exhaustion and fatigue for once the sun start rising this mean that during the night thestral are technically inexhaustible, but when the day come around a thestral that pushed itself too far will drop like a rock and sleep that much longer and deeper.  

the drawback is:

-cold's embrace: thestral hate the cold, their large naked wing mean the cold seep the heat out of them quickly and this rapidly can cause frostbite as such they tend to shirk cold places and high altitude instead flying low and living in warm climate. this make them weak to weather magic making them lackluster in it and forcing them to live on the ground where they are more likely to be targeted by ground bound threats.

objects.title: unicorn
objects.text:
unicorn pony -once adult- can through their horn manipulate magic much more freely than almost all other races but this come at a cost, contrary to all other ponies unicorn have no instinctive feel of their magic and must instead learn to use it by themselves. a unicorn pony feel for magic hardly ever work for another, sure standardized spell are easy to learn but freeform magic also call spell crafting is a whole other can of worm, worst yet it is highly dangerous for a unicorn horn is both a focus and a mean of channeling magic and a wrongly cast spell can fail explosively. if you are lucky around your horn if not inside, the moment said spell fail the horn shatter and a broken horn lose all capacity for fine casting and is only able to release very wild and destructive spell. but if a unicorn take the time to learn and familiarize itself with its own magic its power grow exponentially as the more time a unicorn pony successfully cast spells the more robust its horn grow and the more potent its core -the source of its magic- become allowing for more daring experimentation and longer training session. an old unicorn pony is a force that can challenge armies by itself.

height at maturity: 

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-star touched: unicorn pony where touched by the star of magic itself, this mean that from the moment they are born they are guaranteed genius level compréhension of at least one basic magical practice amongst: safe telekinesis, small scale transfiguration, small item conjuration, self teleportation or self shielding. this genius can and will stretch toward understanding of the  advanced, expert and even master level standard spell connected to the chosen magical practice through  pursued study and training but will not offer assistance for spell crafting above advanced.    

-endless well of magic: unicorn pony can perceive magic much more clearly than other races and its show contrary to most other species who are bound to the natural and passive recovery of their magic unicorn have the unique ability to not only absorb magic consciously to replenish their own store but to do so from nothing, unicorn can slowly and with great concentration freely generate magic in their surrounding and slowly guide it through their horn to their core for storage and use, this ability become contrary to expectation more potent with a broken horn. this task require the complet inactivity of a unicorn core and cannot be done while casting, channeling or supplying spells in any way shape and form.

the drawback is: 

-the endless abyss: unicorn pony are at all time, all their lives aware that should they fall to temptation even once the fall will be quick and the landing most likely fatal. A unicorn who start using dark magic will almost instantly become trapped into a viscous cycle that only a third party can free it from. dark magic is a potent cancerous infection that spread eagerly onto whoever it get a hold of and sadly the gift for magic unicorn have been born with also make them the more vulnerable to it, mind you all species not born to use it can fall to dark magic and all will be made lesser by it for a time after freeing themselves from it but to unicorn it is a most foul poison one that corrode their mind and corrupt their heart so quickly and strongly that there is no hope of the unicorn freeing itself from it alone.

objects.title: yaks
objects.text:
yaks are good at three things in particular, breaking stuff when mildly displeased, building beautiful and robust woodworks, and standing up for their friend and allies. yaks are simple, straightforward as well as brutally honest they are the most confortable in cold places, can endure but never relish being wet. they are master woodworker but happily break it on a moments notice absolutely certain they can make it just as good if not better again right after and that the cold land they inhabit can always use more firewood. they see fighting as a good way to keep the blood warm and flowing but look down on brutality and cruelty. one of the more violence inclined of my creation. (also drink alcohol by the pints almost every meal.)

height at maturity: 

tiny=2.5m
small=2.9m
average=3.6m
tall=4.3m
gigantic=5m

the  perks are:

-träarbetare: yaks are skilled woodworker they have a strong affinity with working with it that allow them to shape it into work of arts with an otherworldly ease, those works beat the test of time as well lasting for centuries with ease and this is why it is often the targets of yak assault as its the only way to make room for new creation of younger yaks eager to contribute to the rich woodworking history of the yaks.

- brutal revelry: yaks celebration are wild and filled with alcohol, friendly bout of violence and very loud noise. yet the next morning yaks wake up with the sun and get to work with no troubles or loss of productivity. come the dusk they will celebrate the hard work of the day being done in a massive party and yet again not face any consequences on the morrow. Yaks are impossible to drink under the table impossible to put down with a good time and will never let any form of enjoyment stop them from doing of their work the next day, nothing.

the drawback is:

-hair trigger: yaks get loudly angry very easily. simple as that, it does not make you more angry nor does it make you more likely to hurt others you jus start screaming and hitting things -not others- almost the moment something tick you off. does make you out to be a bit immature and lacking in self control.

objects.title: zebra
objects.text:
zebra are similar to earth pony but lack the strength and constitution part instead they have stronger connection to the spiritual world they use the wild spirit of magic help's to make potion and alchemical concoction as well as perform shamanism and voodoo ritual to their purpose. they in exchange protect and preserve the land in which those spirit live and prosper. zebra are connected deeply to the spiritual world and while their power are borrowed regular use and good relation with the spirit can see them earn and develop their own spiritual form with which to influence the world and power their craft with. 

height at maturity: 

tiny=1m
small=1.6m
average=1.8m
tall=2.3m
gigantic=3m

the perks are:

-spiritual attention: the spirit pay closer attention to zebra than other races, this make it more likely for zebra to earn their favor and increase the zebra chance of making a connection with said spirit, this also make zebra more successful in awakening new spirit from area filled with wild magic.

-stripped charisma: zebra have a unique aura and mystical presence to them, this stem from the spirits often gathering around them and give their words and action more weight to magical beings. to the untrained this pressure cause unease and sometime even fear and to the magical practitioner this incite respect and reverence in proportion to the amount of spirit willingly following the zebra.

the drawback is:

-the wrong kind of attention: not all spirits are benevolent some were twisted by the corruption of their home and the twisting of their mind by dark magic and event, those spirit can attempt to possess vulnerable being and zebra are more vulnerable to this than other races due to their affinity with spirit magic. a zebra need to train from young age to build strong mental fortitude and self control so as to prevent possession, this also mean they require daily meditation to maintain this inner control or strong emotion will give twisted spirit an opening.

rows.title: Faust menagerie
rows.titleText:
now that you are done with "the basics" its time to move on to you new race. 

I know i said earlier that i would make you one of my pony but it was more a figure of speech, i also have plenty of non-pony races for you to pick from!

i mean human are okay but what i have in store for you is just wild, i mean isn't it a human that once said: "Always be yourself. Unless you can be a dragon. Then always be a dragon." 

well i got more than dragon right here, each with perks and traits -and a drawbacks inherent to the races- and you get to pick!

Each species have unique upgrades or "traits" you can take as well for a few more points, those are either "rare trait" seen amongst less than 10% of the race population and "unique"(not literally they are just so rare that the list of creature having them is only around one digit.) still all traits where found on exceptional individual of that chosen species or very rare mutations.

you can pick up to two races and become an hybride, in this case you get all perks and all drawbacks.

remember there are some hidden species only accessible by taking specific races.

objects.title: Personify.
objects.text:
*sigh* Alright fine, but i warned you, sure Draconequus when they have mastered their concept are far more powerful than even Alicorn, but there is a reason so few of them are around. Most never reach this stage and even when they do they often suffer from the combinaison of getting into conflict with others because of their "quirky" way of living and their "existential imperative" mean they have many enemies and a constant unmitigable weakness that can unmake them instantly no matter how powerful they become.

This "Achilles hills" mean that draconequus are always a sort of "glass canon" at the higher level of powers.

objects.title: spirit of: productivity.
objects.text:
As a draconequus you will hold the concept of productivity, the concept of how much output can be produced with a given set of inputs. 

You can as such influence how much result an action taken as, to both increase or reduce it. 

but also swap the needed input or the result of an input. like changing the needed fuel of a diesel car to water or to swap the liquide pouring out from a underground water source to wine. 

As long as it relate to producing something you can influence it.

Remember that i said that your "concept" would affect you as well over time, it was not a figure of speech, each concept come with a "mental influence" that can be endured and resisted with just will and as no tangible consequence for doing so aside discomfort and an "existential imperative" you have to follow or start to fade away over time. 

Mental influence: You become restless when you are not being productive, you feel the need to optimize and streamline any project or activities you take part in and seeing other being lazy let alone being so yourself so upset you. 

Imperative: You need to always at least have one or more projects in the work at all time and to work on said projects at least 4 hours a day, 4 days a week. 

Any failure to meet this quota will have any missing hours added to a tab of sort that you will have to catch up to  during your free time, more than a 100 hours on the tab and you fade away.

objects.title: spirit of: success.
objects.text:
As a draconequus you will hold the concept of success, the concept of accomplishment of an aim or purpose.

You can influence how successful someone or a task is, either through luck or sudden bout of inspiration or burst of skill. 

you can also influence the "degree" of a success, making a triumph of a participation trophée.  

Remember that i said that your "concept" would affect you as well over time, it was not a figure of speech, each concept come with a "mental influence"  and an "existential imperative" you have to follow. 

Mental influence: You are very competitive and a sore loser, simple as that. Defeat in any contest or refusing a contest make you upset and frustrated.

Imperative: You cannot lose against anyone more than 3 time in a row, if you do you fade away but any win will break the streak and allow you up to two loss again.

objects.title: spirit of: information.
objects.text:
