As a draconequus you will hold the concept of information, the concept of facts provided or learned about something or someone.

You can perceive and catch any information being shared as if it was floating in the air, both gaining it for yourself and stopping it in its way to the intended receiver. 

you can also at any time information is lost, as in it was known by a sapient being and then all who know this information died, you somehow recall the information out of nowhere.  


Remember that i said that your "concept" would affect you as well over time, it was not a figure of speech, each concept come with a "mental influence"  and an "existential imperative" you have to follow. 

Mental influence: You are curious to the point of recklessness and anyone keeping secret from you make you upset. 

You also feel the urge to share any information you have into any subject to others, you also dislike any information you provide to be ignored or rejected.  

Imperative: Every years any "false" information you share and learn is added up and compared to all the "true" information you shared and learned, if the false outnumber the right you fade away.

objects.title: spirit of: communication.
objects.text:
As a draconequus you will hold the concept of productivity

Remember that i said that your "concept" would affect you as well over time, it was not a figure of speech, each concept come with a "mental influence"  and an "existential imperative" you have to follow. 

Mental influence: You feel the need to listen to others opinion and consider them fairly, you also get upset when anyone cut off someone else or refuse to listen to an argument.

Imperative: You need to talk to at least a 100 different peoples a month and at least one need to be a new acquaintance. if not, you fade away.

objects.title: spirit of: perfection.
objects.text:
As a draconequus you will hold the concept of productivity, 

Remember that i said that your "concept" would affect you as well over time, it was not a figure of speech, each concept come with a "mental influence"  and an "existential imperative" you have to follow. 

Mental influence: You feel upset when something you did or made fail to meet expectation, you also get upset when you are forced to use less ressource and time than initially intended for a task.

Imperative: You need to make one "perfect action" -no matter how small- every day or fade away.

objects.title: spirit of: surprise.
objects.text:
As a draconequus you will hold the concept of productivity, 

Remember that i said that your "concept" would affect you as well over time, it was not a figure of speech, each concept come with a "mental influence"  and an "existential imperative" you have to follow. 

Mental influence: You feel upset when predicted or manipulated, in fact you greatly dislike routine and schedules as a whole unless it to set up surprise. 

Imperative: You need to jump-scare at least 1 person a day or fade away.

rows.title: special race: draconequus
rows.titleText:
Wait, how did that get here?! *cough* i mean, draconequus! draconequus are not really living being instead they are a concept given form, one made of at least 4 and up to 10 other animal races.

Concept are similar to the alicorn domains but are more powerful, where an alicorn with the domain of growth could make plants or even see her skill at anything they do grow faster, a draconequus with the concept of growth could do think like make the economy "grow" generating prosperity out of seemingly nowhere or the average moral baseline "grow" making others better beings or more spirited and so on.

Off course it come at the price of the concept influencing the draconequus to the point of being crippling or even cause death unless they embody their concept properly.

The draconequus of chaos discord -and the one in the picture- cannot for exemples act in an orderly manner and must use roundabout way to accomplish anything.

This is no challenge most of the time considering how powerful draconequus tend to be but it does crop up from time to time , taking discord as an example once again, he cannot grant " immortality" like most beings conceptualize it, the whole ageless undying unchanging thing being too much of a constant and so anathema to the chaos concept.

As such he cannot do it the expected way but if he make someone capable of coming back to life after death as a random race and that form happen to be at a random age from foal to prime even with the soul and all memories preserved intact in all lives it is technically "immortality" but random enough that the chaotic concept can pull it of. 

In addition, the convoluted way their concept interact with core aspects most fields of magic rely on or are based upon mean only "spirit magic" can reliably be used by a draconequus.

By adding a degree of sentience to their spell to "correct" any "glitch". Any other fields of magic are best cast through spirit magic and tend to "deviate" or fail completely when used by a draconequus directly.  

There are also three thing that cannot be done by draconequus:

First is making other draconequus, instead draconequus offspring are the race of their partners and let me be blunt draconequus are never compatible or get along as more than friends, they always find the other too overbearing to get along with -also i oversee all draconequus creation-. 

The second is making alicorn, because alicorn can reproduce the fun way and i don't really need a draconequus to flood the omniverse with them. Also it would be bothersome to keep track of too divinities. 

The final thing is kill directly through their concept, yep even the draconequus of lets say "destruction" can't just kill you and must instead rely on other mean at least 3 time removed from their last action or influence to do so. 

The reason for that is because i keep the concept of death in my realities safely under my control and separated from any other domain or concept to keep it out of anyone reach.

Even the hunting or war domain and concept don't have the permission to pull from the death domain and concept to kill another instantly.

This come with the advantage that no action you take will ever lead to instant death unless you make a massive, long lasting mess with lot of unforeseeable consequences down the line.

Concept are powerful things which can cause catastrophe of unimageable scale unless properly managed and as such i can't in good conscience let you pick freely but i can provide you a list of concept to pick from.

objects.title: fanciful plumage. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Bird folk history is filled with daring rogue and extraordinary duelist, the common points of those was their flair, charisma and their tendency for taunting others.

With this trait you get the first, this trait amplify your beauty and shroud your fault in relation to how other conceptualized it.

Simply put other notices what they would like about you a hundred time more and what they would dislike a hundred time less. 

This affect everything through all medium but progressively lose effectiveness the more someone interact with you personally.

The trait effects will completely dissipate in about 48 hours worth of one on one conversation and will never regenerate once lost.

still first impression are kind of a big deal and if you don't intend to stay around to interact with others this power is technically endless on them, quite the boon to craft your  legend and positive reputation.

objects.title: en guarde! (rare trait)
objects.text:
Bird folk history is filled with daring rogue and extraordinary duelist, the common points of those was their flair and charisma and their tendency for taunting others, with this trait you gain the second and when you challenge someone you just know how to make it personal. 

When you challenge someone in public with this trait the target has an almost imperative need to agree and face you one on one. (this does not compel other nearby to not interfere.)

During a duel the two of you can trade banter as well as taunts and whichever overwhelm the other in the verbal joust get progressively more skilled and physically boosted.

this bonus is tied to whoever you face and disappear when the duel is interrupted or finished but reappear instantly and at whatever balance it was during the last duel should a new one happen with the same individual.

Beware, this trait does not make you more skilled at banter and taunting.

objects.title: at home in distant skies. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Airship are to the bird folk what fire is to humanity, a vital part of their very existences, this trait give you the knowledge of how to craft, upgrade and maintain those wonders of the skies, all sizes, shapes and function be it a civilian or military vessel. From a corvette or a sloop to a man o'war or an aircraft carrier. 

It also grant you the full knowledge of how to captain an airship to the highest level, with you in command any airship will fly through battle and tempest unchallenged no matter the odds and weather.

you also find that living on an airship now prevent all form of depression and  grant a significant bonus to any activities you perform on board.

objects.title: bird of wealth. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Some bird folk have a knack for collecting wealth, those with this trait have a sort of sixth sense for making money while either "adventuring" or trading and always seem to make a profit in their venture, this effect beneficiate greatly from having a larger starting capital but is still noticeable even when starting from scraps. 

on average a bird folk make 60 to 70 percent more profits through trades and exploratory venture than any other race.

objects.title: locked in. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Some bird folk can at will focus their entire being on an opponent, when they does so feinting, parrying or even blocking the bird folk in combat become almost impossible let alone scoring a hit back. 

In this state the bird folk is aware of everything about its opponent, its physical capacity, its stance, its mental state, its movement and more and along this come the ability to predict their every possible movements and reacting to them instantly.

This is also easy to maintain even against a more skilled opponent but rapidly grow more taxing to maintain if:

-The speed gap grow too wide.
-The opponent's body is particularly fluid (shapeshifting) 
-The enemy has area of effect attacks.

Anything else and the bird folk can generally get a standoff at worst.

it can also become a liability against multiple enemies at once or if someone else sneak attack you as you will have no awareness of anything aside your locked in opponent.

objects.title: carrion bird. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Bird folk are generally of the "Psittaciformes" or "parrot" type but their was once a "Corvidae" or  "crow/raven" type, those bird folk did not go extinct as much as "moved beyond life".

 This trait grant you their unique ability to physically interact with the non-living and talk with the dead, the greatest use of this power is the ability to bind a soul to an item, the item become the soul new body and render the item alive in a way, ever seen the furniture from the beauty and the beast? well you can make all the items like that by shoving a beings soul in it.

Its in a way resurrection but not really as the being is still technically dead as such its more assisted possession.

also those are the limitation of it:

-you can only interact with a soul that hasn't moved on or by calling upon them at their graves or bodies.
-you cannot bind soul to organic matter.
-you cannot bind soul to object bigger than a castle.
 -you do not gain any authority over the bound soul.
-the item have a sense of touch but does not feel pain.
-if the item is damaged too much the soul is expulsed from it with no harm.
-the item does not need but can sleep but cannot eat or reproduce.(obviously)

objects.title: fairy swarm.(rare trait)
objects.text:
With how small breezie are you would probably expect the breezie to be fragile and powerless against other larger race and you would be just as mistaken as all who fell to the breezie "swarm leader".

while a handful of breezie are powerless to the slightest stray winds the more numerous and the more tightly grouped the more stable and controlled their flight and for all that they are small and weak like most species their biting muscle are the strongest in their bodies. 

while it is rare, when breezie are oppressed and denied pollen for too long breezie will begin swarming and hunt down those who wronged them.

those swarm form around swarm leader who empower all nearby breezy into an invulnerable rabid cloud of teeth that can tear apart almost anything but the swarm leader are both the source and weakness of said swarm, if the swarm leader is killed or separated from the swarm  said swarm empowerment collapse.

This trait make you a swarm leader and help you form, control and be part of those swarm like the best swarm leader ever born.

objects.title: fairy trail.(rare trait)
objects.text:
Ever noticed how many hero have fairy as guide/advisor in story? well breezie are very similar to that in my world. they are often old and well traveled so knowledgeable, that make them good companion on a daring quest. 

What is less obvious is that the breezie that go on said adventure are those few among them that also have a minor form of psychometry and the ability to understand the speech of all species including the insect living in whatever forgotten ruin no one explored ever, explain how well informed breezie then appear to be to whatever hero they are following.

this trait grant you those same abilities and a knack for playing the funny -if sometime annoying- tagalong to any would be hero you chose to follow.

objects.title: Whimsycap mushroom.
objects.text:
While breezie live in a giant fruit tree they also cultivate mushroom as their main food, those mushroom are grown from the rotten remain of sacred fruit like the peels.

those mushroom always taste like what you want to eat at the moment you bite into it and are healthy enough to sustain yourself on them alone. 

They can also be made into a trio of potent drugs:

-"Adoribus" is made of the mushroom cap and cause those that eat it to shrink to the size of an average breezy for a minute per gram eaten. they remain as strong, fast, tough or any other aspects as they were at their original size.

-"Delightify" is made of the stem and make those who consume it to fall into a deep slumber and dream of their greatest hidden desire, one minute for each gram consumed.

-"Transmogulate" is made of the spore and can change the races of those who consume it for one minute per gram, this work on all races and for all races aside ascended one. they gain/loses all perk and drawback as they change races.

Those drugs are a closely guarded secret among the breezie and are very hard to make, with this trait you both know how to make them but also have a 100% success rate at making them.

objects.title: the veil.(rare traits)
objects.text:
Just like for changeling the insectoid appearance of most breezie form can make peoples uncomfortable but contrary to changeling breezie do not have the ability to shapeshift to fit into the crowd, at least not all of them. 

Some breezie have a sort of glamour that can hide their apparence, this disguise only work on sentient life and not through camera or picture and is only visual but contrary to changeling this disguise does not restrain them at all, even while looking like a earth pony a spider breezie can weave a web around someone their limbs unnoticeable even right in front of someone or even move around the room as long as at least one body part stay wherever you glamour's head is supposed to be. 

this tend to make those breezie even more uncanny to others races than changeling though.

objects.title: fair-ish contract.(rare trait)
objects.text:
As said in their description the existence of the breezie is a miracle and this miraculous existence come for a rare few breezie with the ability to rewrite reality at a small scale, this power can grant minor wish but since this power stem from the miracle of their existence granting said wish diminish them.

Simply put a breezie lose one centimeter of size for every wish granted all the way to being erased, on the other hand, you can gain centimeters up to your original height by having someone give you:

-their presence: erasing them from everyone memories.
-their identity: changing their gender and race irreversibly.
-their talent: whatever they were the best at they are now the worst and vice versa.
-their time: turn them into a toddler or an elderly, their lifespan is unchanged.
their life: they cannot bear or sire children.

Both of the con-tracte parties must be willing for the contract to work and only a basic breezie can grant wishes, lost height need to be regained for a breezie to change shape again.

objects.title: hollow king.(unique traits)
objects.text:
in wilds beyond they speak your name with reverence and regret,
For none could tame our savage souls yet you the challenge met,
Under palest watch, you taught, you changed, base instincts were redeemed,
A world you gave to bug and beast as they had never dreamed.

Amongst all breezie the tale of the pale king is the first story they are taught
and the one they venerate the most. 

the pale king was the one who made the breezie, said to be born from a common insect egg yet like no other insect ever seen, he traveled the world seeking other like him, insect with a mind beyond savage survival. 

He gathered the few (alike yet so much lesser) of them amongst every insect and arachnide of the world along with a seed from every fruit tree and then bound all of it to is own existence.

He forged a realm from is very soul and dispersed out is mind as a dream of sentience to is kin their body once so beastly and feral changed to the breezie we know today. the seed sprouted and grew as one singular tree feeding of the husk that was the pale king body and so the breezie were born. All that is left of the pale king is the breezie race.

This trait make you the same kind of being as the pale king, you are the hollow king of the breezie and all breezie will be compelled to obey you.(the title is king no matter your gender.)

you can freely change among all breezie's forms and no longer need sacred fruits or to die to do so, if you die you die for good but returning to the breezie realm is now possible everywhere, instantaneous and doing so heal your body, mind and soul completely.

rows.title: breezie traits

objects.title: the endless march.(rare trait)
objects.text:
Buffalos stampede are  said to fuel the very cycle of day and night and time as a whole, while this is not completely true it does have an effect on some buffalos perception of it. When they are in motion those buffalos can either accelerate or slow down their perception of time to instant or standstill. 

Ever seen a movie scene from a speedster point of view? where everything is almost standing still? that is what they can do. they can also pass time like a game character by just going on a short walk.   

This does not make your body faster but can be used in short burst and at will as long as you are in motion and can be used to do repetitive task like workout without getting bored or distracted since it will be over in an instant from you point of view.

(you are still perfectly aware of your surrounding even when your perception of time move faster.)

objects.title: the ancestors mark.(rare trait)
objects.text:
As the buffalos travel many of the older ones dies along the way and are buried wherever they fell, yet their memory and life is not forgotten instead a simple post is built over their grave and it become a fixed waypoint for any future stampede. Some buffalos chaman can use those grave pole to travel instantly to any other grave poll they know of no matter the distance.

With this trait you can now build those pole with just a few drop of blood as cost and travel with them, you cannot carry anyone along with you and only bring about your own weight in item with every fast travel.

Whatever poll you depart from is turned off and require you to return to it in person to reactivate it.

objects.title: initiation rites. (rare trait)
objects.text:
While the buffalos are a tight knitted kind they openly welcome those that are willing to follow their rites, they can through rite attune any other species to their own way of life and share their perks (and the drawback) with other races.
in exchange the buffalos also receive the perk (but not the drawbacks) of the new member though its potency is divided amongst all buffalos in the tribe so to have a 100% of the perks benefits you need to have as many of another race in the tribe as their are buffalos, a tribe is required and a group of buffalos is considered a tribe from 5 members and up.

objects.title: the rainbow crow's blessing.(unique trait)
objects.text:
Let me tell you a story,

Long ago, when the buffalo first treaded the earth, the cold season were harsh and unforgiving. But the buffalo traveled anyway, believing the winter would soon give way to spring. When it did not, the buffalo stubbornly kept running to preserve their way of life, no matter how hungry they became.

During one of their stampedes, the early buffalo met the  lonely Rainbow Crow whose bright color and melodious song isolated her from her kindred, the buffalo welcomed her amongst them as a friend and honored member of the herd for her beautiful song lifted the buffalo's spirits and whose rainbow wings would shine bright as she danced into the frail light of the winter days. The buffalo stamped sadly was stopped when a blizzard came and the relentless snow was at risk of killing them all and so they beseeched the Rainbow Crow to bring them warmth from the sun. The rainbow crow loyal to those that took her in departed for a long six-day journey to the sun and back, she sang to the sun her most beautiful song and danced her brightest dance and was granted as reward the sun's flames, the Rainbow Crow flew the sun's fire to the buffalo even as it burned all around her. 

the smoke and soot of the fire caused her feathers to turn black and damaged her singing voice with her every breath yet her loyalty would not allow her to fail and heedless of the cost to herself the Rainbow Crow brought the flame to the buffalo, the sun's fire melted the snow, and the buffalo were saved.

As tribute to the Rainbow Crow's generosity, loyalty and kindness every year the buffalo set fire to one of her shed feathers as part of a ceremony to welcome spring and dedicate the spring to the rainbow crow.

this trait is both a gift and responsibility, every spring you must burn a single crow's feather into a pyre and pay your thanks to the rainbow crow, in doing so a rainbow crow (a fragment of the ascended being she became.) will appear and follow you for the rest of the year until winter ends, impervious to any harm and restrain she is capable of fetching and bringing to you anything she can carry no matter the distance and place. this include concept and metaphysical items, yes even the sun's flame; moonlight or even time. whether you can use such thing depend on your own abilities, if not such things can have unpredictable effect on the world around them so be careful what you ask for.

the rarer and the more potent the things you tell her to bring you are the longer it will take her to do so but never more than six days, earthly distances and obstacles on the other hand have no impact so most mundane local items are always instantaneous.

rows.title: buffalos traits

objects.title: physiological instinct. (rare trait)
objects.text:
This trait allow you to redistribute your physicals attribute around your immediate need instantly and automatically if wanted.

Your strength go up and dexterity go down when you land a hit maximizing damage, your dexterity go up and strength go down when dodging ensuring maximum chance of success. This work on all physical attribute like strength, dexterity and endurance but not intelligence and magical potency. 

This cost no magic and can be turned on and off.

objects.title: armor of disdain. (rare trait)
objects.text:
As a centaur grow in power beyond their need, the surrounding grow weaker beyond tolerable and so many beings will come to challenge said centaur and restore harmony to the area.

This trait is one that appear in centaur that have ruled for many years and fought -and defeated- countless challengers and learned through experience that renown is more often than not a façade and that the true threat come from the unknown wildcard. 

This trait make it that the more well know a challenger is the harder it is for them to hurt you. On the other hand the less well known a challenger is the more your defense grow thin.

(this cannot negate an attack nor reduce you defense by more than 50%.)

objects.title: gluttonous trinket. (rare trait)
objects.text:
While centaur can absorb the magical core of regular races easily, core from ascended races are another matter. Yet a special kind of tool were once forged to assist in doing so.

 those tool were called "glutenous trinket" and would weaken the hold a being wearing them had on their magical core making stealing it easier. Those trinket also worked in reverse for centaur making it easier for the centaur wearing them to keep hold of the cores stolen using said trinket. 

the downside was that relying on the trinket made centaur less capable of holding onto core stolen without the trinket and that the trinket had to be worn willingly to work, its why the gluttonous trinket is also called the "betrayer's amulet".

This trait tell you how to make and destroy those amulet.

objects.title: living cataclysm. (rare traits)
objects.text:
Some centaur interact differently with the world as they grow in power,  they no longer seem to need to breath or eat or even rest. those centaur become living cataclysm that need only magic to sustain their terrifying existence. 

this trait reduce all your biological needs by 1% and increase your environnemental resistance to all harm by 0.1 for every 1% bigger you become from your original size that mean that becoming two time bigger (a 100% size increase) would grant a 100% reduction to all your needs and 10% environnemental resistance increases.
and you becoming ten time bigger (a 1000% size increase) would make you immune to all environnemental harm.

objects.title: skin deep core. (rare trait)
objects.text: This trait teach you how to store cores as gemstone inlaid skin deep instead of swallowing them and remove the risk of throwing those core up. it still require those core to be at least 40% inside your body and at least 40% outside, this mean that a well made cut can remove said core from you. this is particularly useful when you have a few very potent cores you really want to keep if you end up throwing up cores. those gem are as tough as the weakest part of your body and are always the size of your fist no matter your size and immediately shatter and disperse back to their original owner when cut out of your body or broken.

objects.title: false god. (unique trait)
objects.text:
When all is said and done centaur are probably the strongest non ascended races on this list, obviously this power had one of them be seen as a god and they could fake it really well indeed. 

This trait allow you to implant core you've stolen into other instead of consuming it, this diminish one being as usual but empower another greatly especially if they are both of the same race, in this case the empowered one also does not suffer from the centaur limitation of only using simple basic magic blast and shield but retain the full complexity of their magic. 

This only happened once and the centaur was slain by is own empowered followers, while you could take this as a warning to not take this i actually see this as an exemples of how centaurs who attain power had such terrible personalities that even them granting untold powers does not make them bearable company.

Perhaps you will be the first exception?

rows.title: centaure traits

objects.title: base changeling.
objects.text:
Similar in appearance to the drone, the common changeling are weaker on all front than the other two changeling casts the common changeling also require less food on the daily and can still -given a large amount of love and some time- grow into the other casts. 

Rarely seen outside younger smaller hives unless famine strike.

A healthy sentient being when drained safely of love for about an hour would be able to feed ten common changeling for a month if they did not use it frivolously. 

They can control about 4 drones but cannot lay eggs.

objects.title: nobles changeling.
objects.text:
More robust and less feral looking the nobles changeling are the cornerstone of larger changeling hives and generally oversee most of their infrastructures. 

the corner stone in all healthy hives.

They are about as strong as unicorn in magic, about as fast as pegasus in flight and about as strong as earth pony physically when well fed but this change dramatically when their love stores run low.

A healthy sentient being when drained safely of love for about an hour would be able to feed one noble changeling for a week if they did not use it frivolously. 

They can control about 8 drones and can lay about:

1 noble eggs per month who hatch after 9 month.
or
3 base eggs per month who hatch in about 3 month.
or
10 drone eggs per moth who hatch in a single day.

All eggs are raised communally and with the direct attention of any royal changeling present.

objects.title: royal changeling.
objects.text:
Stronger than all other casts the royal changeling are the apex of changeling kind and are more powerful than most races top percentile in magic, flight and body

That is as long as they are fed enough, they are generally only seen in larger hives as they require large love supplies.

A healthy sentient being when drained safely of love for about an hour would be able to feed one royal changeling for a day if they did not use it frivolously. 

they can control about 12 drones and can lay about:

1  royal eggs per month who hatch after 12 month.
or   
10 noble eggs per month who hatch after 9 month.
or
30 base eggs per month who hatch in about 3 month.
or
100 drone eggs per moth who hatch in 1 day.

All eggs are raised communally and with the direct attention of any royal changeling present.

rows.title: changeling cast.
rows.titleText:
Changeling casts are not a matter of birth but merit, a changeling will sometime grow to be a queen/king when population need to rise and regress when the food is scarce, only the most powerful or competent ever stay queen/king for extended period of time.

Depending on cast changeling can control a certain amount of auxiliary bodies called drones and stronger cast can store larger quantity of love, they also consume more love than weaker casts.

Two cast of changeling -nobles and royals- have access to egg laying be they male or female, the only difference is the body shape both have an ovipositor and can lay both outside or inside a host with the eggs laid inside a host hatching slower and into a live birth but with less love needed to complete. 

Eggs only hatch if another changeling prime it otherwise it will turn into a green amber like gem after a few day.

objects.title: love poison. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Changeling cannot feed on love that is not aimed at another being, like the love for money or power...Unless you have this trait that is, now you can eat those love as well but beware, those form of love are perversion of true love and as such is somewhat toxic. 

While it can supplement your diet pleasantly like piment and empower your magic like an additive, eat too much of this love without diluting it into proper love and it will damage your core, cause you terrible pain and even death. the explosive kind of death.

pure love when extracted is red while tainted love is green.

objects.title: trust in me. (rare trait)
objects.text:
hypnosis is one if the predatorial changeling less known tool but mostly because they use it sparingly -since few changeling ever truly master it- and very well and those that do are absolute nightmare to face. 

a changeling master hypnotist is akin to  medusa and can the moment you crosse their gaze freeze you in their thrall, after that their orders are the only thing that matter to you until the spell is broken by a third party.

this trait give you this mastery and let you plant order deep into the subconscious of your prey and even rewrite aspect of them through carful layering of commands.

be careful though, just like medusa reflective surfaces are a threat to you, or perhaps a potential boon?

objects.title: who am i? (rare trait)
objects.text:
while all predatorial changeling can copy memories its another thing entirely to steal an entire life worth of them instantly and not become mentally unhinged. 

this trait let you do just that, the moment you touch another being and turn into them you can copy all their memories and store them safely into your brain for perusal. 

all of it will be organized and ready for study at your own convenience and with no impact on your own psyche.

objects.title: Feast of excessive delights. (rare trait)
objects.text:
changeling cannot feed on lust normally but some changelings have devoted a lot of time trying and have somewhat succeeded from time to time, those rare few now named Lustling gained a privileged places amongst their hives as they become a potent source of food if time consuming to harness.

those changeling would gather together into org-group i meant group and through various..."activities" generate lust within then they would partially digest and mix this lust with love in themselves and share the result with non-Lustling, this mix would be as nutritious as love  and could double and even triple the initial love investment.

this trait allow you to do the same, it also let you drain the lust of other but this action will leave them with not "urges" for some time. as a side effect you now have perfects control of your reproductive function and urges.  

pure love is red while love/lust mix is pink.

objects.title: soulmate. (rare trait)
objects.text:
now with all i have  told you about changeling you might perhaps believe that they don't feel love themselves and that is why they feed on this so elusive emotion? 

well they are not and in fact can love more than any other races because for them emotion is a tangible and vital thing and so they value it greatly in fact being truly loved for who they are with no disguise or manipulation while exceedingly rare is also a wonderous thing for a changeling and is often indication that this lover is the changeling soulmate. 

when a changeling find that special someone its need to feed on love find itself greatly reduced and even a single chaste kiss from that lover will feed them for weeks. this love also empower them greatly and this effect grow limitlessly as more of this special love is shared, especially if the changeling soulmate is in need of help or all forbid in danger. 

this trait will make it easier for you to find that soulmate by giving you a general sense of their direction at all time even once you find them. you can have more than one soulmate just like your soulmate can, changeling more than all other species are also very open in their relationship as more lovers mean more love.

objects.title: the swarm. (unique trait)
objects.text:
remember how each cast has a limit on the number of drones they can control? well one crazy queen once figured out how to bypass that and formed a massive swarm of drones to wage a war of conquest across the world. 

she failed obviously the celestia of that world just glassed the desert she lived in but the trick to do it is possible to reproduce, you just need drones build for the sole purposes of expending your processing and multitasking power, those node drones look like blob of brain and love storage and cannot do anything but help you control more drones....about 24 for each node drone. each nodes is tuned to one user after its birth and cannot be changed.

this trait allow you to lay node drones eggs instead of having to slowly shape them after birth like the crazy bug that did it first.

rows.title: changeling traits

objects.title: the plant whisperer. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Most plants don't really have the capacity to feel or think in way that relate to us let alone express those feeling clearly but in your presence, that boundary seem oh so thin and the gap in comprehension not quite so wide.


Plants near you now understand instinctively what you are doing, your intent and should it approve it will assist in your efforts to the best of its abilities. Better yet you can give them guidance and teach them things and they will -as you help them- grow fond of you personally. 

Plants you raise will show in a handful of years positives mutation that would have taken hundreds of years of careful breeding to create.

objects.title: woodlands companion. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Deer tend to gather in small groups and generally live inside expansive forests, they also settle rather far from each other for both privacy and to build their own personal gardens. 

This led some deer to feeling alone and those deer developed what's is called a Timberwolf.(note that the wolf aspect is more tradition than an obligation, you can do other form.)

those beast are made by deer that isolated part of their soul (isolated not cut off) and infused said part into a wooden puppet. this grant it both life and a will of its own, one that is based on the deer and very compatible and friendly. 

This companion is immune to death as the destruction of the puppet merely return the soul to you so you can infuse it into a new body, it also share all your blessing/trait/perks/drawback and can do anything you can do about half as good as you.(the companion cannot be bigger than thrice your own size.)

objects.title: winter's cloven hoof. (rare trait)
objects.text:
While most deer prefer forest with temperate climates some of them chose to live in colder lands, over the years they adapted and are now called reindeer. reindeer mostly have greater ability in maintaining large but few magically reinforced Bosque that they surround with tall ice wall made with their new affinity for anything to do with ice.  

This new way of life in the cold limit their number but each reindeer is far stronger and larger than regular deer and gain a strong boost to all thing related to ice. 

This trait make you 1 meter taller than what size you originally picked and immun to cold as well as better at using ice in any way. Also make it easier to increase plants survivability.

objects.title: shamanic extreme (rare trait)
objects.text:
The shamanic ritual of the deer generally use plant based ingredients and shed parts of animals as reagent but a few shaman pushed that further and developed method to extract more power from the more significant part of an animal as well.

Using this method it is possible to borrow the powers of other species and use it for yourself but beware, while you only borrow the power they left behind as they moved to the after life doing so require you to pay tribute to the parted soul of the foci through ritual from time to time or the item will lose its power forever.

those items can be used by any deer or trained shaman, their effect can also be altered by combining different parts together to create complexe esoteric powers. 

This trait also include the creation of ink for tattoo using humors such as blood, tears, saliva, etc. tattoo made with those are stronger and can be layered without interfering with each others.

objects.title: survival of the fittest. (rare trait)
objects.text:
It is said by those living near deer forest that their woodland are filled with brutal and violent beast, those rumors rarely mention that those beasts appear shortly after the forest was wronged by outsider.

As you probably guessed a few terrifying deer are said beasts and the tales of bestiale assault are actually tale of their violent vendetta against any that wrong the forest they inhabit.

 Those deer are called wendigos (no relation to windigos) and are carnivorous deer that gain part of the strength of the prey they eat. this does not require the prey to die and only require and work on the first bite but the gains are definitive. 

Those gain are all physical  attributes (strength, dexterity, endurance) and their potency depend on how much weaker or stronger the deer was compared to the prey, a weaker prey give weaker gain while a stronger prey give stronger gain.

the wendigos live by one simple quote: "cut down our woods we'll chew down your flesh."

objects.title: thorned one. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Amongst the deer one of them is revered by all, she who fed the first forest with her blood and let her body be consumed by the wild. letting plants roots themselves around her bones and replace her organs and fuse with her flesh. 

Snawfus she was called, once a pure white deer she took on all the color of the forest and is now a wandering forest, wherever she step nature blossom and the longer she stand still the more it turn into a verdant forest. 

This trait give you this ability as well, from now on all your plant based power can be turned on as a passive ability, you yourself also now count as a plant based lifeform for any ability you have.

rows.title: deer traits

objects.title: gamma
objects.text:
Dexterity and intelligence greatly increased.
Strength and endurance slightly reduced.

objects.title: beta
objects.text:
Strength and endurance greatly increased.
Intelligence and dexterity slightly reduced.

objects.title: alpha
objects.text: Strength, dexterity, endurance and intelligence slightly increased.

rows.title: diamond dog category

objects.title: puppy eyes of bartering. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Diamond dog are a mercantile bunch but some of them figured out the trick to making cash, be cute and adorable, open those peeper wide and ear straight and forward. seem stupid but it work every time and on everyone.

This trait make it second nature for you to perform and it generally get you a 15 to 25% discount when buying and markup when selling anything.

objects.title: rider by necessity. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Diamond have short legs and lack mobility as such some of them have taken to borrowing the legs of others to move around, those rider developed strong hips strength and grasping technic that make it impossible to throw them off. 

With this trait you can now do so as well, be it riding a bike or holding on to the hide of a building sized beast, once you are latched onto something the only way to get you off is if you let go willingly or are dead.

You also know how to do anything you could do on solid ground and dodge harm while mounted (as long as its possible).

objects.title: service bitch. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Every diamond dog agrees: pride is a cat thing.

Amongst diamond dog shame and humiliation doesn't exist when in service of someone you love and trust. 

Ever felt your ego and pride stop you from doing something you want or rightfully should be doing? that need to bitch and moan at doing a chore your mother told you to  do BECAUSE she told you to do it? 

Well no more this trait remove those pesky feelings when doing something for someone who earned your affection and as a bonus you gain a massive increase in ability when doing anything for someone and instinctively recognize whether someone is a good person by your standard or faking it to get you to do things for them.

objects.title: tool master. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Diamond dog are very dexterous with those fingers of them and for some this go even further. These diamond dogs have a knack for sleight of hands and handling any tools like it was made for their hands.

with this trait you only need a second of holding something to know it in and out and use it with you maximum level of mastery with no adaptation period. 

With this trait you know how to operate any tool or appliance with just a glance at it in function.

Also make you ambidextrous.

objects.title: lifter of mountain. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Most diamond dog are renowned for their lack of speed but in exchange of this diamond dogs are born with massive upper body strength and for a few of them this upper body strength is truly limitless. 

With this trait there is nothing you cannot lift above your head just plant your feet grasp it and lift and be it a whole house or a mountain it will go up, the heavier what you want to lift is the longer it take and the more static you must be but it cannot take more than 3 days straight to lift something up.

Once its done you can move it up to twice your size in distance before having to set it down during this movement tripping over will break the effect so beware.

And yes you can even do something like "lift the mood." or "lift a curse"(this only displace the curse not break it.)

objects.title: wagging trail. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Magic is everywhere in my worlds and diamond dogs are no different but as you probably noticed from the trait and perks they don't seem quite so magical at first glance compared to other races. 

In truth diamond dog magic is mostly invested into this field called a "wagging trail" that they maintain around themselves, this field allow diamond dogs to become invulnerable to any and all ranged attack (aside entropy capped at 90% reduction) and grant them inexhaustible stamina, of course you need a lot of diamond dogs to power this effect as well as a central figure to drive them.

Those figures are called pack leaders and are capable of harnessing this power consciously, of course this broken ability does have a weakness, if someone challenge the pack leader publicly he or she has to agree to a one on one and should the pack leader fall the winner can either become the new pack leader or disband the pack breaking the "wagging trail" effect.

this trait make you a natural born pack leader.

rows.title: diamond dog traits

objects.title: parent of the year all year round. (donkey trait)
objects.text:
Being a loving parent does not make you a good one, but in the case of donkey its generally the case. 

With this trait you are the best parent ever, you can do anything for your children and you do it with ease and no sweat or stress. 

As long as its for your kid you can literally not fail at anything, this work less when you have the ulterior motive of profiting from it for something else than being a good parent.

objects.title: donkey rizz. ( donkey trait)
objects.text: While all donkey have game, some have "rizz" that little ''je ne sais quoi'' which make mares weak at the knees and *cough* anyway this trait give you that, you always look your best no matter the situation, never have a bad picture or a bad wake up hairdo. YOU are the impossible standard of beauty now.

rows.title: donkey traits

objects.title: Omnilinguals
objects.text:
You can understand anyone and anything, no matter how profane or eldritch, no matter how simple or complexe you can quickly grasp and translate it into any other language. 

This make you capable of interacting with any beings and to translate it for others. 

this trait also negate any memetic hazard from communicating with other beings and from knowing anything told to you or that you read.

objects.title: evolutive concept
objects.text:
As time goes on the reach or meaning of a concept can change with new understanding or discovery, with this traits you are always one step ahead of this evolution. 

you always know and can use any new "meaning" your concept will gain a year in advance.

This trait also make it easier to "stretch" your concept into new "meaning" yourself.

objects.title: anchoring presence
objects.text:
With this traits by "anchoring" yourself to a mortal you can gain a week of grace period before the "existential imperative" make you fade away, during this time you will slowly weaken but embodying your concept a lot will allow you to recuperate and even no longer fade away. 

The grace period grow longer with how fond of you your anchor is and you recuperate faster the more beings around you partake into your concept around you. 

A casual level of concept embodiment or participation will not work it need to be more "extreme".

This trait also make it easier to resist the "mental influence" of your concept in your anchor presence.

objects.title: conceptual area
objects.text:
You have your own realm, it is thematically fitting for your concept and under your complete control, you can go there and pull items or beings out freely, this place is generally very confortable to you for better or for worst, be carful not to become a neet. 

In addition it tend to..."disagree" with anything that oppose your concept happening in it and will push back against them rather fervently, once again for better or for worst. 

This trait also make it easier for you to twist your surrounding using your concept.

objects.title: a joker with an ace up its sleeve
objects.text:
You can now "share" your concept with other, those beings will now be apostle of your concept and this allow them to do the things you do but also afflict them with the same "mental influence" you have but not the "existential imperative". 

You cannot take away those powers unless the apostle renounce them or die or perform too many action opposed to your concept.

You do not lose your own power by sharing it but if you fade away with an apostle still active they can either host your mind and try to bring you back with a large demonstration of your concept or take over your concept for their own, so be careful who you trust. 

If you have more than one apostle you can go from apostle to apostle until all reject you or one host you, an apostle cannot claim a concept in full as long as at least one other apostle remain.

This also make it easier for you to affect other living beings with your concept directly.

rows.title: draconequus traits

objects.title: dungeon bait. (rare trait)
objects.text:
For dragon it take about a hundred years grow into teenagers at least in body but in mind they can mature a lot faster or slower than other species depending of their upbringing, it mean that sometime a dragon can look like a 17 years old and actually be about 10 in mental age or look like a 17 and be closer to 40 mentally. 

A clear sign to look for that they are actually teenager mentally no matter their sizes is their wings, a dragon upon reaching 17 years old mentally get a pair of wings that is also when they truly start growing in size.

Those change generally come with responsibilities and duty for the teenage dragon/dragoness so some of them found a way to hide their wings completely and even shrink their body as they pleases and that is what this trait is about and to be fair it has its fair share of convenient use, mostly to enter the building of smaller races.

this allow you two switch between your chosen size to any smaller size at will and to retract your wings into scale pattern on your back, those changes are instantaneous and effortless to maintain.

objects.title: scalechemy. (rare trait)
objects.text:
As said before dragon are mostly magical being and their body parts are potent magical ingredients, scalechemy is the art of using said parts exclusively, by doing so the dragon do not open itself to harm from magic only to other dragon or weapon made of dragon parts. 

This also teach you the dragon runic language, this runic system cannot be used or even understood by non-dragon and by using those rune on you own scale while they are still alive, they will grow stronger over time endlessly as dragon don't shed scales.

Enchantment you made on a scale will still be present when you rip out the scale its engraved into, it will only stop growing stronger afterward.

The enchantement will instead be destroyed if you didn't fit all the runes on one scale.

objects.title: dragon fire endowment. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Dragon fire is by default a potent weapon and tool as it can be enchanted with magical effect from most school of magic, but some dragon have made this their specialty and developed way to imbu some aspect of the concept of fire to their flames.

By doing so their flames take new properties based on this aspect, properties that grow stronger the longer this aspect is imbued into the flame with no limits aside one: all the accumulated power reset when the aspect is changed and two: you cannot imbue more than one aspect at a time.  

With this trait you can do the same, you can imbue your fire breath with any of the following aspect of the concept of fire at any time.

Aspect of the concept of fire: destruction/ purification/ healing/ renewal/ wrath/ pain/ heat / civilisation/ progress/ light/ life/ guidance/ safety/ war/ danger.

Depending on the imbued concept your fire will have new and different effects.

objects.title: dragon fire channeling. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Dragon and fire are tied to the very core, a dragon breath fire before learning to talk.

A dragon is born with fire at its maw and it dies with fire at its maw. Most dragon never truly grasp fully the intimate bond their races has with fire but those that do are a wonder to behold.

Their body seem to glitter in iridescent flames and every move they make spread wind as warm as those of deserts.  

Where most dragon have to breath their fire out as they did since they were freshly hatched drakes those dragon instead channel their flammes through their vey body, it seep out from between every scale ignite with every twitch of their wings and coalesce into blade at their claws. 

With this trait so can you channel your fire through every part of yourself and every tools or weapon you yield. by doing so you empower the items and sublimate yourself. 

Channeling remove any de-buff and act as a passive shield, any harm aimed at you must first resist contact with your fire to reach you, adding you offensive potential to your defense. 


Any tools, weapon and armor you channel your fire into gain any and all advantage your dragon fire has and the dragon's immunity to magical fields that where not used to empower him/her.

objects.title: cliche's upheaval. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Did you know that in my world, amongst the dragon population a small but noticeable portion of them dream of being Knights?  Ironic i know but also poetic, even in my world its no secret that knight are told to slay dragon, it is a classic tale.

Why is it then that the very same race that is often slayed by knights so dream of following a knight way of life? of going out and saving the weak and the innocent? 

In one of my world, one such dragon raised by the princesses of the sun and moon became the closest friend of a young dragoness that would one day become the dragon lord and together they turned the "dragon code" into the "dragon knights codex" and from this day all the dragon of his world became the highest paragon of justice and good, as a reward the young dragon was crowned the dragon king by his surrogate mothers and earned their blessing. 

This trait give you the honor of carrying and following this codex instead of the dragon code.

In addition as long as you follow this codex you gain two unique power at noon and midnight of the first day of every week.

from the first noon you gain "hope lies beyond despair." : once only until the next week, restore yourself too peak state no matter you condition then benefit from instant regeneration and infinite stamina for the next 12 hours. 

from midnight you gain "let me save one more.": once until next week, revert any event that happened in front of you as if it was a dream and rewind time for up to 8 hours, you retain any knowledge or benefit gained of the nullified event and reversed time.

the dragon knight codex:

"A knight is sworn to valor,
Their heart knows only virtue,
Their blade defends the helpless,
Their might upholds the weak,
Their word speaks only truth,
Their wrath undoes the wicked."

objects.title: dragon king. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Royalty amongst the dragon is a touchy subject, while the dragon lord lead dragon kind the position is earned and its power and authority is limited. So even though dragon are by nature proud and by default powerful they can tolerate it, but the concept of a king, one that rule by divine right both irk them and entice them.

To claim a divine right to rule has meaning amongst dragon since they are both the closest race to godhood on average and yet have never seen one rise to divine statut amongst them, it is a claim of standing above all dragon kind and such claim demand challenges. 

If you pick this trait all dragon will, the moment they see you, become aware of your claim and challenge it, win and they will acknowledge your divine right and become a believer. 

As long as even one believer remain you cannot die from old age, you are no longer bound to the dragon code or the command of the dragon lord and for every 100 believer make you 1% more powerful in all physicals attribute (strength, dexterity, endurance).

rows.title: dragon traits

objects.title: rock and roll. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Earth pony are a communal kind and the more earth pony work in tunes the more potent their individual abilities become. 

This trait make you a master at guiding this power toward specifics goal, rousing other earth pony from the "calm" is now instinctive, even for yourself. The more ponies you have working toward the same goal in your group the more competent every members of the group become.

You also instinctively pick up when and what is perturbing your group harmony.

objects.title: mind over mane. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Your mane and tale are now under your complete control.

they can store about three time you body mass without weighting even a hair more and can shape shift to fit your need and mood -even its shade but not the color-, and even phase through itself to make full rotation.

 Combined with other earth pony perks and traits this mean your mane and tail are now additional limbs and a potent shield and weapon.

objects.title: the skin of the world. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Earth pony are though and strong or rather though OR strong if you read the perks right but sometime a pony is born with a affinity for being both.

Those pony are made of stone more than figuratively and this grant them both perk effect at the same time at half strength at all time in both body and mind. You still get the bonus at a 100% when the criteria are met.

Those with this gift are patient yet decisive, strong and fast yet precise and controlled.

objects.title: speed of obsession. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Have you ever been so obsessed with something you lost track of time and entered a sort of trance only to realize you finished what you were doing in no time at all? 

This is that cranked to eleven, when you do something and you need or want to get it done quickly you get fast, very fast, impossibly fast even and this is without ever doing any mistakes or problems from time sensitives steps and with no additional exhaustion after.

 To other this look very uncanny to witness though.

objects.title: maker of wonder. (rare trait)
objects.text:
You know how to build everything you could build with what you know.

No no hear me out, you can build everything you could build using every bit of knowledge you ever learned, that mean if you study mechanics every things that can be built by you using this knowledge is clear in your mind at all times with just a thought. 

The more you know the more you can build. 

The only limitation is that it only work with "mundane" fields not with magical field like enchantement, alchemy, etc. 

Nothing stop you from combining magical fields with things you built with this through your own creativity though.

objects.title: party pony. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Some pony love party but they merely adopted the merriment, some are born for it, molded by it and when they come out into the world, the world can only bend, twist and buckle under their power.

Party pony make you a force of merriment and nothing can ever stop any action you take in the name of spreading cheer and smiles -aside another party pony- not even the law of physics. 

You gain toon like power (yes like bugs bunny and daffy duck.) and something called the "-your name- sense" which cannot be fooled and is always active granting you a sixth sense that grow to fit your own preferences warning you through twitches and itches of any events that matter to you happening around you.

objects.title: be brave, flee! (rare trait)
objects.text:
Abyssinian are not know for holding their ground and fighting for their values. Instead they are known for running away and coming later to shank you in the ribs while you sleep, figure of speech off course but the idea is there. 

Some Abyssinian are particularly skilled at the run away part and with this trait so are you.

As long as what you are trying to do is run away you get a ramping up bonus to speed and stamina with no cap until you either get caught, decide to fight back or successfully escape.

objects.title: savvy feline. (rare trait)
objects.text:
With this trait you too can become a charming rogue, with smooth lines and an easy gait to your steps, in fact no matter the situation you exude confidence and an easy going attitude that put other at ease and make them underestimate you.

Your perk "an eye for detail" also become a passive and no longer require line of sight at closer than 20 meter from you. 

You also somehow know what peoples around you are thinking of you as well as their general moods. 

This trait make you appear well informed and very shrewd indeed.

objects.title: once a predator...(rare trait)
objects.text:
Abyssinian are of predatory decent and some still carry to this day the instinct and defining aura of ones, you can with a glance know how dangerous a being is to you and with a longer stare "weaken" its willpower, this effect can be ramped up to causing full on panic attacks and only stop and start reverting when line of sight is broken. 

If you try to get close to perform a stealth take down on a being with at least 50% broken will and succeed you will automatically do so without alerting anyone even if they are right beside you, if you fail but disengage and hide the target will immediately assume an hallucinations after a short moment of panicked flailing.

objects.title: deft claws and sure paws. (rare trait)
objects.text:
When it come to stealing and climbing the best all come from amongst the Abyssinian, this trait give you the three new abilities that will make you the best of them.

First: from now on as long as you are within arms reach from something you can simply will it away into you own paws, this minor feat of teleportation is undetectable and leave no traces but the disappearing of the stolen items, the range is limited to the lengths of your arms and to item you could hold and lift yourself but walls, locks or any other things in the way do not matter. 

Second: when climbing your grip is effortless to maintain no matter the surface you hold onto, your weight is negated and your balance is perfect. 

Third: you no longer take fall damage as long as you land on all your paws within 5 second from first to last no matter the height.

objects.title: cats do dance! (unique trait)
objects.text:
While Abyssinian have a long history of trader and merchants what is even more known is that Abyssinian are theatrical, real drama queen the lot of them but one amongst them has made it the last card in their rigged decks. 

With this trait you now get a small to overwhelming luck boost based on how theatrical you perform anything. The more dramatic and showy you are the more successful you will be in general.

rows.title: Abyssinian traits

objects.title: curiosity hunter. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Cats are curious, bird like shiny things, and griffon are both of those things. Amongst all griffon treasure hunter are the most envied, those griffon are gifted with a sixth sense in finding lost treasures and unique items of not just great monetary value but also of great significance. 

This trait basically make you very lucky when it come to finding curiosity, named or unique items, but also in restoring, maintaining and using said items.

objects.title: inner compass. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Some griffon are born with a talent for travel and those griffon cannot get lost, period. Those griffon have perfect geographical awareness, they know where the north is, how high they are compared to the sea, what day and time it is and how far they are from their home at all time. 

This awareness scale up and down depending of how large of an area the griffon operate in, if they only operate in a  small area this awareness slowly grow more precise and restrained to useful information like where they are precisely to the millimeter, if the griffon is exploring the vast expanse of space it will instead have larger marge of errors but still allow you to navigate the unknown stars unaided, on your own and better than any other races.
 
Even if you somehow lose your way accros dimension and realities, after a few days of focusing on multiverse wide travel you will know roughly where to go to get back home.(this only work for place you have already been to personally.)

objects.title: bird of prey. (rare trait)
objects.text:
While all the races in my worlds can eat meat my worlds don't have many actual sentient predators but they do have some and griffon are part of this small group.

In my world predators don't hunt sentient races and feed mostly on fish, eggs and sometime meat but hunting is harder in my worlds because even feral animals in my worlds are smarter and harder to prey on than in yours. 

Yet amongst the griffon there are some hunters that can take down hydra by themselves, those hunter have mastered the art and skill of hunting. Those hunter once they mark a prey for hunting never lose track of them, they can precisely judge how exhausted their prey is and when said prey as let its guard down. 

Even further the very act of hunting fuel them, while they are hunting a mark they do not grow mentally tired at all, their focus remaining impeccable.

objects.title: hear me roar! (rare trait)
objects.text:
While griffon are no dragon they still have a sort of threatening aura to them, they are made of two apex predator after all, an eagle and a lion.

Of those two animal the one thing they have in commun is how their roar and screech both strike at the psych of those who hear them, a lion roar is majestic yet terrifying, an eagle screech is awe-inspiring yet chilling. 

Their are griffon that have cultivated this aura and crystalized this aspect of themselves to paralyse those they face, those griffon can pin a target with but a glance and force onto them deep feeling of terror with but one screeching roar. 

This effect grow stronger or weaker depending of the difference in willpower between you and the targets, anything else like strength is irrelevant.

objects.title: bird-y animals. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Griffon know how to party and where ponies have fun party griffon have savage one where alcohol flow and things get "heated", amongst them some are real party animal and not only get to wake up after a week long party with no drawbacks but also get healthier from it, that's right some griffon can party so hard that it act like a workout for them. 

With this trait every hour of partying count as a seven hours full body work out with no side effects. you do not lose your intellectual faculty when drunk nor nauseous from overeating.

A party require at least seven participant to trigger this effect, once triggered the effect ends when you next fall asleep or start actively working on something aside partying.

objects.title: the legacy of Boreas.  (unique trait)
objects.text:
*sigh* Boreas was the god of the griffon, he was a mortal griffon that ascended to divinity and used its gained divine power to unit the griffon into an age of prosperity. 

Sadly during the era of chaos  he chose to oppose the spirit of chaos Discord and was lost never to return, before he left for battle he crafted the idol of Boreas whose presence purified hubristic pride into constructive pride and was given to the griffon king Grover, sadly with its disappearance and latter destruction the griffon have lost the last remnant of their lost god and fallen into on hard time.

Still its possible a few griffon still share a bloodline with Boreas from his time as a mortal, with this bound of blood would come power and potential for more. 

This trait give you a blood relation to Boreas and with it the ability to know the alignement of anyone you meet as well as their deepest desire and shame. You can also purge other from any mental illness, trauma and mind control of any kind, this also prevent new ones.

rows.title: griffon traits

objects.title: cute fueled sanctity. (rare trait)
objects.text:
This trait is relatively cheap because a lot of hippogriff have it, to put it simply when someone see you included into a conflict they will side with you by default.

Unless they saw you initiate said conflict while you where with no shadow of a doubt in the wrong they will consider you as in the right, to be fair in the case of hippogriff its generally true and they do look to innocent to hurt a fly. 

This trait is strongly affected by reputation,  have a good one and witnesses will flock to your defense, a bad one and you will be treated to the punishment you deserve by law and nothing more, that's right this trait make you off limit when it come to cruel and unusual punishments.

Another reason its so cheap is also because this trait does not work on being who have cruel and/or sadistic tendencies.

objects.title: graceful shifter.(rare trait)
objects.text:
While all hippogriff can change into Seapony it is not a swift or easy process, it take about 1 minutes and for about half of that time they are unable to breath at all as they go from lungs to gills. 

Its also require them to be in water to become Seapony and out of water to become hippogriff. this trait remove that, it allow you to shift in less than a second and do so at any time.

Also you are never disoriented from any form of shapeshifting.

objects.title: Merpony aspect. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Seapony are sea flavored pony but there are a few Merpony amongst them, those hippogriff that truly embraced their Seapony form as their "true" form

Those are creatures of myth said to be able to bewitch the heart of entire crew with songs, now what they do after getting the crew under their spells in the legend is up for debate but in truth the Merpony mostly retrieve any marine life the crew had caught (along with anything shiny and alcohol.) 

You see Merponyhave learned to assimilate different physicals traits of marine life in their form but they need to attune themselves with said animals this mean that if the attuned animal dies they need to find another, this naturally made them dislike fishing.

With this trait you can do the same, by attuning yourself to marine life you can pick and choose physicals traits from them to add to your form, tentacles, double row of teeth or bioluminescent body part everything is possible.

Contrary to shapeshifting those change are always stable and require no understanding of biologie or even conscious effort to make or maintain their is also no limit to the amount of trait you can gather nor does it require biomass, you can also freely revert a change by pausing the attunement at any moment, this does not break said attunement merely turn it off.

You can pick more than one trait from one being but if said being your are attuned to dies all the related traits disappear and a new attunement need to be made.

objects.title: abyss royalty. (rare trait)
objects.text:
This trait grant you authority over all sea life, they will obey your command to the best of their abilities and go out of their way to assist you or warn you about things they notice that might concern you. 

You can obviously now understand their "speech". most of marine life is limited intellectually but whales and octopus are great conversationalist, deep thinker and good natured. 

Also stay away from dolphin if you can, appearance are misleading with those perverts.

objects.title: avian flair. (rare trait)
objects.text:
"Over the top." is a good way to describe those larger than life hippogriff, they stand out and impress anywhere they go and they love it just so! 

With this trait the more peoples around who pay attention to you in a positive manner the better you are for a future performance up to a thousand time better.

This boost accumulate slowly but work through any artistic media be it painting you have made or songs you sang or anything that is recognized as part of the seven major arts:

-Painting.
-Sculpture.
-Architecture.
-Literature.
-Cinema.
-Theatre.
-Music.

For every 100 peoples that like one of your performances you charge up  1% of this performances booster up to a 1000%.

This boost can be used at any time before starting a performance or action and must be spent whole. Once the action is finished or you interrupt it the boost end. only one boost can be active at a time. 

Charge can also be accumulated from boosted performances or action.

objects.title: symbole of holy purity. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Hippogriff are a decidedly good race, they also lack a godly figure for they never needed anything to scare themselves away from evil or rewards to incite goodness. 

Yet i know from my own divinity that a hippogriff god or goddess is possible for many hippogriff have reached the nascent stage only to never take that decisive final step. But maybe a divine hippogriff is exactly what whatever world you go to need.

this trait grant you the one thing shared by all the hippogriff to have almost ascended: purity.

purity make your self sacrosaint and incorruptible, you cannot be affected by any negative effects from being lacking the good alignment and can even purge those effect from others. attack can still arm you but any thing more complexe and conceptually evil simply fail to affect you and those you protect.

rows.title: hippogriff traits

objects.title: inextinguishable. (rare trait)
objects.text:
While the Kirin ability to turn into Nirik is often a disadvantage in time of peace it is also? their best defense when threatened so for it to be extinguishable like any other fire is a pretty big weakness. 

Amongst the kirin some have learned the difficult skill of fanning their flames with their roaring willpower, this skill allow them to prevent their fire from going out as long as they have the will to feed the flames. 

This mean that any fire you ever made become ever burning unless you forget about it or move out of your sight. 

Any attempt of extinguishing your fires by others tire you mentally instead of extinguishing your flames. 

Shutting down your Nirik transformation is still just as hard.

objects.title: serene presence. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Kirin living in a valley surrounded by a treacherous chain of mountains, while this natural defense is potent the true reason why the kirin are certain of the safety of their homeland is that a few kirin amongst them have learned to create areas where serenity CANNOT be broken.

The creation and maintenance of those areas require a few obligatory components:

1-at least one cherry tree.
2- at least one stone lantern.
3-at least one water feature.
4-at least one place to meditate.
5-it must have at least 75% of its totale area under the open sky.
6-the daily presence of the creator of the area.

the area grow with how much of the area is maintained and by adding more components to it.

In this area none can commit any aggressive action, this does not prevent friendly sparring if both parties are willing. Death in this area is impossible unless the deadly event has an area of effect bigger than the serene area but this deadly event cannot begin inside the serene area.(exemple: a bombe dropped right on the area will always be a dud even a nuke if it does not detonate outside the area. bullets and shells always miss when entering the area but can harm someone when it come out.)

objects.title: joyful flames. (rare trait)
objects.text:
For most kirin bad emotions can trigger the Nirik form almost instantly while the positive emotions need to be truly driven to do so, with this trait you get rid of half this hard truth and now all emotion can trigger the change as easily as breathing, you can now change form even with mere boredom and keep it on no problem. turning it off on the other hoof is now almost impossible without a tremendous force of will, you passing out or the you flamme being extinguished and one final way: 

Choose one single emotion, when feeling this emotion you can at will and as easily as breathing turn off the Nirik state.

objects.title: amaterasu. (rare trait)
objects.text:
The hottest a Nirik fire can burn is about 2500°C when pushed to the ultimate limit of rage, despair and even love.

But a few have in the past pushed the Nirik fire further by fueling their flames with sheer entropy. This desire so complete to destroy that nothing can resist the flame, those flame no longer burn and instead erase what they touch reducing it to nothing, a fire made of entropy.

Your Nirik form can now use entropy infused flames which negate all defenses, this fire does not discriminate and anything they touch will start to be erased until you turn off the Nirik transformation or pass out so be carful.

objects.title: thunderstruck. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Much rarer than most of the other rare trait of the kirin, this trait grant you the very rare ability to have lightning powers both in your kirin and Nirik form. while much more destructive in Nirik form the kirin form gain in control and finesse what it lack in raw power. 

Thunderstruck allow you to: shoot lightning bolt from your horn or to summon them from above, walk on cloud and even turn into a bolt of lightning yourself to move around and the general power of electro kinesis and an immunity to electricity of all source.

objects.title: nascent heaven. (unique trait)
objects.text:
In your world there are tales of cultivators and their ascension to the heavens, but those story are making it more complexe than it really is, with climbing to other worlds and defying the "laws of heaven" and other such thing but in the end their ascension is just the act of empowering themselves by taking power from other beings, creatures and places.

A kirin once found a simpler way to ascend and it was to birth an inner heaven inside their own being.
