this inner heaven start as a small and inhospitable barren planet with no atmosphere into an empty universe save for a sun, said sun constantly produce and emit as much magic as you can along with the usual light, heat and radiation.

in this inner heaven you are the only force of creation and destruction, no law of heavens or higher powers exist here aside of the law of physics and only for as long as you take to find a way to change those through your own powers.

contrary to any other world this inner heaven's universe grow and shrink to your desire and the sun will never go out or run out of material or even be destroyed unless you die for it is your very soul and can be used in any way a star (Dyson sphere, plasma harvest, hydrogen harvest, etc) but can now also be modified through other way than soul magic.

You can go in and out of this inner heaven, bring things in with you and summon things out at will. Anything you do in this inner heaven is real for better and worse so training progress and injuries remain but death inside the realm only cause you to black out for a day before you reform fully healed (every death double the black out time exponentially, this reset every 10 000 years that pass in your inner heaven. 

time in your inner heaven is 1:1 with whatever place you were in before entering it even when your are not in it. 

You can do anything you want with this inner heaven and it give you a more stable and straightforward way to access your soul, the option this give you is limitless if you are creative.

rows.title: kirin traits

objects.title: the will of P-egasus. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Pegasus pony relish the pain that come with progress toward their goals, they are not afraid of pushing themselves too far because to them life is always too short to waste no matter how long it could ever be. 

Pegasus pony rarely die of old age but always die fulfilled, pushing themselves ever onward until their body break and then further yet.

Through sheer force of will commanding sinew and bone long after they are spent and yet holding on for that one additional wings beat that could make the difference.

Yes a Pegasus pony rarely dies of old age but always fulfilled and now so will you, this perk make you more than driven it make you a zealot when pursuing your goals and ensure you always dies with a smile on your face.

this boost confidence and prevent loss of motivation as well as turn pain into pleasure when working on bettering yourself.

objects.title: rainbow road. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Rainbows are part of the Pegasus pony first creation it hold within the condensed powers of the sky and now you can make it yourself, this potent substance is a liquide that when painted on surface can imbue the surface with one or more of the seven attribute of the sky.

1:the red of the ascending heat of summer.
2:the orange of the burning horizon of dawn and dusk.
3:yellow of the flash of lightning strike.
4:green of the breeze of spring.
5:blue of the rain of autumn.
6:indigo of the deep frost of winter
7:violet of the endless above it all.

Each can grant power to item in tune with their meaning.

A pegasus pony can if they ingest and channel it and power through the pain of doing so, empower all its perk and traits by 700% for one minutes by season for a total of four minutes.

This will leave the Pegasus pony utterly spent afterward.

(your tail and mane can turn rainbow colored and you leave rainbow on your trail when flying at sprinting speed you alone can harvest it with a glass jar, if not used or stored in a container made of hardened cloud it dissipate after a few minutes.)

objects.title: eye of the storm. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Pegasus ponies all have an affinity with weather manipulation and a few of those even control lightning, but for most pegasus doing so require tools and teamwork and so can't be used "freely", it also always affect large areas.

With this traits you can now us lightning manipulation at small scale by yourself it allow you to generate lightning on your own and wield it to various effect from ranged attack to boosting reaction time and speed and even turn yourself into lightning.

In adition while large scale weather manipulation normally need multiple Pegasus pony to use, that is not the case for you, you are the eye of the storm and weather are born and turned effortlessly to your purpose.

You are the hurricane.

objects.title: master forever more. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Many species have over the years found way to take to the sky, some have even made it their lifegoal to reach the stars beyond and it may sometime cause some to think Pegasus pony will one day be outmatched when it come to flight, often forgetting that Pegasus pony too can use tools to empower their inherent talent.

With this perk you take this even further, no matter what tool any species has ever built to take to the air you will always be able to master and improve upon it, this extend to any speed or weather related tech as well.

Furthermore as long as specific knowledge is needed to maintain your air superiority you will easily find, understand and assimilate said knowledge in record time, as expected of a Pegasus pony.

objects.title: builder of the heaven.(rare trait)
objects.text:
Like fish belong to water and worm to the dirt Pegasus belong to the sky and so this is where they live, confortable into building made of "hardened" cloud shaped by hooves and weather magic.

With this perk you become a master clouds builder and can effortlessly use any trait and perk you have to speed up building large cloud based infrastructure. 

It is said that a few Pegasus could grant sapience to cloud a long time ago and this is true for you now, those cloud will be capable of minor fit of shapeshifting to perform simple job for you and be incorporeal when attacked. 

They lack any form of offensive mean but are good at gathering information in vertu that only freezing cold or intense flames can truly harm them.

objects.title: you.are.speed. (unique trait)
objects.text:
The Rainboom, the act of reaching magic speed.

To you it might look like the sound barrier but it isn't. when one does a Rainboom their speed is uncapped and they can move as fast as they want, from the speed of sound to the speed of light or even beyond even the time barrier is within hoof reach. 

And this perk guarantee you can do it. At this speed causality break and you can finish doing things before you started doing them, be at multiple places at once and even rewrite the past yet not suffer paradox and jump from reality to reality. 

Breaking those barrier beyond the light one have consequence for you and others and you can instantly lose yourself to this speed for even i know not what lies beyond the edge of the omniverse.

Something far easier for you to accidentally cross than you should probably risk.

rows.title: pegasus pony traits
rows.titleText:
here are the pegasus ponies traits.

keep in mind that every perks and traits and the drawback potency are based on "build" and "beauty" with better one amplifying the perks and traits as well as mitigating the drawback.

objects.title: dark desire. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Shadow pony exude a martial attractiveness, a dominant charisma. At least that's what most non shadow pony think when meeting one, instead some shadow pony are capable of sensing the dark -as in hidden- desires of those who look at them and know how to fan and twist those desire to incite attraction and obedience as well as cooperation. 

While the most well known shadow pony king sombra is known for his straight forward aggressivity never forget that a shadow pony perform better in, well the shadow. Pulling at the string and networking in backroom dealing and even yes, seduction and manipulation.

objects.title: undying fury. (rare trait)
objects.text: While all shadow pony can heal using shadow some master of the technic have found a way to even reverse almost full body destruction by slowly reforming from whatever scrap of their magic is left, be they enchantement and remnant of spells those shadow pony cannot die unless there legacy is truly burned whole, and this trait make you one of them. be careful though, reforming this way will take centuries without a way to speed it up.

objects.title: blot out the light. (rare trait)
objects.text:
This trait allow you to deal with a shadow pony greatest weakness, light. 

With this trait you gain the "blackout" ability, instead of being dispersed by light your shadow can absorb some light, this cause your shadows to weaken and eventually disperse but prevent the light from shining through and if you have enough shadows you can even cover the light, doing so reduce the cost in shadows to keep its ray contained.

objects.title: shadowed mind army. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Shadow is a strange concept in magic, one that seem so unrelated to mind control. yet powerful shadow pony have proven capable of pulling over the mind of others a veil of shadow that push their mind into dormancy and allow the shadow pony to overtake their body.

By doing so the shadow pony become a pseudo hive mind, no abilities are shared between the bodies but neither do they lose access to what they could do before and while the shadow pony multitasking and processing power grow with each body it is barely enough to make using said bodies all at the same time as well as his own and no more. 

Their intellect isn't enhanced and whatever knowledge the mind controlled beings had is inaccessible as well and this control require the head of the target to be in an dark space (like a helmet) and is broken otherwise.

Yet this remain a powerful force multiplier considering the lack of limit on range between bodies or numbers of possessed beings.

 This magic is considered evil as you'd expect of something that deny other beings their free will but maybe you can find a way to use it in a morally acceptable way?

objects.title: friend-sith is magic. (rare trait)
objects.text:
(It is recommended to read "dark magic compendium" and "dark magic symbiosis" in the blessing section.)

Dark magic is corruptive and its user can rapidly find themselves stuck between not casting magic or being corrupted beyond recovery, this trait help deal with this problem as from now on you can purify yourself of corruption by... being a good person, that's right every good deed will slightly reduce corruption and the nicer and more helpful you are the more corruption is removed.

The unlocked tier of dark magic remain unlocked even when the corruption fall below the threshold.

You can now turn on and off any part/whole mutation but the last one (that of the lich).

objects.title: King in Black. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Darkness is generally interpreted as the lack of all light but true darkness only existed when nothing else did. the primordial darkness from before the first stars ignited and banished it away, this darkness is not gone though merely held at bay and always eager to swallow the world once more.

Some think darkness is their ally but they merely adopted the darkness, you are born from it, molded from it. you are the primordial darkness of your chosen universe.

In practical term this mean all your shadow can now also become as tangible and solid as flesh or liquide like ink. This increase its resistance to light tremendously and instead of being erased it is merely slowed under light. 

While the basic benefits of this trait are great, one can only wonder what would happen if you could reach the primordial darkness at the edge of the universe.

rows.title: shadow pony traits

objects.title: "pragmatic" fighter. (rare trait)
objects.text:
In my worlds most races react to conflict in two way, the obviously better method of dialogue and befriending or if it doesn't work straightforward beatdown, i know not very friendly but i can assure you that a good buck to the head more often than not succeed where dialogue fail to reset someone out of being an asshole. 

Yet in the case of thestral some almost have a compulsion to preemptively and instinctively prepare devious back up plan for when dialogue fail, in fact when entering a situation that can devolve into physicals conflict you will  now instinctively know.

You will also also have a sixth sense and almost cutscene like moment of extra sensorial perception for any detail that can help you end fight quickly and decisively, the catch is that all the method will be "cheap" and "unsightly""

No fanciful show of skills or quick precise takedown with finesse and technic, instead it will more likely happen with a hoof-full of sand to the face and a quick kick to the groin.

No heroic parade for you if anyone see you fighting I'm afraid but then again fighting should hardly be seen as glorious to begin with. 

While this trait by way of how it work act as a danger sense and warning of incoming conflict it doesn't work on being that don't intend to attack you and also fail if you don't make an honest attempt at solving the matter through dialogue once you are aware of the coming conflict.

objects.title: Felonious Cauldron. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Thestral are well known for forming organized crime syndicates, at time robin hood and at other ruthless mafia their nocturnal lifestyle made them predisposed to becoming smuggler and perfect to fulfill shady businesses under the cover of darkness and out of the law's gaze.

This meant that over time a part of them developed a talent for it and gained the ability to not only sense criminal-ish gents and ladies near them but also the ability to fit in into any illegal organisation or even make their own with no challenge from any one but the agents of the law

That's right other gangs, mafia family and dirty ne'er do well will ignore you at worst or welcome you the rest of the time, that is unless you make a move against them or grow to about 80% of their own size or power whichever is higher. 

You also gain a supernatural sense for making a profit through illegal but not necessarily immoral methods. No one who officially joined your syndicate even if they go straight one day will ever betray you unless you betrayed them first.

objects.title: "vampire" pony. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Thestral once had a reputation as blood sucker, this is sadly pretty accurate since a small part of their population developed a unique feeding method that allowed them to "suck out" the "life" from anything they bit to replenish their energy, magic store and even supercharge healing. 

By biting something biological with their fangs a thestral can "suck" anything inside that the thestral can use this mean that yes biting some pony will provide everything a thestral might need but doing so with actual food work just fine as well.

This trait allow you to do the same, this method of feeding remove any risk of being poisoned or ingesting anything detrimental and ensure that 100% of what you eat is used optimally thus keeping you in the best health of your life. 

Feeding solely this way also remove the need to go to the bathroom and any risk of becoming overweight or underweight.

objects.title: stealth flyer. (rare trait)
objects.text:
While thestral like to fly as much as any other flying race they are noticeably less prone to make it their actual focus in life and never draw out the true potential of their flight.

Those who do quickly find how easy and natural it is for them to become stealth flyer, and i mean that in the literal magical sense, when in flight those thestral are invisible and completely silent they have no smell and don't create draft when flapping.

The only weakness of this power is that they still have a shadow so keep that in mind (unless you have shadow magic).

objects.title: the abyss stare back. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Some thestral have the ability to command obedience with but a single glare, this power rely on the unique shifting of blood vessels patterns inside a thestral iris and require eye contact just like hypnosis magic.

But contrary to hypnosis this magic can work through videos recording, as this hypnosis require a rapid series of blood patterns pictures and drawing fail to carry the induced compulsion.

In this state a thestral can give orders to the target but once eye contact is broken the targets will regain its freedom.

Unless ordered otherwise the target will remember everything you made it do. Orders the targets forget will still be followed subconsciously.  

Be aware that your reflection and recording of yourself affect you as well.

objects.title: eldritch insight. (unique trait)
objects.text:
Moon drunk monster beautiful and strange,
howl your melancholic questions  and tell me:
which you dread more...
The echo or the answer?

You can now peer beyond the masquerade, peel the skin of the world and see the truth of reality. Listen to the whispered names of forgotten and yet unborn beings from a place beyond time and reason. 

Hunt those truth and collect the true name of all things and grow your insight, as you do you will become something...more.

you can ear the answer of anything you talk to be it object, place or event, the answer is always the truth as the targets know it. 

You can also see "seam" in reality where major event happened and can look or cross through those to the alternate path not taken, action taken in those alternate event have no impact on reality but things can be taken before returning to the main timeline with no consequence. 

As implied those alternate event are not real and crumble to nothing the longer you stay there, this does not affect what you bring back to reality.

Be aware that the moment you enter an alternate event an identical alternate of you abilities wise but opposite morally will appear somewhere in the event and try to kill you and take your place, those alternate cannot leave the event while you are alive and cease to exist when you leave.

They cannot be reasoned with.

rows.title: thestral pony traits

objects.title: glowing teamwork. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Unicorn -once in decent control of their magic- are real powerhouse, earth pony are tough and strong but unicorn have shield spells and telekinesis, Pegasus are fast and can fly but unicorn can teleport and cast fireballs. 

Sadly this led to unicorn pony leaving rather solitary lifestyle, their own prowess making teamwork a rather pointless affair in general. 

But the truth is unicorn can just like everyone else benefit greatly from working together as magic spells can very easily resonate with similar spells cast nearby and even merge into massive feat of spell casting. 

Any sudden surge or loss of control from one unicorn is buffered by the other nearby and granting a safety net to cast ever grandeur spells.

This trait give you all the know how of this lost art and make you a central node of any group casting amplifying the group control and power for every caster that assist and granting you all an awareness of who in the group struggle the most and how to help them the best.

objects.title: wisdom of eons. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Unicorn can learn a lot from books, while spell crafting require careful experimentation of a unicorn personal magic, standard spell are a different matter and are spells that were developed and codified to be usable by all.

Those spell are less efficient, slower to use and often much weaker than a unicorn personal repertoire but have the advantage that failure to cast it will only be mildly unpleasant instead of catastrophically crippling, they can also be learned from regular books.

The problem arise when one want to learn a large variety of them and here come the relevances of magic books, magic books are book that hold a standard spell "code" called "runic pattern".

This runic pattern can be studied and even modified and this can shorten a unicorn study of their personal magic by leaps and bound through more informed experimentation by cross-referencing those books with their own perception of their magic.

Those books can also become powerful focuses and allow even unicorn with broken horn to cast intricate spells, those books are also able to record a unicorn spell craft to allow precise modification and even fusion of different spells. 

The problem of standard spell for most unicorn is that spell in written form appear as massive and complicated runic pattern that are a pain to remember, especially when juggling a few hundreds different patterns.

This trait fix that by giving you the complete compression and perfect memory of all runic patterns and languages you study and a knack for modifying them to your needs.

“Books are a uniquely portable magic.”-Stephen king.

objects.title: shattered limits. (rare trait)
objects.text:
A broken horn is a gruesome sight for anyone but even more so for a unicorn, it is the vision of lost potential and proof of a painful and often troubled past, it also make unicorn more likely to lash out in fear and panic, the loss of their horn leaving them feeling vulnerable. 

In truth a unicorn is not actually defenseless despite a broken horn, they just loose all finesse and regain it all in pure power as the only limitation between a unicorn core and the outside world is shattered wide open, the mean to shape spells may be gone but the mana output increase.

Yet sometime there come a unicorn who regain its control, its finesse. They do this using raw mana to shape spells outside their body right where their horn use to be. this action is seen as beyond reckless by other unicorn as raw mana is prone to go wild and can cast completely unique effect onto what it touches and those unicorn cast it right in front of their faces but casting spells this way is said -and i confirm it is true- to slowly regrow the horn of unicorn from the root.

This trait give you a gift for raw finesse and control that would allow you to cast normally even with a broken horn let alone with one, and should your horn ever break know that it will regrow far faster than for other pony using this technic.

objects.title: tools of the trade. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Unicorn are rather frail by pony standard, they also lack endurance and are definitely prone to overthinking, yet those reason are why you will find no pony more prepared than a unicorn.

Its not rare for unicorn to dabble into enchantment and alchemy no matter their talents and career if only to maintain their own tools since enchanted item are a core component of a unicorn life and can do a large number of things.

This trait give you a knack for creating and maintaining enchanted item and manifest as a guaranteed success on enchanting items with enchantement you have completed on your own at least once as well as perfect repair guaranteed on enchanted item you personally created.

From magic books to staff, from bag of holding to spell scrolls all of it come from enchanting, of course it as its own drawback mainly the wide variety and rarity of the reagent and ingredients required for higher quality items as well as a steeper mana cost to create enchantement than just casting the equivalent spell and the limited amount of uses for some items.

on the other hoof enchanted item are faster to use, can be used by even non-unicorn and allow unicorn to spend mana before rest to store magical effect that can then be hoarded indefinitely until dire time since enchantement does not deplete unless actively used.

objects.title: SCIENCE! (rare trait)
objects.text:
Unicorn ponies need from a very young age to experiment and record their progress in magic to use it safely, this make them -in most case- very good at scientific endeavor.

This perk take it a bit further and grant you an increased talent with sciences of all kind as long as it is to:

-gather datas of any kind.
-solve a specific problems yet to be readily solved.
-make a new (for you) discovery. 
-create/reverse engineer an item that cannot be readily acquired. 
 
This power allow you to make massive progress on your work in every step from research, study, conception, prototyping, finition all the way to a completed product or study.

In addition this power allow you to "brainstorm" let me explain, you pick a scientific project and then get on with you life in the meantime your brain will brainstorm it while you do other things and about once every three cumulated hours of doing something else but science you will get flash of genius that will let you progress whatever project you picked jump a few weeks ahead in just a few minutes of work. 

This repeat three time in a row before you brain go on strike and leave you with an hours long case of brain freeze and "brainstorm" go into a three month cooldown while the brain rest and recharge.

The perfect trait for urgent projects.

objects.title: a taste of divinity. (unique trait)
objects.text:
"Magic, Magic doesn’t require beauty, Easy magic is pretty. Great magic asks you trouble the waters. It requires a disruption, something new."-Leigh Bardugo

You are the disruption, you are what is new.

You no longer require to practice the previous ranks of spells to unlock the full knowledge of the compendiums, and any spell cast perfectly make recasting it easier until even master ranked spells can be cast with the ease of a beginner one. 

Crafting a new master level spells in a magical field you do not have the compendium of will unlock said compendium.

rows.title: unicorn pony traits

objects.title: good natured. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Yak are one and all very good natured, brutish loud and messy but good natured they will accept honest apology and when a yak forgive he will forget and not hold grudges, they are also generous and friendly with others, all those aspect make it easy for yaks to make allies and this trait embody that.

Indeed this trait give you an instinct for finding other that you will get along with and more importantly are worthy of all you have to offer, this also ensure you will know who is the opposite around you, never be afraid of making false friends or trusting the wrong person ever again.

objects.title: static stealth. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Yaks are big and often smell of strong odors such as wood varnish, wet fur and alcohol they are noisy and loud and boisterous and yet some are terrifyingly stealthy. 

Indeed some yak have mastered the art of being so still and silent that they become invisible to they eye and any other sense. 

This power fail completely upon the yak making any noise or movement aside of breathing and blinking and cannot reactivate while someone is watching you or know you are there, on the other hoof it can be active in your sleep as long as you don't snore.

objects.title: happiness go-getter. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Yaks do not always know exactly what they want in life, 
is it fame, is it glory, is it fortune? 
How many actually know what they want to do with their life? 
and how many amongst them take the steps needed to get it? 

Well when a yak know they will, this trait give you a drive to see your goal through, as long as you desire something you will be filled with determination and will to carry on evermore toward fulfilling that desire.

No mountain are high enough, no valley wide enough and no river wide enough to stop you for you will always instinctively know how to bypass or break though all roadblock. 

This power only work on one goal at a time and work better for personnel goal where you are emotionally invested into, this almost guarantee you will find the love of your life one day should you ever seek it.

objects.title: steadfast. (rare trait)
objects.text:
The yaks ruler is an elected but unlike most democratic government they are "elec-told" to take charge, the yak literally chosen to rule is always the one that the most yaks know and trust to embody and never renounce their values. 

This is considered the greatest honor and responsibility amongst yaks and as such is both valued and dreaded and can be given and taken on a dime with no maximum or minimum service time and to have the post taken for any reason other than death, health issue, old age or nominating  another more deserving yaks with humility is seen as either a tragedy or a dishonor.

The mere possibility of being elected and the unspoken threat of being deposed ungracefully incite amongst yaks of renown a subconscious need to hold themselves to higher standard and to hold onto their virtues.

This trait give you the same subconscious drive and make you a more steadfast all around mentally, the way this work is similar to "Invictus" and "patience of saint" but only for yaks. 

This also make you hyper competent in rulership and management as well as any skill related to guiding a civilisation to prosperity.

objects.title: carver of legends. (rare trait)
objects.text:
"Yak saw yak in the wood and carved until yak set yak free.  Michelyakgelo"

Yakyakistan is a harsh land of bitterly cold and humid winter as well as blood freezing winds all year long and for all the fur and bulk of the yaks woods is their greatest ally for it is wood that fuel the fire that cast out the cold and the walls built with it that block out the winds that sap all warmth.

Generation of sculpting and carving wood have given birth among the yaks to a small population among them now called the wood-life sculptors, those sculptor can breath life into their sculpture not just artistically but literally.

Once a wood-life sculpture finish sculpting a piece they can grant it the potential for life and the Ability to come alive for 8 hours for 16 hours of rest, this time can be stocked in reserve indefinitely. 

This trait contrary to other magic compendium that allow the creation of animated objects require no active magic power or special ressource on your part aside wood and the skill to carve it.

objects.title: yak effect. (unique trait)
objects.text:
When a yak believe, truly believe in something from the depth of their hearts it tend to prove "somewhat" right. 

When many yaks believe with such fervor it "reliably" prove right.

That is because while yak rarely have any mastery of magic they all possess the power of belief over reality and the more yaks believe in the same thing the more this thing become reality.

The problem with this aside that yak tend to believe whatever is told to them convincingly enough is that it only work on and for yaks meaning that no matter how much they believe something about other non yaks being it has no effect and no matter how much they like someone from other races anything the yak use that rely on the yaaaaak effect  will fail to work when shared.

Funnily enough despite how mindbogglingly powerful this sound it is also in actual practice very weak in general, only allowing small change in how likely things could happen and in general is merely seen as yaks being lucky, not so much with this trait, instead this trait allow you to focus this effect inward and toward crafting to make it so that the more you and other yaks believe you can do something or make something work the more likely that you can and that can ramp up with the number of yaks from memorizing an entire field of science  with mere self study to building a fusion reactor with a dishwasher.

Of course what you can learn through this trait is limited to how much yaks believe you can actually learn at all and what you built will fail in any none yaks appendages but when you need a miracle and have only charisma or guile to work with? that trait is a goldmine.

rows.title: yak traits

objects.title: escape artist. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Zebra prefer to  live in wild untamed lands where they can peacefully cultivate and raise the wide array of plants, fungus and animals they use in their crafting.

This mean that more often than not dangerous creature are always close by, and while most zebra can defend themselves this is time and ressources consuming.

Instead of fighting zebra learned to make themselves undesirable targets by simply being impossible to catch and by picking this trait so are you.

You can dodge and weave through entire pack of rabid wolves with ease.
you can spot cover and break line of sight in a flash and you always have a little more pockets sand to throw into a pursuer eyes.

As long as flight is possible you will make it unharmed, beware that this trait does not warn you of ambush or if you are stepping into a traps until after you started fleeing so stay vigilant.

objects.title: off road. (rare traits)
objects.text:
Zebra are master of roughing it out in the wild and yet, even most them would balk at where the zebra shaman called Zecora went to. 

This mare explored and perfected her craft all over the world until arriving to the Everfree forest a place of sentient purposeful wilderness and untamable land and she thrived in it. While her skill as a shaman are what most notice her ability to survive, live and thrive in those inhospitable lands is what this trait is all about. 

With this trait the more terrible your environnement is the greater your ability rise across the board by up to 300%, that mean that physically and mentally you can think 3 time faster be 3 time smarter, 3 time stronger and 3 time faster. 

The moment the situation around you start settling down those boosts diminish in proportion to how good you are doing.

objects.title: born magical potioneer. (rare trait)
objects.text:
Zebra have learned the value of being prepared a long time ago, through hardship and carful study some of them have developed a sixth sense when it come to making the potion version of any magic they know or studied. 

This trait allow you to make any magical spells or effect into a drinkable or throwable potion that work either when consumed or applied. 

None of the potion you create will have their effect last past 168 hours after use.

This rely heavily on your crafting masteries and compendium's knowledge and access to magical reagents but require barely no active magical power of your own if any.

objects.title: voodoo savvy. (rare trait)
objects.text:
In your world voodoo is done by performing ritual to call upon iwa spirits, in my world that is also the case though the iwa are just one part of the population of varied spirits that live there.  

Though the practice of voodoo a zebra can perform many things from many magical field's compendium those fields being: illusion, divination, ward and healing.

The one thing that only voodoo does that other magical fields do not is curses, indeed by reversing a spell with the help of an iwa spirit it is possible to turn a healing spell into a hurtful curse or a ward into a curse upon the land itself etc. 

Be aware that voodoo by nature can only have two amongst: cheap, powerful and fast and that voodoo often require a sacrifice or a deal of sort to be made to the iwa and they always cash in.

(This trait allow you to perform the spells of illusion, divination, ward and healing compendium at up to master level without having to progress through the learning stage but only through crafting masteries instead of casting. also, to ask iwa to cast those spells for you in exchange of something they want, iwa are heteroclite and varied and all will not accept the same payment, though they all enjoy possessing mortal from time to time to enjoy the finer things in life.

objects.title: not-not-necromancy. (rare trait)
objects.text:
If you look ahead at the magical fields compendium section you will notice the lack of necromancy compendium, that is because in my worlds none may forcefully tear a soul out from the afterlife and even resurrections through healing magic is limited. 

This trait is a cheeky roundabout that the zebra came up with.

They don't bring the dead back to un-life instead they bring the bodies back to un-life and then stretch their own soul to inhabit both their own and the resurrected body at the same time, this allow them to use any innate ability the body had like unicorn horns and pegasus wings or changeling shapeshifting as well as know what the body knew but only for as long as they have said body since knowledge and abilities does not transfer from body to body.

Range is unlimited as soul care not for distance and stretch with no limit (be aware that other being capable of seeing and interacting with soul could interfere with your soul "strands" should you spread you bodies to far.) this does not provide any innate talent for multitasking, indeed learning how to move multiple bodies differently at the same time will be all up to you.

Body need to be at least 50% intact to be and stay resurrected and will degrade unless maintained through healing or transmutation magic.

objects.title: pitit Bondye. (unique trait)
objects.text:
In your world voodoo is ruled by Bondye, but in my worlds a god of voodoo as yet to rise, to embody it. 

This trait give you a Head start in doing so, it allow you to see and talk to iwa at all time without ritual. 

To become the god of voodoo at least 131313 iwa spirits need to pledge themselves to you, good news is this trait also make iwa who have yet to pledge allegiance to any other Vodouisants flocks to you eager to make deal.

This also mean they will often pester you but be assured, without assistance they are unable to interact with the mortal world in anything but voices.

Becoming the god/goddess of voodoo will allow you to rule over iwa spirits contracts -to break and enforce them- and to reverse the effects of magic spell without the help of iwa spirits, but more importantly you ca do so not only on your own spell but also the spell of others, this make most magic less than useless against you.

This trait also make it possible for you to use the "spirits magic compendium" to convert major spirit into iwa spirits, those iwa spirits also count toward your ascension.

rows.title: zebra traits

objects.title: Ascend.
objects.text:
You want to be an alicorn? Are you sure? Very well i respect your choice then but remember, immortality isn't living forever. That's not what it feels like, Immortality is everybody else dying....Well except other alicorn i suppose. 

Now,  as an alicorn you will have:

-Faith powered Absolute Immortality: Immortality as long as even one being (except yourself of course )worship you. no aging past your prime and Absolute Regeneration from even a single atome or if nothing of you remain you will instead reform close to where you died from nothing. its in fact easier to imprison you than kill you, if you are forgotten by all beings you will lose this immortality but it will return if enough peoples start worshiping you again bringing you back to life.

-Up to three pony tribe worth (including the ones you already choose to unlock this choice) of perks for a total of six perks and one of the drawbacks of your choice amongst the three chosen tribes ( the tribes available are: earth pony , pegasus pony , unicorn pony, bat pony, shadow pony and kirin.)

-Your size is multiplied by a factor of 1.5 to 2.5. your size based on what pony tribes you picked first.

-You get all three natural focus for free. 

-You get to choose a domain amongst the list below, this domain will be yours to rule and manage. it will influence you as well over time so pick something you see yourself loving first and foremost.

objects.title: Alicorn of music
objects.text:
You shall rule over music, this mean that you control sound as a whole around you? the range increasing with time and practice with your domain. 

This also make you a genius level song writer and singer and a master at playing any and all instruments past, present and futur. 

any information or knowledge  anyone ever sing or has sung that is also true or relevant will be added to your brain as information you can call upon or "recall" when you need it.

Anything you do is empowered when done while singing or music is playing around you, along with the ability to regain magic and faith (see divine magic compendium) from singing and instruments playing for you, around you and in worship of you. 

Favored material: Bone

Favored elements: Wind

objects.title: Alicorn of desire
objects.text:
You shall rule over desire, lust yes but also desire as a whole the very feeling of longing for something. You now always know all your desire, conscious or not and the next three step to fulfill said desire the fastest way with what you have on hoof. the number of step increase with times and practice with your domain.

This give you the ability to know what anyone you meet both desire and how much, even the thing they desire subconsciously.

Granting desire and igniting new ones will empower you and help you regain magic and generate faith (see divine magic compendium), anything you do to fulfill a desire of yours or someone else's are made easier the more sapient and sentient beings long for you to succeed.

Favored material: Cloth

Favored elements: Light

objects.title: Alicorn of growth
objects.text:
You shall rule over the domain of growth, you shall benefit from any training and from any practice in any domain or skills a hundred time more than normally you will also never degrade in any skill you have learned, you now have no limit to how much your attributes (strength, dexterity, endurance, intelligence, magical potency) can grow aside your access to greater challenge. 

you can also induce this effect at a tenth of the potency in other physically and mentally but not metaphysically aside you're own magical practice. the number of simultaneous targets for this effect increase with time and practice, it start at 1 and can "grow" without limit . 

When other practice or use technics and knowledge you shared or taught them it generate faith (see divine magic compendium) and your mana regenerate faster.

Favored material: Wood

Favored elements: Water

objects.title: Alicorn  of game
objects.text:
You shall rule over games? Any activities that follow established rules and can be won or lost is henceforth considered a game, as such even thing like politics can be a game for you as long as you openly "challenge" another beings into a "game of politics "and explain the rule/s, goal/s and win/loss conditions, they can refuse but once they accept only victory or defeat will stop the game.

You can force someone to accept a challenge by allowing them to chose the games amongst the classic ones: chess, checkers, poker, rock paper scissor, othello, shogi, go, or coin flip. 

Time and practice with your domain allow you to limit those choices, any bets will be enforced at the end no matter who win or lose.

You know all the rules of any game you want to play or watch but cannot cheat unless the game include cheating as a rule, if someone cheat in a game that does not allow cheating and you catch them you instantly win. 

You become better at any specific games every time you win at said game but also become worst at it any time you lose. you never become worst than you were right when gaining this domain.

you gain a genius level intellect when it come to creating new games and any one playing a games you created grant you faith as long as they play (see divine magic compendium), while playing a game personally with someone else you magic regenerate faster when close to defeat and slower closer to victory.

Favored material: Gold

Favored elements: Light

objects.title: Alicorn  of science
objects.text:
You shall rule over science, the systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical, natural and magical world through observation, experimentation, and the testing of theories against the evidence obtained.

You gain technopathy access to any tech you built or own and are capable of adapting to any tech you replace or upgrade your body with and grant it any biological or magical effects you had without anomaly.

Any scientific knowledge known world wide ( meaning any planet you step on) by at least 25% of the (planet) scientific community and yet to be disproved (correctly disproved not by mistake) is added to your mind for you to peruse and make use of, you can seamlessly recall and understand any of this knowledge and it is additively updated daily (knowledge can only be added not removed unless disproved).

you can reverse engineer any tech you personally disassemble bypassing any black boxing and correcting any purposeful flaw born from shady craftmanship or corner/cost cutting.

Anyone studying or using scientific discovery you made grant you faith (see divine magic compendium) , when using the seven step of the scientific process for anything your magic regenerate faster.

Favored material: Steel

Favored elements: Lightning

objects.title: Alicorn of food
objects.text:
You shall rule over food or rather sustenance as a whole, you can eat and drink anything without limits and without any worry about your health from either obesity, poison or sickness or metaphysical effect bound to what you eat.

You also gain decent sustenance from anything you eat,  whatever it is even if it shouldn't be edible or if its metaphysical (a.k.a you can eat light or time or pain). the effect of doing so for the source of you "food" vary with intent and context. 

Time and practice increase your precision and how large your "bite" is when you try to eat something, it start at what you can actually reach and bite physically and what fit in your mouth.

You also become a master chef and cook and know how to cook every dish considered food ever made or that will be made.

When someone eat the food you made or make and offer food in your name to another being or altar you gain faith (see divine magic compendium) and eating actual food regenerate your magic faster.

Favored material: Sugar

Favored elements: Fire

objects.title: Alicorn  of fantasy
objects.text:
You shall rule over fantasy, the imaginary world of the impossible and wonderous. You know all the fantasy (the sweet and trauma inducing one, yes even those.) of those you meet, you can also use piece of fantasy and fiction to create (and close obviously) windows to alternate realities where those fantasy and fiction are real and ask question to native or borrow items from this realities.

No one can cross those windows, only sounds, sight and items only one exception exist where a being (dead or alive) can trade place (or be swapped) with an alternate of him/her or their equivalent, for exemple two protagonist trading place or two villain you need to make both being cross the portal at about the same time.

Time and practice will allow you to create more window, bigger window and create them further away as well as faster or even move them around after creation (in both realities).

You can learn, practice and use any skills, technics and abilities from other realities and use any items you bring from those even if you shouldn't be able to. You have no advantage in learning those skills technics and abilities aside bypassing any physicals metaphysical or mental requirement they usually would have.

when someone read or write a piece (positive or negative) of fantasy or fiction based on you or something you did or wrote you gain faith (see divine magic compendium).

When acting like a fantasy character or a specific character of fiction and hamming it up you regen magic faster.

Favored material: Glass

Favored elements: Water

objects.title: Alicorn  of conflict
objects.text:
You shall rule over conflict, or rather its swift and if needed violent resolution as the alicorn of conflict you can sense, predict and resolve conflict before they ever become a problem and should you need to start one you will end it at the same time 9 time out of 10.  

When included, dragged, involved or even preparing in/for conflicts of any kind your magic regenerate faster and all your attribute (strength, dexterity, endurance, intelligence, magical potency) increase with the potential scale and intensity of the conflicts. 

Any mundane skills or knowledge that you feel could help you in a conflict are immediately known and understood 1 hours before said conflict begin, this is updated instantly anytime a new skill or bit of knowledge is needed and all of it is retained until the conflict is resolved, it is fully lost afterward. 

Time and practice grant the skill and knowledge earlier up to six years before the conflict start.

When a conflict end thanks to you help or guidance direct or through someone you influenced you gain faith (see divine magic compendium). 

Favored material: Obsidian

Favored elements: Fire

objects.title: Alicorn of freedom
objects.text:
Y ou shall rule over freedom, you are unbound and all tyrants will fall at your hooves for you are the queen of the free, the breaker of chains.

No power can ever contain you merely slow you down and all curse you suffer, seal that Bind you and any other ailments lose grip on you after at most a 1000 years and far less if you fight and rage against your bindings.

You also cannot be denied entry anywhere nor can anything stop you from going where you wish be it walls or magic for you can simply walk through them ignoring their presence and effects.

You can see the "chain" that restrain anyone you meet, be they mental, physical or metaphysical and their source by following said chain, you can also break them to remove their effects on the targets like breaking a chain off toxic love between a violent partner and their victime, allowing the victim to réalise the truth and give them finally the courage and will to leave.

Any being exercising their freedom thanks to you grant you faith (see divine magic compendium). when you challenge oppressions your magic regenerate faster.

As the alicorn of freedom you can now at will travel back and forth (and bring others along with you) to any world you have been to, yes even your original one. be aware that nothing stop other beings from following you if they have the capabilities to do so and they notice your world hoping.

Remember that, while time stop in the worlds you fixed in your absence, worlds you are in the process of fixing still move forward should you leave them before being done.

Favored material: Gemstones

Favored elements: Wind

rows.title: special race: alicorn
rows.titleText:
Alicorn are to be frank divinities, this give alicorn the ability to not only have up to three pony tribe worth of attributes including both perks and only one of the drawbacks (earth pony , pegasus pony , unicorn pony, bat pony, shadow pony and even kirin.) this also give them a domain.

A domain is in essence the admin key to control any law of reality and rules of all things related to said domain in an area (decided by how magically powerful the alicorn is.)

My daughters celestia and luna where the alicorn of the day and night respectively and as such celestia could move the sun with but a flick of her horn but also control plant growth and had virtually endless amount of magic during the day while luna could move the moon and rearrange the stars canopy (by hiding or revealing stars not moving them of course.) as well as exist and control the dream realm or make dream reality.

Of course domain have some overlap, strange interaction and even limitation within reality like how while luna could affect the stars she could not control her world sun despite it being technically a star and that is because as luna was living under it it become the star that would dictate her night and day and as the alicorn of the night she had no control over the day.

Hope you are following me so far because this are the kind of convoluted thinking divinities have to deal with when applying their domain to different tasks and if you want to be one you will have to figure this mess out yourself, indeed i will hardly be able to help as you domain rules are often dictated by your own frame of mind and its own limitation. 

speaking of domain you cannot exactly pick freely sadly as alicorn are serious business and i try to keep a hoof on their creation -also some domain are already taken- so i will instead provide you a list to pick from depending of your blessings i strongly advise you pick one you like instead of one you think is powerful after all an alicorn only show its true potential when in harmony with its domain.

by the way my first domain was "creation".

objects.title: divine poise.
objects.text:
With this trait you are gifted with a godly mastery of yourself in anything you do. 

You always know perfectly what you can and cannot do, never underestimating or overestimating yourself.

You know everything about the state of your wellbeing -physical, mental and magical-  at any time.

You can through sheer, focused will, break curses, block scrying and dispel spells trying to affect you from beings magically weaker than you. 

You also endure the mental impact of the passage of time better than other alicorn.

objects.title: It came through the void.
objects.text:
With this trait you are now capable of moving through the void between the star, you require no air, no warmth, no water or food to survive and thrive. 

You can even survive being sealed for thousands of years upon a desolated, radiation washed world, with nothing and no one with you and not suffer for it. 

You also become more physically robust than other alicorn.

objects.title: Domain physiologie.
objects.text:
If your remember each domain had a favored material and elements at the end. 

With this traits you can now turn into a mix of said material and elements freely changing your appearance and the way your body can move an react to outside forces.

It also allow you to more easily affect your surrounding with your domain and grow more powerful the more you have its material and elements around you.

You also regenerate faster than other alicorn.

objects.title: Magical apex.
objects.text:
With this trait you can now have 3 free compendium except "divine magic", they all still start at the basic level as normal .  

You also get the "magical potency boost" to rank B for free.

objects.title: Ascend, once more.
objects.text:
Oh, so you are truly determined to become a true divine in more than just body and mind.  

If so then this traits will greatly help you, it give you rulership of a small piece of my own heaven.

It will be about the size of your previous earth and will in fact be a 1 to 1 copy of it  with none of the humans, infrastructure and animals or insects on it.

This verdant world ecosystem does not collapse for its is fueled by the pure magical star and moon that circle around and shine down on it.

Now you shall rule all things in this small heaven, any that worship you will go there when they die and will keep providing you with faith even after death as long as they are happy, so make sure to manage this place well.

You can go in and out of your heaven with a simple effort of will but anything you want to do in it will rely on your own powers and skills so do your best to make it into a wonderful place worthy of the name "heaven".

You can also now sense when beings nearby (100km) are both worthy (good or seeking redemption) and ready to join your religion and merely need a sign from you.

objects.title: "Magical apex." Refund box.
objects.text:
Use this to refund the cost of three compendium of your choice, "divine magic" cannot be chosen. 

You also refund the "magical potency boost" up to to rank B

(Exemple: if you take 3 compendium worth 30 and both rank of boosts you refund 30*3+10*2=110 points.)

rows.title: Alicorn traits

objects.title: earth pony core race.
objects.text:
the earth pony perks are:

-weight of the mountain: when earth ponies make a stand no one can subdue them, they become invulnerable, immovable objects as long as they remain static and all four hooves on the ground this can be interpreted as a 100% decrease in incoming damage and a 100% reduction to all form of unwilling momentum gain. (the damage reduction is caped at a 90% against entropy based attack.). nothing can move an earth pony making a stand but victory, hunger and thirst. you can still damage the ground around their hoof to break the effect or somehow suffocate them.

-tireless unrelenting charge: An earth pony charge is like an unstoppable force, the longer a earth pony run without interruption the faster they move up to a 100x multiplier and the faster they move the stronger they become with up to a 100x multiplier. still they can be redirected or made to stumble.

the earth pony drawback is:

-the lethargy of calm: earth pony lack the drive for conflict -even necessary ones- and will almost always pick a less confrontational path if offered ones, the longer this "calm" last the less likely they become to ever rouse themselves from it.

objects.title: kirin core race.
objects.text:
the kirin perks are:

-burning love: a kirin in love can ignite in a fire that does not burn said loved one, instead shielding them and burning away disease and curses, it is said this ability was developed when the first kirin lost their access to easy healing magic and a terrible plague befall them. its not, its just how the dragon-flavored magic comming from the Dragonland and seeped into them over generation shaped itself to preserve what those kirin valued most: their very few kirin kin.

-kirin scale: kirin can sniff out a scam a mile away, that as well as betrayal, lies and in fact injustice of all kind. kirin are fervent believer in karma and are more than capable of helping the scale of said karma be righted. they are skilled judge lawyer and prosecutor, their skill with the spoken word and written law is unrivaled and while they tend to blabber and speak a lot to tell nothing of value in their free time when justice call for it a kirin is a masterful orator. this come from their often damaging burst of anger, those require kirin to be honest with their feelings and maintaining a society when any ressentiment can cause property damage in a cascading disaster tend to make one a fervent follower of the written law and inclined toward honesty to prevent bad blood from forming.

the kirin drawback is:

-forced isolationist: kirin are immune to their own fire as well the the flames of other kirin -or any other flames not fueled by entropy-, not so much the other species on this list, even dragon can be burned by kirin flames if the kirin is mad enough. this mean that a kirin living in a non kirin settlement is a moving fire hazard and living in a kirin settlement is like walking amongst fire hazard that move all around you and might ignite at any inconvenience. this lead to kirin being often asked to both keep at a minimum distance from others species or to make their own house a distance from any Neighbors this also cause trouble for relationship with non kirin who might not really thrust the "burning love" of the interested kirin or worst count on it even when the kirin isn't interested, sadly while even my most pushy creation are less pushy than any pushy human ever was some still get burned for the trouble.

objects.title: pegasus core race.
objects.text:
the pegasus perks are:

-born amongst the heaven: a Pegasus in flight cannot ever lose its way for it is always home, a Pegasus pony will always find what it seek when looking at the world below no matter the distances and always know whoever share its sky in a large radius around itself in spite of any kind of stealth.

-beloved of the sky: Pegasus are never hurt by weather phenomenon they may be tossed around even loose control but they will always survive the fall with no crippling wounds for the sky love them beyond measure, further more they can easily turn those weather toward their own goal for a storm wind will send them ever onward their destination and the rain quench their thirst as it come and astray cloud wait for them to sleep on when tiredness arrive.

the pegasus drawback is:

-like dust in the winds: Pegasus pony were never meant to settle themselves elsewhere than their clouds made homes and become fragile on the solid ground and the longer they stay on contact with the ground the weaker its perk become, this doesn't happen when on things who themselves rest on cloud but anything set anywhere else will also -if more slowly- sap the perks powers (such as tree and roof) and it will take a few minutes of flight for them to regrow to full power.

objects.title: shadown pony core race.
objects.text:
the shadow pony perks are:

-shadow born: a shadow pony is not fully made of flesh and can repair or even reconstruct limbs or their horn and non vital organs by gathering shadow nearby, this can also be used to "bulk up" by absorbing excess shadow to renforce the physical attribute of the shadow pony; this also allow minor flight by partially dispersing into shadow and can even mimic teleportation by dispersing and reforming somewhere else, this incorporeal state greatly increase the shadow pony weakness to light.

-encroaching darkness: a shadow pony can -in a twisted mirror of a unicorn- generate magic in the surrounding area to absorb and replenish their own store but in this case they generate unnatural shadow they then absorb through their body to empower either their magic or body with the main difference being that shadow pony can contrary to unicorn still cast other spells while doing so, in exchange focused light and even strong wind can disperse those shadow and that the dispersion of those shadows while they are being absorbed inflict pain if not damages on the shadow pony.

the shadow pony drawback is:

-shadow constitution: shadow ponies are half flesh half shadow they are as such weakened greatly in both too bright environment and in an ironic twist completely dark ones as they require shadow not complete darkness to truly bring their power to bear. in addition direct focused light can hurt and even kill them.

objects.title: thestral core race.
objects.text:
the thestral perks are:

-red diet: thestral enjoy meat and this show in their strong body, despite being smaller than all other pony subtype thestral are generally three time stronger than they look, easily capable of splitting tree in half with their back hooves, their wings can also prove to be deadly weapon considering the clawed tips and the strong muscles moving them.

-night blessed: thestral are in their element in the dark of the night and it show, when it is night thestral are faster stronger and more focused and attentive, delaying any exhaustion and fatigue for once the sun start rising this mean that during the night thestral are technically inexhaustible, but when the day come around a thestral that pushed itself too far will drop like a rock and sleep that much longer and deeper.

the thestral drawback is:

-cold's embrace: thestral hate the cold, their large naked wing mean the cold seep the heat out of them quickly and this rapidly can cause frostbite as such they tend to shirk cold places and high altitude instead flying low and living in warm climate. this make them weak to weather magic making them lackluster in it and forcing them to live on the ground where they are more likely to be targeted by ground bound threats.

objects.title: unicorn core race.
objects.text:
the unicorn perks are:

-star touched: unicorn pony where touched by the star of magic itself, this mean that from the moment they are born they are guaranteed genius level compréhension of at least one basic magical practice amongst: safe telekinesis, small scale transfiguration, small item conjuration, self teleportation or self shielding. this genius can and will stretch toward understanding of the advanced, expert and even master level standard spell connected to the chosen magical practice through pursued study and training but will not offer assistance for spell crafting above advanced.

-endless well of magic: unicorn pony can perceive magic much more clearly than other races and its show contrary to most other species who are bound to the natural and passive recovery of their magic unicorn have the unique ability to not only absorb magic consciously to replenish their own store but to do so from nothing, unicorn can slowly and with great concentration freely generate magic in their surrounding and slowly guide it through their horn to their core for storage and use, this ability become contrary to expectation more potent with a broken horn. this task require the complet inactivity of a unicorn core and cannot be done while casting, channeling or supplying spells in any way shape and form.

the unicorn drawback is:

-the endless abyss: unicorn pony are at all time, all their lives aware that should they fall to temptation even once the fall will be quick and the landing most likely fatal. A unicorn who start using dark magic will almost instantly become trapped into a viscous cycle that only a third party can free it from. dark magic is a potent cancerous infection that spread eagerly onto whoever it get a hold of and sadly the gift for magic unicorn have been born with also make them the more vulnerable to it, mind you all species not born to use it can fall to dark magic and all will be made lesser by it for a time after freeing themselves from it but to unicorn it is a most foul poison one that corrode their mind and corrupt their heart so quickly and strongly that there is no hope of the unicorn freeing itself from it alone.

objects.title: standard pony body.
objects.text:
short coat, rounded ears, and flat teeth like most herbivore species. mane and tail are easy to maintain and clean up and the coat and hooves meld seamlessly.

-body effect: A very malleable if classical, reliable and well rounded basic body. Its simplicity make it very receptive to healing magic and a wide variety of enhancements method by default.

objects.title: shadow pony body.
objects.text:
sharp wide fangs similar to carnivores species and a thicker coat with longer hairs at the hooves and near the joints, mane tend to grow longer and fast as well.

-body effect: noticeable healing factor and regeneration while you are in a dark environment by default.

objects.title: thestral body.
objects.text:
short coat with ears and chest tuft. they also have two thin sharp fangs along mostly flat teeth. also has slit pupils. mane and tale tend to be unruly. the coat and hooves meld seamlessly.

-body effect: increased strength, you enjoy the taste and can digest meat much better than other type of body by default.

objects.title: kirin body.
objects.text:
rounded ears, short coat with partial scales covering, a long tail with a brush at the end and a mane reaching all around the neck. cloven hooves with tuft at the back joint. mix of flat and sharp teeth similar to omnivore species.

-body effect: stronger scaled body parts and hooves, you have the basic Nirik transformation by default.

objects.title: shadow pony horn.
objects.text:
a smooth, pointy and curved horn that go from the coat color to another in a smooth gradient. 

-horn effect: you are more resistant to the mental influence and addictive nature of dark magic by default.

objects.title: kirin horn.
objects.text:
a thick, ribbed curved horn that split into two toward the back at the middle point. generally has a similar if deeper color than the mane.

-horn effect: you horn can regrow fast by default.

objects.title: unicorn horn.
objects.text:
a straight spiraling horn, very pointy and smooth. Generally the same color as the coat.

-horn effect: you regenerate magic faster and use less magic to cast spells by default.

objects.title: pegasus wings.
objects.text:
feathered wings, soft and warm.

-wings effect: your wings are well insulated against wet and cold weather better by default.

objects.title: thestral wings.
objects.text:
leather wings, large and predatory.

-wings effect: you are a very silent flyer and endure hot weather better  by default.

rows.title: alicorn settings.
rows.titleText:
Here you can chose what pony races constitute the cores races of your alicorn form. 

You have to pick three pony races, including all the pony races you picked already, (if you picked unicorn and thestral then two of you choice of core races must be unicorn and thestral. ) you gain all the perks and drawbacks of all three races as well as any biological feature that make senses for you to have depending of the body parts selected.

You must also select one physical feature from "the body" and "the horn" or "the wings".

you must pick at least one physical feature from each pony races you picked.

If you took two pony races, you must pick one physical feature from each race then on from another pony race of your choice.

This mean that depending on your choice of races you have:

2 choices of wing (pegasus/thestral)

4 choices of body (shadow pony/thestral/kirin/ the three other are the same so they count as one.)

3 choices of horn (shadow pony/kirin/unicorn)

rows.title: The access patchs
rows.titleText:
You may have not noticed but while all races have unique powers and innate magical abilities not all races proposed can do "active" magic aka cast vast array of spells and not even those who do are able to use every magical fields.

This section help with that by letting you pick if and how you would like to cast active magic. 

They come in two categories: 
 
Naturals focus: those are simple since they are literally body parts or organs, you get all the necessary of how to use this new part of yourself as it should be used to about the same level of skill as you can use your dominant hand by default. those focus grow stronger with use and practice.

Artificial focus: those are items, they can be lost or stolen (and used by others) but can also be rebuilt and replaced easier than crippled naturals focus, they are also easier to upgrade. in exchange those do not automatically follow you own growth. you also know how to built the chosen focus from scratch and how to remake any upgrade you have built before.

objects.title: Mystic eyes
objects.text:
Your eyes become your focus, it does not affect your sight but do illuminate the place and can be unsettling for others.

Your eyes need to stay open while casting and can still be blinded by others source of light.

objects.title: Magical horn/s
objects.text:
One or two horns in any shape you want, a classic and reliable way of casting magic. it is a clear "weak spot" to target but is actually hard to damage if you have a strong body as magical horns are as hard as their owner bones.

Your horn require monthly filling and cannot be surrounded with solid matter  around its full circumference anywhere along its length to cast spells.

objects.title: Mane/hair
objects.text:
Your mane or any other growth of supple keratin can be used to cast spell, very noticeable and fragile except when channeling magic for a spell but also easy to regrow.

Your mane is not made any stronger or immune to being burned unless channeling a spell.

objects.title: Horned/alicorn races discount
objects.text: You picked a horned race so the cost of the horn natural focus is returned.

rows.title: Naturals focus
rows.titleText:
Naturals focus: those are simple since they are literally body parts or organs, you get all the necessary of how to use this new part of yourself as it should be used to about the same level of skill as you can use your dominant hand by default. those focus grow stronger with you naturally. 

Natural focus are not identical when it come to casting through them so they all require individual practice and time to master.

objects.title: Instrument of power
objects.text:
A tool of any kind, it must be one that is held wen in use and of non violent design, this tool can be lost, stolen or destroyed by someone and must be rebuilt if so.

Fragile and sometime cumbersome but easy to replace and can be hidden easely.

Exemples: staff, wand, lantern, shovel, or even a wrench or screwdriver.

The starting model require only mundane material and mundane crafting skill.

objects.title: Garnment of power
objects.text:
A wearable piece of clothing, armor or jewelry, easy to hide and hard to lose but more fragile or cumbersome than other artificial choice,  its effectiveness in casting spells also lower when damaged and stop working at all if destroyed at more than 50% and must be rebuilt or repaired.

This choice allow the concealed casting of most spells. 

Fragile and can be obvious when other notice you always wearing it. 

Exemples: robe, hat, plate armor, belt, necklace, crown, even a shield or a mask.

the starting model require only mundane material and mundane crafting skill.

objects.title: Weapon of power
objects.text:
A melee weapon of your choice, solid and fit for rougher treatment than the other artificial choices, it require to be held in hand to cast spells and  is pretty much impossible to hide in most situation, can be stolen but as long as it can be used as a weapon wear and tear does not reduce its casting potential. can be rebuilt or repaired.

Exemples: sword, mace, spear, halberd, flail or even a knife or a brass knuckle.  

The starting model require only mundane material and mundane crafting skill.

rows.title: Artificial focus
rows.titleText:
Artificial focus: those are items, they can be lost or stolen but can also be rebuilt and replaced easier than crippled naturals focus, they are also easier to upgrade. in exchange those do not automatically follow you own growth. you still get the know how to use and care for those items and also know how to built the basic chosen focuses from scratch and how to remake any upgrade you have built before.

Contrary to natural focus, artificial focuses are all similar in how you cast through them and require no individual practice to use.

You can pick all thee but only get one of each choice, nothing stop you from building duplicata yourself later.

rows.title: A blessing on you!
rows.titleText:
Blessings peoples blessings! blessings are my like a tune up of your soul and are either tied to your race and basic choices which are applied automatically or from me when you chose them. 

Blessings come in four variety : 

The boosts: grant effect that are always actives and boost something like   strength, dexterity, endurance and so on. those come in degree of potency. those empower your build, if the bombshell build make you like the peak-of your races in all physical attributes (strength dexterity, endurance) then adding the strength boost will take you to super-beings level of strength .

The masteries: give you all the strictly necessary related know how and muscle memories instantly as well as about 5 years of training and 5years of on the field experience but only to the mastery level that a "regular" being could ever achieve by studying said specific field. (note that nothing stop you from learning those skill later on on your own.)

The compendiums: are for magical field and give you the full meta knowledge of how to apply, combine and teach a specific field but not the magical power or "muscle memory" to pull it off. the first can be mitigated with a boost but the second can only be solved through actual practice because the feel of magic is unique to each individual and any one method does not translate well from one being to another, as such it require you to practice progressively through the field, still each compendium contain the entire knowledge to an omnisciente level and a good few "standard spell" for you to practice with. (note that nothing stop you from learning  most of those magical fields on your own later.)

The safeguard: a catchall for blessings that grant you unique effects that i grant you and i actively ensure remain in working order even when other higher powers attempt to mess with you, stuff like immunity to peri cognition or global awareness or protection from temporal event and so on. those are take them or lose them and some are vital depending of what world you decide to go to. (i recommend you take a peek at what world you can go to and make a list of the thing you need for where you intend to go.)
