objects.title: Singing mastery
objects.text:
Tone deafness be gone! This blessing give you absolute and perfect pitch as well as a talent for writing songs and poetry.

Yet the greatest of gift from this is a talent for improvisation that can turn you into a one pony musical, at least as long as you also have dancing mastery and music somehow playing in the background. 

This does not grant you the knowledge of how songs are supposed to be recorded but you understand and learn those ways instantly when you encounter them, the knowledge remain forever afterward.

objects.title: Survival mastery
objects.text:
You know how to survive without money or mean, whether that's in the wilderness or in a city you quickly figure out where to scavenge food and find a safe place to sleep.

You notice dangerous plants, peoples and places long before they become an active threat, that also include hazard that would risk you falling ill or injured.

objects.title: Dancing mastery
objects.text:
This blessing will make you the devil of the dancefloor, the deity of shuffling and the lord of the dance because yes with this blessing be it waltz, boogie or belly dancing you get it on like a house on fire.

You learn any dancing form you see and can adapt it to yourself instantly, this knowledge remain forever afterward. 

This effect also empower your direct partner to bring him/her to your level when you two are dancing, 

This effect stop if you are not touching but they do retain the knowhow for the move they just pulled with you.

objects.title: Instrumental mastery
objects.text:
You master any musical instrument you get a hold of and the knowledge remain forever afterward even when you let it go, this also give you a talent for writing tune and musical masterpieces. 

This does not grant you the knowledge of how songs are supposed to be recorded but you understand and learn those ways instantly when you encounter them, the knowledge remain forever afterward.

objects.title: Traveling mastery
objects.text:
Do you know the way? Well now you do for sure, this blessing make you a globe trotting master, from packing to camping to building trailer as long as its travel related you are the one to call on for a safe and relaxed travel. 

Also forget going around the world in 80 day for you could pull it off in 60 nay 40 and not one more, that's right you are so good at traveling you always know what roads to take to make it there in the shortest time as long as it possible at all.

objects.title: Flight mastery
objects.text:
Many races can fly but some being are born to fly, this blessing grant you a mastery of flight that make others dream of doing what you can do, you are graceful, fast and precise. 

You can fly higher and longer than you possibly should and bringing you down is a pipe dream for the common being though be aware this is flight mastery not a mastery of fighting while in flight this is a whole other art and those who have trained into it will take you down easily if you try to match them, if you have both on the other hoof? Nothing will ever match you in the air.

objects.title: Strategy/tactics mastery
objects.text:
With this blessing you have the Art of War living rent free in you brain and have a tactical mindset.

You also find yourself with the ability to make a mental map of any area you see. 

You also know how to make long-term plans, you find it easy to grasp geography, troop locations, and the best move for you and your enemy to make.

objects.title: Piloting/driving mastery
objects.text:
With this blessing you are capable of operating any land vehicle, sea vessel, or aircraft without exception even for especially exotic vehicles to the best of your ability.

this also include how to care for those vehicles, you also know how to adapt those vehicle for your personal use should they be unsuited.

objects.title: Crafting mastery
objects.text:
This blessing grant you a variety of physical crafting skills at a professional level, such as carpentry, smiting, sewing, electrical engineering, and more. 

You also pick up esoteric crafting skills as easily as breathing, but you don't innately have the necessary ability to apply them.

(As most of the crafting mastery this truly shine when combined with other crafting field.)

objects.title: Chemistry mastery
objects.text:
Chemistry and alchemy are often related to one another, but where alchemy work by mixing multiple magical properties extracted from "conceptual" matter, chemistry mix the physicals properties extracted from "real" matter.

This give you the complete understanding of chemistry, giving you a thorough understanding of the properties, composition, and behavior of "real" matter. 

This expertise enables you to conduct chemical analyses, design experiments, and contribute to fields like pharmaceuticals, materials science, and environmental science.

(As most of the crafting mastery this truly shine when combined with other crafting field.)

objects.title: Cloud construction mastery
objects.text:
The art of building using clouds is truly a wonderous one, they can be produced using water, wind and ligtning as ingredient generally -but not uniquely- by wings.

Cloud can through this mastery be turned to solid object yet remain weightless and to those who can shape them have the consistency of cool velvet that can be molded like soft clay and once a cloud reach the desired shape they can be treated to have the best properties of concrete and steel combined together.

Those construct can later on be softened again for repairs, this is done by just pressing them back into shape and hardening them once more making cloud a very economical material. 

this mastery also provide you with the knowledge of how to use and  produce liquide rainbow using magic and the extensive variety of storm clouds and tornados, those can be stabilized into self sustaining constructs that are used to produce magic, water, wind and lightning the components of cloud construction.

(As most of the crafting mastery this truly shine when combined with other crafting field.)

objects.title: Martial mastery
objects.text:
With this blessing i will grant you the minds of the greatest martial masters. Your acumen, your instincts and your reflexes for combat will  make you the greatest genius of personal combat.

you will learn fighting style that fit your form almost instantly and can adapt those that don't for your use. 

You instantly know how to use any object created for combat be it weapons or equipment to the best of your ability and how to care for it as well as the best soldier would.

The other element of this blessing is the ability to evaluate opponents and situation you face and accurately gauge your own chance against them.

objects.title: A.C.M mastery
objects.text:
A.C.M or Air combat maneuverings is the knowledge of how to fight while in flight this include all the knowledge of how to fight ground targets and air targets this does not include sport, fancy or civilian flying and only combat flying.

This blessing also teach you to to use you wings to fight on the ground and how to fly while wounded.

Having this blessing without the flight blessing will make it hard to fly in the company of civilian as your "predatory" flight technics will incite instinctual fear from other flyer nearby. It will also make it harder to enjoy flying as you will always expect conflict when flying.

objects.title: G.C.M mastery
objects.text:
G.C.M or ground combat maneuvering the art of fighting while grounded and against both ground and flying targets, this help in both ranged and melee combat and include way to get close or keep enemy away this only teach you in how to fight using your limbs and while on the ground.

This blessing also help you with the construction of ground based fortification and all the necessary step of holding territory in conflict.

objects.title: M.C.M mastery
objects.text:
M.C.M or magical combat maneuvering teach you the technics required to use magic well while in combat, this can be applied to all the magic you know and learn later on and ensure you know how to juggle both the intense mobility needed to remain at range where magic fighter do best and the casting of complex spell through intense combat.  

It also help you with figuring out combat application of any magic you learn.

objects.title: Hunting mastery
objects.text:
This blessing give you an extraordinary mastery, talent and instinct for hunting all things. With this you can easily track anything under any conditions, instantly sense the weaknesses of your prey and exploit them to finally kill or capture said prey. 

This also include knowledge of traps making.

objects.title: Leadership mastery
objects.text:
With this blessing you will know how to be a great leader allowing you to effectively keep order and morale. 

You have an intuitive mastery of the associated leadership skills, speech, tone and body language, expertly sending all the right signals, granting you major leverage in any social situation and allowing you to forge a fanatical level of trust and devotion in whoever you exert these talents on. 

This also allow you to perceive the expectation of those who follow you more clearly. 

All those effect only work when what you preach is really what you are leading toward and cannot be used to deceive unless it would advance the cause you proclaim. 

(This limitation is removed if you have the deception mastery.)

objects.title: "Cool" mastery
objects.text:
Oh so you wanna be "hype" i see? Well with this blessing you will have both knowledge and ability in being "cool", making it so that you can do anything with flair and style, whether intentionally or not. 

You know how to dress stylishly, speak stylishly, move stylishly and act stylishly. This is done usually with impressive and creative use of skill. 

You perfectly and without a single flaw or mistake know how to carry yourself with undeniable style, whenever you want with zero effort.

objects.title: Stealth mastery
objects.text:
You know how to be stealthy, this includes both the crowd blending and the sneaking/hiding approach. 

In addition espionage in all its form is as easy as breathing for you, with gaining contacts, expanding networks, planting spies, and more being trivial for you.

Within days you could have your thumb on the pulse of any city, with even its deepest secrets unable to stay hidden from you.

objects.title: Deception mastery
objects.text:
You’re good at lying. Not just good, but it’s more like you are an artist of the lie. You know just what emotions to fake and how to say things that will convince others of your professed sincerity, and can spin almost endless bullshit while knowing just how to keep it believable. 

If you have the "honest" safeguard you only become good at deceiving by omission but to an unreal level, doing so is still viscerally distasteful to you.

objects.title: Seduction mastery
objects.text:
This blessing is all about making you attractive, with this you possesses flawless seductive skills and overwhelming charming allure which can be used to easily and efficiently seduce, charm, persuade anyone and everyone of either the same, opposite, or entirely different kind of gender.

The blessing grant masterful knowledge of how to make people feel sexual arousal, lust, etc., and how to always make anyone and themselves feel immense sexual arousal.

This is the ultimate seducing mechanism, since the user will automatically seduce with perfect skill, technique, and timing but beware, it will rapidly and almost instantly lose all effect if the targets know a lot of things about you that they dislike, in this case you can still get them aroused but not seduce them though if you would change for them  they would most likely welcome you with open arm. 

The effect also does not work on target that have pure honest love for another.

objects.title: Investigation mastery
objects.text:
You have all the skills necessary to be a detective... Except the knowledge of the law though you do learn it fast. 

This make you more perceptive, and make it so you know what to look for and how to think to figure out whatever mystery you pursue.

objects.title: Cooking mastery
objects.text:
You possess an extraordinary talent for transforming ordinary ingredients into extraordinary meals.

Through your mastery of cooking techniques and knowledge of flavor, you can transmute any ingredients into gastronomic marvels. 

Your cooking is an art form, your ability to combine flavors, textures, and presentation is nothing short of magical. 

You understand the entire world of cooking, knowing the precise ratios and techniques to create dishes that captivate the senses. 

Your culinary skills goes beyond taste alone for you also have a deep understanding of the nutritional properties of ingredients, allowing you to create dishes that not only taste great but also nourish the body to peak condition. 

This also give you the ability to judge any ingredients you come across for their risks, value and potential uses.

objects.title: Learning mastery
objects.text:
You find it easier to take notes, pay attention, and follow along with speeches, seminars, lectures, discussions, and anything written. 

Also helps you learn physically and makes studying -be it mundane or magical field- easier.  

This also synergies with other masteries and compendiums you take.

objects.title: Raw mana magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield raw magic which is not truly a magical practice as much as the practice of controlling magic before a spell is formed at all.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to safely cast spells.  
-how to dispel spells.

advanced
-how to empower spells.
-how to counter spells

expert
-how to multicast spells
-how to modify spells.

master
-how to usurp spells.
-how to craft spells.

objects.title: Plant magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield plant magic, those spells allow the control and modification of plant life and is one of the fastest field to progress through as the plant's awareness -limited as it is- is almost always cooperating with the mage but plant magic cannot create life from nothing and require a base to work with this can be solved by combining it with conjuration or carrying a few seed. 

Another weakness and strengths of plant magic is that the more fertile the ground is around them the cheaper and easier their magic is to cast, on the other hoof the more dead and infertile the more taxing they become.  

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to speed up the plants growth.
-how to guide the plants shape during growth.

advanced
-how to optimise the plants natural ability.
-how to talk to and understand the plants.

expert
-how to combine plants into new breed.
-how to modify plants using other organic material.

master
-how to create fully sentient plant life.
-how to merge with plant life to empower yourself.

objects.title: Weather magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield weather magic, this magic work mostly with large spells and require large quantity of water, wind and electricity to be cast. 

In exchange for those requirement they are capable of large scale destruction unmatched for almost any other magical field, or construction if you have the cloud construction mastery.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to absorb and store the water and wind in the area around you.  
-how to control water and air in the air around you.

advanced
-how to generate and channel electricity. 
-how to create and control different kind of clouds.

expert
-how to create and control ice and snow.
-how to create control self sustaining weather formation.

master
-how to store weather formation in bottle to release them later.
-how to do all the above at a continental scale.

objects.title: Transmutation magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield transmutation magic, this magic allow you to reshape object and living being including yourself. 

This magical field generally still follow the rule of conservation of mass but more magic can be used to store excess or substitute missing mass, this make transmutation magic usability limited by magical potential.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to transmute the shape of inorganic material. 
-how to transmute your appearance within the limit of your race. 

advanced
-how to fuse and combine inorganic material.
-how to transmute yourself within limit of your mass.

expert
-how to transmute organic but non living material.
-how to fuse with organic material to transmute yourself beyond your mass.

master
-how to convert organic material into inorganic one and vice versa.
-how to transmute even other living being.

objects.title: Illusion magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield illusion magic, this magical field is about distracting and deceiving the senses of others as well as hiding things and beings from other and is the opposite of divination. 

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to cast fleeting auditive and static visual illusion.
-how to blur the appearance and muffle the sound of things and beings.

advanced
-how to cast moving illusion and sounds as well as smells.
-how to tie illusion to places/beings/items.

expert
-how to program illusion to react to specific condition. 
-how to deceive all senses perfectly.  

master
-how to block or deceive scrying from divination.(cannot hide the entire truth from master divination).
-how to make non-sentient solid illusion.

objects.title: Divination magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield divination magic which regroup all the spell that allow for the gathering of information be it scrying places, the past and even predicting the future and making prophecy. 

While this also include way to read the memory and mind of other as well it does not allow you to modify or erase them. 
This is the opposite of the illusion magical field.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to cast spells that improve the perception and clarity of you senses.
-how to scry present places and peoples using names, blood or related object.

advanced
-how to read the surface thought of others, even through scrying.
-how to use scrying spell to see past events.

expert
-how to scry the many possible futures, become hopelessly inaccurate beyond a few hours but grow more stable the more in control of the observed events the caster is.(100% accurate in a vacuum with only the caster taking action.)
-how to read, copy, store and assimilate memories.

master
-how to overpower scrying blocking using more magic.(cannot see clearly through deception from master illusion.)
-how to make prophecy, the making of a fixed event into the timeline. once made it is bound to happen but prophecy can only set an outcome not a process.

objects.title: Destruction magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield destruction magic and is pretty straightforward. its all the magic made to destroy things.

Those spells by default unsuited to be tied to items through enchantements as they are damaging by nature and rely on wielding the power of entropy an element that turn into any "effective attack" on hit, meaning unless the targets is immun to everything an attack always does damages. 

Do take into account the spell adapt to what it hit not what you targets so beware of peoples fighting through proxy. 

In addition, destruction spell stored in scrolls or used in enchanting are very very short lived (second to minutes at best.) as they by nature erode the materials they are tied to.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to cast straight bolt, short ray, and nova blasts of entropy from you own body.
-how to release entropy as an aura that slowly erode surrounding and yourself.

advanced
-how to cast homing bolts, channeled ray, explosive blasts of entropy. 
-how to cast entropy spells anywhere within line of sight.

expert
-how to change the state of entropy to liquide, gaseous and solid freely.
--how to freely control entropy after casting it. entropy naturally degrade over time.

master
-how to infuse entropy into yourself making others entropy spells you cast stronger over time prevent casting any other magic until ending infusion. 
-how to infuse the property of entropy spells into other magical field's spells.

objects.title: Ward magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield ward magic, this is basically defensive magic. This and destruction magic are opposite in a constant state of one upping the others, by nature ward magic is slower to cast and inefficient but can be used in enchantement or accumulated in scrolls over time contrary to entropy based spells.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to cast fleeting shields and channeled barrier.
-how to place temporary defense enhancement on object and beings. 

advanced
-how to bind ward magic spells to structures and places using a central foci.
-how to tie ward magic spells to specific trigger condition.

expert
-how to create complexe defensive formation that grow stronger with the amount of foci powering it.
-how to set complexe parameters on ward magic spells for it to follow.

master
-how to create adaptative shields and barrier that grow stronger against what hit it, reset when broken, also work on entropy.
-how to create bounded field that prevent any offensive action, affect all in the field indiscriminately.

objects.title: Healing magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield healing magic, while similar to transfiguration this spell does not really modify but instead only restore or improve the targets as it restore body, mind and soul to either a stable state or when pushed further optimal state sadly since the soul leave for another plane shortly after death this magic cannot do true resurrections past seven hours after death...not alone at least.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics 
-how to mend injury of the flesh and replenish blood.
-how to cure bacterial disease and clean infections.

advanced
-how to cure viral disease and remove parasite and others foreign bodies.
-how to sooth mental distress and restore minds from illness, trauma and mind control .

expert
-how to cleanse affliction of the soul and make them whole when damaged.
-how to regrow limbs and heal brain damage.

master
-how to resurrect beings within seven hour after death and restore a body whole in seconds from a single cell. 
-how to elevate other to [in dominie spiritus] and [thy name is perfection].

objects.title: Empathetic magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield empathetic  magic, the act of reading, modify, remove and create emotion from the emotional spectrum. 

Emotion are split into "base emotion"(anger, sadness, anger, disgust, happiness and fear) and "complexe emotion", "complexe emotion" are made of multiples "base emotion". 

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to read, amplify, modify, create and remove the base emotions of others.
-how to absorb other's base emotion and store to use for other purposes.

advanced
-how to channel base emotion into spells to empower them.
-how to shield yourself from emotion affecting/born condition and ill.

expert
-how to read, amplify, modify, create and remove the complex emotions of others.
-how to cast emotion into solid-light construct or enchantements. 

master
-how to turn emotions into pure magic for casting spells.
-how to imbue sentience into things by infusing the entire emotional spectrum into it. the now sentient being is aware of its personal history and will act accordingly.

objects.title: Conjuration magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield conjuration magic , the act of creating matter from magic or summoning things from different magical realms. this magical field spells are magically taxing to cast.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to turn magic into mundane matter.
-how to temporarily summon non sapient being weaker magically than you from other reality. such as sprite and elemental.

advanced
-how to turn magic into magical item.
-how to summon sapient being weaker magically than you. such as imps and animals. 

expert
-how to create anything non living using samples as templates. (even organic things.)
-how to tie summoned being to external source of magic to sustain them.

master
-how to summon willing sapient being under a fair contract. the summon will always be benevolent but will expect a fair trade.
-how to summon the soul of the departed, the soul cannot be compelled to do things and cannot be harmed in any way, it can talk to you and follow you around.

objects.title: Shadow magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield shadow magic and not just the dark shape that is formed when an object blocks a source of light but also the darkness that is always there unless light chase it away, or dark matter as you call it. 

In utter and complete darkness this power is much more powerful but is also chokingly hard to control with any form of precision and the more light is present the less power it has but the easier it is to use in complexe way.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to control and move your shadow independently to your body and see and ear through it.
-how to conjure three dimensional shadow that look like smoke.

advanced
-how to render your shadow just as solid as your own body.
-how to swap place with your own shadow.

expert
-how to tie other spells to your shadow granting them the same effects.
-how to make your shadow toxic to all but you, the toxicity grow stronger and weaker with how large it is. 

master
-how to wield dark matter, dark matter is the isolant of the universe, its what lies between everything and its presence is needed by physics and space to exist.
-how to combine dark matter manipulation with other magical field.

objects.title: Spatial magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield spatial magic, teleportation, portal, expended space, pocket dimension and even dimensional travel are all here, its one of the BIG magical field.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to perform line of sight personal teleportation. 
-how to fold space to make bigger things fit in smaller place or hide large things behind small things.

advanced
-how  to create gateway from place to place.
-how to expand space to create things like bag of holdings.

expert
-how to freeze items in space, this does not render the item indestructible but does make it and its broken fragments immovable.
-how to cut space. it does not last beyond a second unstained and its use is limited by the fact that it cut everything in a straight line all the way to a lightyear away but it is the most lethal physical force and cannot be blocked only dodged. (you are not protected from its effect.) 

master
-how to bridge different dimension and realities, this does not provide a way to see what the other worlds are like without you connecting them to your world first.
-how to create new dimension and add layer over existing dimension, like changing the direction of the basic three dimension to deflect an attack, or creating an empty dimension to trap other into. (this does not include the "fourth dimension" of time.)

objects.title: Time magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield time magic, this can do a lot of very risky things and i advise you not to underestimate the consequence of your action, on the other hoof i also assure you that you will not be able to break time with this as time is more robust then you can possibly imagine, you will erase yourself long before you do any damage to the fabric of time itself. 

Not that i will let it get this bad but some find it oddly reassuring.


The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to accelerate and slow down your own and other's perception of time.
-how to de-age objects, this does not restore missing parts unless they are within the spell range.

advanced
-how to de-age beings, this does not preserve memories and is magic intensive.
-how to slow-down and speed-up time in an area.

expert
-how to jump forward and backward in time, cost exponentially more with every second forward or backward. every forward jump force a cooldown equal to the precedent jump. backward jump cannot be reversed.
-how to stop time in an area, this grow more unstable the longer its maintained without the opportunity the resync with the rest of the world. if the time stop grow to unstable the content of the time stop will collapse causing a variety of side effect including: alternate timeline version of beings inside to appear, time clones, complete madness, appearance of elder gods, the resetting of your timeline, appearance of lost time traveler, the doctor.

master
-how to interact with alternate timeline or create new one and move through them. alternate timeline are always within 90% similarity to your chosen reality beyond that they would be considered alternate dimension.
.
-how to stop time reality wide, nothing not even you can move inside a frozen reality but you can still think and resume its time flow freely, you can still move to another non frozen timeline to move around while keeping the frozen one frozen. require prohibitive amount of magic to maintain.

objects.title: Celestial magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield celestial magic and revolve around binding yourself to a celestial objects like a planet or a star, this grant power beyond belief and is relatively simple and cheap but in exchange you become tied to that celestial objects and should it be damaged you will as well, bind yourself to the earth and pollution will make terribly sick, the moon and the meteorite that impact it will cause you to feel stings, a star and solar flare will give you terrible heart ache. 

You will also die with it unless you somehow make it last longer.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to selectively negate or amplify the effects of your bound celestial objects around you when it is visible to you.
-how to strengthen yourself when your bounded celestial object is visible to you.  

advanced
-how to repair and rejuvenate you bound celestial object using your own magic.
-how to strengthen the connection between you and your celestial object to store its power in yourself, allowing you to use effects requiring you bound celestial object even when it is not in sight.
.


expert
-how to shrink and move your bound celestial object freely with your will alone without loss in power or mass.
-how to fully or partially maintain and negate the law of physics and nature partaking to your bound celestial object to keep the local solar system safe in spite of the statut and position of your celestial object.


master
-how to create a 1/1 copy of the celestial objects bound to you. it is now considered as your bound celestial object (the original is unbound to you) when casting spell and can be taken to others reality, you still die if it is destroyed.
-how to temporarily fuse with your bound celestial object and turn yourself into its living avatar.

objects.title: Dark magic compendiums
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield dark magic a magical field that work by turning any other magical fields spell more powerful and virtually costless. 

This aspect of dark magic make casting powerful spells a breeze as the spell literally cost nothing and is even stronger but in reality the spell isn't cheaper its just that the cost moved somewhere else in fact the cost is placed on your soul. 

With every spell cast through dark magic your soul grow more corrupted and it twist you into a dark being and should you be wholly corrupted you will turn into an abomination. 

Finally dark magic corruption cannot be cleansed from the soul as such any one being can cast a limited amount of dark magic in their entire life before the effect of the corruption become apparent, worst is that until the corruption reach a certain threshold their is no sign at all of corruption when not using dark magic. 

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics:
-how to amplify the power and reduce the cost of basic spells.
-at 25% soul corruption your eyes and magic take a constant hue of toxic green and purples that radiate a bubbly almost acidic smoke. you grow worried and uncomfortable when your own mortality is pointed out or mentioned, the urge to cast dark magic is akin to wanting to practice a hobby.

advanced: require at least 25% corruption
-how to amplify the power and reduce the cost of advanced spells.
-at 50% soul corruption you lose the ability to show emotion on your face and your colors all become darker your voice is colder and sound like you are whispering directly into the ears of those you talk to, your fear of death remind itself to you almost daily, the need to cast dark magic is akin to a tobaccos addiction.

expert: require at least 50% corruption
-how to amplify the power and reduce the cost of expert spells.
-at 75% soul corruption your body grow larger yet thinner and you feature turn sharper you lose all reproductive and parental instinct your fear of death skyrocket, the urge to use dark magic become equal to the urge of drinking when parched under the hot summer sun.

master: require at least 75% corruption
-how to amplify the power and reduce the cost of master spells.
-at 100% soul corruption you become a lich. your body no longer display any signs of life, like breathing or blinking or even heartbeat, it will also generate a singular core in place of your heart should it be broken you will die. death terrify you to your core and should you die you will cease to exist nothing can spare you from this, you can only cast spells through dark magic now.

objects.title: Spirit magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield spiritual magic, one of Discord favorite shortcut to avoid doing any work himself and is about creating minor or major "spirits" who can fulfill a variety of task using your magic and automating the casting of spells for you, to be clear spirits are magical A.I.

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-how to create and maintain 10 minor spirit.
-how to program minor spirit to use any basic spells you can use.

advanced
-how to maintain unlimited amount of minor spirits.
-how to program minor spirit to use any advanced spells you can use.

expert
-how to create and maintain 1 major spirits for every 100 minor spirits.
-how to program major spirit to use any expert spells you can use.

master
-how to make major spirits fully sapient.
-how to program major spirit to use any master spells you can use.

objects.title: Soul magic compendium
objects.text:
This is the compendium on soul magic, it grant all the knowledge of how to perform soul magic. 

The teaching of this compendiums include but is not limited to:

basics
-see the unique aura and trail of souls left behind by living beings allowing you to track anyone with eerie precision. 
-the ability to perceive the statut of souls to assess if they are healthy or not but also the "karmic state" of others by the aura they possess and trail they leave behind. 

advanced
-the ability to see the and communicate with the soul of the dead but not departed. 
-the ability to perform astral projection.

expert
-the ability to "tune" your soul, purposefully shifting some aspect of yourself using other's soul as template. exemple: making yourself more patient by tuning your soul to someone patient, smarter by tuning yourself to someone smarter etc.
-the ability to "read" other's and your own soul, allowing you to know the talents they have as well as the potential yet to be developed or the shortcoming they developed and the potential that was locked because of it.

master
-the ability to affect the soul of other by using your own astral projection this allow you to strike at soul directly but also to push a soul that as yet to move on back into its body, the body still need to be healthy and alive for a resurrections to succeed. 
-your soul and body merge, you can now do everything you can do in astral form even without projecting yourself but also move to realm where only soul should with you body and without dying, you can as such move into any afterlife freely by following a soul moving on there.

objects.title: Enchantement compendium
objects.text:
A compendium that grant you the knowledge of how to perform every forms of enchantements in my world and make learning new methods very easy.

By default enchantements in my world work by binding one or more spell to an item, the main elements of enchantements are that you can stacks those effects (its why the most powerful item in my world are generally old) and that all being can perform some enchantements using magically potent ingredients and spell scrolls. 

scrolls are made by enchanter and require merely paper and ink and to write enchantement runes as well as either to be able to cast spells or to absorb the main components of the spell in a scrolls, a fire spell require fire and the stronger the flame the stronger the scroll. (for more esoteric effects you will have to get creative and experiments.)

Do know that scrolls need about 20 seconds to absorb something,  they cannot absorb living things (dead things are okay, but not undead.) or absorb things larger than the scroll surface itself those limits make scroll useless to block attack.

(As most of the crafting mastery this truly shine when combined with other crafting field.)

objects.title: Alchemy compendium
objects.text:
This is the compendium of alchemy and it grant all the knowledge of how to perform alchemy. This art is about using alchemy circles and work by mixing multiple magical properties extracted from "conceptual" elements of matter, for exemples a wing as an ingredients would hold the conceptual element of flight and could be used to grant flight through a potion. 

Alchemy main vector is potion and other ointments that have to be ingested or applied to an organic being to work. 

(As most of the crafting mastery this truly shine when combined with other crafting field.)

objects.title: Divine magic compendium
objects.text:
This compendiums contain the knowledge of how to wield divine magic, this magic can do everything it is literally omnipotence but only in territory where your faithful outnumber the faithless and other gods worshippers, it is also not cast using magic it instead require the true worship and faith of others to work, this make divine magic weak early on but unmatched once it get going.


The teaching of this compendiums include:

-omnipotence using faith.

objects.title: Faust's chosen.
objects.text:
Blank, Sanctity of The Mind, Trumped the Trump. this blessing give you these three thing.

Blank: With this, you’ve been rendered completely immune to being perceived by other's abilities. Your future and past cannot be observed, clairvoyants cannot detect you, danger senses cannot warn their users about you, and even models constructed by the user's knowledge yield no results. This is pervading enough that you cannot even be perceived by noticing the blind spots in their sight, such powers simply acting as if you didn’t exist.

Sanctity of the mind: You are absolutely protected from any and all things that would directly affect your mind, emotions, and senses. There is nothing that can influence your mind ranging from hypnotic technology to memetic hazards. (this only work on things coming from outside forces, any change that stem from choices you made in this still apply.)

Trumped the trump: Any powers and internal power supplies you possess cannot be drained, suppressed, weakened, stolen, copied, altered, controlled, reproduced, or otherwise manipulated against your will.

You are on a mission from me why would i not ensure the cards are stacked in your favor? As such I'm giving you the "chosen one" treatment, basically those buffs stay on as long as you still work for me and only come off if you actively try to sabotage my goal of changing grimdark worlds to as close to noble bright as possible. 

This also stop you from aging past your prime until you finish all the tasks you picked up in this whole affair.

objects.title: Well adjusted.
objects.text:
You won't lose your ability to think rationally under any circumstances unless you're being controlled by a power. And even if you somehow did, no matter the circumstances, you will regain it well before you do anything irreversible.
This also makes you highly resistant to brainwashing and manipulation, though not completely immune.

objects.title: Care subscription.
objects.text:
This blessing ensure that no matter the side effects or flaws you took on in this cyoa or were present in you from the start will always be surmontable trough personal care from me, it work by taking you to a meeting spot with me every time you are free or you need it, contrary to other mental related blessings this one is not instant or easy but guaranteed to work on everything.
 
This also make your personal issues much easier to work through and even without help you'll be able to get through them in time should you chose not meet me often. This might take a while if it's bad, but you'll make it out eventually.

objects.title: Inner harmony.
objects.text:
This blessing will help you attain inner peace and balance, allowing you to remain calm and centered in any situation. 

This blessing work by giving you the ability to go through you own mind and face your evils personified such as your anger issue, your obsession and remorse one at a time but instead of being alone you are helped by your virtues personified. 

Once you have dealt with all your evils you then become a fusion of all your better parts while the evil ones becoming nothing but memories of what you overcame. 

This process is instantaneous from the outside but can take years from your perception should you resist the harmonizing, sometime truth about oneself can be hard to come to term with.

objects.title: Pain resistance.
objects.text:
This blessing make you resistant to pain be it mental of physicals you can take it with not a flinch or wavering focus.

This goes beyond just willpower its that pain become a mere sensory warning of you taking damage and is no longer a deterrent at all. 

Even subconscious or biological response are negated, things like shakings, nausea or vertigo are now absent, instinctual fear also become mere situational awareness. 

You also become resistant to developing  P.T.S.D.

objects.title: Inner goodness.
objects.text:
This blessing will ensure that in spite of being faced with evil you will never lose you own goodness.

Sometime confronted with the evil of the world some can fall to despair and lose faith in the greater good and even start thinking that peoples and the world at large doesn't deserve to exist, well not you as with this blessing your belief in goodness remain unshaken and as long as you have goodness in your heart you cannot be corrupted by the evil of others instead they become just more reason to spread goodness to all.

objects.title: In the service of others.
objects.text:
someone once said: "a strong man stand up for himself a stronger man stand for others." This blessing make it that every time you risk your life or wellbeing to personally save another being you will gain one charge by peoples saved. Those charges can be used to different effects.

10 charges to heal wholly a being from wounds/illnesses.

100 charges to cancel out an attack you block no matter its nature or power.

500 charges to bring a dead person or yourself to life.

1000 charges to reverse the consequence of a catastrophe.

10000 charges to strike down someone that ever committed pure evil.

(To get the charge you must personally be at actual risk when saving them.)

You have no need to sleep, you'll constantly be alert and awake. You can still sleep if you want and can do so at will instantly and peacefully. 

This also make any sleep related abilities work through mere mediation. This does not make your stamina infinite only mental fatigue is affected physicals rest is still  needed so take a few hours a day to just lay down and rest those sore hooves.

objects.title: Retroactive legal identity.
objects.text:
With a little work its actually quite easy to set you up as having always existed in whatever world you decide to go to, with this blessing you now have a legal identity in the place of your arrival. You can choose to customize this legal identity within reason, ranging from a student of a certain school to a dockworker to a lawyer. 

You can even make yourself related to peoples though it will not grant you any of their bloodline's granted advantages or downsides,  you cannot replace or become someone alive though.

objects.title: World voice's songs.
objects.text:
Where i come from the world sing along with us, instrumental coming from the ether to bolster us and help us express our feeling and trouble and scream our success to the all who would ear it. 

With this blessing you too gain a theme song or even multiple theme songs that can either come from an unknown source or your mind.

You can even have a song for every emotion you're currently feeling. It can be any song or even an unknown song that fits the current situation. 

You're not limited by the number of songs you can possess and can even add more songs later on.

You can also choose to enable/disable this blessing.

objects.title: World knowledge.
objects.text:
Knowledge is power and this blessing is powerful indeed for upon entering your new world, you will be granted the comprehensive knowledge pertaining to that world directly inside your mind. 

This knowledge encompasses all relevant media, lore, and information, granting you an in-depth understanding of the intricacies and details of the world you are about to explore.

This includes not only the official canon but also the insights and notes of the authors, creators and correct guesswork of fanfiction ensuring that you are well-equipped to navigate the world you are entering.

This also work retroactively on any change made to the chosen world through the choices you made here, ensuring you are not taken by surprise by any butterfly effect from your arrival.

None of the knowledge that could harm you will, no curse will be triggered or other power bound to that knowledge will be made aware of you own acquisition of this knowledge.

While no outside action can cause you to lose this knowledge you yourself can still forget it over time unless you either got a perfect memory or record said knowledge, written and spoken knowledge are no longer protected unless you also have blank from the "Faust's chosen." blessing.

objects.title: Natural leader.
objects.text:
This blessing grant you an aura that make people tend to look to you for guidance and leadership. You have an easy time recruiting people and for some reason, they tend to be pretty loyal.

This also teach you how to keep a group tight and cohesive as well as how to best use them in every situation with as few risk to them as possible.

objects.title: You have no enemies.
objects.text:
Before a fight with an intelligent being capable of communication begins. You will have a 5-second window to initiate dialogue with said opponent, for the next 60 seconds -refreshed every time a party talk- both you and your opponent will be unable to attack or affect each other during said time. 

The dialogue is considered over when one side stop talking at all for 60 seconds.

After the dialogue break down, you will gain an increase in speed and defense for as long as you do not attack your opponent. (This includes physical, mental, and spiritual attacks.) but does not include persuasion non assisted by active powers.

If your opponent is absolutely set on killing you, and their mind won't be changed through dialogue alone, then this perk does not activate beyond the warning during sneak attacks.

Sneak attacks aimed at you are also under this effect. However, instead of preventing the attack it warn you 5 second before the attack happen and give you 60 second of speed and defense boost for a total of 65 second of boosts.

You cannot turn this perk off but you can chose not to activate the dialogue at all during the 5 second window.

objects.title: Serendipitous Luck.
objects.text:
This blessing make the universe conspires in your favor, no matter what you seek to achieve or overcome. 

This increase the likelihood of success and decrease the likelihood of failure in all your endeavors, no matter how challenging they may be.

objects.title: Self sanctity.
objects.text:
This prevent any esoteric effect from from bypassing your outermost layer, what it mean is that while a hammer blow or explosion will shake your inside normally a curse or telekinesis can only affect your outside, most time your coat, scale, fur or skin but once that layer is gone the muscle underneath are fair game.

This work on pretty much anything but purely physicals attack and attack with penetration as a primary purpose, so bullets will go through you normally but a spell meant to shatter bones will fizzle out unless your bones are exposed.

objects.title: Dark magic symbiosis.
objects.text:
With a few tweaks its possible to make your soul compatible with dark magic this mean that contrary to other you soul can keep the corruption of dark magic under control.

What this mean is that you can now go to up to 200% corruption with the side effect starting to appear at 125% and that the corruption will slowly go down at a rate of about 1% for every hours of meditation.

objects.title: Deus-ex immunity.
objects.text:
You are protected from deus-ex, any "i win!" abilities or "instant defeat" scenario are rendered very bad at worst, with this no one can prevent the event that led to your existence or erase you from reality and so on.

You are a fixed event and can only be defeated once you had a chance to fight back but be careful for this blessing only activate for thing that would defeat you instantly no matter what you would have done not things you could have dealt with through other means.

objects.title: Patience of a saint.
objects.text:
This blessing is a staple of immortal everywhere and make your patience inexhaustible. You could sit without moving for days with no problem, or easily spend countless hours on a single, mind-numbing task. 

It also does not make you less prone to react decisively or bored when doing again something you have already done a hundred time before.

objects.title: Invictus.
objects.text:
This blessing is one of the more dangerous one, for anyone who oppose you that is. It make it so your will is absolute, boundless, and unbreakable. Your ideals, your ambition, the certainty in how you will see your plan brought to fruition. 

Your willpower is endless and no matter how difficult the situation, even if you're torn in half, locked in a time loop of endless agony for thousands of years, or subjected to a fate worse than death, you'll be able to shrug it off as long as its in the name of your goals. You will never be left drifting without a sense of purpose, and though you may change your goals and refine your ideals you always have the motivation to turn them into reality.

This will greatly bolster your sense of self in the face of adversity, and you’ll be able to plant your hooves when everyone else is giving up. Of course, you still have emotions and you can still be hurt emotionally. 

Take care that you don't suffer from tunnel vision so much that you become blind to others being actual peoples with dream and wills of their own.

objects.title: Soul guard.
objects.text:
Your soul is the metaphysical core of your being, it is you more than your brain or memories. This blessing prevent outside force from messing with your soul and insure you will never be denied your after life unless its by your own choices and action. 

This also mean that you can choose what happen to you when you die, be it go to a heaven of your choice, *cough* mine is the best*cough* reincarnate or just return as an incorporeal ghost or undead, you will also retain all  your abilities and memories no matter your choice. 

Also any new body you find yourself in will shift into you chosen appearance and species in this cyoa should you wish it.

objects.title: Old bloodline.
objects.text:
Normally your new body would be a brand new bloodline made up of up to two base races.

By using existing bloodline that already have mixed bloodline and balancing those i can allow you to have more than two bases races,.

This would require a lot of energy (blessing points) to search and retrieve amongst all my worlds for the perfect bloodline and both modify and balance all your choices for a perfect assimilation of so many traits.

objects.title: Friendly.
objects.text:
You find it easier to make friends, your path somehow crossing at the best of time and understanding somehow forming easily, and the friends you make are in it for the long run as this blessing protect your friends from most harms.

The more friend you have and the deeper the friendship the more This blessing ability to protect them grow potent. 

#friendly
objects.wordChangeSelect: *as you select this blessing you heart almost miss a beat as the image of a star appear for half a second in you mind, you feel like something just approved of you.*

objects.title: Joyful.
objects.text:
You can spread cheers and fun far and wide and you mere presence make every pony smile. The joy of seeing other happy fuel you, the more peoples there are smiling around you the more your other powers grow. 

If something happen to make those you cheered up to loose their smiles you will instantly know what.

#joyful
objects.wordChangeSelect: *as you select this blessing you heart almost miss a beat as the image of a balloon appear for half a second in you mind, you feel like something just approved of you.*

objects.title: Loyal.
objects.text:
You are loyal to the core and that make that loyalty work both way, you cannot break the trust of other and neither can they yours once they spoke it to you. 

You betraying other or other betraying you become impossible. The more peoples believe in you the more easily you find yourself pushing past your limits to meet their expectation.

#loyal
objects.wordChangeSelect: *as you select this blessing you heart almost miss a beat as the image of a lightning bolt appear for half a second in you mind, you feel like something just approved of you.*

objects.title: Kind.
objects.text:
Your heart is filled with kindness and you can seemingly care for everyone you meet, whatever troubles other faces you have the know how to heal bruised heart and guide lost spirit to better places. 

When you care for other they too become more caring in turn and the one they help in turn become more caring in an endless chain of kindness.

#kind
objects.wordChangeSelect: *as you select this blessing you heart almost miss a beat as the image of a butterfly appear for half a second in you mind, you feel like something just approved of you.*

objects.title: Generous.
objects.text:
You are never without a little more to give for those who need it the most, in fact you are constantly somehow stumbling upon more wealth as soon as you finish giving it all away,  the more you give to others one day the more you find the next in an exponential manner till somehow gemstone the size of fist seem to form undergrounds right as you start digging.

#generous
objects.wordChangeSelect: *as you select this blessing you heart almost miss a beat as the image of a diamond appear for half a second in you mind, you feel like something just approved of you.*

objects.title: Honest.
objects.text:
You cannot lie and everyone somehow know it, what other don't know is that none can lie to you either for you can see through all deception with ease. 

If you ask someone the same question three time in a row this someone as to say the truth.

#honest

objects.title: On a quest for friendship.
objects.text:
Instead of having this blessing as you arrive in a world you must first find the bearers of all 5 other values of friendship, when you do you gain both this effect and all others values effects and so does the bearers. 

Your own gem will then form and take on the color and shape that fit you best the stone will also become a magical focus for you that empower all magic by you plus the amount of other bearers near you time a 100%. so a 600% when all together.

While the safeguard effects remain unlocked forever the boost provided by the six gem only work in their home world and cannot be taken but a new set appears each time you enter a world.

This require "friendly" and all the others "On a quest for friendship." choices.

objects.title: spell sword.
objects.text:
a sword that take on the attribute of what ever word is written on its pommel, i found the thing some time ago and as a writer found it a delightful idea. 

the sword has five spot for letters and you would be surprised how much those five letters can do.

truly the pen is mightier than the sword. 

bound give the usual benefits and prevent other from using the item without permission.

endless allow you to shift to different melee weapon changing along the number of letters you have to use. Warhammer for exemple as 9 letters to work with and axe 3.

(can be delivered on demand or you can have it on you on arrival.)

objects.title: a tomes of knowledge.
objects.text:
a book that transcribe and translate any information on and about what it touches in a language you understand and in a format you can easily grasp.

the number of page is unlimited and and the weight of the book never changes from its starting two kilos. 

any information inside the book can be accessed with a single push of will and remain in the book forever.

anyone can use this book but the format and language remain yours.

bound give the usual benefits and prevent other from using the item without permission.

endless allow you to change the book to any other form of information storage items.

(can be delivered on demand or you can have it on you on arrival.)

objects.title: the throne of a ruler.
objects.text:
this throne is built for you by me to fit you to a T.

when you sit on it you can unload magic into it to store it, you can arbitrarily set a spherical area of any size around the throne in which you can set rules on who can use magic or not and stop spells cast outside from entering it, if someone not authorized cast a spell in this radius the cost of the spells is deduced from the throne and the spell fail, the caster still spent their own magic trying. if a spell cast outside enter the area it is dispelled just the same. if a spell is cast and the throne does not have the stored up magic to stop it the spells is cast successfully and the area disappear. 

the throne can only be moved around by you and no-others and if its destroyed you lose all saved up magic.
 
(placed whenever and wherever at your demand.)

objects.title: a magical war-chest.
objects.text:
this keychain sized chest can stretch into a massive chest and come from the "god of weapons" universe.

any personal equipment or item stored inside are considered equipped granting whatever enchantements and benefit that actually equipping the gears would grant in a cumulative effect.

this also allow projection of stored weapons or shields to float around you and be wielded with your mind manually or automatically target nearby threat and block attack.

the chest use a slot system, any items have a slot cost and the chest start with a 4x4 square of slot and it increase by 3 slot every month up to a 16x16 square.

bound give the usual benefit and prevent others from opening the chest.

endless make the box 16x16 from the start and remove the maximum limit.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

a photo camera from a small unfortunate world where tragedy came and struck harshly from  the media's greed and lack of honesty. 

it can take up to one hundred photo and is a completely mundane as.

when you take a photo with this camera you can then give it a headline, the moment you do it will always be seen one way or another by at least 10% of the planet population within the day, the headline will influence their perception of the photo for better or worst. 

bound and endless give the usual benefit.


(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: a siege tank.
objects.text:
a siege tank, enough to say its a behemoth of a machine. at 3200 tons the "love and tolerance" come from a crossover world of "my little pony" and "girls und panzer" where tank development never stopped. 

with a 240 mm thick armor at its thinnest and multiple Active protection system both soft and hard as well as a large sensory array and disruption cloak. it is
powered by a reactor fueled by literal magic, it can be refueled by any magic user but consume about as much magic as 10 master level spells every km. the average unicorn could -by using all its magic- power this things for about 1/10 of a kilometer.

it come armed with:

-1 double barreled  120mm railgun firing kinetic/HE/plasma rounds.
-1 heavy plasma machine gun firing 9mm bullets equivalent in plasma which add an armor stripping effect.
-2 modules of 6 pod containing each 4 short range rockets for ground ground assault.(mounted on each side of the turrets)
-2 modules of 18 long range guided missiles for ground to air assault. (mounted static on both side of the tank frame.)
-1 long ranges mortar unit with a total of 45 shots fired from a 15 barreled pod. (mounted on the back right of the turret.) 
-8 barrels of 8 spider mines deployable during movement for retreat or setting up fortification and ambush.(mounted static on the back of the tank frame.)

can be driven by 1 user but require 4 to truly reach maximum potential.

bound and endless give the usual benefit.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: a wandering castle and town..
objects.text:
this castle and small village is about  the size of "Mont Saint-Michel" in your world version of France and is strapped to an equine shaped mountain, it can teleport once a day anywhere you can see from the highest tower but cannot teleport without enough space to fit its hooves on the ground or into another object, it must also be able to support the weight of the mountain, that mean you generally cannot teleport into the sea or on sand. (when trying to teleport the castle you are instinctively aware of all spot fit for teleportation in range.)

any living being at the landing spot is displaced at a safe distance. it come with all the usual bells and whistle a castle is expected to have including an army of golem knights and servants ready to serve, those are not alive and lack souls or free wills and merely follow simple orders or fulfill their standard tasks of defending and maintaining the castle.

bound give the usual benefits and prevent other from tempering with the castle foundation or teleporting it around or you out of it. 

endless allo you to now respawn a brand new castle and golems after one year and you can have up to 4 at a time.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: an airship.
objects.text:
a luxury airship built and powered by magic and technologie, it require some decent expertise in both to use and maintain it properly.

its the size of a large campus with an added large stretch of land as a garden and small lake. it fly using magic and has both a personal bubble shield and a small fleet of 24 civilian craft.

its top speed is about that of a commercial airliner and does not carry weapon, the shield can easily block small arms fire and even conventional missile for a long while but it is a rather easy target with no point defense and as such not meant for combat. 

it is instead made for very fine living as it come with all the comfort of modern life and more for about two hundred fifty peoples easily.

while most basic fonctions can be operated by one person from the bridge this ship still require a crew to properly sail and manage its utilities, as such get a crew of servent and crewman golem but while they are in "theme" with the ship (golden artistic looks and finely crafted) they are also still civilian golem and are very simplistic (no AI, just good VI.) and fragile (not meant for conflict at all.) if fancy looking.

bound give the usual benefits and prevent others from teleporting it around or you out of it.

bound and endless give the usual benefit.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: a Kakugane
objects.text:
coming from the world of "buso renkin" those palm sized trinket allow one to summon a "buso renkin" or alchemy's arms, the weapon or piece of equipment generated can go from a simple interactive map to a multy story gundam and depend on the user personality but no user ever disliked what they got.

though all arms have their own weakness and strength they all have the common point of being very tough to damage even in an inactive state the kakugane can block a few direct blow from others arms, in addition kakugan can self regenerate from damage and will slowly heal whoever is holding one. Its regenerative properties are so great that one can also function as a replacement  organ, while it cannot replace the brain it can take over less existential and complexe fonction such as motion and basic senses to allow the brain time to heal or adapt, it can even replace the whole nerve system to fix partial or complete paralysis. those effects doesn't require the kakugan to stay inactive and still allow the user to function even when it has transformed into a Buso Renkin but should the buso renkin be destroyed the effect my weaken while the kakugane is reappearing itself. 

bound give the usual ability to recall the kakugane when lost or stolen and also increase the self repair and healing potential of the kakugane threefold.

endless allow you to use two kakugane at the same time a very rare abiity, it also allow your kakugane to multiply over time, a new kakugane is made in twice the time it would take for your kakugane to repair itself from 99% destruction, without bound it would take three month. the production pause while your own kakunage is reapairing.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: an iron maiden golem cape.
objects.text:
a cape and hood combo made of enchanted steel and made into a golem, it follow any order you give or think at it.

it has two mode:

-a four limbed "active defense" mode that can act as legs to automatically dodge any attack possible and shield parry/deflect the rest, its drill shaped spikes can be shot like homing bullets to intercept attack but need to be retrieved. 

-the second is a "static defense" it prevent movement and isolate the wearer from the outside completely, in this state the user is blind except for two small shielded eye socket at the front and cannot interact with the outside world in any way but is completely invulnerable as well. i mean that literally in this state no harm can befool you at all but you are locked in place and mostly blind to what happen around you, the spikes retract when in this state obviously. the only weakness is that you have only so much air inside the iron maiden.  

bound give the usual benefits.

endless give the spikes auto return ability and give endless air supply in static defense mode.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: A golden cloth: Armor of the alicorn.
objects.text:
Inspired by the golden cloth of the goddess Athena's zodiac knights, this armor offer many benefit and in fact bring the mortal wearing it close to godly level of power.

Its use is only possible if one is worthy of it, its requirement are "a pure heart, a wise mind and unshakable determination."

Picking this armor will also grant you the ability to use cosmos and train in it as long as you are worthy (should you lose this statut you lose said ability but regain it and you will regain any progress you had made.).

Attack made using cosmos is highly destructive and would tear anyone using it to pieces long before they could bring it to bear in full, wearing a "cloth" drain your cosmos during use to shield the user from its own attack as much as their enemy's.

At the start you will be able to use this cloth for about 12 minutes before it drain you to much to keep using safely, this will grow with you mastery of your cosmos.

It grant when worn:
-Superhuman Physical characteristics:
set physical attribute to bombshell with max level physicals boosts.
-Immortality:
you don't age while wearing the armor. 
-Extrasensory Perception:
 you have perfect awareness of present and near-future event (twelve second) in your immediate surrounding( 20 meter radius).
- Durability Negation: 
attack ignore most non magical defenses.
- Resistance to:
Mind Manipulation, Soul Manipulation, Matter Manipulation, Illusions, Dream Manipulation, Life Manipulation, Death Manipulation, Space-Time Manipulation, Existence Erasure, Heat , cold, and Electricity.
-Energy Manipulation type cosmos:
you can use cosmos and convert cosmos to any other form of energy.
-Healing:
you can heal all wound using cosmos as fuel.
-Telepathy:
you can talk to and read the minds of others.
-Telekinesis:
force equal to your physicals strength but use intellect for precision and finesse.
-Teleportation:
you can teleport using line of sight or to place you visited.
-True Flight:
you are void capable and your dexterity determine speed.
-Spatial Manipulation:
equal to spatial magic compendium master level.
-Time Manipulation:
equal to time magic compendium master level.
-Probability Manipulation:
increase the chance of success or reduce risk of failure in luck based instance to 50/50 at worst.
-Attack Reflection:
any attack made at you that you successfully block are reflected back automatically and in full.

when not in use the armor turn into a small gold statue of an alicorn, it is no more resistant than mundane gold in its stored state. 

Due to its nature as a holy relics that can judge unworthy its users it cannot benefit from the "bound" effect. 

This item already received my godly touch to be this powerful and cannot benefit from the "endless" effect.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear with it on arrival.)

objects.title: A heavy object: Baby Magnum
objects.text:
sitting at about 75 meter tall this "heavy object" come from the world of...well "heavy object" and is part of this world "unique" military doctrine of making massive mobile weapon platform capable of shrugging off direct nuclear strike and carrying enough heavy weaponry and air defenses to raze country on their own.

powered by a fusion reactor and moving using static electricity to hover slightly above ground or sea at a top speed of 530km/h.  the Baby Magnum's main weapons are 7 giant cannons attached to the 7 arms on the back of the sphere, which are capable of piercing through even other heavy object at close range. The Baby Magnum main cannons have a special functionality; they can switch their devices like a microscope switching its lens, rotating the core of the barrel it can switch between laser beams, railguns, coilguns and low-stability plasma cannons .
A key part of an Object's structure is its special armor called "onion armor". The main body of a standard Object alone is over 50 meters, it is made of Steel sheets and tens of thousands of them are put together in layers to create the giant sphere, The thin sheets serve to disperse and diffuse an impact rather than provide the defensive power of a thick wall.

A nuke can still be effective if it manages to slip past the Object's sensors and point-defense system, though it's been noted that a single nuke -even a direct strike- would not destroy a normal Object and would only "distort" 20-30% of their weapons and armor.

bound and endless give the usual benefit.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: a continental ark ship.
objects.text:
an ark ship the size of Australia, half of that is used for the biosphere that serve as the middle of the ark ship and its source of oxygen and food, the rest serve into a tower at the back that hold the living habitat and industrial infrastructure to maintain its fleet and be self sufficient but not much more, as well as the hangars for said fleet. 

the habitat in addition to its maintenance droid crew can house about 60 million habitant comfortably and transports a flotilla of vessels i retrieved from a hooful  of universe in its hangars, in detail it carry (can be swapped for equivalent alternate on demand):
 
1  Lucrehulk-class in carrier configuration with shield generator, 3000 droid fighters, 1500 droid bombers and 50 C-9979 landing craft.
and 139.000 t1 battledroid army and crew. (star wars)

2  Zmey-class dreadnought armed with primary Heavy Plasma canon, secondary heavy flak turrets, a Plasma cannon Broadside , pods of homing light missile, Anti-Missile Lasers point defense and a Warp Jump drive (5000km range).
(dreadnought)

20 Halberd-class light destroyer 
primary mac cannon, secondary missile pods, point defense guns and nuclear missile. (halo)

the ark ship itself lack weaponry but come with layered shields generators that make a lucrehulk envious. its top speed is about 192 km/s or earth jupiter in 36 days, the gravity inside the ark remain 1G earth standard.

bound and endless give the usual benefit.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: a planetoid ark ship.
objects.text:
an ark the ship of your home world moon, its inside are completely hollowed out and filled with infrastructure aside the small artificial sun that power it in the middle. the outside is covered into a "shell" of screen and window that can be covered into a invisibility field and as much shielding as the continental ark ship. 

its daily maintenance are fulfilled by an army of small drones and droid and it contain everything needed for about a billion people to live in comfortably in the large towers used to house the population. it lack green spots larger than a park aside area for food production instead being mostly filled with large automated industrials complexe and its hangar filled with its fleet of ressources collecting drones, it can harvest ressources all around it even on nearby planet to produce enough goods to supply an entire solar system by itself with about anything it has a template or blueprint for. 

it lack any kind of conventional active defense instead relying on its shields, camouflage and its ability to move surprisingly quickly even without warp drive or FTL system.

worst come to worst its drones (tear shaped craft with four fold-in tentacles, two million at first but can hold about 10 should you produce some, each one about the size of three Hitachi EH400 Haul Truck combined.) are reinforced for heavy duty mining in hostile environment and equipped with potent short range mining equipment. laser cutter, diamond tipped drill and hydraulic pile bunker are just a few of the tools they are equipped with and the very thick armor they have make even ramming viable.

this ark ship can -after charging its unique engine, one that forcefully bend space using artificial gravity to make the ship "fall" where it need to go while keeping gravity at 1G earth standard for the ship itself- move at about 1236 km/s but only in a straight line and with with clear coordinates with no premature stop or adjustment along the way, the gravity engine take a few hour to cooldown afterward. this speed allow to go from earth to Jupiter in 6 days and look for most organic species like you like the the ark ship just disappearing from sight leaving behind a faint smeared afterimage, unless invisible then its untraceable through sight.

bound and endless give the usual benefit.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: a world ark ship.
objects.text:
okay this one is the big one, its a whole "planet" that is already fully developed with a neat trick to it, the "planet" is surrounded in a "cage" where the cities and town and village are built while the "planet" is actually nothing but a mass of compressed usables ressources.

the ring has 6 main city, one by pole and four around its circumference those cities come with a central spire that can: scan, examine, infer, zone, encroach (or "S.E.I.Z.E" in short) anything they points toward, be it a whole planet or a single person on said planet. when they are not doing so they can be instead set to absorb any form of ambient energy around your world and storing it inside the "planet" core and can then channel it to the factory inside the ring to maintain them and to produce anything you might need as well as to the shield. 

a S.E.I.Z.E performed by the a spire basically "scan" the entire world, "examine" all the data, "infer" all its past and potential futur claim the local temporal "zone" finally it encroach on its conceptual sovereignty. this process can take as little as a few second or as long as days but from that completion point the spire can then retroactively (or  not) change the past  present and immediate future of anything it has seized. what this mean is you can scan a world and change anything that is and has happened, mind you it is prohibitively expensive in term of energy and time when used on a large scale, a few  resurrections? easy and done in a  flash, rewriting the past at the dawn of life on a world? multiple star worth of energy and a few decade of boot up time for the spire to do it. this world can also only hold 6 time its own mass in seized mass at a time.
