the difference between this ark ship and the other is also is that this planet cannot move easily, you need to send drones at the point of arrival and have them create a wormhole gate using millions of drones to fabricate the opening and then your world will slowly appear at the point of arrival any interruption can have a catastrophic impact on your world. ever seen the transformers movie from Michael bay where cybertron teleportation get interrupted? yeah that but worst since your world is actually a mass of highly compressed ressources kept compressed by relatively fragile rings. two words "explosive decompression".

this world come with said drones, a literal billion of them, and a massive shield generator, I am talking completely impenetrable shield here, its only default is you can't use the spire or anything else through the shield heck you can't even see or be seen through or communicate as it is not a one way barrier. while up it run on about "yes" amount of energy but thankfully the shield energy draw is not affected by whether or not its being attacked or how much, it cannot be broken unless you turn in off or it run out of power. (draining your home world sun could power the shield for about 1 maybe 1,5  millennia.)

another default is that its "empty" as in unpopulated by anything but its maintenance drones and while they can keep things in working order, the world sheer size (twice that of Jupiter but still with 1g earth standard.) mean that third parties sneaking on it are very likely and drones are hardly hard to fool or dodges.

the world is also the ultimate factory and living habitat capable of housing more than a hundred billion people with ease and produce anything be it scientific or magical and even both combined thanks to the modular nature of the factories in the ring rings.

whatever you could ever need or want it can make it,  its for all intent and purpose a paradise for you to own if a little lonely at the moment.

cannot benefit from bound or endless.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: The alicorn amulet.
objects.text:
(pulled from the Ponyverse cannon.)

The alicorn amulet provide no benefit or negative effect when worn by an alicorn.

The alicorn amulet is a double edged sword, it progressively grant whoever wears it the powers of an alicorn at the cost of amplifying any "dark urges" they have, this come as intrusive thoughts and impulsive tendency to see them manifested, while those "dark urges" are not necessarily evil or even bad they tend to be very chaotic, reckless, selfish or even destructive or cruel.

the amulet must be worn to work and can only be removed by the wearer willingly. it effect (positives and negatives) also disappear instantly on removal and need to "ramp up" from scratch when worn again.

the wearer effectively gain one level of a random boost per day until they are all S rank.
two random pony core race after a year. 
after gaining two new core race they gain alicorn traits every month until are all unlocked.
finally after three years, they either gain a domain if they resisted their dark urges or are sealed into the amulet and become part of its powers if they fell to them. the amulet consider the wearer to have failed when said wearer cannot make the difference between the dark urges and their own thought.

gaining the domain does not free you of the dark urges, this will be a constant battle of will.

the domain gained is based on how the wearer used the amulet but cannot be the "death" domain. 

after a hundred years of being worn the amulet unlatch drained and powerless but the wearer remain empowered.

cannot benefit from bound or endless.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: The Inspiration, Manifestation magical book.
objects.text:
(pulled from the Ponyverse cannon.)

The Inspiration, Manifestation magical book work as a magical focus geared specifically toward conjuration and transmutation.

While using it for the two magical fields the owner just need to imagine a desired result and without having to cast any spell the books will do it for them, it require no magic from the owner nor any skill aside a good imagination. 

the book also does not contain any text or clue of how it perform this feat, making it a crutch rather than training wheels. 

overuse of the book can lead to sharp headache, insomnia, paranoia, OCD, ADHD,  all those side effect can appear after just two (2) day of use but are all temporary and will fade away after about a weeks of no use. using it for more than two day can result in coma, heart failure and aneurysm.

bound give the usual benefit. endless bring no advantage as the item require no fuel.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: The mirror.
objects.text:
(pulled from the Ponyverse cannon.)

this mirror is actually a portal toward other realities. the small mirror  at the top can be used to define what world you want to enter,  you just place against it any item you want and its nature will open a gate to a reality that "match" the item in theme, this method give completely different result at every use even with the same item, thankfully you can also just place an item sourced from another reality against it and it will open a gate toward its precise home reality so after a bit of mapping you should be able to compile a list of realities to reliably access. 

piece of fiction -generally books- can also be used  to more precisely pinpoint the kind of world you are searching for, the more detailed and compelling the piece the more precise the result. 

the gate when used can remain opened for about one (1) month or less if turned off but then require one (1) month rest time no matter the opening time. 

the entry and exit point cannot be moved during this time and if the gate is destroyed you will be stranded unless you have both a piece of you home reality with you and the bound effects to restore the mirror.

bound give the usual benefit. endless make the item "cooldown" time of the mirror equal to the time it remained open.  .

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: The windigo's last breath.
objects.text:
(pulled from the Ponyverse fandom.)

The windigo's last breath allow its wielder to control the magical ice of the windigo, a terrible ice that feed on hate and anger to become colder and more resistant. using it one can project blast of cold that grow more potent the more they or their targets feel hate and anger. 

as sole weakness this ice melt and release its victime instantly when someone that felt true friendship or love touch its icy surface.    

the ice also tend to radiate a sort of "aura" that make sapient nearby more hateful, this effect scale with the amount of windigo's ice manifested in the world.

bound give the usual benefit. endless bring no advantage as the item require no fuel.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

objects.title: The cornucopia.
objects.text:
(pulled from the Ponyverse fandom.)

The cornucopia is a room sized item that, when asked politely (exemple: May i please have____.) will provide anything asked of it, the trick is that the items are not created but instead stolen from somewhere in the world. 
If you ask for a length of rope the same length of rope is removed from a rope somewhere and teleported in the cornucopia. ask for someone, and they are teleported, as long as the item or beings exist in the local reality it will appear. mind you this item does not have any way of bypassing defenses the targets may have,  so asking for a beings heart might just not work if they are shielded from space magic attacks. 

bound give the usual benefit. endless allow the cornucopia to make copy instead of stealing items.

(can be delivered on demand or you can appear in it on arrival.)

rows.title: gears and items
rows.titleText:
items, what did you really think i would leave you destitute? this list contain some useful gears and even places to live in that i either made myself or gathered around worlds i visited while taking stock of the omniverse general state.

("ark" are the only void worthy item anything else is intended for atmospheric use only unless stated otherwise, ark ship are capable of motion but mainly intended to be lived in not sail the star and lack any means of conventional FTL.)

some item can be picked three time, the first time you get the item, the second time you get the one effects from either "bound" or "endless" and the third time you get "bound" and "endless".

Bound: items are bound to you and if lost or stolen return to you with a simple focus of will, if damaged or destroyed they slowly regenerate over time or reappear brand new after about a month of time. (unless stated differently in the item description.)

Endless: items require no additional fuel or ammunition or even any consumable of any kind to use as they magically reload ammo and refuel fuel as soon as either are spent, this happen even if you unload ammo or siphon fuel out. (unless stated differently in the item description.)

objects.title: Tier zero
objects.text:
those worlds offer no point but if you want you can chose to go and spend some time in one of my own "darker" world as "practice runs" or a "tutorial" before the real deal. 

those worlds are basically the classical "my little pony" world but who either got unlucky or villain/s won at some point somewhere, i generally fix them up with a generous application of time travel and "deus ex" but i keep the more frequents cases around temporarily in stasis for study purposes so i can better prevent repeating events. they are still far easier to deal with than actual grimdark worlds. 

just pick one or more and you get about 100 years (total) to fix them up and move on, don't worry those world can generally be fixed to my bare minimum criteria in less than one decade, two decade at worst, this will leave you plenty of time to practice for your departure. 

those world follow my worlds usual advantage:

-almost no death aside old age.
-villain tend to capture their foes a few time before going for more permanent measure.
-the odds conspire in favor of those who have good hearts and good intent.
-peoples and even villain can always be redeemed or convinced to join you.

in all those world you will appear somewhere safe and right in front of someone willing -and capable- to assit you in your task, but always after the catalyst event that turned those worlds dark happened.

objects.title: the lunar empire.
objects.text:
in this world nightmare mood was never banished and now rule over a millennia old empire that as not seen the sun in just as long.

Thankfully the magic of the alicorn of the night can compensate for the lack of sun but the people and the world as a whole is now starting to fail as nightmare moon herself is losing her will to carry on. 

the cause is simple yet even the empress of the night is helpless to solve it, the loneliness and fury that started her crusade and founded her empire is ever growing and ever dimming respectively and now her grasp on the world fail ever more with each lonely night.

objects.title: the solar empire.
objects.text:
in this world celestia alicorn of the day was the one to fall to her darker side when Star swirl the bearded destroyed the portal to an alternate world where her lover -a good version of king Sombra- resided. to be fair her anger is somewhat justified but the portal was destabilizing both world and needed to be closed or risked destroying both. 

heartbroken and mad with despair celestia became furious turned into Daybreaker, obliterated star swirl and tried to forcefully open a path to her lover's world using the sun as a gateway, this meant bringing the sun closer than ever to the planet and risked destroying it wholesale, Luna her sister and alicorn of the night tried to stop her and was banished to the moon for her troubles. luna nonetheless successfully bound the sun's place with her moon's, stopping either of them from moving. 

now she rule over a world forever at noon, terrified of her mood swing as she erratically go from furious to despairing to ashamed under a sun trapped in place, just as she is.

objects.title: the changeling queendom.
objects.text:
in this world queen chrysalis defeated celestia, luna, cadence and twilight sparkle and all who opposed her during the wedding and now rule over Equestria with an iron hoof, capturing pony and harvesting their love for her now very well fed and very powerful hive, her gaze turn now to Equestria's neighbors for her next conquest. 

the remnant of Equestria's have gathered in the Everfree forest to form a resistance movement around Zecora but they are few and badly armed nor prepared,  the wedding invasion seeing all their leaders captured and imprisoned by the changelings.

objects.title: the umbrum's return.
objects.text:
in this world king sombra refused to help "Grogar"(discord in disguise) but instead bid is time in hiding, thanks to the additional time to recuperate and being better prepared, he successfully returned to power as ruler of the crystal empire and imprisoned cadence the alicorn of love and shining armor her husband as well as all the elements of harmony. 

now at war with equestria he get ever closer to is goal of ruling all of pony kind as the two alicorn left -celestia the alicorn of the sun and luna alicorn of the night- are kept in check by the two younger, mind controlled, cadence alicorn of love and twilight alicorn of friendship.

with the call to war a trio of once misguided unicorns have united to defend their homeland:

-starlight glimmer, student of twilight sparkle, most knowledgeable unicorn.
-sunset shimmer, student of celestia, most powerful unicorn.
-tempest shadow, lover of twilight sparkle, most skilled unicorn fighter.

objects.title: the rise of lord Tirek.
objects.text:
in this world lord Tirek successfully stole all magic in equestria and threw the princesses, elements and discord into tartarus, the prison that once held him. 

he now rule the entire world through fear and is unmatched power demanding tribute and even at time worship of all, he now reside into a colossal castle the size of 5 mount Everest where once stood equestria and built for him by enslaved dragons and diamond dogs to accommodate is ever growing size and maintained by the hordes of beings that serve is every wishes.  

there is no résistance in this world for there can be no hope when any who dare even just displease him are drained of their magic with nary a thought. 

his power is rapidly reaching the limit of what he can hold before his size become too much for his castle or even the planet.

objects.title: the father of monster.
objects.text:
in this world grogar the father of monster used the three fool messing with his bell to bring about his true return to power when they stole discord magic, an error they very quickly paid for in their newfound servitude. 

back from the dead and more powerful than ever with the magic of discord running through his vein he summoned to him his splintered hordes of monsters.

hydra, chimera, manticore, basilisk and more now flocks to their primordial father eager or not to serve him matter little, when their very existence belong to him, if it wasn't enough he can now -through the power of chaos- conjure monster from the depth of his mind with but an effort of will though for obvious reason none are more powerful than himself.

soon he will march upon a world ill prepared to face him and his army of million and growing, even the princess for all their power will be drowned under the unrelenting monsters tide.

objects.title: the Kaos god.
objects.text:
in this world as in most other world, during his time sealed in stone discord went from is usual funny mad to actually eldritch mad and then back to funny countless time.

In this world, contrary to others he broke free while eldritch mad and turned the world into twisted wonderland while he himself became twisted by is own power.

Now a gigantic winged serpent he roam the world tearing apart any form of order and sanity he meet leaving behind only raving lunatics and twisted landscape. the few that escaped his initial rampage now hide deep inside tartarus dreading the time discord now named Kaos stumble its way to them.

objects.title: the endless hour.
objects.text:
in this world a miscast spell during the wedding caused a 1 hour time loop to form,  only twilight sparkle lost in a city at war remember the events from the loops.

multiples years of trying to get free of this loop have made the young mare more a more determined to find an escape but it seem she just cannot reach the castle in time through the chaos of the changeling invasion to even uncover the event that started said loop. 

her lack of progress and the loneliness it brought also eroded her hope, morality and restraint leaving behind a much more violent and cynical mare that recently stoped trying to do anything and just spend what little time the loop give her to mess around.

objects.title: equestria at war.
objects.text:
this world is special in the way that it isn't, its an average human world but with pony and magic mixed in. i mean that its a world that follow your own world "genre" and "habit"  and i applied magic and "fantasy" races on it and here we are.

to be fair this world is not actually dark, more grey but while its is a proof that i am doing things right since my creation don't become too bad even when having the same "condition" as other world its still too dark for me, its mostly the same as my other world even, but with a lot more politics and injustice as well as moral ambiguity, ideological and faith related conflict. all around its a nicer version of your world.

also a world war and about 10 or 15 civil war all over the world are brewing and technologie is closer to the 1930/1950 than medieval which mean gun, tanks and airplane but socially its still a fair bit better than your world at the time. also magical nuke could be a thing.

objects.title: Tier one
objects.text:
those worlds generally have at least three or more of:

-small scale problem.
-mostly human level of risks.
-low percentage of the land and population affected or responsible.
-no existential threat from beyond mortal comprehension.
-plenty of area safe and free of grimdark-ness to retreat to.

in all those worlds you will land there one week before an in world event you can name in a safe place within a 100 km of a person of your choice. the person must have been born before the event chosen. but never more than a week before the catalyst events that turned those worlds dark happened. where in those 100km is up to you, you can pop right on top or at the very edge

objects.title: snow piercer
objects.text:
Survivors of Earth's second ice age live out their days on a luxury train that ploughs through snow and ice. The train's poorest residents, who live in the squalid caboose, plan to improve their lot by taking over the engine room.

this world ice age is actually coming to an end soon, and while life would be rough it is now possible outside that accursed train. if you just deal with the handful of lightly armed men abusing the poor peoples of the train and screw the heads of the rich one back on straight, no actual enemy stand against you but the harsh weather.

objects.title: hunger game
objects.text:
In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

perhaps the girl could us a little help? and who know, maybe all this world need is a little push to turn itself around before its too late. after all only a small wealthy minority is truly responsible for what is wrong in this world, and their victims have not yet had all the fight beaten out of them, they only need a leader with a plan.

objects.title: bioshock
objects.text:
A man in a plane crash in the Atlantic Ocean and finds a lighthouse in the middle of the sea, which takes him to an underwater city created by a man named Andrew Ryan called Rapture, which is home to many violent creatures called Splicers, who are peoples made insane because of mutation. 

in this once hopeful utopia driven by the ideal of one man the worst of mankind sipped in, blossomed and now flourish as its root spread over minds and bodies alike.

of course the city could be reclaimed, once more becoming a home to the innocent children that now haunt those depth and are in need a kind and gentle soul to rescue and guide them.

objects.title: beastar
objects.text:
In a world of anthropomorphic animals, a reclusive wolf's -Legoshi- complicated relationship with a kindly rabbit is tested by a classmate's murder, a charismatic deer's influence, and his own burgeoning predatory instincts in a society where prey and predator are constantly in battle against their instinct, needs, and the terrible risks and sacrifices cohabitation demand of them.

still, most of them are trying for cohabitation so if you somehow solve their practical problems like food and safety concern, things should fall into place easily enough.

objects.title: witcher
objects.text:
the world of Geralt of Rivia, a Witcher, and Ciri, a princess who becomes a witcher-in-training. Geralt, with the help of Yennefer of Vengerberg, must keep Ciri safe from the many people who wish to use her for political gains, all while training her in the ways of being a Witcher.  beware that outsider are now seeking ciri for her burgeoning powers over time and space.

this world is mostly suffering from misconception, paranoia and prejudice. make communication easier and create safe place for contact between different races and this world has no lack of means to grow into a high fantasy world full of wonder and beauty. 

Ciri especially, with your help could be the start of something truly wonderful for this and other worlds.

objects.title: deadman wonderland
objects.text:
After being falsely convicted for the murder of his entire class, a young man named Ganta Igarashi must learn to survive in a mysterious prison with a perverted take on incarceration while also looking to clear his name. He soon figures out he and the other prisoner here aren't like any normal prisoner, but that they are Deadman, peoples who have a Branch of Sin, powers related to blood.

most deadman are not actually guilty, instead they were framed so they could be used in the twisted gladiator fight they are forced to play, if you can tear apart the lies and reveal what is really happening cooler heads can perhaps prevail and right many wrongs.

objects.title: game of throne
objects.text:
the world of westeros is host to a long struggle for power between nobles families while a threat looms over their kingdoms, an external enemy that destroys everything in its path: the White Walkers.

in a world where magic was greatly reduced for so long that most doubt it ever existed, and where the ages of glory and wonder are gone, a world of grim and raw brutality and little hope was born.

in the end though, with most native gods of this world dead, weakened or fake this world is just your standard medieval world and can be fixed through pretty mundane scientific and sociological advancement.

objects.title: Tier two
objects.text:
those worlds generally have at least some of:

-country or society wide problem
-occasional inhuman level of risk.
-average percentage of the land and population affected or responsible.
-existential threat is manageable by the native in most cases. 
-some safe area free of grimdark-ness to retreat to.

in all those worlds you will land there one week before an in world event you can name in a safe place within a 100 km of a person of your choice. the person must have been born before the event chosen. but never more than a week before the the catalyst events that turned those worlds dark happened. where in those 100km is up to you, you can pop right on top or at the very edge

objects.title: elfen lied
objects.text:
Elfen Lied takes place in Kamakura and Kanagawa, and focuses on the "Diclonius", a newly mutated species. Their appearance is similar to humans, but with several differences, namely horn-like protrusions on the forehead, the presence of telekinetic invisible arms called "vectors" and unconventional hair colour.

to help this world will not be simple for it lies at a crossroad, helping the Diclonius integrate will not be easy as no Diclonius as yet to grow into a stable healthy adult  yet, no one know if its even possible considering how different they are to regular human.

they are threated as you would expect from most worlds on this list that is to say as both a threat to study and neutralize and a ressource to appropriate and exploit. 

most "Diclonius" are never given the chance to grow into healthy adult, they gain their ability when very young -about 5/6 years old- and their "vectors" are from the very beginning capable of ripping peoples and steel to shred something a child would not realize when calm let alone when distressed leading to tragedy.

objects.title: alita battle angel
objects.text:
this world is set on Earth in the 26th century. The primary location is the iron city, a metropolis which lies beneath the massive aerial city of Tiphares. 

Tiphares itself is suspended from an orbital ring which surrounds the Earth. the abandoned Alita is found by Ido, a compassionate cyber-doctor who takes the unconscious cyborg Alita to his clinic. When Alita awakens, she has no memory of who she is, nor does she have any recognition of the world she finds herself in. As Alita learns to navigate her new life and the treacherous streets of Iron City, Ido tries to shield her from her mysterious past.

a post apocalyptical world where humanity is lost, literally, humanity as a concept is lost and forgotten. in some world the idea of replacing limbs with tech immediately create the worry of losing oneself along with them in this world whole brains are replaced by a bio-chip and life is created and discarded without care or worry for bloodsport, its a world were morality is alien if not non-existant. 

remember the saying: "Scientists were so preoccupied with whether or not they could, they didn’t stop to think if they should."?  in this world of apathy and fickle curiosity, scientists actually thought about it and found nothing wrong with the atrocity they were committing and did a lot more terrible things indeed.

objects.title: cyberpunk: edgerunners
objects.text:
In a dystopia overrun by corruption, crime, and cybernetic implants, an impulsive but talented street kid named David Martinez, after losing everything he has in a drive-by shooting, chooses to survive on the wrong side of the law as an "edgerunner": a high-tech, black-market mercenary also known as a "cyberpunk".

this world is very unique when it come to post apocalyptique world in that a rather large part of civilisation actually survived, sadly this part is the greedy corporate parts and it has now infiltrated every facet of life and is slowly choking and molding what little humanity remain amongst the peoples.

there is also the matter of the group of rogue A.I that are doing who know what on the fringe of the world and beyond the black wall it what was once the internet.

objects.title: fullmetal alchemist brothjerhood
objects.text:
in this world there exist an additional "system" to basic physics called alchemy, this new system follow the law of equivalent exchange to turn anything into any other things, it work on both inanimate object and being but also on esoteric concept like the soul or "sins". this entire system rely on alchemical circles who are complexe but can be scaled up or profane knowledge acquired by reaching to the semi-sentient system itself and peeking behind the curtain of reality through one own "gate of truth" a door that reside in the soul and allow one ti use alchemy.

in this world an entity created from the profane power from behind the gate as been setting up a plan to harvest all the soul and life from a continent to fuel is plan to consume "god", the semi-sentient entity that oversee alchemy.

the plan is doomed to failure mind you as it is akin to consuming an entire law of physics and so at best it will gain all the knowledge of alchemy and a massive increase in raw power but not the omniscience required to put it to proper use but it would still be a genocide of tremendous scale, one the creature already performed once across a whole country to gain "immortality" mind you it only become very long lived and a strong regeneration factor fueled by the soul it harvested. 

the other problem are the "philosopher stones", those item are made by harvesting and condensing souls into a blood red stone that can substitute for any requirement for alchemy, the thing is the stone is consumed as it is used and by the law of alchemy what is happening is that the soul are being transmuted into the needed material or energy and sop seize to exist, forever denied afterlife and literally unmade.

objects.title: attack on titan
objects.text:
this world is set in a world where humanity is forced to live in cities surrounded by three enormous walls that protect them from gigantic man-eating humanoids referred to as Titans; the story follows Eren Yeager, who vows to exterminate the Titans after they bring about the destruction of his hometown and the death of his mother.

not the worst world out there but it is a big mess of old grudge and generational hatred and vengeance and trauma. in this world no one is completely good or bad they just have grievance and belief and it will be up to you to navigate this political and ideological minefield to resolve the conflicts peacefully. 

there is also the matter of the half goddess stuck in limbo by the trauma she endured at the hand of the evil man she loved.

objects.title: akame ga kill
objects.text:
The world focuses on Tatsumi, a young villager who travels to the Capital to raise money for his home only to discover strong corruption in the area. The assassin group known as Night Raid recruits the young man to help them in their fight against the corrupt Empire.

this world become grimdark after the king and queen died, the prime minister Honest -sickening irony- is now manipulating the very young emperor and pulling the wool over is eyes constantly, shaping the empire into is personal hedonistic paradise at the cost of everyone else.

while the revolutionary army is fighting against him and his sycophant, the cost of doing so is proving to be heavy and many more good peoples would need to die to achieve victory.

objects.title: the walking dead
objects.text:
in this world sheriff Deputy Rick Grimes wakes up from a coma after getting shot in combat and awakens to a world that is in ruins and infested with zombie. He meets a group on the outskirts of Atlanta and, soon, becomes their leader. he now guide the group of survivors through the danger of this world.

i hate zombie, thankfully in this world zombie lack souls and are instead just reanimated bodies.

If you can wait about 1 maybe 2 decades most zombies will be gone, while they decay slower than they should they also suffer from the elements far more since they lack any instinct to shield themselves from the cold or heat. this mean that after a few winters most zombie's limbs will be damaged to the point of falling apart under their own weight.

no the more long lasting threat come from the survivors who have lost their mind after the apocalypses, some relishing the new state of the world or seeing opportunities in society's fall and other are just paranoid about everyone else. 

its wont be easy to find a good balance between being too trusting and getting backstabbed and being too warry and being alone against the world but its why this world is on this list.

objects.title: fallout
objects.text:
this world start with the reemerging and dangerous faction called the Enclave made up of old America's "deep state" group of rich politician, military and corporate figures, who seeks to take control of the Capital Wasteland and eventually post-war America as a whole.

The faction's ideology -if you could call it that- incorporate pseudo-scientific concepts like social Darwinism and racism towards non-Enclave humans, super mutants and ghouls and the intent to basically genocide anything outside the Enclave who are also designated as "near-human mutants" to be exterminated. 

Their plans to wipe out all other life worldwide, establish a racially pure state of "true humans," coupled with its authoritarian structure, use of slaves, human experimentation and torture should tell you why they are the main problem here.

this world went to crap because of two world war followed by a cold war and now a civil war is coming, no one really know what is happening beyond America and the world is still seeing radiation induced mutation popping everyday, oh also aliens are a thing. 

thankfully for you this world is relatively stable since most weapon of mass destruction are gone -or rather used up- so conflict will be relatively small scale all things considered. also there is tech in this world capable of restoring the planet ecosystem as well as fix any problematic mutation. you just have to somehow acquire it.

objects.title: mad max: furiosa
objects.text:
Set years before the events of Fury Road, this world follows young Furiosa a child born in on of the last place filled with green and life in Australia after the economical collapse and world war over vital resources led to complete societal breakdown. young Furiosa is in her youth kidnapped by the forces of warlord Dementus a madman at the head of a murderous biker gang of nomads.

this world is brutal and dangerous but also completely mundane, no alien or magic or eldritch entity, just regular human doing crazy stuff because life is miserable and radiation poisoning and disease run rampant. 

This mean this world is also relatively easy to fix if time consuming, the major part of peoples will obey anyone that can provide for their basic needs and is strong enough to keep them in check, a few generation and things should be  back to normal.

objects.title: prototype
objects.text:
In the world of Prototype, an amnesiac shapeshifter named Alex Mercer attempts to stop an outbreak of a virus called Blacklight in Manhattan which mutates individuals into powerful violent monsters, while also uncovering his past.

this world danger level is low only because most of said danger is safely contained -for now- and only a hooful of individual presently hold any conscious control over the virus they are now made up of, indeed while the "infected" look like and remember their past lives they are just mass of virus cells having their memories and not them, so don't get infected.

objects.title: tokyo ghoul
objects.text:
in This world ghouls, creatures that look like normal people but can only survive by eating human flesh, live among the human population in secrecy, hiding their true nature in order to evade pursuit from the authorities.

Said authorities proves to be just as capable of cruelties as any ghoul, as while ghoul need human meat to survive they are also capable of empathy and love they are merely a races that predate on another races that just happen to be sapient and consider ghouls unnatural.

As the saying goes: "normal is an illusion. what is normal for the spider is chaos to the fly."

this world dangers are ghoul and the forces fighting, in the case of ghoul they are well known and purely mundane threat, and the second only is a threat for ghouls and those that help them.

objects.title: parasyte
objects.text:
the world of parasyte is set on an average earth where One night, worm-like aliens called Parasytes invade Earth, taking over the brains of human hosts by entering through their ears or noses.

the parasyte are not actually evil, its just how their species reproduce and evolved, given the chance symbiosis is not just possible but would usher a new era of prosperity for both species. doing so would require multiples proof of success and to, somehow, convince belligerent parasyte and xenophobic human.

objects.title: silent hills
objects.text:
this world trouble all happen in the town of Silent Hill, a place plagued by supernatural events, and follows various characters drawn to the town, where they encounter horrifying creatures, psychological torment, and mysteries tied to their own pasts.

the danger of this world are mostly psychological and karmic, the more bad karma or tragic event into your past and the more dangerous and traumatic "things" will appear in town and target you, and those projection are far more "physicals" than the usual psychological trauma.

those danger are restrained by default to silent hill, a small town leaving the entire world free but its nature is anything but mundane.

objects.title: made in abyss
objects.text:
in the world of made in abyss an enormous pit and cave system called "The Abyss" is the only unexplored place in the world. Strange and wonderful creatures reside in its depths, and it is full of precious relics, called Artifacts, that current humans are unable to make. An orphaned girl named Riko lives in the Belchero Orphanage in the town of Orth surrounding said pit and is intending to travel through the abyss to find her mother.

this place is a mess, all its dangers are safely contained but by its honeytrap nature most of its victims find out to late the horror it hides, the abys bait and trap all who wander it through its curses and the remnant of past victims now haunting its depth. 

even those who traveled through most of the abyss did so using cruelty and suffering in spades only for most of them to get stuck at level five. all who didn't get stuck? well despite their skill, experience and knowledge have somehow all disappeared past level 6, never to return.

remember: those that go in the abyss, have the abyss go in them as well, to go down that pit is to condemn yourself to reach its bottom somehow or become one more part of its horrors.

objects.title: firepunch
objects.text:
in this world  Earth has become frozen over and barren. Agni, a young man who is able to regenerate his body. After his village and beloved sister succumbs to inextinguishable flames he is left constantly on fire, leaving him in anguish and vowing to get revenge.

this world is dangerous in mostly mundane way but does have the sporadic meta-human threat. the most dangerous area would be Behemdorg, a city that "rebuilt" civilization by enslaving meta-human like cattle.

if you try to fix this world Behemdorg will consider you both competition and  a potential ressource to exploit, to be fair the second one will most likely happen either way.

objects.title: harry potters: 1929-the global wizarding war
objects.text:
In 1927, the Magical Congress of the United States of America (MACUSA) is transferring the powerful dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald, An infamous powerful dark wizard who caused mass violence, terror and chaos around the globe, seeking to lead a new Wizarding World Order based on his strong belief in Wizarding superiority from their maximum-security prison to London to be tried for his crimes in Europe. Grindelwald escapes during the transfer, aided by his follower and MACUSA employee, Abernathy.

those events preclude the beginning of a long war in the magical world that mirror the war in the mundane one. But where mundane human are plentiful and their population growing quickly the magical are few and on a constant population decline, while the war would not lead to immediate extinction it is omen of it. 

this world innate magic may very well enter its death throes along with the 20th century.

objects.title: resident evil 1
objects.text:
The RPD are investigating strange cannibalized corpses on the outskirts of the city. The Alpha squad, Jill and Chris, are sent to locate missing team members. While there, mutated dogs cause them to flee into a supposedly abandoned mansion.

this world is about to fall to chaos from a dangerous outbreak of virus-T, the danger this virus are variable from simple "zombie" to mutated behemoth or sociopathic super soldier but most have yet to spread and are vulnerable to most mundane weapon of high enough caliber and lack any form of magic.

the true danger lies in its virulence should it reach highly populated area and is allowed to mutate freely for to long and more importantly from the fools who made such a virus and released it into the world.

objects.title: terraformars
objects.text:
In an attempt to colonize Mars, scientists are tasked with terraforming the planet. Their goal is to seed the planet with a modified algae.

Five hundred years later, the first crewed ship to Mars lands and are attacked by giant mutated humanoid cockroaches with incredible physical strength, later labeled "Terraformars".

the crew is wiped out after sending a warning back to Earth. Two years later, BUGS II, a multinational expedition of genetically modified humans, is sent to collect samples of both sexes of roaches, and exterminate the mutated bugs to take control of the red planet. Only two survivors manage to return to Earth. As a third expedition is assembled questions are raised about the true origin of the Terraformars and their connection with an unknown disease afflicting mankind, the Alien Engine Virus, or A.E. Virus. To fight the Terraformars' strength and agility, members of the second and third expedition undergo genetic modification to inherit the characteristics of other organisms, only possible after having a special organ implanted with a 36% chance of surviving the surgery itself.

this world main threat are young but developing quickly,  worst still it is unkown if the beings that created the terraformars and humanity -the rahab-  have created other races in their time and that they have made human and terraformars instinctually hate each others is also worrisome in case they did.

objects.title: Tier three
objects.text:
those worlds generally have at least three or more of:

-planetary and society wide problem.
-constant inhuman level of risks.
-the entirety of the land and population affected or responsible.
-existential threat is slowly overtaking the natives resistance in most cases. 
-few area free of grimdark-ness to retreat to.

in all those worlds you will land there one week before an in world event you can name in a safe place within a 100 km of a person of your choice. the person must have been born before the event chosen. but never more than a week before the the catalyst events that turned those worlds dark happened.

objects.title: outer world
objects.text:
The outer Worlds at its heart it a perfect exemple what happens when people worship corporations from a societal , consumer , and employee point of view and put nature , individualism, and the value of life under the lens of how they affect quarterly reports and not general quality of life. 

in this world humanity are slave to a system built by their predecessor and have never really known free will and self determination instead they live by rules and laws made and enforced by other human and yet apply them like the law of physics and reality, for them it is no more possible to oppose the corporation's rules than flying through sheer force of will or walk inside the sun. strangely enough even the peoples in power did not prove immune to this "degeneration" and are very much so slave/dependent to the system as well even if they live comfortably within it.

this world is dangerous yes but not because of some evil overlord or existential threat but because the peoples of this world are technically all insane and need both deprogramming and re-education and that any "cure" given to them can very easily become just a different form of insanity due to their now instinctual tendency to take any "rules" to their extremes.

objects.title: horizon zero dawn
objects.text:
The world is set in a post-apocalyptic earth, in the 31st century. Humans live in scattered, primitive tribes with varying levels of technological development. Their technologically advanced predecessors are remembered as the "Old Ones." Large robotic machines dominate the Earth. For the most part, they peacefully coexist with humans, who occasionally hunt them for parts. However, a phenomenon known as the "Derangement" has caused machines to become more aggressive toward humans, and larger and deadlier machines have begun to appear. 

in this world humanity fell to hubris and are now living in a very different world where animal no longer exist and are instead replaced by complexe machine mimicking animals. this mean that humanity is far likely to ever become the apex predator of their world on their own and that "nature" in a strange irony is far more capable of protecting itself from abuse and overexploitation. 

the danger in this world is the remnant of what humanity built that destroyed their previous civilisation coming back to finish their grim task as well as the very real possibility of the earth natural ressources running dry at some point in the far futur since even if the "system" in charge of nature as a whole is very efficient it is still operating at a net loss over time as no mundane system at this level of technology can reach 100% efficiency.

objects.title: metro 2033
objects.text:
this world event takes place in the year 2033, twenty years after a nuclear war has destroyed the surface of the Earth. The survivors seek refuge in the vast underground network of the Metro, where different stations have become independent city-states, each with its own culture and political system.

while you might be familiar with the event happening in Moscow it is also happening all over the world, the undergrown tunnels humanity built in the past have proven perfect to keep out of the cold and danger of the irradiated surface and its many dangers. 

in this world the danger come from not only radiation and the cold but also on the difficulty talking with the new species now walking the earth the "dark one" descendent of the human that were irradiated and have adapted and evolved to live in this changed world. sadly the dark one presence can drive human o insanity and have fostered conflict between the two cousin races but maybe you can solve the matter peacefully?

objects.title: muv-luv unlimited/alternative
objects.text:
whe you arrive this world humanity is at war with alien being called beta, they were created by a silicon based lifeform that used carbon based technology in short they are the opposite of humanity who are carbon based life form using silicon based technology. the beta were actually made for mining ressources the reason of their conflict with humanity is unknow, the statut of their creators is unknown and if they are actually controlling the beta or not is also unknown. 

this world is  a bit problematic in that there is mind centric time travel involved as in someone minds is moving through time in this case the protagonist takeru shirogane will have his mind go back three years into the past, three years after your arrival. at least as long as he stay alive, the reason for this is unknown but maybe you can benefit from this.

the danger in this world are the large size and number of beta that either went rogue or if still controlled by their creators the potential conflict between two species that use the other's equivalent of flesh to craft things, this make any potential peace complicated if possible at all.

objects.title: gears of war
objects.text:
The Gears of War world is an alternate universe with a earth-like planet called sera. Human civilization develops and endures a millennia-long conflict that leaves humanity on the brink of extinction. Sera's leaders broker an era of peace that ushers scientific advancements and a cultural renaissance. Humanity's population sporadically grows and demands more energy provided by fossil fuel and nuclear power. Sera's scientists discover Imulsion, a naturally occurring substance that can be refined into a potent energy source. Imulsion solves Sera's energy crisis but ultimately creates great economic disparity as nations with direct access to Imulsion prosper, while other nations fall into financial turmoil.

Sera's citizens balkanize into two warring factions: the Coalition of Ordered Governments (COG) and Union of Independent Republics (UIR). The ensuing 79-year strife, known as the Pendulum Wars, consumes millions of lives with both sides locked in a virtual stalemate.

Six weeks after the COG and UIR agreed to an armistice, a race of subterranean creatures known as the Locust Horde emerge from Sera's depths and begin assaulting human cities, wiping out 25% of the world population in the first 26 hours, referred to as 'Emergence Day'. The Locust overwhelm the already battle-worn COG forces during this surprise attack, causing them to retreat to the Jacinto Plateau, where the Locust cannot dig through its granite bedrock, and reluctantly bombard their own cities to halt the Locust's advance. The ensuing scorched earth tactic destroys much of Sera's cities and human population. The COG continues to operate out of the COG capital of Ephyra and other cities on the plateau, such as Jacinto. The surviving humans outside the plateau and COG jurisdiction, known as Stranded, are left to wander through Sera's charred ruins.

the danger of this world are that humanity was never really at peace, it was more short period of calm between conflict this led to a complexe political situation where no sides is innocent and all of them under threat of extinction. adding to that is the dangerous substance called Imulsion, once believed by the habitant of sera as a miracle fuel was in fact a fungus based parasitic lifeform capable of overtaking other life form and rapid evolution under any form of stress, like being harvested and used as fuel by an entire civilisation.

objects.title: frostpunk
objects.text:
this world is set an alternate history of earth in the late 19th century, in which humanity must build and maintain a city during a worldwide volcanic winter, managing resources, making choices on how to survive, and exploring the area outside their city for survivors, resources, or other useful items. 

when you arrive humanity is still coming to term with their world changing for the worst and of the things they have lost. that the way of old are not viable anymore, they are scarred, unsure but also often too prideful considering their present situation. clueless of said newfound situation as desperate survivor in an era of strife they can and will learn and adapt but sadly they can also quickly go too far in seeking a stay from desperation and  commit atrocities when seeking control or even in blind faith.

in this world the environment is a constant threat yes and it is just the beginning of the storm, but the true danger come from the survivors and what they might do if they become hopeless and desperate, beware for they are very much still capable of greed, arrogance and should you cuddle them too much they will fall to old instinct of greed, nepotism and many traits common to the "enterprising" peoples of the 19th century of your world especially if they had a certain "statut" and standard of living in the past for better or worst. in short, beware the lords and criminal of the previous society.

objects.title: borderland
objects.text:
the world of borderland is set mainly set on Pandora, a planet with a lot of history  but the gist of it is that an alien species -the eridian- sealed away a threat to all life there -the destroyer- and went extinct to do it. now humanity -more precisely corporation- discovered the planet and started to exploit it while looking for alien tech vaults and caches.  

the problem is that they fought each other a lot got wrecked by each other and circumstance and have now mostly lost control of the planet. left behind are a lot of settlers, worker and their families now stuck on world along with the literal army of prisoners they had used as basically slaves in their labor camp that have now turned to banditisme of the most violent sort. said world is also kept hidden to most of humanity so as to keep buying the alien item those stranded on Pandora unearth for cheap and prevent further corporation to come to Pandora.

the danger here is both the destroyer -think Cthulhu- but it is a contained threat already unless some fool release it. ironically the second threat is what is most likely to set of the firs, the corporation holding the planet of Pandora, even if you somehow deal with the force of the corrupt corporation present on Pandora they still have entire worlds under their ownership and much more forces all over the galaxy. off course the bandits and treasure hunter are also going to try and either kill you for any possible reason they can come up with for the first and will try to open the vault holding the destroyer in search of a big payday.

objects.title: R.W.B.Y
objects.text:
the world of R.W.B.Y or rather Remnant, is composed of four kingdoms and are under constant assault by malevolent monsters known as the "Creatures of Grimm". the present state of the world came to be  after the two deities overseeing it, the God of Light and the God of Darkness obliterated the original human due to the actions of Salem, a vengeful woman cursed with immortality for trying to manipulate them into reviving her beloved Ozma. Ozma was subsequently reincarnated by the Gods to guide a new human race toward harmony and after succeeding, summon the gods back for judgement using four relics, leading to an endless conflict between him and Salem, as she believes that the gods' final judgement is the only way she can die. 

let me begin this by warning you that the two gods of remnant are neither good or evil, they are both neutral they do not care for humanity as more than a curiosity or experiment and are hardly worthy of worship considering they destroyed the previous human because of one grieving widow pissing them off. 

while the grim are dangerous and while human society is afflicted with racism and societal issues and a dark sorceress is plotting in the background the most worrisome aspect of this world is the very trigger happy gods that intend to bring something called "the final judgement." to a race they already obliterated once.

objects.title: blood C
objects.text:
in this world humanity is not the dominant race, instead a race called "elder bairns" or "old ones" feed solely on humans and "normally" lack any empathy for human -wink, wink- in this world humanity tried to initiate dialogue (a first.) with old one and where dismissed by the old one who saw them as nothing but food. somehow, humanity successfully established a contract with the old ones where they could feed on human freely only within a certain place and time.

recently something has happened in said place and the "peace" between human and old one is getting unstable as peoples and old one are plotting something around a young girl called Saya Kisaragi.

this world threat is in the unknown for the most part, from what i gathered the old one numbers have plummeted recently but as they are hidden from society and are capable of crossbreeding with human as well as varie wildly in term of abilities they could easily resurge should the contract that  limited their interaction with humanity were to be broken. also while most old ones are evil there can be exceptions just like most human fear and despise old ones but their are exceptions that wish to "ascend" to their statut for one reason or another, those humans that seek to become old ones should probably be your main concern.

objects.title: the boys
objects.text:
The Boys is a world set on an alternat earth where super-powered individuals are recognized as heroes by the general public and work for a powerful corporation known as Vought International, which markets and monetizes them. Outside of their heroic personas, most are arrogant, selfish, corrupt and often time sadistic.

in this world the danger come from both the super-powered individuals but also that most of human society is convinced they are the good guys and will see you as the villain if you try to fight them without first revealing the truth but doing so will be hard with Vought' PR machine backing them up and the general risk involved with pushing peoples with super powers and an ego feel threatened and helpless.

objects.title: x-men days of future pasts
objects.text:
on an alternate earth in the distant future of 2023 (lol), Sentinel robots hunt and kill mutants, as well as humans who either possess the genetic potential to have mutant offspring or try to protect them. most of the mutant and meta human in general have either been killed or imprisoned into concentration camp, first by the state aligned hero who thought the containment of the mutant would be temporary until they were registered and then by the sentinel when those hero team realized the truth and tried to stop the atrocities from happening, they are now amongst the mutant, as in dead or imprisoned. 

this world is very much so a "fight the nazie 2.0" the criteria have changed but the intent and mean are the same, to bring a cast of peoples to extinction and they are very close to succeeding. there are hundred of thousand of sentinel all capable of adapting to almost all threat and power after a few second of exposure and unless you can out-adapt them you will be swarmed, overwhelmed and overpowered.

objects.title: arcane
objects.text:
this choice' world is actually called runterra, Runeterra currently consists of  The Void and three realms of existence: the Celestial realm of Targon and space as a whole. the spiritual realm of Bandle City, Marus Omegnum and the Death Realm, and finally the Physical realm is the actual planet of Runeterra. The Void is the unknowable nothingness outside of existence which interacts with it through the Watchers and Voidborn.

this world house gods and undead and dragon and so much more it is filled with cosmic being of untold powers and incomprehensible nature; the only reason it is not higher on the list is that for every powerful being of pure evil that exist there a good one also exist of equal power, the world if runeterra is not defenseless and without hero and legends willing and capable to fight against oblivion and the void for it. 

if you go there have no doubt that you will find many allies -some being literal gods- along every enemies you make, and that the option of working with them is the only thing that stop this world from being a tier 5 world and as such not really optional.

the dangers of this world are too many to count and tell about but if you must keep some in mind above all others its to be wary of the void and the black mist.  remember that in this world there is no limit to what one can accomplish if he or she really try.

objects.title: Tier four
objects.text:
those worlds generally have at least three or more of:

-galactic and society wide catastrophe.
-almost hopeless level of risks.
-most of the land and population affected or responsible and unwilling to change.
-existential threat has crushed the natives resistance in most cases. 
-none of the very few and small area free of grimdark-ness to retreat to are truly safe.
-multiples safeguards are pretty much required.

in all those worlds you will land there one week before an in world event you can name in a safe place within a 100 km of a person of your choice. the person must have been born before the event chosen. but never more than a week before the the catalyst events that turned those worlds dark happened. where in those 100km is up to you, you can pop right on top or at the very edge

objects.title: berserk
objects.text:
berserk, from its very Beginning it split into two worlds, the Astral world and the “real” world, this two mutually influence each others; humans in the terrestrial world creates entities and creature in the Astral, these creature can go on the real world for better and worst (mostly worst.) and from the Astral world it is possible to manipulate  the sovereign realities through the “Flow of Causality” or “Karma”.
 
Humankind start to desire a reason behind the suffering and evil in the world so within the astral world a god is created, maybe a previous one just assuming form, the name of this God, unknown by humans is “the Hearth Evil” or the "Idea of Evil".

This god now divide the afterlife of the dead according to their karma and for some sort of contrappasso The "Idea of Evil" starts manipulating the flow of causality to give humankind the suffering they subconsciously want, he also creates the beherits.

The Beings created by using beherits, unlike normal humans, can act by their own free will and break from the flow of karma, some beings created by using special beherits, the crimson ones, also known as the Eggs of the King, become something more, they become Members of the Hand of God, while the one created with normal beherits are just Apostles of the Hand of God. Like Archdemons and demons. The Members of the Hand of God, as the name suggest acts accordingly to the Will of the "Idea of Evil", bringing on his plan for the humanity (and all the suffering). They still have free will, but it coincide with the Will of God himself. 

People like "Guts" or the "Skull Knight" are the embodiment of humanity's will to survive, as they are the will of humankind to preserve itself from the will of god they could be called strugglers. So the destiny of mankind is bestowed on the clash between the Strugglers and the Hand/apostles. If the first ones prevail there will be true Free Will. If not then humankind is destined to live in a utopian world ( in the afterlife after untold amount of suffering and death), as the humans desire (so the idea of evil makes it true, through suffering, as it's earned), but without true free will.

this world not being a tier 5 was a close thing, you will find little help in this world worth having and the power disparity between the good and evil peoples here is tremendous. worst yet, without some safeguard the "flow of causality" and "god" will try to suppress your free will at every step. in addition if god's chosen decide to paint you as a false idol or a temping demon the mass could very well turn against you.

objects.title: the matrix
objects.text:
in this world the real world has been taken over by sentient and sapient AI and machine once wrongfully threated by humanity. they ended up fighting back and won but became twisted in the process.

The matrix is a big computer program made by the machines that simulate the earth of old before the war ravaged it. The machines clone humans to make endless fields of human batteries to power themselves and the matrix. they keep their minds in the matrix program to keep their bodies healthy. None of the humans have any idea what is actually going on except the ones in the safe haven called Zion or at least they think so.

in truth the matrix is unstable because some portion of human subjects perceive that they are in a simulation and rebel. One group of machines (led by the Architect) believes that the matrix can only be stable if humans are unaware of what it is. Another group of machines (led by the Oracle) believes that the matrix can't be stable unless humans living in it are fully aware of what it is. The Architect's group uses three safeguards to preserve the matrix's stability:

The first is Zion - a machine-controlled space where human rebels can "escape" to. The problem is that the matrix becomes less stable as more humans rebel against it.

The second is a group of semi-sapient programs called "agents" who eliminate threats to the matrix's security. The problem with the agents is that they can become self-aware and rebel against machine control.

When human rebel/agent interaction hits an unsustainable point, the machines introduce a machine construct called "the one" who acts like a reset button for the whole matrix. Starting the new cycle of humans being freed from the machines and starting a war against them.

The cycle keeps repeating indefinitely.

so, this world is a mess and should you appear there it would be instant "game over" since technically no one is free and the entire world is already under control of a less than nice army of AI. i strongly recommend you take safeguard to deal with this world and warn you against going to this world if you didn't go for "long journey" and traveled to a few easier world since appearing alone and unprepared or trained surrounded by endless machines with not a second to react before being swarmed will be an instant "game over".

objects.title: terminator skynet victorious
objects.text:
in this world the coming of Skynet, an artificial intelligence system that sparked a nuclear holocaust. successfully killed Sarah Connor in the past preventing the birth of son who would have led the fight against her. With the virtually unstoppable AI now in total control humanity's remnant are living in small nomade groups of a few tens hiding from the horde killing machine of Skynet. 

this world is still irradiated and is largely ravaged and occupied by Skynet and while Skynet army is not all encompassing yet it is getting there fast. if you stay hidden and lowkey you will be relatively safe for a time but Skynet will notice any large concentration of peoples or sign of civilisation pretty much instantly as well as any conventional technologie. in addition unless you can somehow deal with her ability to time travel she will be virtually unbeatable. some safeguards are as such both recommended and necessary.

objects.title: neon genesis evengelion
objects.text:
at the turn of the 20th century this world endured something called "the second impact". The Second impact was the second of three major events taking place on Earth as a result of intervention by the "First Ancestral Race". The event took place as a result of the Contact Experiment conducted on Adam by the Katsuragi Expedition, led by Dr. Katsuragi. The experiment reawakened Adam an alien entity, generating an explosion that melted the Antarctic ice caps and shifted the Earth's axis. The scientists subdued Adam, but they were only successful in limiting the damage and averting humanity's complete extinction. The resulting sea level rise, tsunamis, and armed conflicts eventually wiped out half of the human population, and had massive geopolitical implications for the nations of the Earth.

now "angels" are coming to earth in an attempt to complete what the second impact started and set off a third impact by reclaiming their predecessor remnant. doing so would allow the successful angel to ascend as a singular godly being instead of the many individual but weak humans. the human are trying to stop them by using Eva, giant artificial angel created through science and containing the soul of a human.

in this world both angels and the human at the for front of angels study and Eva creation are trying to end the human race, said human a man named katsuragi intend to make the Eva 01 containing his late wife soul ascend using their son as a catalyst.

this world stand on the brink, the angel are powerful and vary wildly in abilities and tactics but all are absolutely colossal and largely immun to most form of harm if it wasn't enough the angel and human are but two of the seven race created by the first ancestral races before they died out and their soul -one of the core aspect of their technology- reincarnated amongst said 7 races, the goals, intent and nature of the other 5 races and the reincarnated members of the first ancestral races remain unknown. it is in your best interest to have safeguards against the almost guaranteed instant death another impact would induce.

objects.title: doom eternal
objects.text:
hell and heaven here are hyper advanced races created by "the father" the creation god of this world. davoth was his first deliberate creation and an immortal, the father then created jekkad and filled it with a mortal race that davoch was charged to lead to greatness. in the end thought davoth rebelled against the father trying to grant his peoples immortality and him and jekkad ended up being sealed away by the father the later devolving into what would be called hell in their eternal pursuit of immortality and the first becoming the dark lord of hell.

heaven was the first creation of the father but mostly accidental and was called urdak, although Urdak appears of an angelic origin, it's still a technologically-driven domain. the Maykrs its inhabitant, are all immortal but without the stabilizing influence of the Father they inevitably succumb to a state of mental and physical decay known as "Transfiguration". With the Father's influence, this would simply result in a voluntary death and rebirth. But without the Father, the Maykrs instead took to holding back Transfiguration with the rejuvenating power of Argent Energy, an energy they harvest from hell. 

this world already has something of a savior -the doom slayer- but its more of an avenger. the demon will try to kill you with endless tide of monsters, the angel will try to kill you with impossibly advanced technology and the human champion might try to kill you with sheer brutality alone. you will hardly find anywhere safe to retreat to and there's three godly being around, the father, the dark lord and the doom slayer. also a lot of technology here are memetic hazard and affect the soul so without safeguards some threats can and will hard counter you.

objects.title: gundam iron blooded orphan
objects.text:
in this world the human galactic civilisation entered a "minor" dark age after a cosmic war happened 3000 years ago, rampant use of chemical weapon, WMD and murdering AI sent humanity spiraling into feudalism in space and nowadays earth nobility rule the rest of the system like colonies while the time of scientific progress and hope are over. 

it is clearest how low this world as fallen in how children are treated, as mere "human debris" sold and bought as slaves to be used as cheap workforce and disposable tools. the world is rotting and falling apart and any attempt by the rare good peoples still trying to build a better tomorrow are snuffed out and targeted by the worms that feed on it. 

this world is filled with young victims that cannot fathom a different life, they have learned to face hope with cynicism and take pride in being "worthless".
to see a pointless death as such a given for them that dying for a purpose is somehow something to strive for. it will be really hard to not just change the way they are treated but also the way they see themselves and that's if you can make your way through the forgotten danger left all over the place by the war, many of those can not only be  a threat on their own but also be used by the forces that would stop you from fixing this world in the way of greed, pettiness or being downright evil.

objects.title: armored core 6
objects.text:
in the distant future on the frontier planet Rubicon 3, a substance dubbed Coral is discovered. Hailed as the key to human advancement, the Coral instead triggered the "Fires of Ibis", an explosion which burned the whole star system and contaminated the planet. While originally thought lost, Coral is rediscovered on Rubicon 3 fifty years later, along with survivors of the Fires of Ibis. 

The planet is now a battleground between the Planetary Closure Administration which is isolating the contaminated planet, multiple megacorporation seeking to exploit the Coral and the planet's human survivors who have formed the Rubicon Liberation Front. 

the Coral is actually sentient, and its expansion towards a "Coral Release" caused the Institute to trigger try and burn it all -making this attempted genocide- and setting off the Fires of Ibis. the survivor of the institute are now called the Overseer and seek to finish what they have started and burn the coral once more. 

in this world money, technology and willpower from least to most are the decisive factor of any endeavor. in this world the poor, the ignorant and the weak are culled like insect and to be free of this fate is to sell out your humanity, soul and body to corporations and fight their wars for profit.

if you would challenge them be aware that in this world scale as gone rampant, the smallest machine of war that hold any sway in battle is 12 meter tall and move at speed in excesses of mach one in burst and mach 3 to 5 at top speed. Entire complexe are built to fit those sizes and speed, forming colossal structure impossible to traverse on foot and consuming entire worlds worth of ressources those same machine are built and deployed in hundreds of thousand all over the galaxy along with other weapons that dwarf them by a hundred or even a thousand time and more. city can fly and moon are crafted. in this world one cannot hope to fight and win outside of a cockpit, neither can you.

objects.title: helldivers 2
objects.text:
in this world humanity is thriving, on papers at least, in truth it actually is a dictatorial fasciste government where the tyrants hide behind "managed democracy." put it simply instead of peoples actually voting for what they want the "system" vote for what they need, need as in what the state want to do and have peoples obey, hence the quote: "Managed democracy offers absolute freedom; freedom from the burden of choice".

the truly terrifying aspect of this world is that the omnipresent conditioning and propaganda as well as generation of brainwashing allow this system to be blatantly straightforward and transparent about what it is actually doing to the point that even a passing glance from anyone not under said conditioning and brainwashing realize the truth instantly yet the super earth citizen don't and can't reconcile with the facts anymore and instead subconsciously twist reality to fit the narrative that was nailed into their mind from birth.. those who somehow break the brainwashing are left so disconnected with reality and unaware and uneducated of how to deal with having freewill they are immediately noticed and eliminated.  

if super earth and humanity as a whole being a dystopia of a society in the most orderly yet terrible form its neighbors are hardly better, an army of hive minded, hyper evolutive bugs who are maybe sapient. murderous rampant artificial intelligence hellbent on human extermination for as revenge for what happened to their creator the cyborg.

in a way this world doesn't want to be fixed because it is filled with peoples persuaded to be doing great and "love" their terrible lives, in fact most of them happily die in endless conflict and are envied for it. you would be trying to save an entire civilisation of abuse victims with Stockholm syndrome and sociopathic issues. a great deal of them being prone to extreme lethal violence and being supported by a colossal industry of war that consider  overkill and martyrdom as its one and only doctrine and you need to save them while not letting the front line collapse and see humanity be destroyed by the two other threat that surround them. if it wasn't enough an advanced alien race called the illuminate ara making recurring incursion on super earth territories to kidnap humans for some unknown purpose.

objects.title: transformers war of cybertron
objects.text:
set on the planet Cybertron, a biomechanical planet, its inhabitant are giant being called Cybertronian or transformers by other races. Robotic in nature, each Transformer has the ability to transform -hence the name- from their robot mode to an alternate form, usually a vehicle, such as a tank or jet. The Transformers are engaged in total civil war with one another, with two factions emerging: the Decepticons, a splinter group led by the powerful and ruthless Megatron, who seeks to conquer Cybertron to force a regime change, perceiving the current leadership as weak and corrupt and the Autobots, who follow the command of Zeta Prime and seek to put an end to Megatron's revolution and restore peace and order to Cybertron.  

now to make things clear the deception did not start evil and the autobots are not the good guy, in truth the decepticon are made up primarily of the lower cast of cybertron called the "cold forged" cybertronian that were denied the right to be born naturally and were instead incarnated into mass produced body intended for unhealthy dangerous work as in working into mines, a fate they had no say about. worse they were starved and left without care for their wounds or relief from  diseases and treated like slaves. 
any attempt to oppose the leadership saw them condemned to things like "ampurata", the removal and replacement of their hands by primitive pincer claw and their heads by a dehumanizing camera like head.

the middle and high class cybertonian enjoyed the level of confort they did by exploiting the cold forged and when said cold forged united around megatron a gladiator -the cybertronian spartacus.- they panicked and started repressing them violently. when a senator called shockwave tried to lead reform and progressism on cybertron he was subjected to ampurata but also shadowplay, a procedure who cripple a cybertronian ability to feel emotion. after many more such instance of cruel attempt at silencing their cries for reform the decepticon have turned violent and vengeful losing their moral high ground for more victory on the field of battle through sheer viciousness. as i said the autobots are not the good guy and the decepticon weren't always the bad ones but in then end if you look through both you will find somethings worth saving.

in the end the inhabitant if this world have centuries of bad blood, they are facing a rapid exhaustion of all vital ressources for their survival, the collapse of most of their civilisation saw them enter a technological dark age and the death of almost their entire population after the tremendous attrition rates their war inflicted leave them scarily close to extinction. if it wasn't enough cybertron is dying after the rampant mining damaged it greatly and its evil counterpart unicron  -yes an evil planet- , is now pretty much unchallenged should it return and awaken to fulfil its goal of consuming all of creation.

objects.title: vampire hunter D
objects.text:
in this world humanity had a nuclear apocalypse and Vampires who lived underground at the time decided to rise up and take over humanity after the nuclear fallout. During this time they advanced technology by a large margin (terraforming the Earth after the nuclear disaster) from gene splicing animals into fantasy monsters (Krakens, Basilisks, etc.), to robotic flying fortresses/giants, weather controlling, to even space travel.
