However, during all these technological advances humanity kept consistently rebelling and although they were constantly put down, eventually this dwindled the vampires numbers. This brought about the near extinction of vampires when aliens showed up and started destroying the earth. vampires ended up pushing back the alien invaders at a huge cost to their numbers. The few survivors left split into 3 groups, one group opting to go back underground and hopefully awaken to a better future, the other continuing what they were doing above ground (although futile at this point), and the final group choosing space travel to find another planet to live on. All that happened over the course of ten thousand years. Humans are now dominated by a few vampires who keep armies of werewolves and mutants to protect them. 

the wild array of technology of up to space age level and powerful magic present in this universe make it a nightmare to deal with. the danger can spike instantly and express itself in unpredictable way and even if you deal with the vampires overlords it won't reverse the damage earth suffered or deal with the literal armies of  bioengineered creatures now populating the planet. even worst while the alien threat was pushed back and a group of vampires left for space, the alien weren't actually beaten and the vampires  that left for space ran away not pursued, so at any time the alien can come back to try and finish the job or the space vampires might grow to be a threat in the future (can't believe i said that.).

objects.title: diablo
objects.text:
The Diablo world involves angels, demons, super humans, giant spiders, world-bearing dragons, an earth that shouldn't rightly exist, necromancy, shape shifting druids, maddened kings, and warring nations. getting lost in it can be easy so to keep it brief, a god called Anu tried to discard all the evil within itself but instead created the primal evil called Tathamet, they killed each other and while the body of Anu created the high heavens and the angels the body of Tathamet created the burning hells and the demons. those two race would fight for the artefact called the "Eye of Anu" or "Heart of Creation"  or "Heart of the World", an artefact that can create anything  even worlds, the seemingly endless war lasted until a new faction of united demons and angels led by Lilith and Inarius respectively decided to stop fighting take the world stone and make a new world where they could live in peace, this world would be named sanctuary and become home of the hybrid of angel and demon called Nehalem a race stronger than either demons or angels. 

the "traditionalist" angel and  demon learned of this and set out to destroy sanctuary. a lot of conflicts and betrayal and Lilith and Inarius broke up, the nephalem were reduced to mortal human and the worldstone was broken. now sanctuary is the unwilling battleground of the war between heaven and hell and humanity part of the collateral damages.

this world is filled with very powerful beings and they all have conceptual powers at their hooftip. the soul is a well known well studied aspect for them and even death is not a guarantee of either escape for their victimes or dispatching of threats. also worldstone shards are  now laying all over sanctuary and who know what they could be used for.

objects.title: Justice League Dark Apokolips War
objects.text:
in this reality the heroes of the justice league have lost everything but a sad pyric victory and all hope is dead. what few remain is awaiting the end after apokolips drained the very planet molten core leaving a slowly dying  world. 

Darkseid the new god of Tyranny and ruler of apokolips, conquered and ruined this world and one of the last hero is set to reset this world's timeline, but the mean to do so will cause butterfly across the entire timeline of this world. if everything is different and everyone changed was this world and its inhabitants truly saved? 

if you choose to go there you will need to give those broken heroes hope once more and convince them not to erase everything in a desperate gamble, by not just giving them a future but also to retrieve all that they loved and was taken from them.  seek out death herself and convince her to restore all those Darkseid's madness killed or seek every heavens and hells and retrieve them, while also finding a way to save earth in the week of time you have left.

beware that even now while earth is dying and its inhabitant stand days close of extinction, others powers may come and threaten it yet again.

objects.title: Tier five
objects.text:
those worlds generally have at least three or more of:

-multi-dimensional and civilisation wide apocalypse.
-hopeless level of risks beyond comprehension.
-the civilisation and population affected and responsible are actively evil.
-evil existential threat has already won and is now ruling supreme. 
-nowhere to run, nowhere to hide, the grimdark-ness is ever-present.

in all those worlds you will land there one week before an in world event you can name in a safe place within a 100 km of a person of your choice. the person must have been born before the event chosen. where in those 100km is up to you, you can pop right on top or at the very edge.

you also appear at a set time within the world events due to the world sheer metaphysical grim-darkness treating any hope your arrival would represent as anathema.

objects.title: mahou shouji madoka magica
objects.text:
"if you ever feel like dying to help the universe, just let me know. i'll be waiting. -Kyubey an incubator."

"our contract are completely dependent upon you agreeing to them first. i think that, in and of itself is quite kind of us. -Kyubey an incubator."

"why is it that when human regret decision based on a misunderstanding they feel resentment toward the other party. -Kyubey an incubator. -Kyubey an incubator."

"in our culture, the phenomena known as emotion is considered a mental disorder. -Kyubey an incubator."

This world story follows a group of middle school girls, led by young Madoka Kaname. those girls made supernatural contracts in exchange of a wish with almost omnipotent beings called incubators. In exchange for this wish they had to become " Puella Magi" or "magical girls" and battle surreal enemies known as "witches".

they would then learn of the anguish and peril associated with their new roles, their body is just a container possessed by their soul. the incubators creates a magical girl by removing this soul and placing it into an external container called the Soul Gem. As their souls are now within these gems, Darkness spreads into a Soul gem turning it into a grief seed when a Magical Girl uses their powers, or experiences despair and similar negative emotions. Although a slayed witch's Grief Seed can be used to reduce this corruption, it is inevitable that a Soul Gem will be fully corrupted and transition into another Grief Seed. The affected magical girl will then transform permanently into a witch. 

As for why the incubators drive this cycle of corruption and tragic death, its so they can harvest a energy excepted from entropy meaning it is not consumed when used merely temporarily inert. this energy is produced from the process of a Puella Magi soul falling to darkness and transforming into a witch and of the witch using its power hence the incubator desire for the Puella Magi to hunt the witch.

This energy is what allow them to grant reality defying wish of untold scale instantly on a seeming whim, the only limit they have is how much they can invest at a time hence why they seek out more.  

this world is a tricky one, the incubator are thoroughly in control and have almost mastered all form of reality warping through both scientific and magical mean from the soul to dimension creation to even time.

you will land there 1 week before Kyubey contact Madoka Kaname, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a week before Madoka Kaname become a puella magi.

objects.title: worm: earth bet.
objects.text:
“I keep on asking myself the same questions over and over again,” she said.  “Maybe you can answer.  Was it worth it?“

I stared down at my hand.  It was shaking, but it wasn’t from fear.

“Would you do it all over again?  Knowing what you know now?  Knowing that you end up here, at gunpoint?“

“I… know I’m supposed to say yes,” the words made their way past my lips.  “But no.  Some-somewhere along way, it became no.”

“Just about everyone comes to this crossroad,” she said.  “Some get seventy years, some only get fifteen.  Enough time to grow, to take stock of who you are.  Enough time to do things you’ll regret when you run out of time.”

“Don’t- don’t regret it.  Was- had to.  Saved lives.  But I would do different, given a chance.”

She smiled, bobbing her head up and down a little.  “It’s always about the people, isn’t it?”

“Protect some, pay less attention to others.”

Her smile twisted.  A little sad.  “Can’t bet on the wrong horse.”

Not what I’d meant.  “Giving too much power to wrong people.  To bullies.  With powers, bullies without.”

-the last words of Contessa-Fortuna and Khepri-Weaver-Skitter-Taylor.
 
in this world multiple universe are threatened by entities that parasite civilisation on a multiverse wide scale, they grant powers to the broken and desperate, their hosts forever marked and twisted by a "trigger event" inevitably lash out while the parasites ramp up their aggression and need for conflict, twisting their mind and bodies in cruel experiments, watching and learning as the world of  their hosts and victimes crumble into anarchy and chaos. those being are Colonial organisms composed of many physically connected, interdependent individuals called shards, each one the size of a continent and all spread out and hidden into inhospitable dimension. 

to hunt and kill them is not enough you must slay the primary entity called zion the warrior, his deceitful projection parading around a earth called "earth bet" playing hero in a bid to distract itself from the recent ego death of its partners. if it wasn't enough a secret organisation know this truth and is preparing themselves to fight zion but are already compromised by the very shards they rely on and their lack of knowledge about the entities true nature and inner working. 

to save this world and all other alternate of it would be in truth a veritable miracle, to work with parahumans -the name given to shard host- is as dangerous as thrusting a mentally unstable, compromised and highly confrontational individual sounds like, that is to say extremely dangerous. if you want to try anyway know that no parahuman power can truly harm Zion if he take the situation seriously since he has access to a superior version of every power on earth bet and every other alternate earth at the same time with no limitation including highly effective method of precognition. 

you will land there 1 week before Taylor Hebert go out for the first time as a vigilant hero, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a week before Taylor Hebert "gain" her power.

objects.title: dead space
objects.text:
"i remember telling  my college professor i wanted to study xenoarchaeology. he laughed right in my face. there's nothing to study, he said. its all dead space. no alien life exist out in the universe. in a way he was right there is no life beyond our system, only a trail of extinction, wrought by the moons. and its right on our doorstep."

in this world many species across the cosmos have been consumed by the being known as the Necromorph, each genocide birthing a brethren moon, the amalgamation of all the dead bodies of their victims and their shattered homeworld. 

those abomination now seek a new word and race to consume and you my chosen, are their only hope for their world is already infested and even if the parasite is purged from their own, entire moons are making their way to feast on their latest targets. 

their will be no reasoning with the Necromorph for they are born and strive out of death. erase them an grant their hosts the mercy of a peaceful rest.

you will land there 1 week before the markers start corrupting humanity physically, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a before before the Necromorphe first begin appearing and rampaging within the sol system.

objects.title: elden ring
objects.text:
"The fallen leaves tell a story.
The great Elden Ring was shattered.
In our home, across the fog, the Lands Between.
Now, Queen Marika the Eternal is nowhere to be found,
and in the Night of the Black Knives, Godwyn the Golden was the first to perish.
Soon, Marika's offspring, demigods all, claimed the shards of the Elden Ring.
The mad taint of their newfound strength triggered the Shattering.
A war from which no lord arose.
A war leading to abandonment by the Greater Will.
Arise now, ye Tarnished.
Ye dead, who yet live.
The call of long-lost grace speaks to us all.
Hoarah Loux, chieftan of the badlands.
The ever-brilliant Goldmask.
Fia, the Deathbed Companion.
The loathsome Dung Eater.
And Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-knowing.
And one other. Whom grace would again bless.
A Tarnished of no renown.
Cross the fog, to the Lands Between.
To stand before the Elden Ring.
And become the Elden Lord."

in this world the law of reality are tied to the elden ring, marika the holder of the elden ring shaterred said ring and sending the world's god and other "profane" factions as well as "outer gods" into total war over the pieces of the elden ring. 

Now the war is over and the world is just as broken as the world and the total war as devolved into sporadic conflict between the weakened remains of those who fought it.

If that wasn't enough the thing that created the elden ring the "greater will" lurk in the background trying to see its vision of total order for land between.

you will land there 1 week before the tarnished supposed to become elden lord leave the stranded graveyard, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a week before a "lowly" Tarnished leave is cave and begin is quest.

objects.title: bloodborn
objects.text:
"We are born by the blood, made men by the blood, undone by the blood. Fear the old blood."

a mess of layered broken realities and civilisation piled onto each other and infested by the remnant of eldritch entities and the twisted remain of the fools and cursed victim of their greed and arrogance. 

to break the cycle will be no easy task my chosen for the force that ruined this world are still here and the madness they spawn in those who behold them is insidious and deadly. 

spilled blood started this maddening decent into insanity, it will be up to you to prevent more spilled blood to put the final nail in this world coffin.

you will land there 1 week before a traveler is treated through blood ministration and join the hunters, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a week before a stranger arrive to Yharnam for blood ministration.

objects.title: dark soul (3)
objects.text:
"In the Age of Ancients the world was unformed, shrouded by fog. A land of gray crags, Archtrees and Everlasting Dragons. But then there was Fire and with fire came disparity. Heat and cold, life and death, and of course, light and dark. Then from the dark, They came, and found the Souls of Lords within the flame. Nito, the First of the Dead, The Witch of Izalith and her Daughters of Chaos, Gwyn, the Lord of Sunlight, and his faithful knights. And the Furtive Pygmy, so easily forgotten. With the strength of Lords, they challenged the Dragons. Gwyn's mighty bolts peeled apart their stone scales. The Witches weaved great firestorms. Nito unleashed a miasma of death and disease. And Seath the Scaleless betrayed his own, and the Dragons were no more. Thus began the Age of Fire. But soon the flames will fade and only Dark will remain. Even now there are only embers, and man sees not light, but only endless nights. And amongst the living are seen, carriers of the accursed Darksign."

a world dying, its light spent not in a blaze of glory but a unsightly whimper and the petering of old flames. 

it is and was for a long time now maintained by burning whatever of value and worth it had for fuel time after time and so little remain now to burn to stretch out its hollow existence

yet what else can they do, when the choices are a slow empty death and a new age of darkness? 

you can give them hope my chosen, you can guide them to a new future but beware, this world inhabitants are used to having to take what they need or be left wanting and your soul, empowered by my blessings and untouched by the decay of this world is such an alluring prize to those poor wretched souls.

you will land there 1 week before a special undead set off from the asylum in a bid to rekindling the flame, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a week before a patient at the undead asylum is let out by a desperate knight.

objects.title: Warhammer 40k
objects.text:
"It is the 41st Millennium. For more than a hundred centuries The Emperor has sat immobile on the Golden Throne of Earth. He is the Master of Mankind by the will of the gods, and master of a million worlds by the might of his inexhaustible armies. He is a rotting carcass writhing invisibly with power from the Dark Age of Technology. He is the Carrion Lord of the Imperium for whom a thousand souls are sacrificed every day, so that he may never truly die.

Yet even in his deathless state, the Emperor continues his eternal vigilance. Mighty battlefleets cross the daemon-infested miasma of the Warp, the only route between distant stars, their way lit by the Astronomican, the psychic manifestation of the Emperor's will. Vast armies give battle in his name on uncounted worlds. Greatest amongst his soldiers are the Adeptus Astartes, the Space Marines, bio-engineered super-warriors. Their comrades in arms are legion: the Imperial Guard and countless planetary defence forces, the ever vigilant Inquisition and the tech-priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus to name only a few. But for all their multitudes, they are barely enough to hold off the ever-present threat from aliens, heretics, mutants - and worse.

To be a man in such times is to be one amongst untold billions. It is to live in the cruelest and most bloody regime imaginable. These are the tales of those times. Forget the power of technology and science, for so much has been forgotten, never to be re-learned. Forget the promise of progress and understanding, for in the grim dark future there is only war. There is no peace amongst the stars, only an eternity of carnage and slaughter, and the laughter of thirsting gods."

the posterchild of all that is grimdark, to challenge this world is in truth utter madness.

still know that i stand with you in this grueling and gruesome pursuit and that should the four chaos gods and their ilk come after you personally, you will have a goddess and her own countless aspects and panthéons at your side.

Have heart my chosen, we will need it.

you will land there 1 week before Cadia face its toughest battle during the 13th crusade, in a safe place within a 100 km of a named person of your choice.

this choice like every other tier five cannot be fulfilled without a lot of safeguards and prior lower tiers of preparation.

you arrive a week before -wait what the, you bucking elf clown don't you dare- what now?! oh piss of you gaudy enthroned husk i don't have time for- who?- oh to Tartarus with you four, and all the other overhyped elemental! 

BY MY POWER OVER ALL STORIES.YOU.WILL.BEND!

*sigh* alright that should do it for now, you will arrive about a week after the fall of cadia during the thirteen crusade, it was the furthest back i could go with all the wanabee gods in the way -never seen such a messy timeline before-. still i did make it impossible for them to interfere with your arrival further and ensured the "Faust chosen one" and any other blessing and world modifiers would work properly.

rows.title: world list
rows.titleText:
the time has come for you to choose a world to go to or worlds, plural. should you engage yourself to go to 5 worlds in a row with only your starting build and items and the same world modification for all of them, change to the items picked here remain and any crew on/in them come along as well.(the content of any pockets space tied to you is included.) i will give you additional points according to whatever world you choose, the more dangerous a world is the more points you will get for choosing it.

you always go from low tier to high tier, the move from one world to another can happen any time you want as soon as you finish "fixing" said world but after 99 years of living in a fixed world i will warn you that you only have one years before compulsory transfer. you can during those 100 years travel between any world you fixed. said world will have by you fixing them fell under my aegis and i will freeze them in time while you are away and will keep doing so until all the world you picked are fixed so you can enjoy the bonds you have formed there at your leisure afterward.  

worlds are organized in 5 tier, the higher the tier the more dangerous/ large scale/ eldritch they are. 

still, i advise you to choose worlds you are familiar with and that you want to help instead of the most "rewarding" ones.

objects.title: Nightmare moon enlightened: the beloved dream
objects.text:
we art nightmare moon, but while many t'ration of our esteem'd self has't descend'd into madness upon being unlov'd we has't risen above caring f'r the loveth of strang'rs.  forsooth we has't learn'd to value our owneth self and to doth and beest as we truly did desire and, seeth and beholdeth our ponies learn'd to loveth us f'r t. we has't learn'd yond to shineth one wilt not dim the whole w'rld but beest confident and honest with their owneth brightness.  
 
mine own task is both simple and complexe at the same timeth, in this w'rld w're mine own oth'r self hath fallen to darkness and yet ruleth triumphant the lady still wasteth hence and languie in loneliness.  instead of having h'r f'rsake h'r dark'r parts and returneth to h'r did reduce luna self as the lady hideth half of h'r being, wend th're and holp h'r agnize, accepteth and bewray h'r true self and to feeleth true loveth f'r who is't the lady is. 
 
accepteth and i shall in advance grant thee the cullionly and knowledge of the dreamscape, with t thee shall beest able to access and int'ract with the weaveth yond connecteth all mind through both dreams and nightmare in a most unique way, one yond bypass all mental defense in exchange f'r f'rgoing any ability to physically harmeth. 
 
shouldst thee faileth and the nightmare moon of this w'rld turneth backeth into luna i expecteth thee to somehow convince and maketh half the w'rld population nocturnal f'r at least three gen'ration to ease h'r loneliness

objects.title: Daybreaker enlightened:  the righteous fury
objects.text:
so you are the latest of mother project? you don't look like much right now,  but mother does know her stuff so lets put you to the test shall we? 

first go in the world where my alternate went mad and fight her. simple and straight to the point right? well not so much, you go there and fight her for as long as she can without actually beating her and instead you fight her until she run out of steam and finally spend her rage in full, beware that as Daybreaker we Celestia are much more "moody" and feel very strongly and while i can assure you that "banter" will be welcome, mind your words unless you want this to turn into either a more lethal encounter... or a carnal one, might go either way honestly.

afterward when she is truly exhausted, whether by fighting or...someway else. she should start to emotionally stabilise, but here is the challenge, you must convince her not to revert from her Daybreaker state and instead embrace and master her full power and the natural "rawness" of emotions that come with it. 

if you fail and she return to being the self restrained and hesitant Celestia, you will have to figure out how to restore the world trust in her once more, convince her to take ruling up again as well as reopen the connexion to the world of the good Sombra and reunite them, fair warning a celestia will feel to guilty, believe herself unworthy and refuse all of those, you have to stay there until you change her mind. 

as for a reward, i will add my own power to your blessings allowing you to choose more amongst mother lists.

objects.title: Queen chrysalis enlightened: the successful seductress
objects.text:
my what have we here? a little morsel on its way to face dark cold worlds out in the omniverse? why you might just need a bit of help from this lovely bedbug isn't it? some safety and comfort to stave of those harsh lonely night in the coming struggles? 

so here is this queen "gift" to you little morsel, i shall grant you a very special spell of my own making one i designed in my grand "conquest" of the world and building my wonderful harem of noble warriors, legendary heroes and immortal royal.(Faust here, she just fucked with everypony important and convinced them that "friendship with benefit" was the ultimate form of friendship.)

Just caress the neck of any one you care about and a collar shall appear around their neck -one that fit their tastes- and as long as they wear this collar they shall benefit from any "safeguard" you possess in addition you will always know where they are and they you, the collar also provide a contraceptive spell that can be turned on and off at the wearer will ~carful with greedy pets~. you can make an infinite number of collars but the wearer can remove it at any time, no third parties can remove them without the wearer permission.

now isn't that a convenient tool? now of cours i do have a little favor to ask of you, surely you understand? 

i want you to go to that world where a younger less creative and more incompetent alternate of my charming self as resorted to base violence to rise to prominence and remind her of why we once opted for a more...subtle and sensual way of getting what we craved. of course by doing so she will be unwilling to leave your side or let you go so i am in fact asking you to "hook up" with "me" in a very convoluted way, but what can i say i know what I'm all about. 

of course i expect you not resort to any form of mind control or Faust forbid brutish force, instead i want you to seduce her and earn her love so...good luck little morsel ~~~~

if you somehow fail and earn my alternate everlasting disdain i expect you to take over the changeling from her and teach them my way of collecting love, using "seduction" and "mutually assured satisfaction." and lead them into becoming the most sought after lover in the world (Faust again, she mean sex and seducing chief of states, also orgies. a lot of orgies.)

objects.title: Sombra enlightened: the king who broke fate
objects.text:
how ironic, i once earned my wings by facing and defeating my worst self and now i have the opportunity to help someone else do the very same, in a way.

I am the wandering king sombra, the ruler of none and yet i know i am loved and respected by all princesses and ponies i now protect. i want you to go to the realm where i failed to deny the umbrum control of my fate and destiny, seek my once and always beloved Radiant Hope and all the alicorn princesses, together convince my other self to cast away his allegiance to the umbum and renounce all the dark power they have given him and then have the princesses and my Hope free him finally of the Umbrum curse turning him into a true pony.

succeed and i shall reward you with a gemstone of my own making, the gem can drain and store dark magic from any beings item it touches or place it goes to, once stored the dark magic is purified and fuel the gemstone growth allowing you to break of pieces that have the same ability to drain and store dark magic, all the gemstones dark magic storage are shared in real time no matter the distance and obstacles. the main gemstone also possess a unique power beyond the purifying of dark magic, the holder can pull on the purified magic and use it to fuel its own spellcasting. 

if you fail and my alternate self still pursue his doomed war i want you to break through his armies and defenses and reach the heart of his kingdom where the crystal empire once stood, once there you must split the very earth beneath and expose the heart of the umbrum infection and purge them of this world freeing my other self and freeing this world of their threat.

objects.title: screwball: the daughter of chaos
objects.text:
heya ~friend~, name's screwball and I'm daddy discord number one priestess, worshipper and faithful ! also maybe his daughter but who can be sure when chaos is at play am i right? anyhow i sneakily sneaked into the old hag study and found out about this whole shebang and got a jolly good idea, instead of fixing the world where daddio got mad and then move on to another, how you instead go for hitting two stone with one bird and take mad daddy out on a wild ride into another world?! you get to unleash some crazy "KAOS" on some Meanies and daddy discord get to let loose "constructively".

TM.
