objects.title: twilight sparkle: the heroin lost in time.
objects.text:
Faust here, this is a bit of a different one here, you see in the world where twilight sparkle was stuck in a loop twilight sparkle was the only one stuck in that loop. what i mean is that twilight sparkle did succeed in resuming time by ripping the loop off the timeline -thus forgetting it even existed as she resumed the normal chain of events- and the twilight still stuck is literally the version of twilight that was stuck in the loop except now there is no timeline to resume, time for her and her world is nothing but one loop of one hour where only her is real, the other are beings there are just soulless échos.

As such this world cannot really be saved the conventional way, instead you if you pick this world you need to find twilight sparkle and convince her of going with you to the next world on your path, sadly twilight sparkle does not know her situation and will neither take it well or even accept it easily and after many years stuck in this state she has developed a rather dismissive and brutal mentality so expect some surprising brutality and apathic vitriol to solve "problem" from her.

if you can do it and convince her to leave i can safely repurpose the loop into a minor time artefact, it will allow you to create a "checkpoint" in time and should you die you will "reload" at that "checkpoint", once set it cannot be undone without being used and cannot be reused into the same amount of time already "reloaded" so if you set the checkpoint and live three years before dying you cannot reset a respawn point for the next three years, any items obtained or personal progress is conserved but items are not duplicated and instead simply disappear from where they were to end up in your possession, no matter the consequence. 

this time artefact can look like any jewelry that can fit in your human palm and is indestructible. 

since you yourself will be in the loop you technically have infinite amount of time until you convince twilight sparkle to follow you so you cannot actually fail this task but any progress you make both physically growth and magically growth are reset every hour so only skill and theoretical knowledge can be trained in her world.

objects.title: Moon dancer: the veteran of the changeling war
objects.text:
alright maggot, i heard from the big mare in the sky that you are set to go to other worlds to solve a whole lot of messes. now i know from personal experiences how much it suck for command to saddle you with extra duties on an already piss poor deployment but i when duty call we  soldiers got to see shit through to the finish line.

now don't worry too much rookie, I'm not leaving you up shit creek without a paddle and if you pick this job up you get my most precious possession, the "medal of honor" an artefact that naturally formed from my own ride through war, the army and a harsh life in general. as long as you wear this old thing anyone you work with will be compelled to retribute any effort you make to do right by them by doing right by you. no more asshole supply officer holding back on you after a well done job just because they can't smell you or anypony in general trying to screw you period in fact. as long as you own this baby and play it straight you'll be golden.

but to get this baby, i need you to go to the world were fancy politician morons are setting the world for this "war to end all war" bullspit and buck their head back on straight, or at least i would have liked to do thing this way, but I'm told it would only ignite the powder keg not really solve the issue so instead why don't you go there and start your own political party i guess. from there make sure the war doesn't become a world war or Faust forbid a war of extermination.

i you fail you are into shit duty for real and i expect you to help with the after war reconstruction effort for at least 10 hours a day, 7 days a week for the next 30 years or the world population is back to what it was or higher than before the war, whatever is longest. with a little luck there will be enough beings left around that you don't have to do all the heavy lifting by yourself including repopulation right?

objects.title: Fluttershy: the wild speaker, chief of the all-tribe.
objects.text:
in my youth my tribes was hunted, many of my family were to hurt to follow and the chief left them to die, many years later i took the title of chief and made the tribe strong, i saw the tribe of predator who hunted us starve to death, too weak to hunt. 

i learned from the pain and with might i gathered all tribes, with kindness i united them. now, the once preys cultivate safely and share both milk, eggs and blood to feed the once predators so that they may fight those who would gorge on all and help us prosper. when the once prey grow old and die they are buried in the fields of the tribe and they stay with the tribe forever more, when the once predators grow old and die they are buried in the field and they stay with the tribe forever more. we live, beyond survival and hunger. we do not embrace cruelty and gluttony's but kindness and respect. 

this world never learned, their minds as grown but the hearts are feeble, instincts still raging while control is lacking. you go and teach, unity, sharing and kindness. make all one tribe.  

the horn of the tribe is the reward, you sound the horn, the simpler beasts now know your voice and you know theirs, you talk and they understand, they answer and you understand. you gain much respect for listening to the beasts and they obey to most demand.

you fail and tribes are divided, prey and predator remain apart, you stay and solve the mess, you find a hundred food both loves and keep healthy and convince all to eat, share and accept. no more blood spilled in hunger for 3 set of 10 winter.

objects.title: Cadenza: the empress in the north
objects.text:
greetings brave soul, i am the crystal empress Mi Amore Cadenza, slayer of the umbrum king sombra and conqueror of chrysalis the queen of the changeling. i was told of your coming journey accros realms to restore light and harmony across the omniverse, to bring and nurture a new hope for love of life to despairing worlds that for too long stood alone with nopony to stand up for them. 

one world remind me of my own and i would offer you my blessing in freeing it from its most terrible flaw, the intolerance and disdain for love of its inhabitant. all the problem of this world stem at their roots from a lack of love, from loveless marriage and jealousy to unrequited love or infidelity or sexism and bigotry.

My quest to you, should you accept it is to spread tolerance for all love for all genders and equality between genders and identities but also a respect for true love and its power of bringing out the best in all of us, be carful to also teach them respect of others right to reject love and seek it out elsewhere and the sanctity of ones own body. 

to assist you in this and future endeavor i give you the "crystal heart" have no fear it is not the original one but instead a perfect reproduction i made personally with Faust assistance. it possess the same power of purging all evil in its presence but more importantly once set into a building it can generate an impenetrable shield and create a corrosive environment to any evil that somehow found their way in. it also fuel the inner goodness of the peoples inside the shield and ensure love, health and prosperity to all who live under its protection. mind you the heart is fragile still so keep it safe. 

if you somehow fail to nurture both tolerance and respect for love in the peoples of Westeros and beyond i want you to form and lead a new order of magical teaching, one that teach the beauty and true potential for good in magic, teach to at least half of a generation. maybe with magic to ease the struggle of life they will have more room in their hearts for love and if you can plant the seeds of this ideal in the next generation it would not hurt either.

objects.title: punkie pie: the edge canter.
objects.text:
name's P, heard you were headed to some shitty place called nightcity? discount neighcity i figured from what Fausty showed me.

anyway i think you can use my experience and some good all street smart from a legend so here's the gig dits,  you go to this "cyberpunk" world and form or take over a crew, once that's done you and your new chooms must become the first edge runners of this world to make it past the finish line all members alive and ready for more. 

Become a living legend and deal with all the consequences of making it big in this world yourself instead of leaving it to others. you can do that either by taking down a major corporation or flatlining a legend like smasher, the important is to make your mark and keep hanging for year to come tall and strong. 

now for the reward, after the gig completion i'll give you my personal databank, in it is all the spec for all the standard cyber ware and bio ware of my world that i used, mind you i used and installed everything at least once  and it also include all the engineer's and reaper's study to both make and install those but they were meant for a earth pony so some are going to need major redésigne of your are a different race, most pony tribe should be fine though. the shard also come with a carry-on net-deck with four chip ware socket so you can read the shard content if you don't have anything better, still its rugged and completely wireless free so no netunner bullshit.

now i can see you looking down on this because you'll have gone through a similar world so obviously you'd already have collected most of this right? well think again gonk, the "cyberpunk" world doesn't have magic does it? well mine does and so the cyber ware and bio ware we got is completely different and far more extensive and varied. here's three clues to motivate you:

-Technorganic Magic.
-Technokinetic Shapeshifting
-technopathy.

i you fail and some of you choom died i want you -and you will too i bet-  to tear a new one to the scav, corpo, gangs, reavers and pretty much every one until the entire world is under your control and then rebuild society nice and proper for the future generation, no compromise no "paperclip" bullshit a blank slate and fair uncompromising justice. afterward finally lead this world to being a true space faring civilisation.

objects.title: rarity: the sinful generosity
objects.text:
my darling you arrived just in time, i was getting a bit bored when her majesty sent for me and told me of her grand project. truly what a noble quest she saddled you with! it will be my honor to contribute. 

in the world of "fullmetal alchemist" -a world similar to mine- i want you to track down all the "sins" and convince them to work for you instead of "father".

To help with this task i give you in advance the artefact that freed me and my friend from a soulless existence to the cruel "grogar, father of monsters".
The artefact is the true "philosopher stone", contrary to local philosopher stone it cannot help with transfiguration and instead it produce the "elixir of life" a  water that heal all physicals ailment but also or replenish local philosopher stone energy stores, more relevant is that it can also grant a "soul" to any sapient being in the form of a "cutie mark". soul in the world of fullmetal alchemist is what allow one to not only use alchemy but would also free "sins" from the terrible compulsion and sanity eroding effect of being "made of sins" of course they will still have a predisposition for them due to their history and lifestyle but trust me, they will feel the difference -and relief- immediately. 

if you somehow fail because one was killed while staying faithful to father till the end i expect you to stay a little longer on this world to rebuild and reorganize the world as well as introduce rights for artificial lifeform, from homonculus to chimera as well as their rights to multiply and populate the world as any other species should.

objects.title: luna: the ice cold general
objects.text:
you are too weak for Faust purpose. its clear as day in my eyes that you lack the force of will and the disciplined strength needed to strike down your foe decisively. 

but it is okay, because you have the heart its proven by you accepting this grand purpose and rising up to the call to arm. as such i shall guide you down the path of strength and domination in battle. 

my help will be a Teigu called Incursio: familiar model. its a dragon made of steel relatively small barely fit for a mount but it is strong and grow stronger with conflict and struggle, it will be bound to you and utterly loyal and focused on your need. It benefit from all the boost and safeguard you have but more importantly it is sapient and sentient, having a custom personality fit to be your best friend and ally.

it will prove invaluable to face the training program i have set for you, i want you to challenge 5 peoples a day to a one on one duel, not to the death but to knock out and personally defeat all the Jaegers and Esdeath in one on one combat. Incursio will prove very useful in keeping third parties and meddlers out of the way while you fight. if by defeating them you convince them into turning coats i will reward you with a copy of any Jaegers Teigu you convinced as well as Esdeath own for you to gift to any ally you have that does not yet have a Teigu, those Teigu are safe to bound to -even demon's extract -and require not compatibility like the local version.

if you somhow fail to face and deafeat each jaegers and esdeath at least once or miss a day of duel i wil expect you to face and defeat the Imperial Guardian: Shikoutazer the ultimate teigu all by yourself with no collateral damage. if you also fail this i expect you to stay and contribute to the reconstruction of the government replacing the empire and be amongst the 10 most influential peoples in the new administration, then using this authority reduce corruption to negligible level for at least 30 years.

objects.title: Littlepipe: the lightbringer
objects.text:
heard you where headed for you own wasteland? when celestia told me her mom wanted to talk to me i admit i was kind of freaked out and a fair bit pissed said mom didn't help but i guess its what having free will and a right to self determination mean, that you have to get shit done yourself even of it painful and end on a tragic bittersweet note. 

still she got rid of spike's flames and made it easier for my friend to come see me and i now know for sure all the peoples i lost are safe in her heaven so there is that.  still she asked me to offer my help to you and i think what you need is a good foundation, as such with my blood magic and faust help
we studied my unique biology and used that to perfect the I.M.P and made a tool to synthesize something called called the template adding race tincture or T.A.R.T.  by collecting a blood sample from a race you can synthesize  a T.A.R.T serum of this race that can when injected allow you to gain and use the perks of this race with no drawbacks. anypony can only have one race's T.A.R.T so chose well, but you can use it for allies you gather. 

as for my job for you it's to create your own faction, one that does not give up the core tennets of harmony, loyalty, kindness, honesty, generosity, humor and magic. try to rebuild the world without crushing the beings that now live in this world and without falling into the societal pitfall that saw the old world burn and fall apart. 
 
if you can't do it before you must move on to the next world you will have to return to it after then end of your travel and stay there until you do but also make the wasteland a Solar punk paradise as well.

objects.title: fluttershy: the brave adventurer
objects.text:
SAVE THEM! oh my i-i am sorry, i mean could you please save the young ones stuck into that horrible place if that's okay with you? i could only gather a hooful of names but if you can save all of them and any other you stumble upon i would be eternally grateful. 

please save the young mitty, vueko, nanachi, Irumyuui, Faputa, Prushka, Sherumi and Menae i beg you. i know some of them will already have faced a terrible fate by the time you arrive so i looked through the artefact i gathered and my contacts and found something that should help if miss Faust confirmation hold true. its called the "Pearl of Transformation" and it allow one to transform themselves and others into a races gaining the new races attributes while losing their previous race's. more importantly it also free one of their previous race flaw and that include the physicals deformity and mental degradation of i believe they are called "Narehate". of course it make turning them back into human impossible but its still an improvement. 

miss Faust also took the time to bless the pearl ensuring the curse of abyss will not be able to jump between form. sadly if the curse strike you again when trying to climb up the new race might also be lost forcing you to transform into a third, don't be reckless and keep the young ones safe or you will run out of option.  

if-if you can't save -please make it not so- i would ask you to find a way to end the abyss curse entirely, i don't know if its possible but please you must try, for all the young ones this horrible curse took so early. 

(Faust here young fluttershy bless her tender heart, was to flustered to also mention that the pearl can be split into parts and reformed so as to be shared and allowing the wearers to change race instantly and rapidly, if you have more than one race you can change into any hybrid form of the same number of races. this transformation lock previous races trait until its resumed and does not grant any traits of the new races.)

objects.title: twilight sparkle: the mare who truly lived.
objects.text:
so,  looking forward to being "the chosen one"? trust me i have been there and its get old fast especially when you somehow get born into it at a time where magic is heavily regulated and somewhat past its heyday. that's actually what took the longest for me to fix back home, making magic a thing of wonders and miracles again.  

anyway the world of "harry potter"  is very similar to mine and magic is dying there too so what i want you to do is to somehow bring magic back to its greatest era and make this world a "high magic world" before you have to leave. if you can't -most likely because of the statut- the next time you go there after finishing you whole journey i want you to stay there and open your own magical school and be such a good headmaster that your students make this world a high magic one, its will be a lot slower and a lot harder but prove way more natural and less jarring for the native.

the moment you succeed I'll give you one of my backup pocket dimension library and all its content as well as an enchanted key to access it using any doorframe, its built as a massive windowless tower of about 7 floor and around a 100 meter in diameter. it contain every compendium to the master level, every guide to mundane and magical crafting to what you would call the 21st century and everything you need to learn and master every skill in the mastery section and more. 

But it also possess a unique enchanted section in the "basement", it is about 200 meter in diameter and three floor high and it can randomly extract and compile an entire world's magical knowledge and store it for use. this enchanted section require a massive amount of magic to do so -if you where an average unicorn with all magical boost you'd need to empty all your magic into it every day for about two month to use it- and the world is totally random aside that it always has some magic. Sometime you get so much new knowledge books flood off the shelves and cover the floor and sometime you get barely enough to fill an afternoon of reading. the book can be copied but only by hooves as the conjured book would be destabilized by even a simple levitation spell. they cannot be removed from the section either and summoning a new selection make them all disappear, getting them again is also purely random.

objects.title: luna: the returned princess of a bygone world
objects.text:
when i had just returned from my exile, i did not even notice that i had, my homeland once warm and bright was now a cold wasteland so similar to my sterile moon. so i know that once leave the safety of your own home to venture to those dark place where comfort are rare to come by what you will need most is a friend, and while i cannot follow you when so many still need me here i shall give you knowledge to create a most faithful companion.

the Tantabus spell was my own creation and a mix of master level dream magic, enchantement, alchemy, conjuration magic and dark magic.

it create a Tantabus, an amortal sentient manifestation of a single feeling, one that grow stronger the more this feeling is felt. this creation is about as smart as a very intelligent dog but can control your subconscious realm of dream to create any scenario you want, invaluable for training or relaxation, they also ensure no dream or nightmare haunt you without your say so. if they grow strong enough they can exit the dream realm and become a solid being that can shapeshift and grow to ludicrous size as well as affect reality around them with the same ease as the dream realm. 

the main weakness and danger of the Tantabus that they are only as strong as the feeling you feel in the moments, if joy is the chosen emotion then feeling sad will weaken them yet, from personal experience i still recommend a positif feeling. Darker feelings like guilt can rapidly have the Tantabus run rampant as it instinctively try to vindicate the feeling that made it. guilt will have it try to cause harm to those around you to vindicate this guilt, joy on the other hood will have it try to make your life better to vindicate this joy.
 

as for your task from me, its to restore some of the planet surface -about a city worth of land- to being comfortably livable, i once threatened to make night eternal and i have seen what it would have done to my world now. bring to this world the warmth of the sun once more, please?

as for if you fail to do so in the time imparted to you, i ask that you return to try again once your journey is over, but this time do not leave until you have done so for the entire world.

objects.title: the gears 6: the hero of the harmonic war
objects.text:
i am twilight sparkle, i lead the delta one team and will be briefing you about your mission and the supply we've provided for you to see it through. 

the objective is to locate and free the peoples the locust have abducted and pushed into forced labor under abominable condition including lobotomy, while sadly most will not be possible to save without healing and sadly healing is hardly our specialty what we do have is the mean to both track and break into any holding the poor souls are held captive.

first is locating the targets, to do this you are immediately provided a repurposed and upgraded  Tac-Com Vehicle, originally it was a large COG tactical communications vehicle but the modification were focused on in depth detection platform using high precision divination based magic and revolutionary software it can not only map out about 3000 kilometer radius to the centimeter but can also pick up specific targets using trigger word or peoples by names, it can both record and play in real time both visual and audio targets. it also provide an interactive 3D map of the entire area in real time. the only tactical communications vehicle flaw is its size, it is the size of a house to be precise so its limited in term of stealth capacity and is unarmed and very lightly armored as well as slow. 

as to reaching and rescuing the targets we will provide you with the Mecha Shibboleth, tech wizard pinky and i built it to serve as a high risk engagement behemoth thrice as big as the original Shibboleth and more legs. coming with a sealed cockpit it can dig through solid stone with no trouble and is armed with an energy Vulcan Gatling Gun using and a single downsized hammer of dawn cannon in its "head". it is heavily armored, self repearing using magic, faster than most ground vehicle, well armed,  requiring no ammo and is -just like the Tac-Com- powered by its own mana fusion core that will power it safely for century to come. 

you cannot "fail" this mission as long as you save at least one person but we hope you do not go for the bare minimum and we will provide you with the blueprints for both vehicle as an additional reward if you can rescue at least 10,000 peoples and bring them to safety, we will also provide an additional blueprint and sample of our armory for each further 1000 peoples rescued merely refer yourself to the database provided (gear of war wiki weapon/vehicle section, nothing larger than an assault derrick, only one sample of each can be asked, ammo and fuel not provided beyond the first loadout, no locust/lambant lifeform can be taken period).

objects.title: pinkie pie: the mare with a mouth!
objects.text:
wheeeeeee! *sound of falling cookware, panicked chickens and barking dogs*

*a pink maned pony in sexy skintight spandex burst through the screen land in your lap* hey there stud, nice catch! name's pinkie pie -the mare with a mouth- *a  large comical reading 'THE mare with a mouth' title appear behind her as you view zoom on her masked face with what you guess are finger fun done with hooves and a bunch of snapshot of incredibly violent yet ridiculous scenes appear at the edge of your vision, as soon as it happen  its gone as she pock you in the eye*
don't pay attention to the crazy for too long or it'll pay attention to you buddy.  you mate are now my newbie bitch in your shitty mmorpg of a life because today i get to dish out the grindiest *she grind herself on your lap* ~kinky narrator~ most insufferable quest like some bucking NPC thankfully for you the reward is worth it if i say so myself!

job's simple paly pal buddy, i want you *she grab both your shoulders and start shaking you madly* to tell me where is starlight! WHERE ESTA STARLIGHTA?! *she let you go as she snort and laugh* na just kidding got that bitch a while ago, stuffed her stupid mouth with her own dumbass mane so far down she shat hairball for a month anyway!

*she jump off you and start passing around you.*

 now nonny you job should you accept it -you will the doodad i brought to pay your whorse ass is bonkers- is to become the new professor X. not the teacher porn one, you can do that too if you want no judgement honest but i mean instead become the new central figure of the goody four shoe mutants community and lead them to  accepting themselves and being accepted by the normies.

as for reward *she suddenly walk behind you and reappear on top of your head* i'll give you my number, now i get it it might sound like a shit gift, "why would i give a shit about that crazy mare numbers?!" am i right? well guess what pal i'm the best and if you succeed personals taxie in this shit caked omniverse. just ring me up tell me where you want to go -any world on this list even the one you snubbed -and poof here i am to ferry your nerdy furry ass there and back at your convenience, i'm gonna be your kickass fast travel bottom bitch stud, love the sound of that don't you, you dog. but mind there is a non zero chance i miiiiight have been on a hosed on sugar when you hook me up and i either drag you into a bender to hilarious if headache inducing omniverse wide joyride, or that i might have been bored and decide to take some time to see the sight, feel the vibes and even sample the dating pool of whatever world you go to and make a mess or ten while there. by non zero i mean fifty/fifty t'be honest.

of course this little prize is only "online" after you did the job cause paying in advance is for sucker, we gambling with our lives here, lets go balls to the wall! 

so what you say nonny feeling like going on a crazy party with this mouthy mare?

*the crazy mare in question ask through her too expressive full mask with a demented grin and provocative eyebrow nudge while forgetting the penalty quest*  what's that, penalty quest? na don't listen to the crazy nonny ain't no one got time for penalty here, if you biffed it I'll just come after you and shit on your parade until the end of time, or get bored whatever come first.

objects.title: skystar: the tidecaller
objects.text:
Hellooooooo! my name is skystar, i was tasked by my mom with delivering her quest and the reward for it to you. don't take her absence badly please i mean its awesome what you are going out to do but mom doesn't really do the whole going out and getting involved with the wider world stuff, but me? i love meeting new beings helping any who need help especially if i get to become friend with them!

still better get my task fulfilled first, mom went through the world of Runterra files and decided she really didn't like the whole blessed isle mess or rather the shadow isles nowadays. i mean mom really disapprove of anything that mess with life and i can't help but agree but i think "burning it to the ground and sinking the whole of it" is a bit too much? so... how about you just use the stuff mom had me bring to you to stop the "ruination" and make the shadow isles blessed once more? 

speaking of the stuff mom had me bring, its a bunch of empty primed magical pearl, mom used one to make our pearl of transformation so you can believe they are really useful. those pearls can hold any enchantement considered "cast and done" that is to say that they do not require constant channeling for free an infinite amount of time with only a few second between casting, if the pearl is broken every pieces can still cast the spell as well no matter the range between the pieces as well. the only limitation really is that the strength of the pearl enchantement is based on the original caster at the moment it was placed on the pearl and that the pearl chosen enchantement is final and cannot be changed ever again or strengthened.

the bag mom sent me with hold 9 pearl, if you really have to burn and sing the shadow isles I'll give you just those and call it a day but if you think you could purify the shadow isles I'm willing to give you a few of my personal ones as an additional reward, lets say 3 more pearls in advance and I'll replace any pearls you might have lost purifying the isles as well?

as for the penalty, how about once you have finished your travel you  start taking down all the evil of the seas in Runterra? i heard about a sentient eating catfish and pirates as well as deep sea monsters under control of dark power. if you fail to purify -or burn and sink i guess- the shadow isles  you better not have thalassophobia.

objects.title: applejack: the buckserker
objects.text:
you are quite the fool ain't ya? taking down evil all over the world while spreading hope and justice? what a selfish bastard you are to go out and impose your will over others. but, if that is your fire, your dream, then go ahead, lets see at the end.  Between all the cruelty the world is capable of and your dream fueled by your will, what will remain after they grind against each other until one is nothing but dust.

as a gift from one fool to another i give you by blade, the dragon slayer. it served me well all those years but now my story is over and i rest on a fairer world. still i know it still crave the blood of the evil beast that lurk in the night. go and satiate her even more, the dragon slayer as grown used to the taste of evil beings and can lethally wound them in spite of any defense or strange nature they could have. that is both my reward and your mission now, to slay the evil of all the world you visit with this blade.

never surrender, never give up, never stop until you can finally see all the evil of the world crawl back into the pit it crawled out from never to return in terror of you and yours, as long as you don't renounce, you will never fail.

(faust here, the dragon slayer is a unique weapon, this massive sword ignore all form of defense aside pure physicals toughness something anyone capable of wielding it would be very adept at breaking through anyway, but more importantly it completely disregard immunity to death of all kind as long as the tarets its strike is of an evil nature. even striking down a god's avatar would severely injure the true being behind it enough to cripple or even kill them. but sadly the weapon suffer from a single low points, it cannot be lifted without tremendous physicals strength, you would need the bombshell body type and boost: strength rank b at least to wield it decently.)

objects.title: sunset shimmer: the second impact
objects.text:
so, i had grandma come up to me and ask me to figure out a good way to help some foal trying to play hero. i decided what you need was a leçon in building other up rather than taking evil down.

my task for you is thus, rescue the Rei Ayanami clones gendo ikari keep in his basement, despite what her say the clones are not really soulless -everything alive capable of good has a soul- but their soul is so young that they cannot function without time out of stasis or a more mature soul being being used to "prime" them  in any cas they will need guidance from a "parents" of sort so take them with you to keep them safe, they are all very intelligent if mostly uneducated, if you can get them somewhere they can grow safely they will become the perfect group of background supporters. it might sound like some twisted form of slavery but those poor ones where made with an instinctive need to support others, just don't abuse them and keep their own wellbeing in mind please.

as for reward, i went to my mom, my aunt, my cousin and even my marefriend and together we developed and are willinto power an upgrade for faust spell using AT-field technology, it will allow you to apply way more world modifications with your arrival.

if you fail to rescue all the rey i want you to take all the eva pilots and all the rey you can and convince then help them all get proper therapy until they are happy, stable adult. sound easy right? here's a hint, all of them are traumatized and distrust adult, all good therapist are adult, good luck.

objects.title: rainbow dash: the seekers wunderkind
objects.text:
sup pal, so you're the brass bearing mad lad going out to save the day eh? i can respect someone with that big of a fluid pump so listen closely, my mate and i we worked out a way to store more item in all maker Faust's spell that mean you can take twice as many item, all you got to do for us is actually fix up this world Cybertron.

should be pretty clean and easy but if you somehow frag it up, once you are done with your travel i want you to help the Cybertronian to end the conflict, assure yourself the cybertronian are safely relocated unto a suitable world and that their populations start going again. in addition the ideology of Functionism must be thoroughly slagged to rust and remembered as the abomination it is.

objects.title: batmare: the dark knight
objects.text:
I am the night, i am the vengeance of those wronged by the evil crawling in the dark. And now by the will of Faust so are you, i could give you tool and training but that, many can provide. what i can do better than any pony else on the other hands is to lend my force of will to your endeavor, i will help Faust in her spell and allow you to strengthen your identity that much more.

my personal task for you is to reform at least 7 villain into hero. it is a simple matter of raw power and cunning to beat a villain down, it take strength of heart and empathy to help them rise above their personal failings or traumatic circumstances.

to fail would imply their are no more villain worth redeeming before you got at least seven to change their ways, that all the villain that remain are unrepentant willful monster roaming the world. if so your task now become clear, track down those monsters and neutralize them all.

objects.title: Trixie Lulamoon: the great and powerful
objects.text:
This is I the great and powerful TRIXIE! Magical mare of wonders and genius, vanquisher of monster and show mare of unmatched talent, a maker of miracle with spells and stunning stage presence!

And today TRIXIE's crowds of adoring fans have brought the attention of the all mother Faust to me for help and guidance in magic, truly even the goddess know TRIXIE is the greatest and most powerful mage in all creation!

now peon, TRIXIE was told YOU are to go and apply TRIXIE's teaching to save a world from fools and fledgling magical FILLY?! while TRIXIE think the goddess Faust should have sent HER to solve this issue in but a flick of my horn TRIXIE can understand when other fledgling legend should be given their chance to make their marks.

Still somepony of middling showmanship as you could definitely use TRIXIE boundless wisdom and vast experience as such TRIXIE give you my newest apprentice this trivial task, become a celebrated star that all young filly can learn and aspire to follow, fill them with hope and confidence in themselves and teach them how to turn their darkest impulse into fire and passion, a drive to shine and dazzle.

Teach them to be proud, strong and brave , just like little Trixie so desperately needed when she was but a small hesitant filly with naught but a dream and a little faith. 

*ahem* TRIXIE shall in exchange reward you with her beloved pointed hat and cape, while its usual flare is in TRIXIE opinion the best of design they can at will reshape to fit any other style and them you may prefer but this is nothing to brag about compared to their true power. the magical hat can store anything its opening face, no matter the size or nature be it a fireball or a whole building all can be sucked in and stored safely and with no time passing inside the hat. the hat is from any other angle just as frail and vulnerable as any other well made and cared for hat though it can self repair when fed magic it is slow and can take day for minor wear and tears, it also cannot bear any other enchantement as they would disturb the complexe spell work giving it its ability. should the hat be damaged too much the spell will collapse and release everything in it all over the place explosively before collapsing into itself and vanishing.

the cape is far simpler, it can deflect anything and prevent any form of perception from peering into what is hidden under it, even if it only partially cover it. just flick your cape at anything and as long as the timing is right -it will make a lovely whipping sound- then the item will be projected or deflected away at the top speed you could throw something or at the same speed it was sent at you, whichever is fastest. the cape is indestructible from the outside but  just as frail and vulnerable as any other well made and cared for cape from on the inside it too can self repair but just as slowly as the hat and it disperse into dust if damaged too much.

you may have those from the beginning of your trial for TRIXIE is kind and generous to those who seek greatness and success by performing dazzling act of heroism.

if you somehow fail to inspire young minds to dream of greatness then TRIXIE expect you to go back there and try again until you do, for TRIXIE does not believe in giving up. if you fail then get up and from the very bottom try again and again, if you lose everything then pick up your worn out tools and start again from the very beginning because for one to dazzle one must show the effortless perfection that come from a lifetime of failure yet speak not of the scars of the leçon learned with anything but pride.

objects.title: chrysalis: the last resort
objects.text:
i am chrysalis, i alone stand against oblivion when all other hero fail. fed by the last breath of love of the beings that fell in defiance of the encroaching evil of the world i face the insurmontable threats of my world as the last resort of harmony. i take and receive their love and with it challenge the darkness that would've won. i carry their sacrifice on my withers and i know, that despite the pains, the loneliness and the guilt i cannot ever fail them as long as i draw breath.

in the world of worm the hero are nothing but façade and deception, they put on a good show but acts speak louder than words and they have taken to piling the burden of sacrifies onto others while shielding themselves of guilt and responsibilities using the "greater good".

breaking the illusion will not be enough, you must prove them wrong. once there rise as an independent hero and earn the respect and trust of the peoples. afterward call out the pretenders of Cauldron on their deception and crimes, demand their surrender, when they inevitably try to brand you a villain the mass must rise against them and rebuke them. 


has a reward, i shall in advance give you my armor, a living artefact of my own making that can take any Shape and heal itself and with the toughness of diamond and the ability to adapt to any damage it endure to better negate it later on. it will allow you to absorb and store pain both physicals and mental in others around you -allies or enemy alike- and use it as fuel for any 
 magic you wield.

if you fail i expect you to prove the mass of you heroism by striking down on your own: all three original endbringers, the slaughterhouse 9 and both the machine army and nilbog or reduce parahuman crimes by 75 percent worldwide.

objects.title: Fluffle puff: the master of pillows
objects.text:
okay so fluffle puff had a mission for you but she has a bit of a....lisp you could say and so i'll translate it.

in her world markers very similar to the ones seen in the world of "dead space" exist but are used as instrument of communication by eldritch beings (wich fluffle puff is part of) as well as beacon for them to meet up and catch up or cast their unique powers through, she once used one to summon her sister to meet her marefriend. 

what she want is for you to get your hooves on one of those markers and hit it with a special...pillow she made, this should "factory reset" it and allow you to use it just like she and her sister do, allowing:

-instant communication. 
-instant teleportation.
-projection of power to any or all "factory reset" markers.
-the creation of more markers.

she will of course let you keep the "pillow of hard reset" for others uses, said pillow can "hard reset" anything making items work perfectly (within the limit of what they could do in the state the items where in when hit.) or beings perfectly rested and in good spirit (within the limit of what they could be when hit.)  this also happen to remove any mind control and emotional distress as well.

objects.title: luna: the ascending moon
objects.text:
A pleasure to meet thee, champion. I am the witch luna. I stole Death long ago, and trotted down the dark path. I one day upended the whole of it, and rid the world of all that came before. I'd heard tell of a Tarnished about to travel to wretched realms and upon looking into the matter, the talk, I surmise, is of thee. 
 
when i discovered the true expense of what lies beyond our "realm in between" i was temporarily filled with hopelessness yet we have found Faust a most pleasant company and so i offered to assist her endeavor and thee by happenstance.

i have discarded the god slaying black knives i once made long ago and so cannot provide you it but i still possess profane knowledge and tools that would aid thee.

I shall grant thee the spirit calling bells and knowledge of creating ashen remain from any slain foes or recently diseased others. this bell can be used in conjunction of the "elden ring" local spirit calling bell should thee somehow acquire it, doubling the number of summon thee can have at a time. in addition i shall give thee the "nightmare moon great sword", while similar to my consort "dark moon great sword" it differ in its very nature and is in truth a superior creation. instead of a biting cold it apply a drowsing effect capable of putting into a deep slumber even the most powerful being should you strike them 12 time, mind weaker beings will fall long before but a following strike may wake them so to strike mindlessly may prove punishing. 

both boon shall be given in advance but come with a daunting if straightforward quest,  to cure the scarlet rot and design for it a vaccine. provide the cure to me and i will be satisfied in whole.

to "fail" as Faust established is impossible truly, as it is more a matter of doing or being undone as any failed attempt will see thee infected in most cases. and so should thee accept thee would merely be unable to leave this world until the scarlet cure and vaccine is found or thee would be smitten by the abominable disease. i hope thee will have made ample use of the time and opportunity granted by the previous realms visited to gather knowledge  and skill of the healing arts.

In truth i doubt we shall again meet. But all the same, I anticipate good work from thee.

objects.title: derpy hooves: the muffin slayer
objects.text:
hi! i'm Derpy, Derpy hooves and some new princess came by and asked me to give you some home work? now i'm not really all that good about teaching but i think i can think of something... oh i know! 

since you can how about you go to the world that look like mine and make muffin for everyone, i don't know about you but my problem are always easier to face with a muffin on hooves! in fact i have something that should help, here you go this is a muffin button, just press it and a muffin appear. 

second best muffin i ever had too, only beaten by my adorable dinky's mother day special's muffin. i always feel more clear headed when i eat those magic muffin too and everyone i gave muffin to in my own town stopped being all hangry, though i bet this scary world of yours are not so easily accept to eat your muffin they seem pretty mad?

the princess said i should give you more homework if you get the first one wrong but that's just silly, instead just keep trying and make friend with everypony, if you don't know what went wrong then just keep trying until you get it right. you just have to restart the dream anyway, until everyone is safe and happy and all that went wrong is fixed.  

(baffled Faust here, the muffin from the muffin button can somehow restore sanity to the insane no matter the origin of said insanity and prevent madness stemming from insight, turning eldritch knowledge into pure erudition and wisdom. no idea how that works to be  honest let alone where she got it. She is also being literal here you need to go and try to save every being in this world unless they are purposefully evil, you must literally somehow fix every single beings in this world you meet, every beast, every peasant, every monstrous boss (you do not have to save them from the environment, themselves or others but cannot purposefully cause said event and decision) by feeding them magic muffin, don't get me wrong its possible thanks to said muffin but trust me you will need healing and resurrections powers as well as the "perfect run" world modification to actually do it. I did not expect her to give you the most tedious quest on this list. to be honest though a pacifist, fix it "playthrough" fit what we are trying to do here.)

objects.title: celestia: the unwavering sun
objects.text:
O chosen Undead. I am Celestia. Daughter of the godess Faust; and Queen of Sunlight. Since the day my mother told me of this grand quest, I have await'd thee. I bequeath the "wish vessel" to thee. And beseech thee. strike down Lord Gwyn for his arrogance and cruelty are the hallmark of the tyrant, and relighteth the Fire of their world. Thou shall endeth this eternal twilight, and avert further sacrifices.

the "wishvessel", t'is an artefact of great power though 't may look as a frail shining flower t'is capable of granting any wish in regard to age for item or being. it solely work in direct presence of the target and only grant five wish before it wither and die. near the fire and wish it be in its prime and everlasting and the dark age will be reverted.  

still it would be poor reward a tool that is a fifth consumed to fulfil the quest it is awarded for, very well let it not be said that the sun is not generous. i shall give thee as well my blessed weapon, a banner whose shaft is made of unbreakable wood and bearing a partisan blade whose edge burn hot as the sun's surface. the flag who presence shine like sunlight upon thou enemy, a light so holy it shall turn to dust all undead that face it and blind those who would harm thee even in the darkest of realm. under true sunlight it will heal thou wounds fast 'nough to see flesh knit itself and bone snap back.

Now thou shalt go forth, chosen champion. May thou be one with the sunlight for evermore.

objects.title: celestia Solaris: sol Invictus
objects.text:
greeting mortal, i am the divine empress celestia solaris and have a most holy mission for you.

should you accept and fulfill this goddess given task i shall reward you afterward with the secret of "true immortality" to use and share, death would never again blight you and yours. 

now death merely become a fleeting inconvenience as you reform instantly and completely unharmed from all harm be it physical, magical or spiritual. 

to succeed i command you to release the god emperor of mankind from his cursed existence and end his half-life. you see, my world is the noble bright version of his and he is as such my homologue, i know that this is not what he would have wanted, he must be released and allowed to move on, for mercy sake if nothing else. 

Sadly the eon of suffering and regrets caused him to decent into madness and should he heal, what will stand back from this throne will not be the man he once was but a twisted, corrupted, maddened husk and cannot be allowed.

should you somehow fail and the emperor rise again as his corrupted self, your penalty goal will be to kill the emperor and convince humanity to crown and worship you, then to bring all the races of this world into complete unity and that include the orks and necron and have them crown and worship you.

rows.title: sponsor list
rows.titleText:
while i was looking into other universes some being from my universes helped me look through them in depth and have decided after seeing many tragic or upsetting things to lend their hooves and other appendages to the cause in the form of sponsorships. 

to put it simply they have specific goals for you to accomplish into certain worlds and i exchange for going out of your way to fulfill them will give you their helps either before or after and sometime both. this help can be in the form of more points or specific item or unique blessings they can grants. 

if you somehow fail the goal set they will not reclaim what was promised or given but instead will have you face a penalty goal to fulfill in the same world once your journey is over. those are very hard, time consuming and grueling but cannot be failed.

objects.title: Transformative Impact.
objects.text:
This modifiers turn each and every native being in the world you go to into the races on the list that fit themselves the most. This change happen when you arrive and remain when you leave. 

They gain both the 2 perks and the 1 drawbacks but also gain traits and boost based on how "strong" they were. They do not lose any ability related to their previous races but in case of conflict the new race is prioritized, they also all get the muscle memory to use their new body as well as their old ones. 

Any wounds or genetic disease of any kind is healed but any curses or parasitic infections are merely rewound to their beginning stage.

That is for everyone even potential threats, this does not affect godly beings in any way but they cannot reverse the effects on non godly beings either. 

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: You got the touch!
objects.text:
This modifiers allow you to embody the "transformative Impact." world modifiers and instead of turning each and every native being in the world into the races on the list that fit themselves the most as you arrive, instead this change happen when you touch them for the first time with the intent to turn them. 

Past that this world modifiers work just the same as "transformative impact." 

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Anthro scaling.
objects.text:
This modifier allow you to choose the "degree" of transformation of "transformative Impact." it can affect the world in two way depending on your preference. The first is you pick this choice a number of time between 1 and 5 and the native are stuck at this level of anthropomorphic form (picture for reference.)

The second option is that if you pick this choice more than once they have access to all form from 1 to whatever number you picked, pick this choice once and they will only have access to form 1, but if you pick this choice 3 time they will have access to form 1, 2 and 3 etc.

Everyone start at the most anthropomorphic form by default.

Form 5 and 4 are weakened when it come to magic and lose access to traits and perks but also their drawback. Form 3 to 1 get the full benefits as normal.

All form can use the mastery and boosts blessings as normal. compendium on the other hand are unusable in form 5 and halved at 4.

Safeguard work in all form.

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Benevolent gaslighting.
objects.text:
Turn out a slight nudge toward harmonization of body and mind can make acclimatation a wee bit quicker, with this modifiers the native will tend to notice and vocalize the positives of their new forms way more than the negative and resonate each others growing appreciation for the changes.

Even better they all tend to actually forget about the change altogether and just take it in stride, no sudden flailing of new limbs or waking up disoriented or even weird itch. Even the new senses and instinct of their new form are less jarring after only a few days. 

The effect of "benevolent gaslighting." also work on any other modifiers that affect the native physically and mentally making all of said modifiers easier to adapt to and accept for the native.

objects.title: Fitting right in.
objects.text:
Now this is very useful if you don't take "transformative Impact.", it basically make your own unique appearance and nature fit right in to the subconscious of the native, unless you point out how out of place you are or are doing something really weird or standing somewhere no one should be they won't notice whatever fantastical races you might be

That mean you still won't be able to stroll into a military base or into the white house or even the scene of a concert but walking down the street will not have anyone even doing a double take or stare at you, you'd be just another face in the crowd.

This effect stop when you point out the oddity of your being to anyone but the real kicker is that it only stop for those peoples and no one else, even if said peoples try to tell the truth, other will just not notice anything unusual until you yourself point it out.

(Think how no one mention Scobey doo -a dog part of a supernatural myth buster group- can talk.)

objects.title: Happy meal.
objects.text:
You are what you eat and guess what? with this modifier food is very good, especially if its shared with other! 

Indeed with this modifiers food health benefit is now cranked up to 11 even eating nothing but sugar will only make you healthier if jittery, you could eat three cake -full on layered one too- a day and you would never get sick.

Even better all food taste great now and everyone can eat everything that can be described as "food" even grass and hay. It might not be enough for races that need more "abstract" sustenance but it will actually taste good to them and not make them sick ever either. 

This effect scale up when shared with others, depending on how happy the cook is and how much love -figure of speech for the changeling out there-  is poured into the meal the food will taste even better and become healthier.

At the end of the scale a full course meal with from a very happy cooks and lot of love for the peoples they are feeding it can even heal diseases and regrow limbs or help one escape depression or recuperate from trauma in a single lovely made meal.

objects.title: Local after life primer.
objects.text:
This world modifier will give you and everyone else all the factual knowledge of how this world after life work and any way you can interact with it. 

It also make it that if no after life existed before it now does, that's right a whole new after life ready to manage the most likely gargantuan backlog of souls that have died and waited in stasis since this world formed.

This also ensure you can use any magic interacting with the dead. Be it communion with the dead or resurrections. Neither are inherently safe if an afterlife already existed and  is managed by a local deity or pantheon. 

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Preacher of the faith.
objects.text:
This world modifier partially change the effects local life primer, if there are local afterlives and divinities peoples will only you will know all about it as for others, they will know of them when you tell them an activation phrase of your choice.

This cause them to suddenly know what they would have learned through local after life primer, they do not remember the activation phrase but peoples who hear  the activation phrase as second time will and can then use it as well to spread the truth of the local world faiths.

objects.title: Safe faith xenotopia.
objects.text:
Remember what i said about soul related magic being inherently unsafe? forget it with this modifier i will crack open the after life and make it "open source", it mean no one can actually command the souls there instead the souls can decide to move anywhere they want in the after life and answer any call they want to. (they still cannot leave the after life without being resurrected.)  

Even the hells or heavens are now open to all, as long as they respect whatever rule a faith has they are free to go in or leave if they renounce the related god or pantheon at any points with no penalty. 

Even better anyone can join and leave religion and be safe and even cleansed from repercussion (curses and holy judgement.) mind the local deities might add more rules to their realms to limit who can go in or is kicked out but they won't be able create or enforce rules to force or keep anyone in, they also cannot make anything more precise than blanket ruling, so no "fuck that guy in particular" rules.

objects.title: The one true god.
objects.text:
I mean at this point i might as well create a backdoor to my own after life, "The Heaven" -it got the capital H cause its the best-. 

That mean anyone that pray to me and follow my edicts will go to my afterlife, this also mean that any living faithful can receive blessings and support from me directly. 

Any souls in my afterlife will be easier for you to reach and you can talk to them with a simple prayer at any time. As for what The Heaven is, think Minecraft in créatif. immortal, invulnerable, capable of doing and having anything at will with real life graphics and everyone has its own world but can also merge and split them freely and their are billion of my children making communal worlds the size of planets.

My edicts are also pretty easy to follow:

-Remember, Work hard for what you believe in.
-Remember that life mean nothing without others to share it with.
-Remember, when all else fails, sing a song.
-Remember that It is okay to ask for help.
-Remember that your success isn't worth endangering yourself and others.
-Remember that Understanding rule and Prejudice drool.
-Remember that ability alone doesn't define worth.
-Remember to speak up when another is doing wrong.
-Remember that who you are is not the same as what you are.
-Remember that you can earn your redemption.
-Remember that even when fighting for a good cause, you are responsible for the consequences of your actions.

and of course the six core tennets:

-to be kind.
-to be loyal.
-to be honest.
-to be mirthful.
-to be generous.
-that Magic make it all complete.

objects.title: Healthy nonsense.
objects.text:
Ever felt a strange sense of foreboding? or seen in fiction thing going to well and just knew the other horseshoe was about to fall? 

Well this world modifier make it so that two out of three time anything bad that should have happened instead fail to pan out out of sheer luck before it should and is replaced by harmless nonsense, it will be nerve-wracking, stressful, cause a decent amount of panic and most definitely necessitate cleanup afterward -most likely involving tree sap-  but at the end of the day and the days after, you and all implicated will get a good laugh out of it and a damn good story to tell to others.

I call it the "peripecias break" or "filler" or even the "rest arc".

objects.title: Toon physics.
objects.text:
This modifier make the world a li'l' bit more silly, a li'l' bit more loony, a li'l' bit more toony. 

This modifier allow anyone to replace the rigid laws of reality with those dictated by humor, creativity, and absurdity. While it does require the result to be funny and is inherently limited in time as reality rapidly reapply itself, it still allows them to defy logic, manipulate their surroundings in impossible ways, and reshape the very fabric of their local area to suit their needs.

Even while freed from the constraints of natural laws and even while anyone can now bend, ignore, or rewrite physics, biology, and time itself, producing outcomes that are as hilarious as they are unpredictable it can only affect the immediate surrounding or themselves personally and can only be done through impulse and not planned out.

Those limitation mean that this will almost only work on the creative and spontaneously funny or silly that don't take anything too seriously.

As a side effect domestic accident are rendered almost non existant, indeed no one does anything intending to be hurt so they will subconsciously just get out of it looking silly but physically fine. Lots of bird flying around head during car crash and big bump on construction site etc.

It does not work at all when actual harm is intended though.

objects.title: Comedic landing.
objects.text:
This one take toon physics and crank it up to eleven, now the effects can be stretched to an entire event if peoples work together. A group making a skit of a plane crash will land miraculously intact, a bank robbery end in flashmob where the would be robbers turn their life around or a nuclear catastrophe into a scientific breakthrough after a burlesque comedy act.

Even better now even peoples that are too serious can use the "toon force" by being "the straight man." adding nuance to the whole of it.

It also allow some planning to be used, if a "comedy classic" is successfully initiated one can just follow the "routine" and the "toon force" will apply as normal.

objects.title: Physiological convenience.
objects.text:
Now the limitation of body shape mean nothing, everyone can bend their  limbs a 180° both way or stand perfectly stable on two legs as a quadruped. Well at least as long as they need to, what it mean is as long as its for some minor convenience the body limitation are more general guideline than hard limit, holding a beer with a hoof? easy, opening a can with a hoof? easy as well,  writing fast on a small keyboard with hooves? somehow possible. 

You get it if you took transformative impact most hooved species will thank you for this as well, it also allow winged species to sit on chair with back support or sleep on their own back without discomfort, also allow hairy species or scaled species to not have to shed or molt unless they want. 

In short this is a quality of life modifier that make life a little more convenient in a lot of minor way, also remove the "need" to go to the bathroom for everyone so that's a net gain in time if nothing else, for medical reason it is still possible if desired and needed.

objects.title: Panic!
objects.text:
Panic is a cause of much strife in almost all world, my little pony are very prone to panic induced stamped almost daily. Because of that i made this little modifier, now when someone panic they will no longer take rash action instead they will freeze up and enter a self preservation mod where they will seek the nearest free safe spot and hunker down for guidance or just stay still until someone give them instruction. 

In addition they will instinctively start doing breathing exercise to try calm themselves down and even walk toward the nearest emergency exit. Even better violence as a response to panic both one's own or another's will almost never be used and instinctively feel distasteful.  

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Games Rules.
objects.text:
No one can cheat or lie under oath anymore, or rather no one can purposefully break any rule they have agree to follow without first saying they are no longer following this rule out loud. This mean that any game played canot be cheated, casino cannot scam peoples without first saying they are scamming peoples.

Even better justice is no longer a mess and anyone can prove they are innocent with but an oath and a few words while those guilty are pretty much screwed.  Also politics, health care and business has just become a lot more interesting.

objects.title: Death not included.
objects.text:
This modifier make it considerably harder for any death to happen, yes even murder attempt and yes even accident and disease. Death as a whole is a lot harder to happen for everyone but it scale especially well the younger one is as such newborn and toddler are basically immortal till they are 3. 

Also healing magic is more powerful and anyone that "died" recently are way easier to resurrect by a third party. Non lethal form of containment of threats are made way more relevant and effective for both hero and villain.

Synergies very well with "evil unexpected patience."

objects.title: Hero never dies.
objects.text:
Upgrade "death not included." so that heroically inclined individual does not have to move on after dying instead they can become like intangible and invisible ghost that can move around and observe the world, if someone try to resurrect them they will return with all their memories of their time as a ghost. 

In addition, while in ghostly form they can "possess" another party, they do not take control of the host instead said host and the ghost can talk to each other and the host gain the powers and ability of the ghost while they are "merged". The host can forcefully expel the ghost at any time and the ghost can leave just as easily.

objects.title: Evil unexpected patience.
objects.text:
Guess what, evil peoples or villains are now much more patient. Might not seem like a good thing but i mean that villains are now much more likely to just not immediately go for lethal force and instead try to manipulate or coerce others, even spare someone defying them a couple of time before going for a more definitive answer to the problem. Mind violence is still used but lethal action are much less likely to be taken. 

This effect grow stronger the more confident and at ease a villain is and weaker the more angry and desperate. A chill villain in a good mood can spare someone up to 20 time while a ruthless, pissed of villain will give one chance to a captive to submit and nothing more.

If a Villain notice this effect it will still affect them but this can drive the villain into being more "creative" out of frustration.

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Argumental hazard.
objects.text:
Ever argued with someone stupid yet certain of themselves? Someone that said absolute garbage as straight fact with no reliable sources? someone that actively reduce the entire country average IQ by half just being alive in whatever country they live in? or a no good two bit Ne'er-do-well spouting hateful speech as ""sensible" ideologies or promoting violent rash action or spiting hate for revenge and retribution against the world for a slight they suffered with no regard for innocent caught in the crossfire? 

Well with this modifier life just got a lot better for you because now if someone make a statement and someone come up with factual proof said statement was false that first someone will now fail to speak -or any other form of communication- on said subject again unless they audibly and publicly acknowledge their error -or lie- in fair spirit first.

In short debates now either progress or stop on some actual truth.
 
This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Moral beatdown.
objects.text:
This modifiers allow defeat on the field of battle to break through even the most stubborn ego and deepest trauma to make the defeated party see reason. 

When two ideologies clash in physical combat -in person not through proxy- once a party is defeated three time even if they survive or escape each time they will suffer from the "Defeat Means Respect" debuff, it will make them take the other party and their arguments seriously and make them reflect on their goals and way of life under a different light. 

it does not mean they will renounce said goals but they might be more receptive to reformation or recruitment attempt. 

if they lose three more time they will now gain the "Defeat Means Friendship" debuff and will renounce evil to instead become an anti-hero or Anti-Villain
depending of the alignment of the winning party until you convince them to become full time hero or villain instead.

Mind that any victory against the winning party will reset the 3 defeat counter. this effect work both way so while it allow you to reform pretty much any villain or misguided natives its at the risk of you falling to evil as well.

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: The perfect run
objects.text:
You can with a single flick of your will reset the timeline of the world you are in to the moment of your arrival.

You yourself return to how you (all training and progress made in compendium lost) where on arrival and at the location of your arrival but conserve all your memories of what happened.

You cannot return to a point in time between when you activate this power and when you arrived using other powers but no force can prevent you from resetting the timeline either.

Using this power and a lot of patience its technically possible to realize a "perfect run", to arrive in a world and to save EVERYONE, to befriend everyone and to change everything for the better, and that is for every world you might have picked.

So tell me, do you fell like you have what it take to make " the perfect run" ?

objects.title: The big no-no.
objects.text:
Rape, one of the most horrible act ever, a perversion of love that deserve no forgiveness, as such this modifier make it impossible.

No one can even think or fathom the very idea of raping another, period. Any who did commit rape before this effect will literally now be unable to enjoy sex ever again or have children. 

Also from now on everyone who just want to fool around and peoples who want serious relationship will somehow always gravitate toward others looking for the same, and toward a compatible partners as well. 

It also make any consensual relationship much more enjoyable for both -or more, i don't judge- parties as well as prevent unwanted pregnancy for everyone, both partners need to want it truly for it to happen.

this modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Orientation purge.
objects.text:
Congrats, every one is bisexuel or rather pansexual? xenophile? who cares every one is attracted to everyone and what is in between anyone's legs become inconsequential. 

Now, peoples are still entitled to their preference about "social" gender of "femininity" and "manliness" and even in "build", "broad  shouldered with tree trunk arms" or "wide hips with dumbstruck ass and legs for days" have their fan for a reason. 

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Addiction be gone.
objects.text:
As written on the tin this modifiers remove addiction from the world, it remove both the physical effect of withdrawal for drugs or processed food and everything in-between. 

This does not remove the effect of drugs but will prevent overdose, if someone take too much they will literally vomit any excess, messily. 

The psychological addiction can still somewhat form but are both harder to pick up and easier to shake down, For the harder drugs it might take a while but it is straight up gone for the lighter stuff, so beer night is pretty safe now. 

Gambling addiction is gone, so is dopamine  and adrenaline addiction. 

Also while the physical consequence of hard drug use are not removed they are lightened enough to be fully reversible with decent health care.

objects.title: Friendship emergency pass.
objects.text:
With this modifiers the native will be more understanding of any minor or "harmless" major break of both the law and common sense if its in the name of friendship.

As long as its mostly material damage and general chaos rather than malicious and violence, witness and legal authority will let it slide as long as you fix your mess afterward. 

This also make punishment's lighter on illegal but morally justified action taken in the interest of the wellbeing of others or in defense of one's right. 

Kicking squatter out of your home will not be punished, knocking out a robber in the night will not result in you being sued and kicking the teeth in of a kidnapper will not see you accused of assault ever. 

Of course this will not go nearly so swell if you go too far or does not fix the mess you made after or worst, do it for personal benefit with no morally driven reason. 

This modifier benefit from "benevolent gaslighting."

objects.title: Let it rain 10/10.
objects.text:
Every one is now beautiful, everyone are now like, a 10/10 in the look department fat is now sexy chubby and starving thin is now petite cuteness, this remove any unflattering physical traits like asymmetrical features or make ambiguous attributes like freckles or wisdom teeth into assets with picture perfect placement.

Even better this also reflect on the general health and hygiene of peoples as this beauty is simply easier to maintain  in even the most strenuous situation. 

It make it harder for ugly scars to happen and reduce risk of infection or disease  that would diminish one's beauty. It also make the native generally healthier with dirt and grime having a harder time sticking to them.

Combine very well with "transformative impact" as it will make the change more pleasant as everyone will be noticeably more "attractive" in a very primal way,  symmetrical features, wider pupils, larger hips, more defined muscle or softer hair in shirt any traits that are instinctively perceived as a sign of good genes and health and seeked-out in potential mate, hence "attractive" in a primal way.

rows.title: carry on option
rows.titleText:
When going from world to world you will have to leave anyone and anything aside yourself (only your "main" body in case of hivemind.) and the item picked here (modification done to it are included but stocked goods and passengers are not.)  

If you really want to take allies or more item between each world, we can make more room in the spell for them using some points.

rows.title: Attributes visualisation.
rows.titleText:
This section show you how potent your new incarnation with be in the five general attributes section. They give a representation of how powerful you are compared to the main "héros" of other world known across the omniverse.

Those estimation are generally conservative, a sort of "bare minimum" that dosent take into account your creativity or the synergy between perks traits and blessings.

Along the road you might have seen perks, traits and blessings that shared commonality in their purposes and benefits, know that while any similar effects are all either additive or work in conjunction of each others, the boosts all ;multiply the total at the end.

Each attribute go up and down depending on the choice you made and go from 1 to 10, anything past 10 is so abstract it no longer make sense to try to quantify it. 

(Remember: boosts are applied last at the end of this section.)

defaultRowText: This is a row, and inside of it, you can place choices. On both rows and choices Requirements can be placed, which will block a row from being viewed, or make the player unable to select a choice, depending on either Point-types or the Ids of other choices. Point-types can be made in Features then Manage Points. Hovering over buttons will explain what they do. The Design of the project can be changed in 'Modify Design' at the side navigation bar, and private styling for each row can be turned on in the rows Settings. Default text like this can be turned off in Features -> Manage Defaults.
defaultChoiceText: This is a Choice, and inside of it, you can place images and text. Scores can be added to it, and have Point-types attached. Addons can be added underneath the image and text. In the Functions at the bottom of the choice, there is an array of different things that can be done. Default text like this can be turned off in Features then Manage Defaults.
